listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Eau De Toilette 200ml & 30ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CBVNGXL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The masculine fragrance is a woody aromatic fougere, full of modern freshness. Top notes of lavender and mandarin spray are softened by the fruity notes of honeydew melon, followed by heart notes of pink pepper and geranium mixed with pineapple leaf. Finally the fragrance unveils a lasting print of patchouli, suede and ambery woods.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Man Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XH9P750]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Davidoff Cool Water is an easy-to-wear range of men’s fragrances. When you are looking for a men’s fragrance you can wear any time of the day or night, this is an excellent fragrance for men to take a closer look at. In the range, there are many excellent candidates for the modern man. What does Cool Water perfume smell like? If you are looking for a soothing scent, this is the one for you. It offers many classic notes including jasmine, oakmoss, lavender and musk. The range of notes is held together by a velvety softness. Perfume Price offers Aftershave Cool water as eau de parfum in a 125ml format. As the bottle is not oversized, it easily slips into your gym kit or weekend bag. Order it as a personal purchase or buy it today as a gift for a special person in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Fleur Musc Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TNP4RYM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The beloved ‘for her’ signature musc heart is given a sparkling twist in the Narciso Rodriguez Fleur Musc for Her Eau de Parfum. Housed in a vibrant pink bottle, the spirited fragrance plays on notes of Roses, Spices and Amber Wood to create an alluring floral EDP. The vibrant scent conveys a passionate and bold femininity, a confident bouquet of pink florals, accentuated by Pink Peppercorns. A blend of Patchouli and soft Amber gives the scent a deeper, woody undertone that adds an irresistible warmth. Self-assured and assertive, Fleur Musc for Her embodies modern femininity. Notes: Rose, Pink Peppercorn, Patchouli, Amber Wood, Spices. Set Includes: 100ml EDP Spray + 75ml Body lotion.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 Heroes Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=X4UKGK6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Perfume Carolina Herrera offers an exciting collection of fragrances. This is a brand that does not hold back and never fails to innovate. Just like its range of clothing and accessories, the fragrances offered are truly world-class. A popular offering from the brand is 212 Perfume. If you have not added it to your collection, now is the perfect opportunity to do so. What does this exciting Caroline Herrera perfume smell like? This fragrance offers a little bit of everything. It is fresh but also has darker slightly more sensual depths thanks to wood and spice. You can also pick up on ginger and pears. Geraniums and musk also make appearances. You can order this eau de toilette from us in a 150ml format. The size makes a generous gift. If you are a fan of CH, there is absolutely no reason why you can’t order the fragrance as a personal purchase. A great fragrance that wears well on any occasion and at any time during the day or night.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 Heroes Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YGRFUCW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Perfume Carolina Herrera never lets you down. When you are looking to expand your fragrance collection this is the most recent range from CH. This fragrance is an excellent choice for daytime wear. However, it has to be said that it works just as well in the evening. If you are going out for dinner, you should consider putting it on. Is 212 perfume a masculine scent? It has to be said that this is a Caroline Herrera perfume with a broad range of nuances. Although it is fresh, it offers hidden depth. Ginger adds a nice touch of spice. You can rely on geranium and wood for interest. Musk and spice add endurance and longevity. Perfume Price is offering this eau de toilette in a 90ml format. This is the perfect size for slipping into your gym kit or male bag. Buy it today for yourself. The fragrance also makes a much-appreciated gift. As it is a rather recent addition to the CH range of men’s fragrances, it is a cologne that not every other man is going to be wearing.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Rose Tangerine Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JY07ASN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloe Perfume is a beautiful, fun and vibrant women’s fragrance. It is the kind of fragrance that you can wear for almost any occasion. It is just as much home on the school run as it is when you are going out with the girls. What does By Chloe smell like? When you are looking for a fragrance that is truly feminine, this is an excellent choice. It offers a rich floral bouquet that comes from white and yellow flowers. Let the scent linger and you discover hidden depths including wood and touches of musk. A powdery freshness from citrus holds the fragrance together. It is available from Perfume Price in a 75ml eau de toilette format. A great perfume to pack when you are thinking about escaping on holiday or taking off for the weekend. Thanks to its broad range of nuances, it is perfect for the modern chic woman. Order it for yourself or buy it for someone in need of a treat.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum 110ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NDR1IIH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The new black KENZO HOMME Eau de Parfum bottle with bluish hues is an ode to poetry. Its shape echoes the vertical strength and flexibility of the bamboo shoot. Its beveled cap conjures up the cut of a katana, the samurai sword. Because KENZO PARFUMS is committed to a more beautiful world, the KENZO HOMME Eau de Toilette bottle contains 15% recycled glass and reduces its weight by 23% to hold 10 ml of additional fragrance*. The design of its cap has been conceived to save 34% of plastic compared to its initial design. The bottle is surrounded by a cardboard box made of untreated kraft paper and a pack made of paper from well-managed FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) certified forests and printed with bio-based inks. Break free with KENZO HOMME Eau de Parfum and reconnect with nature. Enjoy the scent of freedom with KENZO HOMME Eau de Parfum and reconnect with nature. #ReconnectWithNature. Olfactory Classification: Woody Marine Top Notes: Marine Accord Heart Notes: Leather Base Notes: Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Eau de Toilette 100ml + 10ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B67HO4Q]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Boss Bottled fragrance features light, fruity top notes with a strong floral heart with geranium, spice, and olive scents. The base is woody, with notes of sandalwood and cedar, combined with vetiver to give this fragrance a masculine but modern quality. The clean lines of this bottle give it the classic elegance of a whisky bottle, reinforcing the fragrance's themes. This gift set contains: Boss Bottled 100ml Eau de Toilette Spray Boss Bottled 10ml Eau de Toilette Travel Spray

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Aqua Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EPFJM68]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The fragrance of a man who embraces life head on with this Woody Marine Eau de Toilette. To open, the stimulating spice and sweetness of cardamom rides a sparkling wave of grapefruit, before drying down to a fresh heart of icy geranium and clary sage, both of which mingle with the marine accord which sits at the heart of Jimmy Choo Man Aqua. At the base, patchouli and amber is afforded a soft, seafaring-inspired aspect with the addition of salted moss. Jimmy Choo Man Aqua is like an olfactive ode to the ocean, the bottle in flask shape is instantly recognisable with a lacquering reminding of the colour of the sea. In further alignment with the broader Jimmy Choo Man fragrance family, the bottle also comes complete with an embossed crocodile-effect cap in a complimentary shade of cornflower blue.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Pride Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AJMMN6D]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Launched in 2022, Jean Paul Classique Pride is a celebration of freedom. This perfume has no boundaries, wear this perfume and enhance what it truly means to be unapologetically yourself. For Jean Paul Gaultier, beauty is synonymous with pride! Just like his anti-conformist creations and the multiple identities he chooses to put on the catwalk, Jean Paul Gaultier has always been a tireless ambassador for a more inclusive world and fashion. Two bottles, one message: “Freedom, Equality, Sexuality.” Proudly sporting a freedom-striped sailor top, the limited edition Classique & Le Male 2022 supports Jean Paul Gaultier’s values. Two different torsos for the same fragrance because clothes should never define who we are according to Jean Paul Gaultier.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Pride Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TL1GBL1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This bold fragrance stands out from the crowd. Evan when compared to other Le Male fragrances, there is just something intangibly special about this fragrance. Le Male Pride really does live up to its name. This is a fragrance that is happy to be out there and seen, it wants people to take notice and celebrate what makes it unique. Freedom, Equality, Sexuality! Do you know who’s behind this rallying cry? Jean Paul Gaultier of course and since 1982. With this new limited PRIDE edition, l’enfant terrible de la mode declares the party open. United in one cause, iconic Classique & Le Male march at the head of the parade in their chromed bottles adorned with the stripes of love. Long live the beauty that comes from being uniquely you! Let’s celebrate our differences! Accompanied by his partner, here comes Le Male PRIDE in his sailor top wearing the same inclusive fragrance — a unisex Eau de Toilette created for everyone! Feel the freshness on your skin, the sensuality in the air and the lightness in your heart. A uniting rainbow cocktail of citrus, neroli and musky blond woods.

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IBPURM8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Why resist the irresistible lightness of this paradise of the senses? Here pleasure is taken in the most relaxed way possible. Easy: simply, peek inside. Sensual iris, delicious vanilla, petals of blue water lilies, zesty ginger... Solar or aquatic, divinely aphrodisiac, so many scents mixed together that you already desire it. Terrible isn't it?

listings.rawTitle: Dior Sauvage Elixir Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AOWB0PH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The powerful freshness of Sauvage exudes new sensual and mysterious facets, amply renewing itself with the signature of an ingenious composition. Calabrian bergamot, as juicy and spirited as ever, invites new spicy notes to add fullness and sensuality, as the woody ambery trail of Ambroxan is wrapped in the smoky accents of Papua New Guinean vanilla absolute for greater virility. François Demachy, Dior Perfumer-Creator, drew inspiration from the desert in the magical hour of twilight. Mixed with the coolness of the night, the burning desert air exudes profound fragrances. In the hour when the wolves come out and the sky is set ablaze, a new magic unfolds.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau de Parfum 125ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WX1DU73]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The new Terre d'Hermes Eau de Parfum represents the warmth of ice: fresh and intense at the same time. Within the Terre d'Hermes collection, inspired by man's relationship with the earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with nature and the elements, Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree explores a new territory in which freshness and strength are find. The fragrance combines the vigor of citron and the penetrating freshness of juniper berry with the power of Timut pepper. The surprising sensation of an icy breath is combined with the generous mineral and woody notes typical of Terre d'Hermes. “A veil of frost fertilizes the earth and enlivens it with a new and invigorating force”, Christine Nagel, creative director of Hermes Parfums. Top Notes: Citron Heart Notes: Juniper Berries Base notes: Timut pepper

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B9RRFUP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree combines the vigour of citron and the incisive freshness of juniper berry with the power of Timut pepper. The striking sensation of an icy breeze is juxtaposed with the generosity of the woody, mineral notes characteristic of Terre d'Hermes. Refillable and sustainable, the bottle combines glass with aluminium, two fully recyclable materials. As if cut from ice, the object is sleek and limpid. Frosted glass and brushed aluminium evoke the notion of frost covering the earth. The H on its base is a subtle reference to the ancestry of a now-cult object. Olfactory emotion: Fresh, Delicate Main raw materials: Citron, Juniper berry, Timut pepper

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Spirit of The Brave Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PW5G7JG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Spirit of the Brave reinvents the classic fougere and redefines the codes of masculinity in Diesel's most luxurious fragrance yet. The very first notes unveil a modern and masculine green signature bringing a boost of freshness with an unprecedented concentration of natural ingredients for a masculine fragrance. The crisp and elegant resinous heart carries texture and creates a daring contrast with the fresh top. The warm, luxurious dry down laced with Tonka bean brings an addictive twist and conveys a sensual masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Rush 2 Eau de Toilette 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BBWBXMV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created for the self-confident and sexy woman, this perfume will make you an unforgettable appearance. Fresh, flowery and woody, the fragrance opens on an accord of rose, freesia, musk, palm tree, oakmoss and narcissus... Top notes: Bergamot Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber notes, Tahitian vanilla. Heart: Casablanca lily, Orange blossom, ylang ylang

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Insolence Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GI9EI5E]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Insolence paints the portrait of a bold, sensual woman, a woman who is impossible to resist. Floral, fruity and powdery all at once, Insolence is the fragrance of seduction bursting with brazenness. Overdosed to the point of stimulating, violet accord leaves in its fragrant wake the gourmand scent of wild strawberry, the sensuality of iris and the radiance of orange blossom.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Wood Pour Femme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FE68UIH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DSquared2 Wood Pour Femme Eau De Toilette is a floral woody fragrance for women who dare to take the road less travelled, confident, sensual and free-spirited. The feminine counterpart to Wood Pour Homme, it's inspired by the powerful, complex nature of wood and made for those who act on their impulses. It opens on a burst of juicy Sicilian tangerine and raspberry leaf, refreshing and bright, before floral notes of lily of the valley and magnolia bloom through. Enticing osmanthus and oriental jasmine then give the heart a striking feminine character, while a base of white woods, cedar and ambroxan brings out an irresistible depth. Finished with a magnetic cap hand-crafted from ash wood, it's as distinctive in the hand as it is on the skin. A great choice for anyone who loves fresh fruity florals with a confident, woody backbone.

listings.rawTitle: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Misteriosa Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QG7GH49]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Signorina Misteriosa is an innovative olfactive interpretation of black shades with a strong gourmand core, uncovering the secrets every girl keeps hidden. The unexpected and playful scent of wild blackberry, irradiated by the glowing neroli, creates a distinctive opening that then gives way to a sensuous and seductive heart of orange blossom and tuberose. An irresistibly sweet black vanilla mousse accord signs the dry down while patchouli confers an elegantly stylish touch to this Fruity Amber fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake A Drop D'Issey Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J4IOEXO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A Drop d’Issey, Issey Miyake’s new Eau de Parfum for women, is an invitation to see the world in a new way, to discover the beauty and poetry hidden in nature. A perfume with a floral, solar lilac signature perceived through the lens of a musky note and a hint of almond milk accord. The top note of the fragrance is delicately floral with pure, clear, damask rose. The perfume’s middle notes magnify the enveloping fragrance of solar lilac with hints of almond milk and ethically sourced orange flower. The base notes round out the fragrance with a musky accord of upcycled cedarwood atlas and vanillin. SOLAR LILAC ENLIGHTENED BY A MUSKY SIGNATURE One of perfumery’s most mysterious flowers, lilac, doesn’t give up its secrets easily. Its fragrance cannot be extracted from the flower in its natural state and must be recreated by the creative talents and imagination of a perfumer.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray 3Pcs Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QI41UMU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Classique is a floral oriental fragrance by Jean Paul Gaultier. Originally released in 1993. Top notes are bergamot, rose, pear, star anise, mandarin orange and orange blossom. Middle notes are tuberose, ylang-ylang, orchid, plum, ginger and iris. Base notes are sandalwood, vanilla, cinnamon, musk and amber. This three-piece giftset includes: 100ml Eau de Toilette Spray, 75ml Body Lotion and 6ml Eau de Toilette Spray.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TMNJXL9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Le Beau Le Parfum is a rich woody-amber fragrance that starts with a warm, spicy ginger note, which is lifted by the vibrant freshness of pineapple as the milky top note of coconut wood graces the senses. The heart gives into temptation with a creamy, vanillary tonka bean note before salty-skin-like ambergris adds a salty side to soft santal wood. Top notes are Pineapple, Ginger, Coconut Wood. Heart note is Tonka Bean. Base notes are Santal Wood, Ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Ultra Intense Eau de Toilette 40ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SSG9HB4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Devastatingly handsome and more intense than ever, the Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Eau de Toilette Intense Spray tells the tale of a roguish sailor. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WWHTBBP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Classique is a wonderful exciting offering from experienced perfumer Jean Paul Gaultier. As we all know, his scents are appreciated by men and women the world over. But, why should we choose an eau de parfum above an eau de toilette? Is it just a matter of taste? A parfum will commonly linger that little bit longer. That is certainly something that you want this fragrance to do. It is packed with sensational notes including vanilla and orange blossom. As you have probably come to expect from Jean, there is something else in that fragrance mix as well. What you can smell is ginger which has long been used as a pick me up in the Orient. The 100ml bottle is as exciting as ever. You will love to have it on your dressing table. Once the perfume is gone, you can keep the bottle - it really does look that good. Jean Paul Gaultier Classique makes a fantastic gift or personal pat on the back after a long hard day at work.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ASIDNF1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Perfume has many fans across the world. The scent leaves a mysterious trail that endures all night. Encapsulating the essence of bold and glamour of the Jimmy Choo house, this enchanting fragrance will become the backdrop to your most memorable evenings.  Sophisticated and fun, it captures a playful spirit and the atmosphere of a moment of fun ahead of what is sure to be an exciting evening. This set contains:  - Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray - Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum 7.5ml Spray  Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Body Lotion 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Icon Racing Green Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KA02QAU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A floral ambery fragrance that embraces the paradoxes of iconic ingredients to reveal new scented sensations. listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K By Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q455USJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fragrance fit for royalty; K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Toilette Spray is a fresh men’s fragrance with woody aromatic facets. Marrying classic aromas of patchouli, and woods with innovative unique spices and sharp citruses that reign supreme to Dolce&Gabbana’s Italian heritage, the Eau de Toilette makes a sophisticated statement with its contemporary juice and standout fragrance bottle. Handsome inside and out, the royal blue juice is enriched with a wave of rejuvenation from splashes of Sicilian lemon and blood orange. The energising core of lavandin unites with a slightly spicy geranium note, which complements a fiery pimento essence. The composition continues to heat up as warm woods and earthy patchouli rise and dominate the base - it’s a signature scent made for nobility. Top Notes: Blood Orange, Juniper Berry. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Geranium, Lavandin. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Vetiver, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Intense Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Ambree Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Nomade Jasmine Naturelle Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Green Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Ambra Eau de Parfum 180ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Bad Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DEKM7TY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Covered in a grainy black leather texture, the Diesel Bad bottle has a seductive, masculine look, inspired by the classic black leather biker jacket. A daring and sophisticated olfactive signature, Diesel Bad is the first scent combining accords of tobacco and caviar to create an addictive, pulsating, yet fresh woodiness.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Eau De Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MBTEU1V]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A revitalising watermelon note refreshes a wildflower accord tinged with the powdery facets of iris and violet and illuminated by a bouquet of white flowers. Create your own signature by pairing Flora Salvaggia with: Bergamote Calabria, Rosa Rossa, Granada Salvia or Flora Cherrysia.  To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IP21JI4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Granada Salvia smells like juicy red berries as it kicks off with a delicious, mouth-watering opening of pomegranate and blackcurrant, enhanced by the sparkling citrus freshness of cypress, lemon and bergamot. The watery heart gives it a turkish delight quality as a perfumed rose accord is balanced by aromatic sage. The base leaves a lasting impression of woods with sensual white musk, moss and patchouli. Top notes are Pomegranate, Blackcurrant, Cypress, Lemon, Bergamot. Heart notes are Rose, Sage. Base notes are White Musk, Moss, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Nettare di Sole Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J0PW0DK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Aqua Allegoria Nettare Di Sol is a bright and enchanting summer fragrance carrying the warmth of the sun across fields of white florals and honeyed citrus. Orange blossom, bergamot, and water notes create a refreshing splash of fragrance. Solar notes carry the heart amongst touches of magnolia, rose, and jasmine. Luxurious honey fills the base with a delectable gourmand sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier La Panthere Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J5TUGNR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A captivating fragrance that reveals a free-spirited and passionate woman. A feline-floral accord born from the fusion between a radiant and delicate gardenia with sensual musky notes. At the heart of the bottle, an internal sculpture draws the fascinating and majestic panther.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'interdit Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A5OIC0N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Givenchy L’Interdit Eau de Parfum is a bold, feminine fragrance and one of the brand’s most popular fragrances for women. Combining fruity and floral top notes with woody base notes, L’Interdit is the perfect long-lasting fragrance for the evening. Givenchy L’Interdit is packaged in a classy clear glass bottle, complemented by the pretty pink hue of the fragrance. L’Interdit has a chic and feminine design that would look gorgeous on any dressing table. Choose L’Interdit as a luxury fragrance gift for any of the women in your life; they’re bound to love it! Or treat yourself to this alluring scent, and discover your new favourite fragrance from Givenchy. Notes: pear, bergamot, orange blossom, jasmine, tuberose, vetiver, vanilla, patchouli

listings.rawTitle: JOOP! Homme Absolute For Him Eau de Parfum 120ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AI8KKXF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} JOOP! Homme Absolute is made for the man who is confident without trying too hard. He likes a laugh, doesn't take himself too seriously and knows that a bit of charm goes a long way. At the same time, he values real connection and is happy to let his guard down with the people who matter to him. The fragrance reflects both sides of that personality by pairing a surprising floral heart with a strong, masculine base. It opens with black pepper, giving it an energetic, spicy start that grabs your attention straight away. This moves into ylang-ylang, a rich floral note you would normally find in women's fragrances, which gives Homme Absolute a smoother and more unexpected character than you might expect from JOOP! As it dries down, the scent turns warm and bold. Fresh, earthy vetiver sits alongside sweet tonka bean and a touch of incense, leaving a deep, lasting trail that feels unmistakably masculine. A good choice for evenings, cooler weather and anyone who likes the classic JOOP! Homme but wants something a little more grown up. Key notes Top: black pepper Heart: ylang-ylang Base: vetiver, tonka bean, incense

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Forever Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F0R3A0F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Forever is the scent of summer; sunny, positive and intoxicatingly floral. It’s exactly the type of scent that will pick you up and carry you away to the Mediterranean Sea in just one spritz. Honouring Light Blue's signature top notes, the fragrance blends crisp and tangy fruits for an ultimate feeling of freshness before a highly feminine, sunny floral heart blossoms. Finally, the fragrance settles into a sensual base of woods and musk that melt into sun-kissed skin.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Eau De Parfum 150ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BD0E2NO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover the infinite power of the sea encapsulated through a powerful combination of marine, aromatic and woody notes. Acqua di Gio Eau de Parfum is refillable in every format. Heart Notes: Aromatic Essences Clary sage from Provence, crafted for Giorgio Armani and sustainably harvested, blends with fresh lavandin and geranium from Madagascar. Base Notes: Woody Mineral  The patchouli from Guatemala, the signature of the fragrance, is sustainably harvested, through solidarity programs supporting local communities. A true concentrate of savoir-faire. Fragrance Family: Woody

listings.rawTitle: Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H17D8PO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Fusing the scent of sun-drenched jasmine flower and peach nectar with a sensual touch of rose. listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YHO0NPG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The woody-vetiver Eau de Parfum opens with a sun-drenched citrus tone that uplifts the senses from the very first spritz. The heart reveals an unexpected blend of vetiver and orris for an addictive and moreish tone that honours the earth. Finally, the fragrance dives into the raw, earthy richness of the terrae accord, a signature facet that’s exclusive to BVLGARI. This note harmonises with rich styrax for a deep, seductive trail. Top notes are Citron Essence, Calamansi Accord. Heart notes are Vetiver, Orris. Base notes are Terrae Accord, Styrax Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=D9N56CE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Starting as a light airy scent, juicy grapefruit and delicate white floral lily of the valley create a subtle natural sweetness. The heart of the fragrance is an ode to roses, with rosebud smelling innocent and slightly warm in a different way to classic velvety rose with peony completing the floral heart. The initial intense floral feel is long-lasting before the base notes warm on the skin, white musk adding a sensual clean edge whilst cedarwood takes the scent on a woody dive into a richer earthy sweetness. Top notes are Lily of the Valley Accord, Grapefruit Essence. Heart notes are Peony Accord and Rosebud. Base notes are White Musk Accord and Cedarwood Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier Declaration Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HR12VAU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Declaration is a trail of passion led by an overdose of cardamom, locked up in a streamlined bottle, palpitating like a heart waiting for love: a declaration of love. After an electric and intoxicating burst of cardamom, cedar wood emerges with its unrivalled balance and plenitude. A declaration of love and elegance, by Cartier.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WLEMKHL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Defy aftershave is a daring contrast of invigorating freshness and powerful woods: an eau de toilette for men who break boundaries while exploring their authentic truths and the contrasts within. This Calvin Klein fragrance opens with an addictive citrus blend highlighting crisp Bergamot and fresh Lavender Absolute. Rugged and earthy Vetiver Oil—responsibly sourced from Haiti—is the heart of this men's eau de toilette spray, connecting the vibrant textural elements with a rich and alluring base of Amber notes. Packaged in a modern bottle that reflects the iconic codes of Calvin Klein—denim blues and minimalism infused with a sensual edge. This CK scent has a textured matte cap atop the curved yet sharp silhouette, representing the duality of vulnerability and courage on the path to defiance.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Blue Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L8EP4QY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Fresh and clean, Coach For Men Blue Eau de Toilette Spray is an aquatic-aromatic fragrance for men, with exhilarating notes of citrus fruits, black pepper and woods. Perfumer, Juliette Karagueuzoglou’s Eau de Toilette opens with an invigorating blend of zesty lime and grapefruit, which is cleverly paired with the darker aromatic scent of absinthe. The heart welcomes a refreshing ozone accord, which juxtaposes heated black pepper and cedar leaf before the base creates an earthy and masculine tone by combining cedarwood, sandalwood and warm amber. Created for an authentic and optimistic individual, Coach’s scent is inspired by the freedom of an American road trip, with the ombre bottle reflecting expansive blue skies and endless opportunities.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Floral Blush Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LDWRVJX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Coach Floral Blush is inspired by Coach’s iconic leather Tea Roses, which represents Coach’s leather craftsmanship and American spirit, and evokes the carefree energy of summer in New York City. An airy and colourful scent associating sparkling notes of Goji berries with peony and sensual notes of white woods create a sensual, bold fragrance. Fragrance Family: Floral fruity. Top Notes: Goji Berry Heart Notes: Peony Base Notes: White Woods

listings.rawTitle: Coach Coach Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KABRTKK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Coach Eau de Toilette is inspired by the spontaneous energy and downtown style of New York City. A fragrance full of contrasts, it opens with fresh pear, which gives way to timeless and elegant white Alba roses, before drying down to a sensual cedarwood base note.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Platinum For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B5I0223]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fragrance that looks as good as it smells, the Coach For Men Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray is a fresh oriental scent inspired by the confidence and magnetism of New York. Extremely inviting, Coach Platinum is a spicier interpretation of the original Coach for Men fragrance, with a textured fusion of cool and warm elements that are prominent from the first spritz right through to the deeply woody dry down. This luxurious contrast is mirrored in the sleek look of the Eau de Parfum, with a modern metal flacon finished with a classic grained leather tag. As the fragrance opens, black pepper oil heats up sweet notes of pineapple, creating a refreshing tonic boosted by a crisp dash of juniper. A distinctive and deeply seductive note of cashmeran in the heart is stirred up by aromatic touches of clary sage, before a fusion of warm woods, earthy patchouli and tactile leather facets make for a tempting finale. Top Notes: Black Pepper Oil, Pineapple, Juniper Berries Heart Notes: Cashmeran, Clary Sage, Geranium Base Notes: Vanilla Leather, Patchouli, Sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: Coach Signature Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=O3532A6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Its fruity floral scent is uplifting and refreshing with just a hint of the sort of elegant leather accessories that have made the designer famous. The fragrance opens with top notes of pink pepper, pear, and raspberry leaf, and then reveals a luxurious heart of Turkish rose. The base notes are a blend of suede musk and rich sandalwood, to give the perfume an undeniable allure.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold For Men Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RNKN5GX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Drawing on the legacy of The One line, this sophisticated woody, spicy, citrus Eau de Parfum Intense embodies radiant luminosity and charisma. The fragrance celebrates a man who has a natural but unmistakable magnetism. A true gentleman, he exudes confidence with his innate elegance and unique style. An invigorating fusion of juicy Italian bergamot and zesty bloody orange opens the fragrance, with red ginger adding a warm spiciness to the citrus top notes. The vibrant energy of these sparkling citruses evolves to a powerfully masculine heart of aromatic clary sage and crisp Egyptian geranium essence, enlivened by spicy notes of cardamom. Mysterious patchouli gives the perfume an intensely alluring base, its richness and subtle smokiness balanced by earthy Haitian vetiver and woody ambery notes. The One For Men Gold is as powerfully alluring as the man who wears it.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani in Love With You Freeze Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WQB899T]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} In Love With You Freeze, a fresh fragrance for women by Emporio Armani, captures the thrill of the most joyful love, each new day as strong as the first. Alluring, soft and delicate," yet bursting with profound sensuality. In Love With You Freeze is a fresh interpretation of our iconic In Love With You for her. ""Live in the present"," as the present moment is always the happiest one"" - Giorgio Armani. A celebration of life and togetherness", In Love With You Freeze seizes each instant, freezing the moment to make it last. In Love with You Freeze caresses you with fresh and addictive cherry, tender and delicate peony, alluring and warm patchouli, and sensual and elegant white musk.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RBPY0M4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} I Want Choo Forever, an intoxicating chypre ambery gourmand, celebrates energy and intensity, thanks to a particular blend of ingredients.  On top, a powerful rose has been amalgamate with a spicy pink peppercorn to denote attraction. The heart is a potent black cherry liquor, seductive jasmin sambac and a warm feminine vetiver.  Finally, earthy moss, vanilla and tonka bean are combined to make this delicious scent truly addictive. The scent leaves a mysterious trail that endures all night. Encapsulating the essence of bold and glamour of the Jimmy Choo house, this enchanting fragrance will become the backdrop to your most memorable evenings.  Sophisticated and fun, it captures a playful spirit and the atmosphere of a moment of fun ahead of what is sure to be an exciting evening.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum 150ml Refill

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KD1H1QV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Omnia by Mary Katrantzou was launched in 2021.
