Top notes: fig leaf and mandarin orange Heart notes: gardenia and orange blossom Base notes: white woods and musk

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Boisee Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AI74AP8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Warm, woody and made for the modern man, the GIVENCHY Gentleman Boisee Eau de Parfum Spray for men features notes of spice and iris. Gentleman Boisee is the sensual one in the Givenchy Gentleman collection; for Boisee, its deep woody aroma softens the signature note of Patchouli creating a fragrance for men that’s suave and seductive. It’s a statement of sensuality and style. Boisee starts with a spicy introduction from black pepper and strong herbs, then as the scent warms, powdery facets of iris pair with creamy cocoa and warm woods; instantly the masculinity of this scent is empowered when deep woods in the base rise up, creating a long-lasting dry down that smells incredibly handsome and easily identifiable as a GIVENCHY Gentleman fragrance, just woodier.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YR3NTM2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A pure woody fragrance, L'Homme Le Parfum is dedicated for a man at the height of his magnetism. As an epitome of attractive charisma, his effortless elegance draws all the eyes on him. A quintessence of L'Homme's DNA, the fragrance shows a powerful and refined interpretation of the iconic eau de toilette. It opens on a fresh fruity top accord and develops into a rich blend of precious ambery woods, then giving way to a strongly faceted cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JK7865H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A grand floral Eau de Parfum with an unequivocal YSL twist. The burning sensuality of the orange blossom flowers from Morocco, twisted with the aromatic boldness of lavender from France. Lavender, traditionally used in male perfumery is given an ultra-sensual facet for a women's perfume that is both fiery and couture, with that uniquely androgynous YSL attitude.  Top notes: tangerine, neroli, lavender Heart notes: jasmine sambac, orange blossom Base notes: white musks, vanilla extract Key notes: orange blossom, lavender

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Refillable Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EKXMTHK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} MYSLF is Yves Saint Laurent's first woody floral scent. A prominent orange blossom heart blooms throughout the scent, complemented by a fresh & vibrant accord, and underpinned by layers of sensual, textured woods. The fragrance is characterised by its bright and authentic scent, which combines radiant freshness with earthy woods and patchouli, creating a provoking and ever-evolving aroma. Top notes: fresh & vibrant accord with bergamot heart  Heart notes: orange blossom absolute heart Base notes: wood accord with patchouli and Ambrofix

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B2948WB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With both light and dark fougère facets, Y Eau de Parfum blends elegance, sensuality and strength, echoing the multifaceted personality of the YSL man. Woody and aromatic, the original Eau de Parfum opens with fresh notes of bergamot and ginger enhanced by juicy green apple for powerful freshness.  Sage and juniper bring masculinity contrasted with the elegance of geranium absolute and lavender, two floral notes at the heart of the Y olfactive signature. At the base, a mysterious blend of sensual wood, frankincense and warm tonka beans is uncovered, reinforced by smokey vetiver for intensity. Top notes: apple accord, bergamot essence, ginger essence, elemi essence, aldehydes  Heart notes: geranium absolute, juniper essence, sage essence, lavender essence  Base notes: tonka bean, vetiver essence, frankincense essence, operamide

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Men Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OM0GAMA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Intensely cool, but spiked with a shock of spice, NEW Y Eau de Parfum Intense amplifies the strength of the Y signature for long lasting wear. Deeply fresh and vibrant when first applied, a captivating reveal of elegant woody notes unfolds throughout the day. At the heart of this men’s cologne, cool French lavender sensual patchouli, and a vivid blend of blue juniper berries create a striking signature scent, highly fresh with a spicy, seductive twist. This powerful olfactive statement is underscored by the minty radiance of geranium & the sensuality of cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu Parfum Intense 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OW0N87N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With his dazzling skin and smokin’ hot body, the new Male Elixir Absolu is setting the atmosphere alight. Radiating a golden aura, everything in his wake is turned into gold. This new Male — and the most precious of all — keeps the signature fragrance notes of the iconic Le Male Elixir but is intensely richer. Fruity notes of spicy, sensual plum develop into lavender and tonka bean, taking sensuality to the extreme. But be warned! This Le Male will soon become an obsession.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu Parfum Intense 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=D2EFVB6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With his dazzling skin and smokin’ hot body, the new Male Elixir Absolu is setting the atmosphere alight. Radiating a golden aura, everything in his wake is turned into gold. This new Male — and the most precious of all — keeps the signature fragrance notes of the iconic Le Male Elixir but is intensely richer. Fruity notes of spicy, sensual plum develop into lavender and tonka bean, taking sensuality to the extreme. But be warned! This Le Male will soon become an obsession.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Flower Edition Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HAKH1FQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Flower Edition EDP is a floral fruity fragrance for women that combines notes of apricot, magnolia, jasmine and vanilla. This perfume offers a fresh and sweet fragrance, perfect for those who appreciate feminine and enchanting scents...

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Flower Edition Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JJTAYYA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This scent transports us with its fresh citrus and woody notes. Juicy, zesty kumquat fuses with tangy lemon. Desire is aroused. Violet leaf surprises with its intoxicating, masculine floral note, inviting you to explore the heart of this secret garden. Patchouli echoes the woody power of cashmeran and comforting tonka bean. The enchantment begins.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YFG5QX7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DKNY MEN is inspired by all the city has to offer. The energy of a twist of bergamot and mandarin instantly gets you. The feeling of cool city rain shakes up the juniper and clary sage for freshness, while fast, spicy notes of white pepper and cardamom fascinate. A downtown lavender vibe infuses with violet leaves, as wet jasmine drenches with sophistication. Sculpted sandalwood combines with cedarwood and patchouli. The structure of modern luxury is redefined by orris and vetyver for a masculine edge.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WS4T5C5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Since 1976, Jean Paul Gaultier has been fearlessly and passionately celebrating all women. Free in every way, shape and form. Beautiful with their curves. Proud to be themselves and free from all hang-ups, Gaultier women celebrate their unique qualities and otherness. Freedom encapsulated within the gold of a precious, conical and already iconic corset. Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum is a fearless tribute to all women. A spectacular and uniquely Gaultier lily radiates with majesty at the heart of a bouquet of white flowers. Kissed with delicious meringue. And infused with an iodized breeze. Now you’re Divine! With this addictive and irresistible marine floral fragrance. An homage to women, Gaultier Divine proudly shows off her voluptuous and uninhibited curves. Gaultier's famous corset is much more than an item of lingerie, it is a precious jewel that honours women’s bodies and showcases their diversity. Covered in gold. Conical and already iconic.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y8V7QL4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mont Blanc is a top men’s fragrance brand. The company has been producing men’s accessories for a long time. It was not until 2001 that it added its fragrance range for men. Today, the company offers a range of fragrances for both men and women. Notes are sophisticated and work well in a variety of settings. One of its most popular fragrances is Mont Blanc Explorer. Platinum is a recent addition to this range. What does it smell like? This is a very vibrant fragrance. The first notes to burst out of the bottle are fresh grapefruit and violet leaves. Other notes you can also enjoy are herbal aromatics mixed with the balsamic qualities of cedarwood. A great cologne for any time of the day or night. Works well at play and business. We are offering this vibrant cologne in a 100ml EDP spray. Long-lasting and enduring are two of the qualities you will appreciate. Make it a personal purchase or order it for the man in your life who loves vibrant and invigorating fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Mont Blanc Signature Absolue Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VPCOURY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Signature Absolue is a sensual amber-floral fragrance that takes a modern twist on classic accords. A fruity opening features a leading note of pear, mandarin, and pink pepper. Ylang ylang, frangipani, and tuberose allow for a sweet and refreshing floral heart. The base concludes with smooth tonka bean and robust cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Al Haramain L'Aventure Gold Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XH8A0RN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Al Haramain L'Aventure Gold is a luxurious fragrance crafted for women who appreciate elegance and refinement. Launched in 2022, this exquisite scent belongs to the Floral Woody Musk family, blending fresh, floral, and warm notes into a beautifully balanced composition. Designed to make an impression, it embodies sophistication with every spritz, making it a perfect choice for those who love timeless allure. The fragrance opens with an invigorating burst of bergamot, blackcurrant, and green leaves, offering a fresh and vibrant start. As it develops, a floral heart unfolds with delicate jasmine, romantic rose, lily of the valley, plum, and exotic orchid, adding depth and grace. Finally, the warm base of musk, vanilla, and sandalwood creates a sensual and lasting finish, wrapping the wearer in a soft yet striking aura. Crafted by Al Haramain, a brand renowned for its expertise in Middle Eastern perfumery, L'Aventure Gold is a testament to their dedication to creating unforgettable scents. The elegant 6.8 oz bottle ensures a generous supply, allowing you to indulge in this captivating fragrance daily. Whether for a special occasion or everyday wear, this scent brings a touch of luxury and confidence to any moment.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Mr Burberry Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OGDJR01]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum is a bold and refined fragrance that reinterprets the original with a deeper, more intense character. Inspired by the energy and mystery of London at night, it blends classic sophistication with modern sensuality, making it the perfect choice for the confident man. This scent embodies both strength and elegance, creating an unforgettable presence with every wear. The fragrance opens with fresh and aromatic tarragon, balanced by the warm spice of cinnamon for an inviting start. As it develops, rich patchouli adds depth, while the base of smoky vetiver and amber creates a smooth, lingering finish. This expertly layered composition results in a scent that is both dynamic and refined, ideal for evening wear or special occasions. Encased in a sleek bottle that pays tribute to Burberry’s iconic black Heritage Trench Coat, the design exudes timeless masculinity. The weighted cap mirrors the coat’s distinctive horn-look buttons, while a hand-tied knot of English-woven gabardine around the neck honours the craftsmanship of Thomas Burberry. This attention to detail makes Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum not just a fragrance, but a statement of style and heritage.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NSQJWG5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Stronger With You Absolutely parfum is an addictive fragrance for men, inspired by the power of absolute love. This powerful and sensual fragrance is boosted by an addictive new rum accord, while lavender, sustainably sourced in France, is irresistibly enhanced with liquorous and fruity facets. Warm vanilla, harvested in Madagascar while supporting local communities, and smoky cedar wood, carefully extracted in Virginia, USA, round up this powerful scent. Stronger With You Absolutely is enveloped by an intense smoky lacquering that conveys the absolute strength of the parfum. The union of Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum for him and Because It's You for her creates an irresistible couple, empowered by two strong individuals. Together, Stronger.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Nectar Eau de Parfum Intense 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JH0UE7T]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Fly into the heart of the flower and discover Flowerbomb Nectar Eau de Parfum by Viktor&Rolf, the most intense perfume in the Flowerbomb collection. Revolving around a sensual and intense flower liqueur, this addictive perfume offers an explosion of flowers twisted with warm woods and sweet fruits. Flowerbomb Nectar is a feminine floral amber perfume which blends vibrant top notes of fresh bergamot oil and rich blackcurrant syrup. The sweet initial impression develops into floral heart notes of luxurious Sambac Jasmine, bittersweet Orange Flower, and elegant Osmanthus. Base notes of warm, spicy Tonka Bean and creamy, soft Vanilla leave a sensual and unforgettable trail.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OQDGR1O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Viktor&Rolf presents Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid, a bold and seductive addition to the Flowerbomb collection, inspired by the captivating world of Burlesque. This fragrance invites you to embrace your most glamorous and confident self, capturing the essence of a woman who commands attention with elegance and allure. With every spritz, it unveils a magnetic floral explosion that sets the stage for an unforgettable presence. At the heart of this intoxicating scent lies a striking blend of ruby flower orchid and red vanilla bean, creating a rich and velvety warmth. This sensual duo is enhanced by the juicy freshness of a red vine peach accord, adding a luscious and playful contrast. The result is an irresistible balance of floral, fruity, and creamy notes that radiate both sophistication and seduction. Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid is more than just a fragrance—it is a performance, a statement, a moment of pure glamour. Each spray releases an enchanting aroma that allows you to express your most spectacular self. Step into the spotlight, take a deep breath, and let the show begin.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Ultime Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H97HUMX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} L’Interdit Rouge Ultime by Givenchy is a bold and irresistible fragrance that redefines temptation. A luminous bouquet of orange blossom, tuberose, and jasmine is infused with rich cocoa extract, creating an unexpected and indulgent contrast. Upcycled cacao shells enhance the depth of this composition, revealing a captivating gourmand facet that is further intensified by an elegant blend of patchouli and vetiver wood. This sensual Eau de Parfum is crafted with a balance of floral radiance and deep woody undertones, finished with a touch of ambroxan for a long-lasting, unforgettable trail. The interplay of delicate white florals and dark, seductive notes makes it a statement scent for those who embrace both elegance and boldness. Each spritz leaves an impression of mystery and sophistication, perfect for any occasion that calls for confidence and allure. Encased in a striking red bottle with opaque inner lacquering, delicate red lace, and a couture 4G tassel, L’Interdit Rouge Ultime embodies the essence of Givenchy’s signature color—red, the symbol of passion and absolute freedom. More than just a fragrance, it is an invitation to break the rules, embrace your individuality, and experience the thrill of the forbidden.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire Florale Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=S7Q3TGB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} La Vie Est Belle en Rose is a vibrant and uplifting fragrance that celebrates happiness through a fresh, floral interpretation of the beloved La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum. This new edition captures a luminous, petaly essence with a heart of peony and roses, embodying an optimistic outlook on life. It invites you to see the world through a joyful lens, focusing on the brighter, pinker side of things, and encourages you to embrace happiness in all its forms. Crafted by two of France’s top perfumers, La Vie Est Belle en Rose introduces Lancôme's first-ever peony accord, adding a fresh and generous floral note to the fragrance. The blend of peony and roses creates a light, airy bouquet that radiates optimism and joy. This floral heart is complemented by a lively burst of zesty red fruits at the top, providing an immediate sense of energy and brightness. The fragrance maintains the signature gourmand warmth of the original La Vie Est Belle, while adding a modern twist with refined sandalwood oil and musks. These elements offer depth and sophistication to the composition, balancing the fresh floral notes with a soft, elegant base. La Vie Est Belle en Rose is a fragrance that infuses every day with positivity and invites you to savor life’s most joyful moments.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VHS66O8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum is an intense interpretation of the original Mr. Burberry fragrance. Capturing the essence and anticipation of London at night time, the scent is warm, sensual and woody. Opening with fresh and aromatic top notes of tarragon and comforting, spicy cinnamon, the fragrance has a heart of rich patchouli with a base of amber and smoky vetiver. T he Eau de Parfum is housed in a bottle that echoes the black Heritage Trench Coat and its signature design details. Bold and masculine, the weighted cap references horn-look buttons, while a hand-tied knot in English-woven gabardine sits around the neck.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Elixir de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AKUS0BY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms. An intense fragrance for an intense connection, Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum is an ambery floral woody fragrance for women. Guilty Elixirs are a daring assertion, a colourful extraversion: sensual and provocative scents that extend a loving invitation to accept who we are and let our authentic selves be seen while celebrating the countless iterations of love. Perfumers Quentin Bisch and Nathalie Cetto embued this Gucci fragrance with a sensual and mysterious base of vanilla absolute aroused by dark tonka beans, complemented by Gucci Guilty's signature of earthy patchouli, mandora, and floral and feminine wisteria. The fragrance for women is rounded off by a top note of citric bergamot which is beautifully balanced by rose, osmanthus and a sweet and soft violet accord. This Gucci scent is contained within an opulent purple glass bottle, a romantic reminder of feminine power and a reflection of the intense fragrance that lies within. The bottle of this beautiful fragrance unexpectedly plays with transparencies and features a debossed interlocking GG logo: precious ingredients concentrated in a flask.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Magnetic For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WHCADWS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the power of attraction with BOSS The Scent Magnetic for Her, an exhilarating Eau de Parfum that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. With a magnetic pull that draws you in, this enticing interpretation of the original BOSS The Scent fragrance blends ambery and musky notes to create an irresistible, captivating interplay. It opens with dark, textured Osmanthus flower notes set against a powerfully sensual lacing of White Musk. The senses are tantalised further with an enveloping Amber base, taking compelling strength to new heights. BOSS The Scent Magnetic reinvents empowering sensuality in a deep-purple lacquered flacon featuring the BOSS logo and a Double-B monogrammed icy-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this mesmerising scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Magnetic Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CMPML5O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the power of attraction with BOSS The Scent Magnetic for Him, an exhilarating Eau de Parfum that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. With a magnetic pull that draws you in, this enticing interpretation of the original BOSS The Scent fragrance blends ambery, fruity, and leathery notes to create an irresistible, captivating interplay. It opens with exotic, addictive Maninka fruit – crafted exclusively for BOSS – set against vibrant, voluptuous Bran absolute. The senses are tantalised further with an enveloping base of Black Vanilla extract, taking compelling strength to new heights. BOSS The Scent Magnetic reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking deep-black lacquered flacon featuring the BOSS logo and a Double-B monogrammed icy-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this mesmerising scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Bois D'Ambre Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EM7A2WP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The fragrance opens with a whisper of fruit, a fleeting sweetness that draws you in. The heart reveals a rich tapestry of warm woods, creating a sense of depth and masculinity. As the fragrance evolves, the subtle sweetness of tonka bean and the aromatic touch of sage emerge, adding layers of complexity and intrigue.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E7NI056]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Strong yet sensitive, Armani Code Parfum reinvents the olfactory signature of the original Armani Code fragrance. Retaining its woody aromatic, sensual identity, Armani Code Parfum captures the Armani Code quintessence. This is expressed in the fragrance’s aromatic top notes and powerfully masculine base notes, with the heart now infused with an amplified sensitivity. Armani Code Parfum is the new powerful, yet sensitive olfactory signature designed to last, with a 150ml refill format which can renew any of the other sizes. A fragrance for the future. Top note: Armani Code Parfum opens with bright top notes that vibrate with Vert de Bergamote and Bergamot Heart, both sourced from Calabria, Italy. The Vert de Bergamote is extracted using molecular distillation, allowing the perfumer to carefully select a specific molecular segment of the Bergamot. This innovative and exclusive technique of crafting the note captures the Bergamot’s fresh and green top note while creating a long-lasting freshness. Heart note: The heart of the fragrance is composed of Clary Sage Heart, sourced from Provence, in the South of France. The fragrance’s sophisticated heart is driven by the fusion of natural and technological Iris notes. This blend of natural, Resinoid Iris from Morocco, and synthetic, Aldehydes of Iris lends a new sensitivity to the aromatic Armani Code signature. Base note: Drawing on the heritage of the original Armani Code fragrance, the fragrance’s powerful base is characterised by the potent Tonka Bean Absolute from Brazil. Together with Cedar Wood Heart from Virginia, USA, Armani Code Parfum’s base notes underscore the commanding Armani Code signature.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JDPHMIU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lancôme La Vie Est Belle eau de parfum is the brand's bestselling feminine fragrance. Named after the French motto "Life is Beautiful", this perfume encourages wearers to take pleasure in the small things in life. Three of France's leading perfumers created this unique olfactory signature perfume. It opens with top notes of pear and blackcurrant, flowing into floral middle notes of iris, orange blossoms and jasmine. La Vie Est Belle is rounded off with a smooth base of gourmand and patchouli. The elegant signature bottle, le sourire de cristal (the crystal smile), evokes a happy, rounded grin. The finishing touch is a pearlescent grey ribbon tied around the neck, forming twin wings of freedom.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Very Floral Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HPADUSO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Very Floral for women is an empowering journey into the heart of bold femininity and self-confidence. Built around a delicate duo of exquisite roses, this radiant reinterpretation of Givenchy’s iconic fragrance reveals the most fearlessly feminine side of Irresistible with a new solar accord. At its heart, Centifolia Rose Absolute from Grasse and Rose Essential combine for the first time in an intense duo of rose blossoms. In a bold twist, French Blackcurrant Bud absolute and a Coconut Water accord takes the senses on an exhilarating spin with an unexpected freshness. Amplified by the pristine beauty of Iris Concrete, the allure of Ylang-Ylang, and the sweetness of Jasmine Sambac Absolute, this floral and sensual women’s fragrance is irresistibly addictive.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Rose Velvet Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L5DJJCF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Velvety Rose is enveloped in elegant White Patchouli to create the new addictive floral perfume for women, Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Rose Velvet. A captivating fragrance in which tenderness is the new bold. Infused with top notes of succulent Blackcurrant, this graceful feminine fragrance reveals a heart of velvety Rose, Irresistible's signature note. This new floral facet is embraced by the powdery softness of Iris, fusing with the warmth of Tender Wood and sensual White Patchouli. Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Rose Velvet is an irresistible fragrance that invites you to embrace your tender side. Top Notes: Madagascan Pink Pepper, Burgundy Blackcurrant Buds Absolute, Tunisian Neroli  Heart Notes: Rose Essential, Rose Water, Living™ Rose Moschata Base Notes: Indonesian Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C2GE2XB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Armani’s Acqua Di Gio is a light, distinguished eau de parfum refill bottle is inspired by the fresh sea, warm sun and the richness of the earth. This aquatic, aromatic fragrance for men opens with a splash of fresh Calabrian bergamot, neroli and green tangerine. Light, aquatic nuances mix with jasmine petal, crisp rock rose, rosemary, fruity persimmon and warm Indonesian patchouli to create a masculine scent that is both fresh and sensual.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XHTCWQY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Built on a rich heritage of the Eau de Toilette, K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum symbolises the soul of a man who chooses the path of his life with determination and passion. While the Eau de Toilette created a subtle blend of irresistible citrus, enhanced by powerful and woody aromas, K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum reveals an intense spiciness, a more sensual heart and a stronger woody base. Powerfully magnetic and irresistibly seductive, the scent perfectly reflects the passionate intensity of a king of today.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Just Different Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q4V6PS4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Just Different by Hugo Boss is an aromatic fragrance for men, perfect for the vibrant, modern man with style and class. This cool urban scent opens with the invigorating freshness of ice-cold mint leaves, leading to a heart of aromatic freesia and basil. The base is composed of the unique Cashmeran molecule, delivering a distinctive woody and spicy scent. Embrace your individuality and be different from the rest with Hugo Just Different.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Vetiver Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XECUUUS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Powerful and woody: a fragrance exploring the interaction between water and spicy woods.Issey Miyake reinvents the way water interacts with raw, natural elements. Discover a vibrant, contrasting fragrance exploring the interaction between the fluidity and freshness of water and powerful notes of vétyver. An ode to a timeless masculinity triggering an instant addiction.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Musc Nude Eau De Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UADQA7A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The eau de parfum is composed around an elegant and timeless olfactive structure, enhanced with solar facets and the signature Narciso Rodriguez heart of musk. A piquant pink peppercorn accord meets an abstract floral bouquet of delicate white flowers as the fragrance gently caresses the skin. At the perfume's core, the for her heart of musk is infused with floral notes of precious rose oil and orange blossom. As the fragrance dries down, rich tonka bean absolute blends with the softness of cedarwood and patchouli, embracing you in a feeling of caring warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OOJN144]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inspired by the solar vitality of red coral, Bvlgari Omnia Coral brings to life the luminous energy of the vibrant gem in a striking signature. Joyful and colorful like coral, the floral-fruity Eau de Toilette, crafted by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, captures all the liveliness of nature through the fusing aura of hibiscus notes. An emblem of passion, this lively flower is associated with the life-giving force of light, as it only grows if totally immersed in daylight. The new flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's iconic shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the iconic fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective.

listings.rawTitle: Chanel Allure Homme Sport Eau de Cologne 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WCK4111]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A powerful chord of masculine fragrance initiating a bold opening of citrus orange, mandarin, sea notes and aldehydes for a sunny freshness. Allure Homme Sport then incorporates a contrast of spicy pepper, sweet neroli and cedar into an inviting heart. Completing the scent, a fusion of vanilla, notes of tonka bean, amber, musk and elemi resin.

listings.rawTitle: Chanel Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Toilette Refillable 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KYODY4J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inviting a sensual, amber fragrance, the luxurious Coco Mademoiselle by Chanel invites charming opening whispers of citrus within orange, mandarin, bergamot and orange blossoms. A central floral focus creates an accord of mimosa, jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang. A deep filling patchouli note creates a focus for the base adding notes of tonka bean, opoponax, vanilla, vetiver and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Chanel Egoiste Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q0187EN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A symbol of the strong and charismatic man, a bold encounter of spices and amber creating a distinct and memorable signature. Égoïste by Chanel opens with luxurious mahogany, rosewood, coriander and mandarin. A spicy core represents itself in vivid cinnamon, carnations and rose. In the base of the fragrance: amber, tobacco and leather give a warm accord balanced by sweeter vanilla and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Chanel NO.19 Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C9KTMN7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A daring, distinctive fragrance. A floral-woody-green fragrance with perfect balance. The last fragrance launched and worn by Gabrielle Chanel. An uncompromising composition, in the image of Mademoiselle. N°19 is the other great number by CHANEL. A fragrance that pays tribute to the day she was born: August 19, 1883. When the idea for this new women's fragrance came to mind, she met with resistance from those around her who did not think a new fragrance could exist alongside N°5. But Coco refused to give up and asked Henri Robert for a composition with a personality just as strong as that of N°5. And her request was granted, in a completely different olfactory composition: a contrasting accord of green and powdery notes.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Lime Basil & Mandarin Eau de Cologne 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=I4HUPTE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jo Malone Lime Basil & Mandarin Eau de Cologne is an aromatic, citrus fragrance that was launched in 1999. The scent opens with a fruity top note of Mandarin. In the middle, earthy Basil shines through the fragrance. At the base, a warm note of Amberwood brings the scent together.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Oud & Bergamot Eau de Cologne Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VGEEXT6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A time-honoured Middle Eastern tradition centred around an enveloping haze of captivating oud. This mysterious and precious wood is matched with the richness of black musk, radiating with crisp bergamot. Hypnotic and alluring. Top - Bergamot The ingredient that gives Earl Grey tea its lively character. Bergamot brightens with its sparkling, citrus freshness. Heart - Cedarwood Dry and intensely woody, it creates the brambly aspect in the base of the scent. Base - Oud Rich, resinous and dark with animalic accents, it mingles with the textural gourmand qualities of praline in the base, bringing intensity and depth to the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Peony & Blush Suede Eau de Cologne 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L0YCRLC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The essence of charm. Peonies in voluptuous bloom, exquisitely fragile. Flirtatious with the juicy bite of red apple and the opulence of jasmine, rose and gillyflower. Mingling with the sensuality of soft, blush suede. Luxurious and seductive. Top - Red Apple A crisp note that captures the mouth-watering juiciness of apple, opening the fragrance with an innocent, fruity twist. Heart - Peony An exquisite floral with delicate rose and honey accents and a subtle, green freshness. Fills the fragrance with the scent of peonies, just as they unfold. Base - Suede A supple textural note, complementing the floral opulence of peony and bringing enticing sensuality to the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum 50ml + 10ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EHQL8T4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Escape into the wild with the Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau De Parfum Gift Set, a two-piece collection designed for the free-spirited and the fearlessly feminine. Whether you're treating yourself or someone special, this duo delivers the brand's most playfully addictive scent in two versatile sizes. Collection Contains: 1 x Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau De Parfum (50ml) – Bold yet effortlessly feminine, this fruity floral EDP opens with the tangy brightness of Cloudberries before softening into a dreamy heart of Daisy Tree Petals. A lingering base of Cashmere Musks and Driftwood gives it a warm, gourmand depth that's anything but ordinary. Housed in a signature clear bottle with a gold cap and statement white daisy, it's as beautiful on the shelf as it is on the skin. 1 x Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau De Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CETOQ35]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Treat yourself or someone else with the BOSS The Scent Men's Eau de Toilette Gift Set. It comes in a gold gift box with the classic Double B logo, so it already looks the part. Gift Set Contains: BOSS The Scent Eau de Toilette 50ml – A warm, woody EDT with a bit of an edge. It opens with spicy Ginger, which is balanced out by the smooth, sweet Maninka fruit, an ingredient exclusive to BOSS, then dries down to a rich Leather base that sticks around. It's the kind of scent that gets noticed.  BOSS The Scent 150ml Deodorant Spray

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LXDT53V]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau de Parfum is a fresh, confident scent with real depth. It opens with a bright, juicy burst of Pineapple, then settles into a warm heart of Cedarwood before finishing with a rich, lingering base of Benzoin resin that stays on the skin long after you've sprayed it. Top Notes: Green Mandarin, Bergamot, Cardamom Heart Notes: Pineapple, Sesame Seed, Cypress, Lavandin Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedarwood, Benzoin It's the kind of fragrance that works just as well in the office as it does on a night out — fresh enough for daytime, warm enough to carry into the evening.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Goddess Supra Florale Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UL15SFN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mugler Alien Goddess Supra Florale Eau De Parfum is a floral fruity EDP that feels both bold and feminine at the same time...  It opens with the fresh, slightly tart brightness of Prickly Pear Cactus Flower, blooms into a rich, powdery heart of Jasmine, then finishes with the warm, spicy sweetness of Desert Flower. It's an interesting one: floral, but with enough edge to keep it from being too safe or predictable. The bottle is worth mentioning too - gold-adorned and inspired by Amethyst, it looks genuinely beautiful on a dresser. Top Notes: Prickly Pear Cactus Flower Accord Heart Notes: Jasmine Flower Base Notes: Desert Flower

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BV8I8VP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Gift Set is a great pick if you're looking for something a little different. The scent itself is bright and playful, opening with tangy Rhubarb and fresh Daffodil before softening into a warm, cosy base of Almond Milk and Cashmeran. It's floral, but not in an obvious way. There's a sweetness to it that makes it feel really wearable. The set comes with a full-sized bottle and a travel spray, so you've got one for home and one to throw in your bag. This Gift Set Contains: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum (30ml) Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Travel Spray (10ml) Top Notes: Rhubarb, Daffodil Heart Notes: Almond Milk Base Notes: Cashmeran

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Terra di Gioia Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J7I4VK4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Indulge in the exquisite allure of Giorgio Armani Terra Di Gioia Eau De Parfum 50ml, a fragrance that encapsulates the essence of sun-kissed shores and serene landscapes. This captivating scent opens with vibrant notes of bergamot and fresh pear, leading to a heart of delicate jasmine and radiant floral accords, creating a harmonious blend that is both uplifting and sophisticated. Perfect for day or evening wear, Giorgio Armani Terra Di Gioia Eau De Parfum 50ml is designed for those who appreciate elegance and nature's beauty. The warm base notes of amber and cedarwood add depth, making it an enchanting choice for any occasion. With its luxurious 50ml bottle, this perfume is a stunning addition to your collection. Embrace the essence of the Mediterranean and let Giorgio Armani Terra Di Gioia Eau De Parfum 50ml transport you to a tranquil paradise with every spray.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 2 x 5ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WP580DR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum combines the delicacy of the gardenia’s first blossom with the richness of its flower in full bloom. Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum Intense enhances the gardenia’s floral sensuality with woody intensity. What's Included: 5 mL Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 5 mL Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia embodies the authentic and curiously compelling woman. Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum Intense balances boldness and serenity, conveying depth and sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UTNS9AA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} There's a certain kind of woman who walks into a room and doesn't need to say a word. Valentino's Donna Eau de Parfum was made for her. Born from the soul of Rome, Donna is a love letter to femininity in all its forms - the romantic, the graceful, the quietly powerful. It opens with a burst of Grapefruit and Bergamot, sharpened by a hint of Blackcurrant Accord, before softening into the warmth of Rose Essence and ripe Peach. Then comes the dry down: Iris and Vanilla Accord settle into the skin like a second layer, intimate and lingering. It's the kind of scent you catch on a silk scarf hours later and feel something.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Glitter Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IDFWUK9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Some fragrances play it safe. Black Opium Eau de Parfum Glitter is not one of them. SL's most iconic scent gets a new chapter here, and it's a good one. The addition of marshmallow musk accord changes everything in the best possible way, wrapping the signature dark coffee and vanilla at the heart of Black Opium in something softer, almost dreamlike. It shouldn't work as well as it does. It absolutely does. It opens with a bright squeeze of Pear, Green Mandarin, and Lemon that burns off quickly, making way for Orange Flower before the real story begins.  The base is where you want to live: roasted Black Coffee, deep Patchouli, Vanilla Bourbon Absolu, and that pillowy Marshmallow Musk accord that makes the whole thing feel new. Gourmand, yes, but never sweet for the sake of it. Rock couture has always had an edge, and this has plenty. It just happens to smell like the most intoxicating thing you've ever worn to bed.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Amen Fantasm Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VOI9RXD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mugler has always understood that masculinity, at its most compelling, lives somewhere between restraint and obsession. Fantasm leans into that fully. Built around the original AMen's iconic Patchouli and Coffee accord, this Eau de Parfum Sensuelle concentration pushes deeper, darker, further. The coffee steps aside to make room for a Chocolat Noir Grand Cru accord so realistic it borders on edible, bitter and rounded in equal measure. The Patchouli, meanwhile, has been stripped back and made luminous rather than heavy, giving the whole thing a strange, addictive lightness for something this intense. Aromatic, gourmand, and genuinely difficult to stop smelling, it comes housed in that unmistakable black bottle, silver star catching the light. The concentration alone signals this isn't casual wear. It's for the man who knows exactly the effect he wants to have and isn't bothered about being subtle. Wear it like a secret. Or don't bother keeping it one at all.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Paco Rose Eau de Toilete 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UBI6FLA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Paco Rose doesn't take itself too seriously, and that's exactly why you'll love it. There's a bright, almost giddy rush of citrus and blackcurrant from the first spritz, like cracking open something cold on a warm afternoon. The rose that follows is nothing like the heavy, old fashioned kind. It's light and dewy, and by the time the soft musk settles in, the whole thing just feels like you on a really good day. This is a scent for grabbing brunch with no plan, last minute road trips, and dancing in your kitchen at midnight. The vibrant pink, can inspired bottle somehow makes it even better. It looks like it has a personality before you've even opened it. Carefree, fun, and genuinely hard to put down. Paco Rosé is the fragrance equivalent of a good mood.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OECY7CJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} For Her Eau de Parfum Intense opens with a wave of peach and Calabrian bergamot that feels sun warmed and a little intoxicating, the kind of opening that makes people turn their heads before they even realise they're doing it. Then the white flowers bloom, wrapped around a red spider lily accord that adds something almost hypnotic to the mix. It's familiar but deeper, like a version of yourself you only meet on certain nights. The base is where it really gets under your skin. Vetiver, moss, amber, and vanilla settle into something rich and quietly addictive. It doesn't shout, it pulls people closer, and that's far more powerful. If you already love For Her, this is everything you know cranked up beautifully. If you're new to it, you've started in exactly the right place. Either way, don't be surprised if you start getting questions about what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray + 10ml + 5ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DKCHB8L]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce and Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum is a rich fruity gourmand fragrance inspired by the indulgent sweetness of traditional Italian desserts. Warm, radiant and instantly comforting, it delivers a smooth, addictive character that feels both luxurious and uplifting from the very first spray. The scent opens with bright candied lemon, offering a soft citrus sweetness that feels vibrant without being sharp. At its heart, orange blossom adds a honeyed floral warmth, creating a glowing, sunlit character that blends seamlessly into the creamy richness of the base. As it settles, smooth vanilla brings depth and softness, rounding out the composition with a sensual and long lasting finish that wears beautifully on anyone. This gift set includes a 100ml Eau de Parfum alongside 10ml and 5ml travel atomisers, making it perfect for both home use and on the go.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Extraintense Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YTWCMKP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Alien Extraintense is Mugler turning up every dial at once. More concentrated, more carnal, more everything. Jasmine pushed to its loudest, wound together with a tuberose that has no interest in being polite. Underneath it all, a vanilla accord so deep and skin-close it feels less like a fragrance and more like a second self. The florality here is excessive by design. So is the sillage. So is the way it lingers on skin for hours, shifting and evolving into something that feels uniquely yours by the end of the day. This isn't a flanker for the faint-hearted. It's Alien stripped back to its most radical instincts and amplified until there's nowhere left to hide. Wear it when you want to be the only person in the room worth noticing. You already know Alien. This is something else.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'interdit Eau de Parfum Intense 35ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=APIDPGN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Givenchy's darker take on the iconic L'Interdit opens with a sharp hit of Black Pepper before tuberose takes over completely. It's heady, almost narcotic, softened just enough by Orange Blossom and an unexpected note of roasted Black Sesame that adds something smoky and strange to the mix. The kind of heart note combination you don't forget. The base is where it gets truly interesting. Dark Patchouli, Vetiver, and Madagascar Vanilla settle into the skin slowly, leaving behind something warm, leathery, and deeply sensual. It wears close but lingers long. Housed in a black lacquered bottle that gives very little away, this is a fragrance built for the moments when you'd rather ask forgiveness than permission. Wear it when you mean it.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BQFWELU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chemistry isn't something you manufacture. Either it's there or it isn't. BOSS The Scent is built around the kind that stops a room. It opens with natural Ginger oil, sharp and energetic, before Maninka fruit softens the edge into something altogether more addictive. The base is Leather, warm and unhurried, the note that stays on skin long after everything else has settled. Simple in structure, effective in a way that's hard to explain until you're wearing it. The bottle is worth mentioning too. Refillable, solid in the hand, gunmetal cap catching the light. The kind of thing that earns its place on a shelf rather than getting lost in a drawer. Ambery, woody, a little fruity. The kind of scent that makes people lean in without quite knowing why.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum 3x 20ml Refillable Travel Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RNYGNDV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Good girls don't always win. This one knows that. A fragrance that doesn't pick a side, this scent opens with bright Bergamot and Lemon before Jasmine and Tuberose pull it somewhere more interesting.  Sandalwood and Tonka Bean do the rest, grounding everything in something warm, rich, and a little irresistible. The bottle is a stiletto. Enough said. Set includes 3x 20ml bottles, 60ml total.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Barenia Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JJIQCW6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Leather has a smell that's almost impossible to replicate. Hermès didn't try to replicate it. They found something better. Barénia Eau de Parfum takes its name from the brand's most storied leather, the kind that softens and deepens with time rather than wearing out. The fragrance works the same way. Christine Nagel designed it to dissolve into skin rather than sit on top of it, and that's exactly what it does. It opens with Calabrian Bergamot and a quiet touch of miracle berry, barely-there sweetness that clears the way for the heart. Butterfly lily takes centre stage there, a floral note so rare this is its first appearance in perfumery. Worth knowing. Worth smelling. The base settles into roasted oakwood and a dense patchouli absolute that gives the whole thing its quiet, earthy gravity. Hermès calls it a skin perfume. That's accurate. It doesn't announce itself. It just becomes part of you, and stays there.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Reserve Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: DKNY BE Delicious Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray 4 Pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GWMQ3NW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Served in a sleek metal and glass apple bottle, this juicy fragrance combines the scent of apple with a sophisticated blend of exotic flowers and sensual woods. listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Intense Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FINHM4P]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Burberry Hero Parfum Intense is a deeper, more powerful expression of the Hero signature, built around strength, confidence and modern masculinity. From the first spray, it delivers a bold and commanding presence that feels refined yet unmistakably intense. The fragrance opens with the sharp energy of black pepper, bringing an immediate sense of freshness and spice. At its core, a signature trio of cedarwood oils creates a rich, woody structure that defines the scent and gives it depth, warmth and character. As it settles, a deep leather note emerges at the base, amplifying the intensity and adding a smooth, masculine finish that lingers on the skin. The angular bottle, inspired by the shape of a horse’s hoof, reflects the strength and identity of the fragrance with a modern Burberry edge.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MKSLYJN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Crafted by Hermes perfumer Christine Nagel, Terre d’Hermes Eau de Parfum Intense reveals a richer, more powerful connection between earth and man, capturing a sense of inner heat that feels raw, grounded, and quietly intense. The bottle mirrors this intensity with a warm reddish-brown lacquer that evokes molten earth, finished with a structured H-shaped base and a matte black metal cap that recalls the look and feel of lava stone.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez All of Me Eau de Parfum Intense 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BSHTNA2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} At first, it’s soft and floral, almost delicate, but quickly it deepens into something warmer, creamier, more magnetic. It wraps around you like a second skin, creating a quiet kind of sensuality that doesn’t need to try too hard. There’s a boldness to it, but it’s not loud, it’s self-assured. The kind of scent that makes you stand a little taller, feel a little more powerful, and completely at ease in who you are. It feels like stepping into your most confident, unapologetic self. It lingers beautifully, leaving behind a warm, addictive trail that feels both intimate and unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Flash Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KAIUALW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jimmy Choo Flash is one of those fragrances that does exactly what the name suggests. It is bright, confident and a little attention grabbing without tipping into anything too overpowering. The opening is fruity and fresh with hints of raspberry and pear that give it an immediately upbeat feel. That liveliness carries through into a floral heart built around rose and jasmine before the whole thing settles into a warmer base of sandalwood and musk. It is a fairly classic feminine structure but Jimmy Choo pulls it off with enough personality to make it feel distinct. It works well as an evening fragrance or for occasions where you want something with a bit of presence. The longevity is decent for an EDP at this price point and the sillage is noticeable without clearing a room. The 60ml bottle is a good size if you are picking it up for the first time or if you tend to rotate between a few fragrances rather than committing to one daily scent. It is a straightforward option in the Jimmy Choo lineup and one that tends to appeal if you like your fragrances warm, feminine and a little bit glamorous.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Mirto di Panarea Eau de Toilette 180ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KBSRVQ6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With aromas which vividly present landscapes of Italy and breezes of the Mediterranean in our imagination, perfume Mirto di Panarea accentuates sensual side and regenerates your body and soul with aromatic aromas of myrtle, along with luminous citruses, Calabrian lemon and sweet, passionate orange, with calming effect of basil. A heart develops with aromas of jasmine, rose and green lilac, which meet sea breeze and black currant leaves. Base notes fondle with accords of precious wood, juniper, cedar and warm amber.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OQLM0B0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia invites all who encounter it to give in to their heart’s desire with a floral and delicately sweet blend. A signature floral scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PMO0IYY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Indulge in the luxurious allure of Marc Jacobs’ Perfect Intense Eau de Parfum, a captivating rendition inspired by the designer's personal creed: ‘I am perfect as I am.’ Embark on a sensory journey as the top notes of roasted almonds, pink pepper, and the exclusive Pamplezest™ unfold, evoking an atmosphere of warmth and sophistication. In the heart of this fragrance, Daffodil Absolute and Jasmin Sambac intertwine, creating an exquisite bouquet that transcends the boundaries of tradition. A radiant floral sanctuary emerges, radiating vitality day and night. As the composition deepens, embrace the intoxicating embrace of Sesame Oil, Sandalwood from New Caledonia, and Cashmeran in the base notes. These elements converge to form a harmonious blend, seamlessly merging with the skin and leaving a lasting, sensuous impression.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez All of Me Eau de Parfum 90ml + 10ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F4BOMEQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dare to express your boldest side with this new interpretation of the musky floral all of me signature. An intense new episode that takes the scent to new heights with its striking floriental facets. As the fragrance hits your skin, addictive top notes of black iris blend their floral density with the delicate opulence of jasmine sambac absolute. At the perfume’s heart, the all of me duo of geranium and French rose centifolia takes on a new intensity. Faceted by sensual tuberose, this ultra-feminine modern bouquet becomes even more voluptuous. As the perfume unveils its deeper base notes, Narciso Rodriguez’s signature creamy heart of musk combines with responsibly sourced Australian sandalwood essence. The captivating warmth of vanilla embraces the senses, amplifying the fragrance’s memorable trail.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Stellar Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R6YTG18]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Angel Stellar is Mugler's newest addition to the iconic Angel collection, launched in 2025.
