listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum 10ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=S2SF38G]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Perfect Absolute by Marc Jacobs is a captivating fragrance that celebrates empowerment, confidence, and the beauty of self-belief. Inspired by the idea that you are already perfect as you are, this scent embodies the transformative power of self-affirmation and inner strength. It’s a luxurious evolution of the original Perfect Eau de Parfum — richer, deeper, and even more expressive of individuality and authenticity. Opening with a sweet, caramelised fig accord, Perfect Absolute instantly draws you in with its warmth and sensuality. The heart reveals an opulent blend of blooming jasmine absolute, adding elegance and femininity to the composition. As it develops, a rich amber accord wraps around the senses, creating a lasting impression that feels both comforting and empowering. Every note works in harmony to remind you to embrace who you are — unapologetically and wholeheartedly. Perfect Absolute isn’t just a fragrance; it’s a statement of self-love. Bold yet tender, luxurious yet deeply personal, it reflects the spirit of those who live with confidence and authenticity. This is a scent that celebrates your journey, your truth, and everything that makes you perfectly you.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum 100ml +10ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YANWOXA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph’s Club Eau de Parfum is an authentically masculine fragrance that draws you in with its perfect balance of elegance and sophistication.Fresh notes of Lavandin are combined with the warm richness of Virginia Cedarwood, woody Vetiver and aromatic Clary Sage for a uniquely seductive scent. The ingredients are distilled to their highest quality to achieve a clean and long-lasting aroma, making it the most natural aftershave for men in the Ralph Lauren portfolio. Seductive, Powerful and Unique. Top : Lavandin, Apple, Grapefruit Heart : Clary Sage, Geranium, Orange Blossom Base : Virginia Cedarwood, Vetiver

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PBXLO7V]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} ETERNITY Parfum for Him is a rich and multifaceted fougère gourmand fragrance, crafted to deliver depth, warmth and a powerful lasting presence. From the first spray, it feels fresh yet intense, setting the tone for a scent that balances classic structure with a modern, addictive twist. The opening combines organic lavender and cool mint, creating a crisp and aromatic lift that feels clean and invigorating. As it develops, the composition deepens into a warm base of Indonesian patchouli and cedarwood, adding strength and a grounded, masculine character. The finish is where the fragrance reveals its full intensity, with organic Madagascan vanilla and a touch of rum extract bringing a smooth, indulgent richness. This blend creates a long lasting and distinctive trail that feels both refined and boldly expressive.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Extreme Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QENOY1N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Flowerbomb Extreme Eau de Parfum by Viktor and Rolf intensifies the iconic signature with a richer, more indulgent floral vanilla composition. From the first spray, it feels deeper and more enveloping, amplifying the recognisable Flowerbomb DNA with added warmth and sensuality. The fragrance opens with juicy raspberry softened by subtle tea notes, creating a smooth and slightly sweet introduction that feels both vibrant and refined. As it develops, the heart blooms into a full bodied bouquet of freesia, rose and jasmine sambac, delivering the signature floral explosion with added depth and richness. The base settles into warm patchouli and Peruvian balm, wrapped in creamy vanilla for a long lasting, addictive finish that lingers beautifully on the skin. The result is a more intense and luxurious take on a modern classic, designed for those who want their fragrance to leave a lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Good Fortune Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KWEFTK9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Good Fortune by Viktor and Rolf is a modern floral woody fragrance that embodies positivity, self-belief and the idea of shaping your own destiny. Designed as an olfactive manifesto for a new generation, it feels uplifting, spiritual and empowering from the very first spray. The fragrance opens with an intriguing co distillate of fennel and gentian flower, creating a fresh, slightly aromatic brightness with a subtle herbal edge. As it develops, a jasmine superinfusion takes centre stage, bringing a radiant, solar floral heart that feels smooth, luminous and softly sensual. The base settles into creamy Bourbon vanilla, adding warmth, depth and a gentle sweetness that lingers on the skin with comfort and softness. The result is a balanced composition that feels both modern and meaningful, blending freshness, florals and warmth into a harmonious signature.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=V6W9G0F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Body Mist brings the brand's beloved Bum Bum Cream scent to life in a light, wearable spray that transports the senses to a warm summer's day on the coast of Rio. Vibrant, playful and effortlessly uplifting, it captures a holiday feeling that lingers from morning to evening. The fragrance opens with warming notes of pistachio and almond layered with a soft bloom of jasmine petals. A base of sandalwood and salted caramel accords adds a smooth, creamy depth that feels indulgent without being heavy, settling into a long-lasting trail that stays close to the skin throughout the day. Light enough for daily use, this body mist offers an easy way to layer scent or refresh throughout the day. A go-to for anyone drawn to warm, sweet and tropical-inspired fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FTUDPF8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist is a sparkling floral fragrance that captures the feeling of a sun-soaked tropical escape. Light, vibrant and effortlessly wearable, it carries the warmth and energy of a distant shoreline from the first spray to the last lingering note. The fragrance opens with bright top notes of pink dragonfruit and lychee that feel fresh and juicy on the skin. A heart of Brazilian jasmine, ocean air and hibiscus adds an airy, uplifting quality that brings to mind open skies and warm coastal breezes. Creamy vanilla and sun musk settle into the base, adding a soft sensual warmth that rounds out the scent beautifully. Fresh, floral and fun, this body mist is a go-to for those who love a lively, sun-inspired fragrance that wears easily throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YMORG7W]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense is a bold woody aromatic fragrance that captures confidence, energy and modern masculinity. Designed for those who want to stand out, it delivers a rich and addictive scent profile that feels both daring and refined from the first spray. The fragrance opens with a striking hit of cardamom, bringing an immediate spicy freshness that feels vibrant and attention grabbing. As it develops, a warm toffee accord takes over at the heart, adding sweetness and depth that gives the scent its distinctive, indulgent character. The base settles into smooth amberwood, creating a lasting woody warmth that lingers on the skin with strength and sophistication. This gift set includes a 100ml Eau de Parfum spray, a 75ml shower gel and a 10ml travel spray, making it ideal for both everyday use and on the go.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EA666TN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} If you're tired of overly sweet or overly aggressive fragrances, this lands in a better place. The oak gives it a dry woody backbone while the hazelnut adds warmth without tipping into gourmand territory. It's the kind of scent that quietly suits you rather than announces itself. Works well on its own for anyone who likes subtler fragrances, or layer it with something else if you want more presence. The staying power is decent for a cologne but not all day, so you might want to reapply midday if that matters to you.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=M7XEFPM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum is a vibrant floral fragrance that moves from bright citrus into warm, creamy depth. Invigorating, feminine and seductive. The scent opens with a lively burst of mandarin and orange flower petals, setting an energetic, uplifting tone from the start. At the heart, hibiscus and delicate freesia bloom into a lush floral mid-section that feels both rich and easy to wear. The dry down deepens into smooth vanilla and moody musks, creating a creamy, skin-close warmth that lingers. A fragrance that transitions naturally from daytime freshness into something more sultry by evening, I Want Choo With Love is a versatile option that suits a range of occasions and seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Forever Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YUFA7I8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Narciso Rodriguez For Her Forever Eau de Parfum is a luminous floral chypre built around the house's signature musc heart, marking the 20th anniversary of the iconic For Her line. Sensual, elegant and timeless. The fragrance opens with soft frangipani buds and gardenia, easing into a rich floral heart of jasmine, tuberose and osmanthus flower. Each layer feels lush yet controlled, building depth without heaviness. At the base, the signature heart of muscs returns alongside earthy patchouli, grounding the composition with a warm, intimate trail that feels both familiar and fresh. Housed in a refined glass bottle that transitions from black at the top to a delicate pink at the base, For Her Forever carries a quiet sophistication that suits both daytime and evening wear across all seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GLRO3PA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Wrap yourself in the tactile sensuality of Tom Ford Ombré Leather Parfum, a deeper, more intoxicating interpretation of the original Eau De Parfum. A richer take on the much-loved leather scent, this unisex fragrance turns up the intensity and smoothness in equal measure. It opens on the crisp freshness of violet leaf absolute, a green vibrancy that gives way to an elegant touch of cedarwood. A luminous heart of jasmine sambac absolute, harvested before the monsoon season, reveals a delicate fruity-floral nuance reminiscent of honeysuckle, while hints of green tobacco weave through to add depth and character. A double concentration of orris heart leaves an irresistibly smooth, lingering trail, giving the parfum its sumptuous, long-lasting finish. A great choice for anyone who loves leather scents with a green, floral lift and a soft, powdery depth.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=N2GR14V]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Ombré Leather Parfum 100ml is the deepest, most intoxicating expression of the iconic Ombré Leather, a richer interpretation of the original Eau De Parfum. Smooth, sensual and tactile, this unisex fragrance is all about luxurious depth, here in a generous full size. Violet leaf absolute opens the scent with a crisp, green freshness that soon softens into elegant cedarwood. At its heart, jasmine sambac absolute harvested before the monsoon season brings a delicate fruity-floral nuance, like honeysuckle, while green tobacco threads through the composition to add character and warmth. A double concentration of orris heart gives the parfum its irresistibly smooth, powdery finish and a trail that lingers beautifully. In 100ml, it's a great everyday choice for anyone who loves leather scents with a green, floral lift, with plenty to go around.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Oud Minerale Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=URVN6XR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Strike a note of mystery with Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau De Parfum, a unisex fragrance that mixes refreshing marine notes with the richness of oud. A contrasting fusion of elements, it's an unusual, head-turning scent suitable for wear any time of day, any time of year. Rich oud combines with fresh pink peppercorn, fir balsam and ambergris, balancing smoky woods and musks against a cool, aquatic freshness. The result is distinctive and intriguing, oud given an unexpected marine twist rather than the usual heavy, resinous treatment. Packaged in a deep bronze-coloured bottle, it's as striking to look at as it is to wear. A great choice for anyone who loves woody, smoky scents but fancies something fresher and more original, and a fragrance that works equally well on men and women.

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PTU3U8Y]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Strike a note of mystery with Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau De Parfum, a unisex fragrance that mixes refreshing marine notes with the richness of oud. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C8CI83N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Capture the spirit of the sea with Tom Ford Costa Azzurra, a unisex fragrance that tantalises the senses with memories of sea air and salty waters. Woody, citrus and aromatic, it's an evocative scent that conjures a sun-soaked Mediterranean coastline. Top notes of driftwood, seaweed, oud, ambrette and cardamom bring a hint of spice to the sea breeze, before an intriguing heart of lavender, lemon, juniper, mandarin, artemisia and myrtle unfolds. Velvety woods of vetiver, oak, olibanum, incense and vanilla then form the base, creating an olfactory feast of deep woods, evergreens and citrus. Fresh yet warm, aromatic yet grounded, Costa Azzurra works beautifully whatever the season. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau De Parfum 100ml Spray

A great choice for anyone who loves soft, warm florals with a sweet, sensual depth, equally suited to men and women.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HQJBQ9G]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Immerse the senses in a cocoon of oriental florals with Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum, a bold, glamorous fragrance that's the height of femininity. A great choice for anyone who loves rich, glamorous florals with a warm, honeyed depth.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger TH Bold Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

In a generous 100ml size, there's plenty for a regular signature.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl New York Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q6J5OO2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl New York Eau De Toilette 100ml is a floral fruity fragrance for women, launched in 2025 to capture the energy, optimism and rhythm of New York City. Bright and easy to wear, Tommy Girl New York is a lovely everyday choice for spring and summer, or anyone who loves fresh fruity florals with a soft woody finish. A modern, city-inspired update on the much-loved Tommy Girl line.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Now Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PDMBN7R]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Now Eau De Toilette 100ml is a bright, energetic floral fragrance for women, launched in 2018 as a fresh, contemporary take on the much-loved Tommy Girl. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Berry Crush Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray

A great choice for evenings and cooler weather, and for anyone who loves smooth, spicy woods with a sophisticated, sensual edge.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Iced Cologne Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JYPU7PM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} YSL Y Iced Eau De Toilette Intense is a striking, icy take on the Y line, a vibrant aromatic fragrance for men built around a clean, cooling freshness. A rock'n'roll duo of living mint and blue sage, sourced from YSL's Ourika Community Gardens, sharpens the icy, aromatic facets, before woody base notes of ambroxan and Indonesian patchouli add a sophisticated, sensual depth that anchors the scent. Presented in a masculine, elegant glacial blue bottle, redesigned to last up to three times longer per spray, it unleashes fresh power with every press. A great choice for anyone who loves cool, minty aromatics with a warm, woody finish.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Really Her! Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=P0RDVO6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Zadig & Voltaire This Is Really Her! A great choice for anyone who loves bold floral ambers with a warm, sweet depth.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Really Him! Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml Spray

The silver bottle echoes the glow of Paris at night, its sharp, elegant shapes and metallic-finish label reflecting the fragrance's own metallic accords. A great choice for anyone who loves fresh citrus openings that settle into warm, woody amber.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Gold Fresh Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RY6U370]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Make your elegance sparkle with Moschino Gold Fresh Couture Eau De Parfum, a fruity floral fragrance for women with warm woody facets. Deep in the base, warm woods of sandalwood and akigalawood meet musk and vanilla, lending the fragrance a subtle, hard-to-resist sensuality. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Pink Fresh Couture Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=I9R830W]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Moschino Pink Fresh Couture Eau De Toilette is a refreshing fruity floral fragrance for women, made for those who love a bit of humour and hyperbole. A sparkling, happy composition with a playful spirit, it invites you to forget your preconceptions and find beauty in the most unexpected places. It opens on a pleasant rush of pink grapefruit, blackcurrant and lily of the valley, before a magical bouquet of pink hyacinth and wild rose unfolds, accompanied by juicy pomegranate. It's the kind of quirky touch that puts a smile on your face every time you reach for it. A great choice for anyone who loves bright, cheerful fruity florals with a sense of humour.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Funny! Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E6STH8T]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bright, witty and full of life, Moschino Funny! is a playful fruity floral for women that doesn't take itself too seriously. Energising and radiant, it blends charm with vitality and tenderness with spontaneity, made for the joyful, easygoing woman with a sense of fun. The scent kicks off with a lively, slightly spicy burst of pink pepper, Seville orange and redcurrant, before opening into a luminous floral heart of jasmine and peony, freshened with a leafy touch of green tea. As it settles, amber and cedar bring a warm, woody depth that keeps the fragrance grounded and lingering on the skin. Easy to wear and effortlessly cheerful, Funny! suits everyday moments and warmer days especially well. A lovely pick for anyone who loves fresh, fruity florals with a light-hearted, spontaneous character.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Gummy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MN1P2LK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Meet your new sweet obsession. Bold and indulgent, it's like a delicious caramel candy reimagined for the grown-up fragrance lover. It kicks off with a fresh, sparkling burst of bergamot and juicy blood orange, given an unexpected twist by wine essence and the rich, toasted crunch of golden hazelnut. As it settles, things turn seriously indulgent: a velvety praline accord melts into a dreamy milk cream accord, kept from being too sweet by the spicy, woody depth of akigalawood. The dry-down is where the sensuality lives, with resinous myrrh and balsamic benzoin creating a warm glow as Madagascan vanilla lingers on a soft, musky veil. A great choice for anyone who loves rich gourmands with real warmth and a grown-up edge.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EAA7A3Q]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bright, playful and effortlessly feminine, Moschino Eau De Toilette for Women strikes a balance between youthful energy and modern chic. It opens on a sparkling burst of fresh citrus and juicy pear that quickly unfolds into a flirtatious floral heart, lively and upbeat without ever tipping into too sweet, a scent for confident, fun-loving women who like to leave a memorable impression. At its heart, soft floral accords of peony and jasmine rest on a warm, subtly creamy base of musks and light woods, giving the fragrance a clean, wearable finish. That structure keeps it airy and easygoing for daytime, yet layered enough to carry through to evening plans, noticeable and approachable rather than overpowering. Housed in Moschino's stylishly whimsical bottle, it's ideal for everyday wear, weekend outings or gifting to someone who loves contemporary, spirited fragrances. A great choice for anyone after a modern signature that's fun, fresh and easy to wear.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J8QMC4W]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Reveal your soft and playful side with Moschino Toy 2 Eau De Parfum, a floral woody fragrance for women with a hint of musk. Moschino's iconic teddy bear makes a distinctive return with this 2019 follow-up, combining fresh fruity notes with elegant florals and comforting musk for a delicious, eminently wearable everyday scent. Designed to make you feel good, it opens on sparkling mandarin and sharp Granny Smith apple lifted by delicate magnolia, before blending into a sophisticated heart of jasmine, peony and crisp white currant. This addictive combination then mellows into a radiant, soft dry-down of amber woods, sandalwood and crystalline musk. Part of the charm is the bottle: the iconic Moschino teddy reimagined as a collectable frosted glass figure, finished with a classy gold collar. A softer, more sophisticated take on the original Toy, it's a must for Moschino fans and a lovely choice for anyone who loves fresh fruity florals with a warm, musky base.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Uomo Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HV2SV60]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Moschino Uomo is a fresh, fragrant note of wonder created to reawaken the modern man's sense of smell. Designed for the man navigating a world that increasingly questions roles and conventions, it's a scent made to astound and delight, fresh and thoroughly contemporary. It begins with an unusual top note of cyclamen, cinnamon and clary sage, at once profound and generous, before a virile freshness comes through in the heart with coriander seed, kumquat and rosewood. These then blend comfortably over a lively base of cedarwood, amber and musk, lending the fragrance a warm, woody finish. Crisp, spicy and easy to wear, Moschino Uomo is a great everyday choice for the modern man. A good pick for anyone who likes fresh, aromatic scents with a warm, woody depth.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Yummy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C4PUDK5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Looking for a scent that feels like bottled sunshine? Moschino Yummy is a high-energy women's fragrance built on citrus zest, floral elegance and a spicy kick, the fine-fragrance answer to your favourite fizzy lemon candy. Bright and optimistic, it's designed for those who want a daily dose of joy. The heart is where the fizz happens, with luminous geranium and radiant sambac jasmine joined by a double hit of Timut pepper and black pepper for an addictive, energetic edge. As it dries down, velvety Bulgarian rose takes centre stage, grounded by earthy Haitian vetiver and wrapped in a soft, musky finish. If Moschino Gummy is the decadent dessert, Yummy is the sparkling cocktail, its peppery heart mimicking that fizzy citrus-candy sensation without losing its couture edge. Bright, bold and brilliantly wearable, it's a great choice for anyone who needs an instant mood boost.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Pearl Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

This zesty opening gives way to an elegant heart of jasmine, a sand accord and freesia, evoking an island paradise surrounded by crystal-blue waters, before rounding off with sweet vetiver and invigorating cypress. Each bottle is finished in iridescent, pearly hues reminiscent of treasures from the ocean floor, with tones that vary slightly to make every one enchantingly unique. A lovely choice for anyone who loves fresh, citrussy florals with a soft, green woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Pink Bouquet Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

A great pick for anyone who loves fresh, fruity florals with a gently sweet, musky base.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy 2 Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

Housed in a striking matte charcoal grey bottle, it balances a spicy, electric opening with a deeply comforting, velvety base, a sensory journey designed for those looking to escape the ordinary. It opens with an energising burst of sharp nutmeg and sparkling ginger that instantly wakes up the senses, before wrapping you in a rich, sophisticated embrace of intense coffee, punctuated by the bold, woody-spicy edge of akigalawood. It then settles into a smooth, luxurious trail of myrrh and earthy vetiver, offering a comforting, second-skin warmth that still surprises at every turn. Bold, unexpected and full of ironic charm, Toy Boy 2 is the ultimate antidote to the everyday grey. A great choice for anyone who loves warm, spicy gourmands with a deep, woody character.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Green Wood Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KQ7CMQA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DSquared2 Green Wood Eau De Toilette is a woody aromatic fragrance for men, launched in 2019 to capture a sense of effortless personal style. Combining earthy woods with aromatic herbs and a refreshing citrus lift, it's a versatile scent that wears just as well by day as it does in the evening. Juicy lemon, santolina and aromatic bourbon pepper greet you first, bright and a little spicy, before the warmth of cedar, vetiver and resin begins to take over at the heart. As it settles, a base of cypriol, ambroxan and musk lingers on the skin, lending the fragrance a smooth, earthy depth. The bottle is minimalist yet stylish, made from green glass and finished with a distinctive wooden cap. A great everyday choice for anyone who loves fresh, woody scents with an aromatic, slightly peppery character.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Icon Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SHJYG4N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DSquared2 Icon Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml is a floral woody musk fragrance for women, weaving together floral, fruity and ambery notes into a genuinely enchanting scent. Warm yet vibrant, it's a versatile everyday fragrance with a gourmand twist. It opens on the refreshing zest of citrus, with the effervescence heightened by radiant, spicy pink pepper. This leads into a delicate heart that blends fragrant jasmine with crunchy praline for a distinctly gourmand feel, before the composition concludes in a warm, enveloping dry-down of sandalwood, sensual musk, creamy vanilla and woodsy ash. That move from bright and spicy to sweet and woody gives the fragrance real depth and wearability. In this generous 100ml size, it's a lovely choice for anyone who loves floral gourmands with a soft, musky, slightly woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Icon Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MP1OLHW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DSquared2 Icon Pour Homme Eau De Parfum 100ml is an aromatic fougère amber fragrance for men, with an elegant composition that brings together warming, floral and boldly assertive notes. Confident and contemporary, it's a versatile scent with real depth and character. It opens on zesty, sun-soaked citrus, energised by enlivening, spicy ginger, before leading into a sophisticated floral heart where aromatic clary sage, lavender, geranium and rare black tulip combine in an unusual melange. The fragrance then culminates in a warm, earthy dry-down, as balsamic cedarwood and peppery akigalawood meet the rich, deep musk of patchouli. That balance of fresh citrus, aromatic florals and warm woods makes it easy to wear day or night. In this generous 100ml size, it's a great choice for anyone who loves modern fougères with an aromatic lift and a deep, woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Icon Pour Homme 100ml Aftershave Balm
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XAVI181]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The DSquared2 Icon Pour Homme Aftershave Balm 100ml brings the brand's aromatic fougère fragrance into your grooming routine, soothing and comforting the skin after shaving while leaving it lightly scented. A simple way to round off your shave with the confident character of Icon Pour Homme. Its smooth balm formula calms and conditions freshly shaved skin, helping to reduce that post-shave tightness, while carrying the fragrance's signature notes, a zesty, spicy opening of citrus and ginger, an aromatic floral heart of lavender, clary sage and geranium, and a warm base of cedarwood, akigalawood and patchouli. Use it as the finishing step after shaving, on its own or alongside the Icon Pour Homme Eau De Parfum to layer the scent. At 100ml, it's an easy everyday addition for anyone who loves aromatic, woody fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Original Wood Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R6Y66OP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Who hasn't at one time or another wanted to escape into the heart of nature and draw new strength far from civilisation? DSquared2 Original Wood Eau De Parfum 50ml is built around exactly that feeling, a woody, spicy men's fragrance that transports you to the middle of a majestic forest. Created by perfumer Daphné Bugey, it lets a little of the wild into your life. It opens on a refined interplay of fresh violet leaf, aquatic notes and sweet, aromatic cardamom, before the real star comes to the fore: a breathtaking composition of woods, with subtle cedar and the captivating, spicy essence of silver fir, accompanied by the earthy purity of Haitian vetiver. The finale is dark and sensual, with spellbinding musk, sweet earthy patchouli and warm amber. That journey from fresh and green to deep and woody gives the scent real character. In this 50ml size, it's a great choice for self-assured men who love intense, woody fragrances with an aromatic, slightly aquatic lift.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Original Wood Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G7Y3GWL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DSquared2 Original Wood Eau De Parfum 100ml is an invitation to escape into the wild, a woody, spicy fragrance for men that conjures the calm and strength of a majestic forest. Created by perfumer Daphné Bugey, it's intense, masculine and made for those moments when you want to leave civilisation behind and simply be yourself. Fresh violet leaf, cool aquatic notes and sweet, aromatic cardamom open the scent with a green, slightly spicy lift, before the woods take centre stage. Subtle cedar and the captivating, spicy essence of silver fir are joined by earthy Haitian vetiver, lending real depth, before a dark, sensual base of musk, patchouli and warm amber brings the composition to a close. In this generous 100ml size, Original Wood is a great everyday choice for self-assured, sophisticated men who love deep, woody scents with an aromatic, aquatic edge. Plenty of fragrance for a true wardrobe staple.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Red Wood Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

That move from tart and spicy to floral and softly woody gives the fragrance real charm. listings.rawTitle: Hugo boss Ma Vie Florale Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss XX Woman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Homme Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YD63NJB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey have added another sleek flanker to their range. listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QMO6J8V]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Launched in 2011, an aromatic-fruity fragrance for both men and women. listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Ma Vie Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IUHYRKW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss perfume takes the sense of smell to a new, unmatched level. The base notes of fragrant cedarwood linger for hours after the initial spray, rounding out the completely enrapturing experience for your sense of smell. Hugo Boss Ma Vie is a delight for whoever dons this transcendent fragrance, and for those who venture close enough to them. This scent will be sure to last for many of your adventures.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Orange Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray

Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Essence de Parfum has a delightful intro of spicy Chantilly (evoking spiced whipped cream) adorned with a fresh scent of white flowers and an ambery, woody coda makes this creation of Jean Paul a truly magical experience and a bold statement of what it is to be feminine. listings.rawTitle: Prada La Femme Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Black XS For Her Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray

If you like to wear a perfume that is slightly different from the rest, this eau de parfum is a must.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

You will find all of the fragrances associated with spring from countries across the world. Lily of the Valley, jasmine, plum and mandarin orange blossoms are all in there. Finally, subtle notes of Bergamot and Musk will burst through. The 50ml eau de parfum bottle is a master piece of simplicity. It looks classy and sophisticated as it comes out of its box. Best of all, it will carry on to look stunning on any lady's dressers. A fantastic buy when you are looking for a gift or a special personal buy for yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: As bright as a diamond, a scent to seduce. A trail of fresh white flowers, warmed with woods. Bursting: neroli and bitter orange collide with a ripple of raspberry. Intense: orange blossom absolute and sambac jasmine. Addictive: entwined, honey and sexy patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette 100ml Travel Set
listings.description: The scent of victory, the essence of heroes. A daring smash-up of freshness and heat. Marine and grapefruit flirt with the warm breath of gaïac wood and ambergris. Ecstatically addictive, a powerful stimulant. In it to win.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Chloe Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray + 20ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: Discover Chloe Eau de Parfum, the iconic feminine fragrance suited to a free spirit with an utterly innate sense of chic. The scent takes the classic rose and ingeniously translates it into a vivid perfume: feminine, natural & sexy.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: A fresh-oriental, powerfully discreet. The divine union of exalted floral freshness and a skin-loving salty-vanilla accord. A revelation in green mandarin and vanilla that blooms with jasmine and ginger flower, wrapped up in cashmere wood and Ambergris. A sublime wake. Divine.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Male Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U2JIQQO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau is a one off. If you have never bought a branded top class male scent before, this is the one that you must buy. Yes, Jean Paul may be a little bit avant-garde but as far as scents go, he really knows what he is doing. This is exactly what this male eau de toilette goes to prove. What does Le Beau smell like? It has to be pointed out that this is not a complicated scent. Perhaps that is what makes it such a popular entry to the men's fragrances. The first note that you will discover is of Bergamot. The second fragrance you will immediately recognise is coconut. Then your nose will go on to find Tonka bean. It is the combination that makes this such a stand-out fragrance. As always, Jean Paul has produced a bottle that is a real classic. The 75ml bottle even features a leaf just in the right place. The scent makes a great gift or a fantastic personal purchase.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Dream Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: Light and airy, 'Daisy Dream' captivates with its delectably fruity and floral personality. From the first hints of blackberry, fresh grapefruit and succulent pear, 'Daisy Dream' draws you in with her easy charm and an irresistibly feminine mix of jasmine flower, lychee and blue wisteria. The fragrance lingers on the skin, drying down to a dreamy finish of white woods, musk and an elusive hint of coconut water. This free-spirited fruity-floral scent is the creation of Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. Strewn with delicate daisies on its shoulders and cap, the clear-glass bottle reveals a sky-blue fragrance - the colour of a dream.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Oscar Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Oscar is a classic, floral, slightly sharp perfume launched back in 1977. The perfume includes notes of lavender, rosemary and carnation, with sweet, powdery and musky base notes. Gift set comprises of 100ml Spray, 250ml Body Mist & 15ml Purse Spray.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Night Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GLL1L48]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This masculine EDT captures the intensity of the night and a man who likes to shine. The evocative scent is fresh, floral, and woody which develops on the skin to last into the morning without being overpowering. Packaged in the same ovular bottle as Obsession, except with a tinted blue finish, the fragrance epitomises Calvin Klein’s minimal approach to style. Top notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Bitter Orange and White Flowers. Jasmine, Gardenia, Lily and Rose. Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Cashmere and Honey.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Dahlia Divin Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Dahlia Divin makes its perfumery debut with notes of golden fruit including mirabelle plum. Entwined with the aroma of a bouquet of white flowers, highlighted by jasmine, the fragrance develops fully with the rich alluring woody tones of sandalwood for a strikingly delightful aura. The woman who wears it is sublime and sensual, like a modern goddess.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Pure XS Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The first-born who has also inherited an exceedingly hot physique. Remarkably young, extremely brilliant, insanely wealthy [of course], hugely beautiful. Excess in its purest state. His sex-appeal is disturbing, beyond-control. It would appear he has it all, a pure utopia. Pure desire. Magnetic, excess in its purest state. A contemporary design that gives rise to the idea of a lighter, Pure XS opens up, one handed with a black lacquered cap. The bottle is a weighty glass with polished edges: instinctive and substantial. Packaged in velvet [of course], all is luxuriously sensual. Electric blue and gold, the shock of sensory contradictions. Explosive freshness and burning sensuality. Robust, manly, irresistible vapours that hover between the purity of raw desire and the pleasure of excess.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Bella Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: In 2018, Les Belles de Nina are unveiling a third chapter in their saga. A new modern-day princess is joining this duo: Bella. The iconic apple is being decked with a pop green, which is as daring as it is magnetic. The bottle reveals Bella’s irreverence and femininity, marked with her ardour. Golden leaves rustle beneath the feet of a mysterious ladybird, the inseparable partner of this new Nina Ricci eau de toilette. In her heroine wake, a vibrant fruity gourmand eau de toilette in which daringly indulgent rhubarb is refreshed by the romantic femininity of Rose jelly. 80ml.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DRY2V6K]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The composition plays a dynamic rhythm from the very first note. The soft tempo opens with aromatic lavender and effervescent pepper. Warmed by smooth Peru balsam, iris begins a floral solo balancing strength and delicacy. The woody tones of patchouli and the sensuality of black vanilla reveal an addictive oriental note. A rich, textured signature with a rhythm that stays on the skin until the end of the night. Lacquered from the inside with an intense black, the radical bottle is a bold expression of masculine sophistication. Givenchy Gentleman, the ultimate in timeless elegance and refinement.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Male Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CK0KIOA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau is one of the most classic men's fragrances and scents in the world. Since it was first introduced, it has achieved a very loyal following. Yet, there are many men out there that have not as yet discovered it. With its woody scent, it is certainly a very masculine scent. Is Le Beau heavy? Often you will find that a woody scent is heavy. But, that is not what you get with this eau de toilette. The undertones are light and refreshing. That is what makes it so seductive. As the scent lingers, you start picking up gentle notes that may remind you of a walk in a forest after rain. The 200ml bottle also makes a real statement. You just instantly know that this is an offering from Jean Paul Gaultier. Give it away as a present to the man in your life or buy it for yourself as a personal treat.

listings.rawTitle: Mont Blanc Presence D'Une Femme Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: The crisp freshness of cracking pineapple leaves fuses with the sparkling pervasive aroma of pepper and tangerine. A modern floral bouquet of cyclamen and orchid and final sensation of sandalwood, palisanderwood, vanilla flower and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Bleu Noir Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A woody spicy fragrance for the mysterious, modern and elegant man. It opens with top notes of nutmeg and cardamom, a musky heart note, and a base made up of cedar, ebony wood, vetiver, and...

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Tresor Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray + 3 Products Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GJYTFEQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lancome Perfume is one of the world’s leading perfumers. When you are looking for a new feminine fragrance, it is one of the best brands to explore. You can say the fragrances offered are crafted rather than created. One of the best scents offered by the brand is Tresor Perfume. What does it smell like? Unusually, the scent opens with apricot blossom and rose. The middle notes are classic - lilac, iris and peach. You simply can’t go wrong with this combination. Finally, sandalwood, amber, musk and vanilla make an appearance. If you are looking for a fragrance which is going to last the day or night, this is the perfect choice. Perfume Price is delighted to offer this gift set Lancome complete with 100ml EDP. The set allows you to make the most out of the qualities the fragrance has to offer. Chances are this offer is not going to hang around for long. Take the opportunity to snap it up for yourself or buy it for someone special. Set Includes: 100ml EDP + Cleanser + Genifique Serum + Cream

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Givree Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R5ISEKS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Terre d’Hermes Eau Givree Eau de Parfum combines the vigour of citron and the incisive freshness of juniper berry with the power of Timut pepper. The striking sensation of an icy breeze is juxtaposed with the generosity of the woody, mineral notes characteristic of Terre d’Hermes. Terre d’Hermes Eau Givree explores a new territory where freshness and strength nourish each other. 'An icy cloak fertilises the earth, exalting it with new and vibrant strength.' Christine Nagel, creative director of Hermes fragrances. Terre d’Hermes Eau Givree encapsulates in a bottle two contradictions, two opposites- an icy tremor and generous power. The Eau de Parfum combines the vigour of citron, the incisive freshness of juniper berry and the power of Timut pepper. GIFT SET CONTENTS: Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml Shower Gel 80ml 12.5 ml EDP

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=M87RYUG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia invites all who encounter it to give in to their heart’s desire with a floral and delicately sweet blend. A signature floral scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its scent trail. SET CONTENTS: - 100ml Eau de Parfum Spray - 10ml Spray - 50ml Lotion

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CGI2O97]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Intense Eau de Parfum Spray, a fresh and mysterious take on an iconic classic incorporating the Black Opium signature of black coffee with the thrilling aura of blue absinthe. This electrifying and unashamedly bold fragrance beckons the night, where anything is possible, and spirits come alive. Inspired by an independent woman who follows her intuition and desires at all times; nothing can stop her. Black Opium Intense is for the female who is excited by the possibility of what the night holds. She is sensual, alluring and intensely intriguing. Black Opium Intense opens with blue absinthe, flavoured with wormwood and aromatic herbs, combining with boysenberry for a hit of thrilling freshness which effortlessly melts into refreshing orange blossom and jasmine, omitting a wave of sensual femininity at the heart of this ultra-seductive perfume. At the base, overpowering desire takes over as femininity plunges to the dark side, and sultry notes of coffee, liquorice, sandalwood are enhanced by creamy vanilla, creating a sultry warmth that is sure to leave an unforgettable trail and will last long into the night.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R18J98O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This gift set contains Libre Eau de Parfum 50ml and Libre Shower Gel 50ml. A grand floral Eau de Parfum with an unequivocal YSL twist. The burning sensuality of the orange blossom flowers from Morocco, twisted with the aromatic boldness of lavender from France. Lavender, traditionally used in male perfumery is given an ultra-sensual facet for a women's perfume that is both fiery and couture, with that uniquely androgynous YSL attitude. Crafted by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm. - Top notes: tangerine, neroli, lavender - Heart notes: jasmine sambac, orange blossom - Base notes: white musks, vanilla extract - Key notes: orange blossom, lavender

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OQ3WDY5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Y Eau de Parfum represents the balance between freshness and strength. A crisp, refined and powerful fragrancer with notes of bergamot, sage and cedarwood. This 3-piece set contains a 100ml Eau de Parfum spray +10ml Eau de Parfum +10ml Eau de Toilette travel sprays wrapped in a silver & bold holiday gift box.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Paris Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BNL94XU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created by Yves Saint Laurent to reflect a contemporary Parisian attitude, this gorgeous fragrance contains a decadent bouquet and a big dash of fun. Fruity, floral harmonies create a light-hearted scent that will put a happy spring back into your step. Romantic, ultra feminine, exquisitely refined, the scent of a rose in full bloom: YSL Paris, the perfume Yves Saint Laurent designed to give to the world the glamour and allure of the city he loved above all. In a tempered crystal flacon. Fragrance Notes: Top: Bergamot, Violet & Orange Blossom Heart: Rose Centifoila & Iris Base: Sandalwood, Amber & Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Paris Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F0BYKDS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created by Yves Saint Laurent to reflect a contemporary Parisian attitude, this gorgeous fragrance contains a decadent bouquet and a big dash of fun. Fruity, floral harmonies create a light-hearted scent that will put a happy spring back into your step. Romantic, ultra feminine, exquisitely refined, the scent of a rose in full bloom: YSL Paris, the perfume Yves Saint Laurent designed to give to the world the glamour and allure of the city he loved above all. In a tempered crystal flacon. Top: Bergamot, Violet & Orange Blossom Heart: Rose Centifoila & Iris Base: Sandalwood, Amber & Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VHRUO3D]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lady million describes a determined, insightful and seductive woman. With very clear ideas and a high power of conviction. A woman who imposes her rules and does not allow herself to be overshadowed by anyone in any situation. This fragrance was launched in 2010 by perfumers Anne Flipo, Beatrice Piquet, Dominique Ropion and Bruno Jovanovic. It is a sweet perfume, and with eighties allusions. A song to the modern and enterprising woman, who always remains in the foreground and loves herself. A sexy and outgoing profile, who knows how to exploit his best qualities and thus seduces and falls in love wherever he goes. Set has 80ml Spray, 5ml Spray and a 100ml Body Lotion.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 NYC Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WHK73J0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} An eclectic mix of street and book smart 212 Men NYC represents a new generation of urban dwellers; a man with his eye on the future but respect for the past. The sleek metallic cylindrical design of the bottle mimics the architectural design of the city, with a technological reference captured by the tactile magnetic closure. 212 Men NYC contrasts the energetic green freshness with the sensual warmth of the spices in the peppery heart of the scent. The warm personalities of sandalwood and gaiac wood accentuate its masculine base. Top notes: Citrus Leaves, Cut Grass, Spice Leaves. Middle notes: Green Pepper, Ginger, Gardenia Petals. Base notes: Sandalwood, Gaiac Wood, Incense, White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Shalimar Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GFSFTNH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Give the gift of timeless sensuality with the GUERLAIN Shalimar Eau de Parfum Spray Gift Set, a sumptuous spicy oriental fragrance of legendary status. Shalimar has spent almost 100 years enchanting women and men the world over, weaving its mesmerising oriental spell to create an unforgettable trail. Its passionate fragrance is inspired by the ardent tale of true love between an emperor and an Indian princess, embodied in an elegant yet completely seductive creation that never fails to inspire. This luxurious gift set is presented in beautiful packaging and would make the perfect gift for the timeless, sophisticated and special woman in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes H24 Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QK73AY4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This gift set comprises an H24 Eau de Toilette 100ml and an Eau de Toilette miniature 12.5ml. The aromatic, botanical freshness of H24 Eau de Toilette is underpinned by a blend of enveloping clary sage, electric narcissus, invigorating rosewood and warm, metallic sclarene. H24 is the first perfume expressing the contemporary man as seen by Hermès. A lively, sensual and bright perfume, stemming from the daring blend between nature and technology.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Absolu Pour Homme Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E2HIROE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} An addictive, gourmand woody accord rises on the breeze, trailing through to sleepless nights. The scandal is only getting started. A scandalously intense woody gourmand. An intensely concentrated fragrance from Natalie Cetto, Quentin Bisch and Christophe Raynaud. The secret to spreading scandal on the French capital’s party scene? An addictive soul powered by ultra-sensual precious ingredients. This decadent, intense woody fragrance surprises the senses with a gourmand chestnut note underpinned by glorious sandalwood and unexpected, gilded mirabelle plum. Outrageously bold! A bottle with presence. As the evening lingers on, its lacquered gold shines bright in the darkness. Strong, sharp and designed to turn heads. A presence you never forget. A hypnotic palette of graduated shades. All eyes are on this one. Utterly indecent! This king of darkness sits on a throne of scandal, rebelling in the limelight.

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T2SG8N4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A new Scandal Absolu by Jean Paul Gaultier is setting Parisian nights aflame.
