listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WF7LWFJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Vibrant. Tropical. Floral. The Calvin Klein Eternity Reflections fragrances are inspired by the spontaneous, intimate moments shared between a couple at the beach. Against the backdrop of a hot summer day, two lovers indulge in acts of playfulness, creating memories in the sparkling waves and salty sea air. The quintessential summer romance. Calvin Klein Eternity Reflections for Women Eau de Parfum, a vibrant fruity floral, opens with luscious pear and sparkling citrus notes of blood orange. Jasmine Absolute adds an intensely floral and warm facet at the heart of this beautiful fragrance that blends seamlessly with sandalwood for an energetic yet delicate dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier Declaration Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IWYV9FA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Declaration Parfum by Cartier is a rich, amber-woody fragrance for men. It's packed with bold notes of cedar, leather, and amber, giving it a deep, intense vibe. You'll pick up hints of wood, balsamic, leather, and spices, making it complex and captivating. This scent is all about making a statement and expressing emotions. Even though it's rich and intense, there's a fresh note that keeps it lively. If you want a fragrance that leaves a lasting, woody, and spiced trail, Déclaration Parfum is a great choice. Perfect for moments when you want to say something that matters.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes 24 Faubourg Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QQ1S4V2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} In 1996, perfumer Maurice Roucel crafted 24 Faubourg eau de parfum, inspired by the sunny Mediterranean and Indian Ocean. This fragrance is a burst of floral and amber notes with radiant orange blossom, sunny jasmine, and warm vanilla. Designed by Serge Mansau, the bottle looks like a sunlit silk scarf gently blowing in the breeze. Named after the first Hermès store on Rue du Faubourg-Saint-Honoré in Paris, blending tradition with modern flair. Feel: Warm, Sensual Key ingredients: Orange blossom, Jasmine, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OGFW10Y]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Good Girl Blush by Carolina Herrera is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. Make those around you blush in your presence. A beautiful fragrance that combines floral and fruity notes with a touch of warmth and sensuality. The top notes of the fragrance include luscious fruits such as bergamot and mandarin, while the heart notes feature a delicate floral bouquet of peony, ylang-ylang and rose. The base notes of the fragrance are warm and sensual, featuring woody notes and a touch of vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SGXQC4O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover Invictus Victory Elixir, the pinnacle of intensity from Invictus, the new powerful fragrance for men by Paco Rabanne. A potent elixir made to push victory beyond limits. The time has come to embrace your moment of immortality. A rich, powerful, long-lasting nectar that blends spicy woods and a sharp freshness. It's the ultimate expression of victory. Never stop winning. The quintessence of Invictus Victory. A precious amber-woody and spicy elixir with high-impact. Leading to high-performance, highly concentrated ingredients for maximum intensity. A rush of freshness boosts aromatic lavandin from Provence with the bite of green cardamom and the crunch of black pepper. At dark, mysterious incense blends with the woody opulence of Indonesian patchouli. The delicious nectar of tonka bean liqueur adds depth and elegance to a delectable overdose of vanilla bean sourced in Madagascar. The addictive scent of victory.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J0HC2SB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum is a captivating blend of floral, amber, and woody notes, embodying the powerful delicacy of modern femininity. With Jasmine superinfusion, warm Amber, vibrant AmbrofixTM, and a bold Moss accord, it creates a profound and enigmatic scent. The bottle's minimalist design, inspired by Prada's iconic triangle logo, mirrors the fragrance's essence of reinvention. Perfect for the woman who embraces strength and delicacy, Paradoxe Intense is a bold statement of evolving femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R5QUPYS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Giorgio Armani's Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated and eco-conscious fragrance. Featuring marine, citrus, aromatic, and woody notes, it opens with green mandarin, followed by clary sage, lavandin, and geranium, and finishes with sustainably sourced patchouli. The innovative refillable bottle and commitment to sustainability make it perfect for the modern, mindful individual.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Fusion D'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TBM15F4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Fusion d'Issey by ISSEY MIYAKE is a daring, masculine fragrance that explores the contrast between ice-cool freshness and red-hot molten lava. It opens with luminous Lemon and Coconut Water, transitioning into a heart of Rosemary, Geranium, and Cardamom. The base features Ambrox and volcanic woods for a creamy, musky finish. Overflowing with energy and vitality, this fragrance is perfect for daring adventures. Presented in a blue glass flacon that reflects the essence of a volcano, it embodies the heart of nature's contrasts.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QSJUMHM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum is a captivating floral fragrance with Patchouli, Magnolia and Dewberries...   This perfume is built around Magnolia Essence, emanating a bright, floral sweetness and an exquisite feminine dimension, while a Dewberries Accord lends an irresistible fruity quality. This tantalising balance of fresh and sensual notes is enhanced by the woodiness of Patchouli Essence, which grounds the scent with a subtle, earthy facet.    The floral elements of this Gucci scent are magnified by the soft and sensual hues of Blond Woods, while a Coconut Accord offers an addictive and sweet freshness. Finally, Jasmine Sambac Absolute and a trail of Musks combine to offer an enticing warmth. A beautiful fragrance that lasts all day long and will attract compliments every time you wear it.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OCFKTY5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Viktor&Rolf invites to play a new game of seduction in the dark, where the green rays of Night Vision reveal the most mysterious and irresistible facets. With Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Parfum, cross the green light of intensity. Discover this new interpretation of Spicebomb Night Vision, fresh and addictive. The night has never been so intense. Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Parfum is a mysterious explosion of vibrant Black Spices, citrus notes and sensual Green Woody Notes. Incense and green resin are the notes that bring the mysterious facet. The sensual, rich and intense inflections of these ingredients also perfectly enhance the freshness of the black spices and lemon essence.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray 3 pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QJLHYVQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Givenchy L'Interdit EDP is an opulent, oriental scent for women with floral and exotic notes. This incredible perfume will make you feel confident, elegant and stylish. Givenchy L'Interdit EDP has an intense, modern aroma made of a rich perfume composition. The top scent of the perfume includes notes of sweet pear and fresh, citrusy bergamot. After them we feel a floral scent of tuberose, jasmine and orange blossom. The base scent is made of fragrant vanilla, vetiver, patchouli and ambroxan. The set includes 80ml EDP + 75ml Body Lotion + 75ml Shower Gel. Top notes: Pear, bergamot Middle notes: Tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom Base notes: Vanilla, vetiver, patchouli, ambroxan

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WQS2E9O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The new sailor Le Male Elixir 75ml will induce burning cravings and drive your senses crazy. Burning desire spreads with the irresistible notes of fresh lavender, warming tonka bean, and gentle benzoin. With a gilded torso, this fiery novelty from Jean Paul Gaultier embodies radiant power and seductive charisma. It is finished! You melt away with burning desire. This intense fragrance ignites the fire of the senses on his upper body and gives the soft skin a burning sensuality. After a refreshing breeze of mint, the tide rises to addiction, becoming a glowing elixir. In this breath of fresh air, dashing lavender quickly takes on lusty proportions, enhanced by the balsamic richness of benzoin with syrupy vanilla accents. The tonka bean trumps with its warm and sweet tones between honey and tobacco. The time has come: You jump! Radiant at first sight, glowing with masculinity, more fiery than ever. The torso is bursting with muscles, the skin is bathed in copper color by the sinking sun. What a Gaultier body... what accomplished style. Finely chiseled grooves stand out on its muscles dipped in gold and merge with the amber stripes of the sailor shirt, which plays with transparency effects in a highly sexy way.

listings.rawTitle: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina In Fiore Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E5IA59J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina In Fiore For Women EDT is a pretty spring and summer floral fragrance full of delicate floral notes, such as delicate Cherry Blossom and a joyfully blend of juicy fruity shades. Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina In Fiore For Women EDT is a romantic fruity floral fragrance for women that glistens on the skin and uplifts the senses. Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina In Fiore For Women EDT begins with mouthwatering and slightly sharp Pomegranate, refreshing and sweet Pear and an unexpected sacrine Sorbet note. The heart is a gorgeous floral display that allows the Cherry Blossom key note to shine, embolded by humid and sensual Jasmine. The base is a skin scent essence of White Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Les Infusion Fleur D'Orange Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IXAYTJK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Infusion de Fleur d’Oranger Eau de Parfum encapsulates the joyful personality of the orange blossom in a floral citrus fragrance. The joyful orange blossom is immersed in a signature solution of musks and citrus that recreates the enveloping scent of skin, allowing the personality of the ingredient to fuse with you. Les Infusions are second-skin fragrances that suit you right away and instantly feel like you. The luxurious bottle of Infusion de Fleur d’Oranger is highlighted in an orange-tinted hue, evoking the fusion of the signature ingredient in the fragrance. The light orange cap in iconic Saffiano symbolizes the orange blossom and the joyfulness of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SGYWT0R]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A scent for the modern adventurer, gripped by a magnetic calling for discovery. Built on a conviction that with technology as an extension of ourselves, Luna Rossa Ocean can empower us to push ourselves beyond our limits, re-imagine what's possible, and explore new horizons. Luna Rossa Ocean is a powerful fougere fragrance. Fusing naturally inspired, fresh and aquatic accords. The masculine scent encapsulates refreshing bergamot, contrasted with the extreme sophistication of vetiver, tonka bean, and elegant notes of iris. A truly unique and addictive everyday scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray 3 Pcs Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DYLO2OP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jimmy Choo Perfume is known for using top perfumers to create some of the most intriguing and unique scents, and the tradition is continued with I Want Choo. From master perfumers Louise Turner, Sonia Constant and Antoine Maisondieu comes a beautiful amber floral fragrance with top notes of Peach and Mandarin Orange, middle notes of Jasmine and Red Lilley and a subtle but beautiful base of Vanilla that provides a soft spiciness to this elegant perfume. I Want Choo comes with an outer packaging of dual shades of red with the gold JC Logo displayed prominently, and gold lettering that stands out proudly. From the packaging, through the bottle design to the enchanting scent this perfume is all Jimmy Choo style and will become an essential part of your cosmetic wardrobe.  This set contains: - Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau De Perfume Spray 100ml - Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau De Perfume Spray 7.5ml - Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Perfumed Body Lotion 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Red Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JW95G4F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Coffee Floral signature of Black Opium twisted in a new red sensoriality. The iconic coffee floral accord turns red with a unique and juicy ingredient: the cherry accord. This liquorous note takes the signature of Black Opium into a new fruity universe. Black Opium Eau de Parfum Over Red is a daring creation that awakens the senses Precious. Colourful. The iconic BLACK OPIUM bottle takes on a new hypnotic shade. Covered in a red lacquered tone, the bottle matches the liquorous cherry note of BLACK OPIUM EAU DE PARFUM OVER RED. Caress its smooth glass. Peer into its glossy surface. Hear the delightful spritz as you spray on the fragrance. Breathe in the scent of the cherry. Imagine the taste... That bottle is designed to dazzle all your senses. Alcohol, Parfum / Fragrance, Aqua / Water / Eau, Benzyl Salicylate, Benzyl Alcohol, Hydroxycitronellal, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamal, Limonene, Benzyl Benzoate, Geraniol, Coumarin, Citronellol, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Benzyl Cinnamate, Isoeugenol, Amyl Cinnamal, Citral, Anise Alcohol, Farnesol Please be aware that ingredient lists for products in the Yves Saint Laurent brand are updated regularly. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product package for the most up-to-date list of ingredients to ensure it is suitable for your personal use.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray 2 pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y4ETHG7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Gucci Guilty collection enters a new chapter, reintroducing the original Pour Femme scent as a rich eau de parfum, combining superior floral notes and enhanced natural fragrances. Individual, yet fusing together naturally, the men's and women's perfumes embody a declaration of self-expression and fearlessness, conjured up by the statement #ForeverGuilty. Top notes of Mandora—a fruit found in the Mediterranean island of Cyprus—smoothed out by natural Bergamot and Pink Pepper. Heart notes of Lilac, contrasted with rosy and violet notes, and layered with Geranium Oil, resulting in a nuanced blend. Base notes of Patchouli, combined with Ambery notes for an enduring sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Omnia Crystalline For Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=X0I9826]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Rediscover Omnia Crystalline in a new shape, with its inimitable original scent untouched. Like a frame of light, the iconic fascination of OMNIA is now characterised by a new, more precious flacon design. Evoking the purity and clarity of crystal, the iconic BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline is a luminous Eau de Toilette signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. A fragrance inspired by the aquatic transparency of the lotus flower, sublimated by the airy generosity of a white peony. Omnia Crystalline is a delicate scent evolving through watery crispy notes of nashi pear, the vegetal freshness of bamboo and ending on the warmth of balsa wood softened by an accord of crystal musks.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Ultra Blue Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CL6KJXS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Montblanc Explorer Ultra Blue is the perfect scent for the modern man. In a short space of time, it has become one of the leading scents for men. That does not mean that it is a common scent. Far from all men have yet discovered the wonderful qualities of Ultra Blue. When you are looking for a scent that will seamlessly integrate into your life, this is the one for you. Despite its many exciting notes, it does not overpower you. Instead, it offers everything that is associated with a refreshing shower and notes of the sea. It refreshes you and breezes gently through the air. It comes in a modern bottle that looks clean and fresh. In fact, you can say the 100ml eau de parfum bottle matches the scent itself. A fantastic gift for the man in your life, but you may find the man in your life will have already chosen this fragrance for themselves.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Honeysuckle & Davana Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ILJVJ6A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The wildness of honeysuckle, winding through the English countryside. Climbing. Twisting. Ever more alluring after dark. Fresh with rose and the aromatic, fruity twist of davana. Woody with moss. Warmed by sunshine. Top note: Davana Heart note: English Honeysuckle Base note: Moss

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C9LVHIV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jo Malone Peony & Blush Suede Eau de Cologne is a floral fragrance that was made in 2013. The scent opens with a crisp top note of Red Apple, a middle note of Peony provides a subtle freshness. The base closes with a sensual note of Suede.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Poppy & Barley Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L8E8SXG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Iconic, vibrant poppies. Dancing in colour across England's meadows. A lively floral scent, enhanced by rose and violet and topped with juicy blackcurrants. Borrowed from the succulent cereal fields, where grains and flowers mingle, our poppies are cocooned by bran and cotton-soft barley. Top note: Blackcurrant Heart note: Poppy Base note: Barley

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man in Black Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Introducing the latest addition to the Bulgari Man portfolio, Bulgari Man in Black. This neo-oriental Eau de Parfum is a perfect blend of contrasts. Top notes of rum, cardamom and cinnamon provide a vibrant addictiveness, whilst the leathery floral heart of tuberose contributes to the sophistication of the fragrance. Sealed by black amber and a leather accord, a warm and distinctive scent is formed. Set Includes Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray, 100ml After Shave Balm and Carry Pouch.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Aqva Divina Eau de Toilette 65ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Inspired by the wonders of the Mediterranean Sea, the perfumer created a sophisticated Eau de Toilette. A distinctive signature revealing all the radiance and sensuality of Summer. The fragrance evokes the mineral saltiness of the air, vivid citrus fruits and sumptuous sun-kissed flowers. The sensation of Aqva Divina on one`s body is like being enveloped in the natural sensuality of the sea and sun. Set comprises of 65ml spray & 15ml Mini Purse Spray

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Goldea Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: A profusion of luscious sweet sparkles mingled with the intoxicating scent of ylang-ylang and orange blossom and, finally, a caressing addictive base note, radiating splendour. A profound and sensual creation and an addictive Eau de Parfum with a luminous style which transforms sun light into essence. Set comprises of: 50ml EDP Spray, 200ml Body Lotion & 200ml Shower Gel.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Brit Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Burberry Brit for Men is a slightly spicy fragrance for men looking for casual elegance and self-confidence. Be bold and charge right in with strength garnered from invigorating mandarin and bergamot polished with exotic spices and the sweet tones of wild rose and rare woods. Be stylish, be Burberry! Succumb to the essence of masculinity and strength hidden in the modern design of the Burberry Brit for Men bottle. Indulge in elegance and style. Obtain the luxury fragrance of the black cube typical to Brit Men and no woman will ever resist you again. Make an impression on your surroundings and display the strength inherent to your masculinity. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Bergamot, Cardamom, Ginger, Tangerine Heart Notes: Cedar, Nutmeg, Spices, Wild Rose Base Notes: Cedar, Grey Musk, Oriental Woodsy Notes, Patchouli, Tonka Beans

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Brit Sheer Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Burberry Brit Sheer eau de toilette spray for women is described as a light and joyful fragrance, opening with top notes of pineapple, litchi and mandarin orange, flowing into a heart of peony, yuzu, peach blossom and sweet pea, all of which is rounded off with a base of white musk and resins. Fragrance Direct has an extensive range of Burberry fragrances and toiletries in stock, and this Burberry Brit Sheer eau de toilette spray for women is a firm favourite amongst our customers for its lush and sweet aroma. The Burberry fashion label came to life when 21 year old Thomas Burberry opened his own outdoor clothing store in Basingstoke in 1859. The iconic Burberry check was created in 1924, when it was used as a lining in the brands trench coats. In 2000 Burberry expanded into the world of fragrances, with the launch of its debut perfume Burberry Touch, and today the Burberry fragrance collection includes plenty of additional scents for both men and women.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Amber Pour Homme Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Prada introduces an ambery fougere for man. A contemporary, highly natural scent with captivating impact. Freshness vs Sensuality. Cleanliness vs Leathery. There are four olfactory dimensions. Amber blends labdanum, patchouli, vanilla and tonka bean. Fougere marries geranium, vetiver, orange blossom, myrrh and perfumerers Givaudans exclusive musk called Nirvanolide. Cologne is composed of Italian bergamot and mandarin along with neroli and cardamom.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau D'Orange Verte Eau de Cologne 50ml Spray
listings.description: Hermes Eau d'Orange Verte unisex Eau de Cologne is the perfect fragrance for all independent men who live according to their own rules.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau des Merveilles Bleue Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Hermes Eau des Merveilles Bleue Eau de Toilette is a dynamic yet mysterious fragrance that creates an extremely attractive aura around you.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Fleur Musc Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: A floral woody musk fragrance designed to embody the profound sensuality of every woman and her evocation of charm and grace. Fleur Musc features a top note of pink pepper, a heart of rose, peony, and musk, and a base of patchouli, amber, and violet.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Florale Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: This romantic and powdery composition contains accords of limoncello sorbet the top, flower of peony in the heart and the base composed of benzoin, musk, caramel and honey.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Gloss Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Candy Gloss by Prada is a floral fruity fragrance for women. It contains notes of cherry, almond, vanilla, musk, orange blossom, heliotrope, peach, benzoin, cassis and rose.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Kiss Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Candy Kiss by Prada is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Prada Candy Kiss consists of soft sweet musk with hints of vanilla and orange blossom, a powdery fragrance that will instantly lift your mood and bring a smile to your face. The scent isn't too sweet but rather soft and gentle.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Royal Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Characterising regal and powerful femininity, Le Parfum Royal by Elie Saab explores majestic vistas of sophisticated chypre fragrance and a sensual floral embrace. The top of the fragrance invites a signature of mandarin, trailing into a heart of passionate rose and neroli. The base finishes in an accord between rich sandalwood, amber and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Royal Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Characterising regal and powerful femininity, Le Parfum Royal by Elie Saab explores majestic vistas of sophisticated chypre fragrance and a sensual floral embrace. The top of the fragrance invites a signature of mandarin, trailing into a heart of passionate rose and neroli. The base finishes in an accord between rich sandalwood, amber and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Oud Wood Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: This highly alluring cologne boasts green, woody and spicy accords for a delectable, charming scent that's bound to revitalize your soul. Notes of juniper, cypress and angelica create a crisp, sharp atmosphere that immediately awakens the senses with its powerful combination. Meanwhile, notes of pure ginger and agarwood, or oud, blend in seamlessly with their fresh, bold essences. Finally, the remaining note of castoreum lends an animalic, musky aroma for an altogether rich and tantalizing concoction everyone around you won't stop thinking about for hours.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: A leather fragrance for women & men Strong, sweet, smoky, mysterious & charismatic Top notes of saffron, raspberry & thyme Heart notes of olibanum & jasmine Base notes of leather, suede, amber & woody accord Launched in 2007 Suitable for night or colder seasons wear.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Tobacco Oud Intense by Tom Ford sparks an explosive burst of spices and woody nuances, creating a powerful celebration of intoxicating ingredients. Tobacco leads the fragrance's spice, bolstered by an element of coriander. Oud wood gives indulgent woody fragrance combined with patchouli, sandalwood, cedar and patchouli. The final touches lie in animalic shades of castoreum, labdanum and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A surge of animalistic power, unchained desert heat inspiring an expedition into deep leather fragrance. Spicy cardamom commands the opening notes of the scent, following into a roaring heart of leather and accents of jasmine. The base uses amber alongside moss and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Rouge Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: The Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Rouge Eau de Toilette is an irresistible, intense, MAGNETIC fragrance to stir passion. The NARCISO signature Heart of Musc is surrounded by an accord of Roses and Lily of the valley, Cedar, and Tonka Bean to create an airy and bright reinterpretation of the NARCISO Eau de Parfum Rouge. Olfactory family: Oriental Floral Woody Top notes: Rose, Lily of the Valley Heart notes: Heart of Musc Base notes: Tonka, Vetiver, Black Cedar, White Cedar

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Oscar Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BUCHXIW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Oscar De La Renta Oscar is a floral and feminine scent, joyously fragrant with an abundant floral bouquet and soft, woody accents. Released in 1977, it is the first Oscar De La Renta fragrance and is as timeless as their sophisticated fashion designs. This fragrance opens with a bouquet of flowers which blend with its sweet, musky heart and base notes. Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Basil, Coriander, Galbanum, Peach and Gardenia. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang, Jasmine, Tuberose, Rose, Rosemary, Cyclamen, Lavender and Orchid. Base Notes: Opoponax, Carnation, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Lavender and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Sugar Pop Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: The fragrance opens with top notes of refreshing citrus dominated by bergamot. The sweet essences of red apple intermingle with juicy peach and exciting floral notes. Finally, the delicious caramel notes in the drydown give way to gourmand vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Paloma Picasso Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Paloma Picasso is the first perfume created by the daughter of the famous painter, designed as a fragrance self-portrait which is creative and distinctive. Floral and elegant with a Mediterranean feel, Paloma Picasso features top notes which include Carnation, Lily of the Valley, Bergamot, Lemon and Rose, heart notes of Jasmine, Hyacinth, Ylang Ylang, Patchouli and Mimose and base notes which include Sandalwood, Amber, Oakmoss, Vetiver and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Cologne Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A liberated spirit of bold and adventurous flavours, Gentleman Cologne by Givenchy seasons a fresh citrus core with woody and aromatic tones, reflecting a bold and charismatic man. The head of the fragrance instils a citrus freshness through accord of bergamot, lemon and petitgrain. Heart notes of iris, rosemary and vetiver create a savoury blend. An ambroxan base dresses with musk for animalic tones.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier Eau De Cartier Concentree Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Bright citrus coupled with savoury aromatic accords, Eau de Cartier Concentrée highlights itself with a delicious opening accord of citrus yuzu and spicy coriander. The heart drives the metallic tones of violet leaf over aromatic lavender before finishing on a base of cedar wood, patchouli and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Fleur de Parfum Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Chloe Fleur de Parfum is a generous bouquet exclusively composed of the most delicate and quintessential part of flowers, their hearts. Master perfumers Michel Almairac and Mylene Alran artfully combined these to create an exclusive fragrance. The fundamental note comes from the rose heart with slight inflections that recall the scent of raspberry. Verbena flower adds a fresh and luminous dimension that enhances the luxurious rose heart whilst still remaining delicate. Cherry blossom diffuses milky almond notes which filled with sweetness, bring roundness to the composition. A subtle combination of opulence and sensuality, Fleur de Parfum feels like the touch of soft silk on bare skin.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Love Story For Her Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Chloe Love Story is an unforgettable essence of seduction. The freshness of neroli illuminates her. The sensuality of orange blossom captivates him, intensely. The stirring femininity of jasmine stephanotis, the flower of happiness, makes her more irresistible than ever. On her skin, cedar vibrates with flair. A floral love story, fresh and sexy.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Aromatics Elixir For Her Eau de Parfum 25ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1971, this is the oldest perfume from the house of Clinique. It is a chypre-floral scent that contains top notes of lemon verbena, clary sage, geranium, chamomile, Brazilian rosewood, bergamot, coriander and aldehydes. Middle notes of jasmine, orris root, rose, orange blossom, ylang-ylang, tuberose and carnation, and base notes of vetiver, oakmoss, musk, incense, patchouli and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only the Brave Tattoo Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: A power, a fragrance. The potential to change. For the man seeking to leave his mark upon the world, Only The Brave Tattoo by Diesel carries the spirit of the man with the courage to wear his conviction on his skin. An oriental fragrance grounded in patchouli, this fragrance offers exotic sweet and spice whilst carrying a comfy down-to-earth base. Opening in a bite of sweet red apple touched by citrus the fragrance opens refreshingly fruity. Strutting forwards, the fragrance cracks open a savoury heart of spicy Bourbon pepper and sage. As it dries, the fragrance then rouses a solid base composed of patchouli and amber wood with a vein of benzoin offering a sweet and calming diversion.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K By Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: Instantly conjuring the Italian countryside and the Mediterranean midday sun, the warm, enveloping embrace of K by Dolce&Gabbana evokes the fresh, earthy scent of wooded Tuscan hills. The fragrance invigorates the senses with an intense combination of citrus fresh blood orange and Sicilian lemon, amber accents of clary sage, crisp geranium and energising lavandin, a fresh bite of juniper berry and a spark of fiery pimento essence. Then comes a sensual cedarwood note, merging with earthy vetiver, before yielding to the sweet spiciness of patchouli, to intensify the innate charisma of a modern day man who wears K by Dolce & Gabbana.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray 3 Pcs Gift Set
listings.description: A majestic enterprise into bold and captivating aromatic chords. K by Dolce & Gabbana portrays a mastery over the ordinary, showcasing the man who the king of his own life. Respecting a crisp opening the scent carries a sharp accord of citrus, blood orange, lemon and juniper berries. Spicy pimento runs with clary sage, geranium and lavender, creating a deeply aromatic heart. The base find earthy tones within an accord of cedar, vetiver and patchouli. Set Includes: 100ml EDT Spray + 50ml Shower Gel + 75g Deodorant Stick.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum For Her Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Set includes: 90ml EDP Spray + 10ml EDP Spray + 75ml Body Lotion. Le Parfum is a woody, floral fragrance that was launched in 2011. The scent opens with a top note of Orange blossom, middle notes are Jasmine and Patchouli. Base notes are Cedar-wood and Rose honey.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder White Linen Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: White Linen Perfume by Estee Lauder, Launched by the design house of estee lauder in 1978, white linen is classified as a sharp, gentle, floral fragrance. This feminine scent possesses a blend of fresh florals including jasmine, rose, berry, moss and amber. It is recommended for daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Kelly Caleche Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Kelly Caleche dives into the soul of the contemporary Hermes woman. Light and free, the fragrance's notes, mimosa, iris, tuberose and climbing rose, reflect the personality of the woman who stands at the heart of the fragrance: daring, free, trailing her own path, elegant. Yet she refuses to take herself seriously.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a deep, intense iteration of the original Eau de Toilette. Made for the king of everyday life, allowing its wearer to express even deeper facets of his personality. With every spray unearth deep, woody, and spicy notes that add a new sensation of intensity. It’s a fragrance that pays homage to the earthy, rugged landscape of Tuscany, with the long-lasting, woody base permeating throughout. At its head, K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum plays on the citrus familiarity of the Eau de Toilette. An invigorating, sparkling opening accord is fused with zesty citrus, blood orange, and Italian lemon. To truly make this a more intense fragrance, spice from all angles is infused into this perfume, magnified with hints of cardamom and pimento essence. Geranium, clary sage, and a shot of energising lavandin warm the fragrance in its heart, especially when combined with the smoothness of a fig milk accord.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a deep, intense iteration of the original Eau de Toilette. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YCC4JW8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} La Belle comes in a beautiful, elegant bottle that will look amazing on any dresser. It does not matter if you collect Jean Paul Gaultier perfume bottles or love his scents, this is a must have eau de parfum. La Belle perfume was launched in 2021 and is flying off the shelf. To perfume connoisseurs, it is obvious why. Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle was created by the innovative fragrance team Sonia Constant and Quentin Bisch. Together they have put together a scent that excites and totally envelops you. The first note you will come across is pear. After that a rich blend of vanilla and jasmine will hit you. Then you will smell that soothing scent of tonka bean. What else can be said about this scent? It is a must have. The 100ml bottle looks elegant and the scent is one of those scents that truly lingers. Try it for yourself or treat someone special.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Alive For Her Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BGKX5JQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Alive perfume was conceived to empower today's woman through a fruity woody scent that energizes the feminine spirit. Alive contains a fragrance that exudes positivity in its main notes: thyme, plum and jasmine. This fabulous eau de parfum inspires women to live life to the fullest, emanating an exquisite scent as they achieve their daily goals. The top notes of this perfume, such as olive wood and sandalwood, encourage women to conquer their dreams. Hugo Boss perfume is a great ally of modern femininity. This classic 80ml bottle contains the perfect fragrance for women to feel self-confident while developing personally. Olfactory notes such as cinnamon, apple and blackberries build a unique perfume that conveys positive vibes, ideal for living a magnificent day. This fragrance is so special that it creates a beautiful atmosphere of joy around you. Dare to enjoy this exceptional perfume, your days will be illuminated through this empowering scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PTVLS50]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle is an exciting scent that almost bursts out of the bottle. When you are looking for a scent that is both daring and feminine, La Belle is the perfect choice for you. It is not one of those scents that you are going to forget about in a hurry. You can say that it makes it mark on you as well as others. La Belle perfume is packed with exciting notes that linger. First you will encounter the softness of vanilla. After that, stronger notes of bergamot will fuse with your senses. Then you will discover pear drifting through the air. This is truly an eau de parfum like no other. The 50ml bottle makes a great present. As always, it is a little bit provocative. But, perhaps that is why we buy Jean Paul Gaultier fragrances in the first place. If you don't already have this scent in your collection, you are missing out on a truly great fragrance experience.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=D9O4PG0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau is the scent you should go for when you are looking for a classic men's fragrance. With its woody scent and fresh undertones, you can easily say that Le Beau from Jean Paul Gaultier is one of the best fragrances for the modern man. If you have not bought a Jean Paul Gaultier scent before, this is the one you must try. The bottle makes a very bold statement. In many ways, the 125ml represents the scent perfectly. It is bold and tells everyone that you have arrived. Everything this brand does is a little bit more daring. This fragrance is a perfect example of that. The scent of this eau de toilette is very seductive. It tells everyone that you have arrived. But, at the same time, it does not overpower. There isn't a right or a wrong time of the day or night to wear this classic fragrance. It is right for any time of the day and for any occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Ultra Intense Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UBG7ODA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Ultra is a sexy and masculine scent for a man who's at the helm of his ship and desires to exude power and strength wherever he goes. The complimentary notes of this eau de toilette fuse together effortlessly to create an oriental woodsy scent. Combining a top note of cardamom with middle notes of lavender and iris and a base note of vanilla, this warm, intense, and spicy scent is reminiscent of classic shaving soap, but also sexy and seductive. Classically and temptingly dressed in a powerful-looking black and gold torso-shaped bottle, the soothing 100ml fragrance is ready to be worn by the man who is at the top of his game, but still exerts an air of mystery and intuition. Assert confidence and seduction with every application of the most modern and powerful formulation in the Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male line of fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe L'Eau de Chloe For Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Freedom, lightness and femininity: these are the principles on which Chloé was founded in Paris more than 60 years ago. Today Chloé’s vision of romantic, effortless chic lives in ready-to-wear, accessories, and fragrances. An aura, delicate as a breath of air. Like the original fragrance, this unique Eau suggests rare elegance and surprising modernity. Free, spontaneous, radiant femininity. Meet L’Eau by Chloé. The fragrance contains an exceptional concentration of distilled rose water, which gives it a rare refreshing feeling. Light as dew, this chypre rose seems suffused with pure oxygen. A delicate citrus harmony recalls summer’s luscious ice-cool lemonades. At once spirited and elegant, airy and ethereal, the rose leaves a subtle presence on the skin. Little by little, patchouli appears in sophisticated touches, evoking the luxury and perfection of wearing a flawlessly finished garment. The fragrance is enclosed in a modern, delicately pleated bottle adorned with a hand-tied ribbon of a soft green hue, echoing the spring freshness of the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum 50ml + 10ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H0NST4C]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid is a luminous floral gourmand with a fresh twist on vanilla. It blends the creamy sweetness of Vanilla with a breezy Ozonic Accord, creating a fragrance that feels both airy and indulgent. At its heart, the sensual glow of Vanilla Orchid adds depth and richness, while the ozonic freshness keeps it light and modern. Wearing it feels like wrapping yourself in soft petals kissed by sunlight - comforting, radiant, and irresistibly feminine.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Rosa Nobile Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VPSAAR6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Rosa Nobile is a fragrance that feels like a quiet moment in a blooming garden—intimate, tender, and full of life. Inspired by the rare beauty of the centifolia rose, this scent captures everything that flower stands for: passion, grace, and effortless elegance. Grown in the heart of Piedmont, Italy, each rose is hand-picked at dawn, still kissed by morning dew. For just 40 days each year, this fleeting harvest becomes something timeless. What makes Rosa Nobile special isn’t just the rose itself—it’s the way it stirs emotion. Love, joy, softness, strength. This is a fragrance that doesn’t follow trends—it tells a story. One of care, craftsmanship, and unmistakable femininity. Wearing it feels like wrapping yourself in silk petals. Elegant. Authentic. Beautifully Italian.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RE0O8IN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Step into the Irish countryside with Creed’s Green Irish Tweed — a sophisticated fragrance that captures the essence of fresh meadows, cool breezes, and tailored refinement. Originally crafted for men, this iconic scent has become a favorite among fragrance lovers of all genders who appreciate clean, classic elegance. Opening with a crisp blend of lemon verbena and peppermint, it evolves into a smooth heart of violet leaf, before settling into a warm, earthy base of sandalwood and ambergris. The result is a fresh, green fougère that’s as refined as a bespoke suit and as invigorating as a morning walk through dew-covered grass. Perfect for spring and summer, Green Irish Tweed is both effortlessly elegant and refreshingly understated — a true signature scent for those who appreciate timeless luxury. Fragrance Notes: Top: Lemon Verbena, Peppermint Heart: Violet Leaf Base: Sandalwood, Ambergris Style: Fresh, woody, elegant For: Men (but easily worn by anyone) Occasion: Daytime, formal or casual, year-round versatility

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Oud Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GIK8JJG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph Lauren Polo Oud Eau de Parfum feels like stepping into a world where tradition meets modern elegance. From the very first spray, the pink pepper and sage create a bold, almost electric opening - sharp, invigorating, full of possibility. Then, as it settles, the warmth of orange flower and rose emerge, softening the edges like sunlight filtering through silk curtains. There’s something undeniably intimate in that moment - comforting, yet refined. But it’s the base where the story deepens. The smoky whispers of incense and the dark, resinous oud wrap around the skin like a tailored jacket - structured, powerful, and enduring. Patchouli adds that grounding earthiness, making the scent feel rooted yet endlessly expansive. Wearing it isn’t just a sensory experience - it’s a statement. It lingers in the air and in memory, evoking confidence, depth, and quiet strength. A true modern classic with a soul steeped in tradition.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QN9I8DA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph Lauren Polo Red Eau de Toilette is a bold rush of adrenaline captured in a bottle - powerful, sleek, and unapologetically masculine. Inspired by the thrill of fast cars and the elegance of the open road, this fragrance isn’t just worn - it’s experienced. From the first spray, you’re hit with a sharp jolt of red grapefruit and lemon oil - crisp, bright, and energizing - like the ignition of an engine before a race. The cranberry accord adds an unexpected twist: tart and juicy, pulling you into something deeper. As it settles, the heart reveals a spicy edge with red saffron and sage, grounded by smooth lavender. It’s that perfect balance between heat and calm - like leather seats warming in the sun, or the quiet confidence before a challenge. And then comes the finish - rich woods, golden amber, and a subtle coffee accord. Warm, deep, and undeniably seductive, it lingers on the skin like the final lap - unforgettable, refined, and endlessly compelling. Housed in its iconic red bottle with the silver Polo emblem, this fragrance is for the man who lives fast but with style. Cruelty-free and crafted with care, Polo Red is not just a scent - it’s a statement.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OREW0SF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph Lauren Ralph Eau De Toilette is a bright and effortless expression of youthful confidence—playful, fresh, and full of life. Inspired by Ralph Lauren’s own daughter and her circle of vibrant, optimistic friends, this scent is made for women who embrace life with open arms and unapologetic style. From the very first spritz, you’re met with the crisp, juicy notes of apple tree leaves and Italian mandarin—bright and sparkling, like sunshine on skin. Yellow freesia adds a touch of softness, painting a picture of carefree mornings and endless possibilities. As the fragrance unfolds, the heart blooms into an exotic garden. Japanese osmanthus, magnolia, and linden blossom swirl together with freesia and boronia to create a floral bouquet that feels light, radiant, and effortlessly feminine—like laughter carried on a summer breeze. Anchoring the scent is a whisper of musk and white musk, leaving behind a delicate warmth that lingers close to the skin—clean, comforting, and quietly alluring. Packaged in a sleek glass bottle with cool blue accents, Ralph is more than a fragrance—it’s a mood, a memory, a moment of joy. Cruelty-free and full of personality, it’s the perfect signature scent for the woman who lives with heart, hope, and high energy.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff 1861 Naxos Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BJQLY2D]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Naxos brings indulgent whispers of Sicily within an accord of sweet fragrance, citrus, and aromatic chords. It cuts a clean opening with notes of bergamot, lavender, and lemon. Middle notes drizzle honey over a blend of smooth cashmeran, cinnamon, and jasmine. Base notes complete with a combination of tobacco, tonka bean, and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A69AQNK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Imagine standing on a sun-drenched cliffside in Amalfi, the sea breeze brushing past you, citrus groves glistening in the distance. Fico di Amalfi doesn’t just smell like summer—it feels like an escape. It opens with a burst of ripe citrus—bergamot, lemon, and grapefruit—that feels like a breath of morning air by the coast. Then it softens, as if the sun is warming your skin, revealing the creamy sweetness of fig nectar and the delicate touch of jasmine petals. There’s a quiet zing from pink pepper, adding a subtle vibrancy that dances on your senses. As it settles, the scent grounds you with warm fig wood, clean cedar, and a touch of resinous benzoin—comforting, earthy, and a little nostalgic. It's not just a perfume; it's a memory of a place you didn’t know you missed. Wearing this feels like wrapping yourself in sunlight and sea air—bright, soft, and quietly joyful

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mandarino Di Sicilia Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T6UB0MY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} There’s something instantly uplifting about Mandarino di Sicilia, like peeling a sun-warmed mandarin orange with your bare hands while standing under a cloudless sky. The scent opens with a vivid, juicy burst of Sicilian mandarin, so bright and effervescent it feels like sunlight captured in liquid form. Hints of bitter orange and lemon follow, crisp and clean, as if carried on a soft Mediterranean breeze. It's citrus, but not sharp—rich, rounded, and full of life. As it develops, the heart softens into light floral notes with a whisper of neroli and orange blossom, subtle and elegant, like the scent of distant blooms drifting through open shutters on a summer afternoon. The base brings just enough warmth with gentle musk and a touch of amber, grounding the brightness without ever weighing it down. Wearing Mandarino di Sicilia feels like a spontaneous getaway. Easy, radiant, and effortlessly refined. It's not just a fragrance; it’s a mood-lifter, a memory-maker, a daily dose of Sicilian sunshine.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CASVDCJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Colonia is more than a classic—it’s an expression of timeless Italian elegance. From the very first spray, it feels refined yet effortlessly fresh, like stepping out of a crisp linen shirt on a warm day in Rome. It opens with bright citrus—lemon, sweet orange, and Calabrian bergamot—clean and invigorating, like a breath of Mediterranean air. As it evolves, subtle herbal notes of lavender and rosemary begin to surface, lending a touch of sophistication without ever feeling heavy or dated. In the dry-down, the scent becomes warmer and more grounded with vetiver, sandalwood, and a soft hint of patchouli. The result is a perfectly balanced cologne that is fresh, light, and quietly confident. Wearing Colonia is like slipping into a well-tailored suit. It doesn’t shout—it speaks with calm assurance. Elegant, polished, and unmistakably Italian.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GO8E9ND]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Colonia Essenza takes the timeless charm of the original Colonia and sharpens it, adding a modern, more assertive edge. It’s crisp, polished, and quietly powerful—like walking into a room with quiet confidence and leaving a lasting impression. The fragrance opens with a burst of zesty citrus—lemon, orange, and bergamot—that feels instantly uplifting and clean. But where the original Colonia is soft and warm, Essenza introduces a sharper, more aromatic core. Notes of clove, rosemary, and jasmine add depth and structure, creating a refined, masculine energy. As it settles, the base of vetiver, patchouli, white musk, and amber lingers with understated strength. It's elegant without being flashy, modern yet rooted in tradition. Wearing Colonia Essenza feels like starting your day with intention. It’s fresh, focused, and undeniably sophisticated—a fragrance for those who appreciate the classics, but demand more presence.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Lily of The Valley Eau de Parfum 180ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JQ4NVIL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lily of the Valley is a bright and elegant fragrance that beautifully captures the essence of its namesake flower. The scent opens with a lively burst of citrus, combining the freshness of grapefruit, bergamot, and black currant to create a vibrant and uplifting introduction. At the heart of the fragrance, the delicate lily of the valley takes center stage, exuding a soft, floral grace. It is enhanced by the sweet notes of jasmine, geranium, and magnolia, adding layers of sophistication and charm to the composition, evoking a serene garden in full bloom. The base provides a warm, grounding finish, with the subtle richness of cedar and musk. These earthy tones balance the fragrance, leaving a lasting impression that is both fresh and refined, making it a perfect choice for those who appreciate understated elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HT2I5M2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Oud & Spice is a fragrance that speaks in rich, textured layers. It’s bold without being overwhelming, luxurious without trying too hard—an elegant collision between East and West. The scent opens with warm, vibrant notes of bergamot and pink pepper that offer a flash of brightness before the deeper story unfolds. Quickly, the rich heart of oud takes over—deep, resinous, and smooth—tempered by the unexpected warmth of cinnamon and cloves. It’s spicy, yes, but never sharp; the blend is seamless and rounded. In the dry-down, the oud becomes earthier, enveloped in soft labdanum and a whisper of sandalwood. There’s an undeniable richness, but it wears like second skin rather than heavy velvet. Wearing Oud & Spice feels like stepping into a quiet room full of history and intention—calm, confident, and undeniably captivating. It’s a scent for someone who doesn’t chase attention, but effortlessly commands it.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Oud Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LOX5AO4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Acqua di Parma Oud doesn’t just make an impression—it creates a presence. The moment it touches the skin, there’s a sharp clarity from the citrus that wakes you up, like stepping out into cool morning air after a sleepless night. It’s clean, but not light. It has purpose. Then the oud begins to rise. Not loud or smoky, but smooth and steady, like a low hum of confidence just beneath the surface. The warmth of coriander and amyris gives it this elegant tension—bright spice wrapped in velvet. It reminds me of moments when you're dressed just right and don’t have to say much. You already feel seen. As it settles into leather, patchouli, and musk, the scent becomes grounded, almost meditative. It lingers not for attention, but for connection. It’s the kind of fragrance that makes you feel composed in a chaotic world—powerful, but not performative. Wearing it feels like owning your space without needing permission. It's strength, quiet and self-assured.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum 100ml + 2x 10ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ON7G3I7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir isn’t a fragrance you wear in the background. It’s bold, unapologetic, and magnetic from the first moment—like walking into a room where all eyes shift without a word being spoken. The opening is rich and fiery, with warm spices and sweetened resins that pull you in instantly. There’s something addictive about it—like dark amber syrup infused with peppery heat, resting on skin that’s just a little too close. It doesn't just smell intense—it feels it, like adrenaline humming under the surface. As it evolves, there’s a sensual softness beneath the strength. The deeper notes—probably vanilla, incense, and woods—start to take over, wrapping around you like midnight velvet. It’s smoky, slightly sweet, with just enough edge to keep it unpredictable. Wearing Azzaro Elixir feels like living in slow motion while the world watches. It’s confidence turned into scent—seductive, daring, and fully alive. Not for the faint of heart, but perfect if you're the kind of person who never blends in.

listings.rawTitle: Dior J'Adore L'Or Essence Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y21A8DE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior proudly unveils a new chapter in the J’adore story with Rihanna as the radiant new face of the fragrance. Her confident, bold femininity perfectly captures the spirit of J’adore — a celebration of strength, sensuality, and elegance. Together, they usher in a luminous vision of modern luxury and empowerment. Introducing L'Or de J’adore, a refined perfume created by Francis Kurkdjian, Dior’s Perfume Creation Director. This exceptional scent distills the purest essence of the iconic J’adore bouquet, highlighting the rarest floral absolutes. Orange blossom, jasmine grandiflorum, and centifolia rose unfold in rich harmony, offering an experience that is both full-bodied and exquisitely sensual. Encased in the iconic amphora bottle, now wrapped in a molten gold-inspired metal necklace, the design reflects the opulence within. L'Or de J'adore is a radiant floral fragrance, ideal for both day and night, created for the woman who embraces beauty, confidence, and timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Dior J'Adore L'Or Essence Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YO5B108]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior begins a dazzling new era for J’adore with global icon Rihanna as the latest face of the fragrance. Her fearless spirit and magnetic presence embody the essence of J’adore — a tribute to powerful femininity, sensual grace, and modern elegance. Together, they represent a bold vision of contemporary luxury and self-expression. L'Or de J’adore is a sophisticated interpretation of the iconic floral fragrance, crafted by Dior Perfume Creation Director Francis Kurkdjian. This perfume captures the most precious elements of the original bouquet, bringing together exquisite absolutes of orange blossom, jasmine grandiflorum, and centifolia rose. The result is a scent of remarkable depth and luminosity, blooming with warmth and sensual allure. Presented in the classic amphora bottle, now adorned with a sculptural gold-fused necklace, L'Or de J’adore is as stunning to behold as it is to wear. Radiant and elegant, this floral fragrance is perfect for both day and evening wear — made for women who embrace confidence, beauty, and timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Dior J'Adore Infinissime Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VSU7RQC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} J’adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime unveils a bold new take on the iconic floral bouquet, where the signature flowers of J’adore are given space to bloom freely. This scent is a powerful, sensual expression of femininity — enveloping, radiant, and infinitely captivating. A symphony of Centifolia rose, jasmine sambac, and ylang-ylang unfolds in rich layers, sculpted with creamy sandalwood that adds depth and warmth. The composition is elevated by the unique presence of tuberose from the Pays de Grasse, sourced through exclusive Dior partnerships, bringing a luminous and daring twist to the fragrance. More than a perfume, J’adore Infinissime is an endless flight of liberated florals — an intense and expressive trail that celebrates confidence, sensuality, and the infinite power of femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LIRULVO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Emporio Armani’s Stronger With You Intensely is a bold and energetic fragrance designed for the modern man who thrives on deep emotional connections. Inspired by the power of unity and the strength found in love, this scent celebrates the intensity of being truly bonded with someone special. It captures the essence of a passionate relationship, where devotion fuels confidence and shared experiences create an unshakeable foundation. This masculine fragrance opens with the sharp spice of pink pepper, offering an immediate sense of warmth and energy. It blends seamlessly with a roasted chestnut accord, adding depth and a unique signature that feels both familiar and original. At the heart of the fragrance, notes of lavender and sage bring a refined yet youthful character, striking the perfect balance between sophistication and carefree charm. As the scent develops, the base reveals a rich combination of amber wood and smooth vanilla essence, leaving a lasting trail of vibrance and sensuality. These grounding notes enhance the fragrance's overall warmth, creating a deeply addictive finish that lingers on the skin. Stronger With You Intensely is a celebration of passion, confidence, and the strength that comes from loving fearlessly.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EM8U07H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum is a vibrant celebration of femininity, blending fresh, floral notes with a soft, powdery finish. This modern twist on the classic Good Girl fragrance reimagines elegance through delicate contrasts, capturing the many layers of the contemporary woman. Bold yet romantic, this scent reflects a confident spirit wrapped in gentle sophistication. Presented in a signature stiletto-shaped bottle, now in a charming blush-pink hue, Good Girl Blush radiates both strength and grace. Its composition opens with sparkling Italian bergamot and juicy mandarin, wrapped in a subtle touch of almond oil. At its heart, sensual Ylang Ylang and sustainably sourced rose oil create a dreamy, pastel floral bouquet that feels both fresh and timeless. A double dose of creamy vanilla pairs with tonka bean in the base, adding warmth and depth to this enchanting fragrance. Designed for both day and evening wear, Good Girl Blush is a fragrance for the woman who embraces her power and softness in equal measure. Romantic, empowered, and unmistakably modern—it’s good to be pink.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill Bottle
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WWIPRW5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Divine is a daringly elegant fragrance that blends unexpected elements into something truly captivating. At its core is the contrast between bold floral lily and a sharp touch of sea salt, creating a dynamic tension that speaks to the complexities of modern femininity. It's a scent that defies conventions—both seductive and refreshing, refined yet unapologetically edgy. The fragrance opens with a burst of red berries and bergamot, setting a vibrant and inviting tone. The heart continues with a luminous bouquet of lily and ylang-ylang, delicately sweetened with a note of meringue for a creamy, citrusy twist. This middle layer evokes the feeling of standing in a lush garden or wandering through a tropical paradise, where freshness and warmth coexist in harmony. As it settles, the base reveals deeper, earthier tones—musk and patchouli layered with a salty finish that hints at ocean breezes and sun-kissed skin. Housed in an iconic gold bottle shaped like a woman's torso, Gaultier Divine is more than a fragrance; it’s a celebration of strength, sensuality, and the wild beauty of nature. Boldly feminine and endlessly intriguing, it leaves a lasting impression wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Royal Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=X1GC6GG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lady Million Royal by Rabanne is a bold and glamorous fragrance that captures the fearless spirit of modern femininity.
