Radiating elegance with an edge, it’s a scent made for those who claim their space unapologetically—wherever they go. The fragrance opens with a burst of juicy pomegranate and fresh mandarin, balanced by a green vegetal accord that adds a crisp brightness. At its heart lies a radiant floral bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine, and tuberose, delivering a soft, luxurious layer that is both feminine and captivating. Finally, a rich base of cashmeran, patchouli, and musk brings warmth and depth, wrapping the fragrance in sensual sophistication. Encased in the signature Lady Million diamond bottle, Lady Million Royal dazzles with a reimagined twist—flushed in vibrant red with floral detailing, symbolising passion, power, and playful rebellion. It’s more than a perfume; it’s a declaration. Step into your spotlight—because in this world, you’re the queen.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Glitter Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q65MMHK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Indulge in a sparkling new dimension of Black Opium with Eau de Parfum Glitter, a deliciously daring take on the iconic fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. This reimagined scent brings a playful yet sophisticated edge, combining YSL’s signature coffee floral accord with an airy, addictive marshmallow musk twist. It’s an olfactory treat designed for those who crave glamour, edge, and indulgence in every moment. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of pear, green mandarin, and zesty lemon essence, delivering a fresh and luminous first impression. At its heart, a radiant orange flower accord softens the boldness with floral elegance. As it settles, the base reveals the true decadence—marshmallow musk, deep roasted black coffee, rich vanilla bourbon absolute, and patchouli. The result is a gourmand fragrance that is sweet, seductive, and impossible to ignore. Encased in a dazzling bottle drenched in silver glitter, Black Opium Glitter is a couture statement in itself. The sparkling exterior and iconic pink centre evoke a sense of night-time allure and rebellious luxury. Whether worn for late-night adventures or stolen daytime moments, this perfume is for those who live boldly, love intensely, and never shy away from the spotlight.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HGD65BM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Libre by Yves Saint Laurent is a bold, modern interpretation of a classic floral fragrance, created for the woman who lives life on her own terms. Rooted in the French word for “free,” Libre celebrates strength, self-expression, and fearless femininity. It’s more than a scent—it’s a statement of independence, confidence, and elegance that defies convention. This grand floral Eau de Parfum brings together two contrasting worlds: the sensual warmth of orange blossom from Morocco and the cool, aromatic edge of French lavender. Traditionally a masculine note, lavender is reimagined here with a sensual, feminine twist, creating a powerful olfactory contrast that’s both striking and sophisticated. The result is a fragrance that balances softness and strength in perfect harmony. Encapsulated in a sleek, couture-inspired bottle adorned with the iconic YSL logo, Libre is unapologetically luxurious. With British singer Dua Lipa as its global ambassador, this fragrance embodies a spirit of boldness and authenticity. It’s made for those who embrace their freedom, express their true selves, and radiate confidence in everything they do.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers & Flames Eau de Parfum Florale 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NJ8OATK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Libre Flowers and Flames Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent ignites a bold evolution of the original Libre fragrance. Radiating passion and power, this fiery reinterpretation turns up the heat with intensified warmth and vibrant sensuality. It's a fragrance crafted for the woman who owns her flame—fearless, magnetic, and unapologetically free. The scent bursts open with a bright spark of bergamot essence, delivering a citrusy energy that awakens the senses. At the heart lies the iconic Libre orange blossom, now infused with spiced desert lily for a blazing floral twist. This passionate blend is softened by creamy vanilla and a subtle hint of coconut, while ylang-ylang adds a delicate exotic touch—creating a gourmand trail that leaves a lasting impression. Encased in a bottle that glows with golden firelight, the design reflects the inner heat and elegance of the scent it holds. With its signature YSL sophistication and couture edge, Flowers and Flames is more than a fragrance—it's a declaration of strength, beauty, and inner fire. Let it blaze on your skin and illuminate your presence.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J8EKVXO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Myslf by Yves Saint Laurent is a bold, modern fragrance that redefines masculinity through authenticity, self-expression, and contrast. Designed for the man who embraces every facet of himself—light and dark, strength and vulnerability—this scent is a personal statement. It celebrates individuality with a refined edge, encouraging you to be unapologetically yourself. The fragrance opens with a burst of vibrant freshness, led by a luminous bergamot heart that sets a lively and clean tone. At its core, orange blossom absolute blooms with elegance and sensuality, lending a floral warmth rarely seen in masculine scents. As it deepens, the base of earthy patchouli and smooth woody accords adds richness and lasting depth, creating a scent that’s grounded, expressive, and effortlessly confident. Housed in a sleek, black-lacquered bottle, Myslf is a true reflection of YSL style—timeless, edgy, and sophisticated. The iconic Cassandre logo is sculpted into the glass, while subtle gradients of black mirror the fragrance’s nuanced character. Topped with a brushed metal detail, the design speaks to exceptional craftsmanship and quiet power. Refillable and consciously designed, MYSLF is more than a fragrance—it’s your identity, bottled.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Eau de Toilette 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GI67M5N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet is a fresh and tender fragrance. Composed like a bouquet of newly blossomed flowers, this eau de toilette is characterised by notes of Damascus rose, peony, Calabrian bergamot and white musks. Faceted and spontaneous, its richly contrasted trail has all the emotion of that feeling of love at first sight. The signature couture Miss Dior bow, meticulously woven with multicoloured threads, gives the Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet bottle an even more couture identity. Created by Maison Faure, artisanal ribbon-makers since 1864, this ribbon demonstrates precision expertise.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Royal Water Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ETQPDQC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Royal Water was launched in 1997 and was inspired by the charm royalty. This fresh fragrance opens with fruity top notes of Bergamot, Lemon, Mandarin, Verbena, Clementine and Peppermint. Middle notes are Cumin, Basil, Black Pepper and Pink Pepper, followed by warm base notes of Ambergris and Musk. Top notes: Bergamot, lemon, mandarin, verbena, clementine and peppermint. Middle notes: Cumin, basil, black pepper and pink pepper. Base notes: Ambergris and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Wind Flowers Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C39A35C]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Creed Wind Flowers Eau De Parfum Spray 30ml is a graceful and radiant fragrance inspired by the strength and movement of modern femininity. Elegant and expressive, Wind Flowers is the perfect companion for the woman who moves through life with beauty, confidence, and poise. The 30ml bottle offers a luxurious touch of Creed’s artistry in a portable format.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y6FJXER]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Creed Original Vetiver Eau De Parfum is a fresh, woody, aromatic EDP for men which conveys the sensual feeling of time spent outdoors amongst verdant greenery, time spent beneath warm sunshine enjoying the stimulating company and lively conversation of friends. Bottling this captivating atmosphere and the irresistible attraction of the great outdoors, Original Vetiver conveys sophistication and romance through its traditional Vetiver interpretation. With a green and masculine signature, the composition includes refreshing Vetiver leaves, aromatic heart and earthy roots for a captivating, fresh and warming effect. Opening with the zesty, fresh and uplifting notes of Lemon, Green Notes and Ginger, the heart features the earthy, leathery characteristics of Vetiver in combination with herbaceous Coriander, peppery Cypress and fresh floral scents. This culminates in a rich and woody base combining White Musk, balsamic Cedarwood and sweet, powdery Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Viking Cologne Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GBYT51G]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Viking Cologne Eau de Parfum is a daring creation from The House of Creed designed for the modern adventurer who charts their own course. listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Intense Eau de Toilette 60ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EMDDCS8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Obsession is a classic oriental and woody fragrance for women. listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UN4EW2P]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover a new dimension of fragrance with the Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 90ml Gift Set—a bold reimagining of elegance and individuality through scent. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK Everyone Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Dahlia Divin Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

A quintessentially sensual Eau de Parfum inspired by golden and olfactory harmonies. This powerfully feminine fragrance takes off with the juicy notes of a Mirabelle Plum accord. Then the heart of Dahlia Divin bursts into a heady bouquet filled with the floral accents of Sambac Jasmine Absolute. While at the base, Sandalwood Essence infuses the scent with sensual woody depths. Suffused with the sensual glow of Sambac Jasmine, Dahlia Divin Eau de Parfum embodies absolute femininity. A floral woody fruity perfume for a modern goddess. Givenchy pays tribute to its iconic fragrances, including Dahlia Divin Eau de Parfum, with a new refined bottle emblematic of the Maison's style encasing the original, unchanged scent. Reminiscent of Hubert de Givenchy's taste for purity, it evokes the authentic luxury born of the designer's talent for Haute Couture.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U7FNTWH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bloom into your true self with the new Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette. Inspiring a journey of self-discovery built on the empowering notion of connecting through difference, the floral fragrance for women stays true to the original Bloom signature. The newest addition to the Bloom bouquet is a lighter, more luminous interpretation of the Bloom signature that gently encourages women to Bloom into the truest version of themselves Characterised by a trio of Jasmine, Tuberose and Rangoon Creeper, it is now enlightened by a sweetened Neroli accord. Just like the scent unfurls as its name suggests, Gucci Bloom women flourish in a natural, expressive and individual way, without conventional limitations. The perfume for her is presented in a frosted and luminous square-shaped pink glass bottle to bring freshness and vitality. The Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette for women celebrate the vitality and diversity of those who identify with the House’s modern philosophy. Fragrance Family: Floral Top Notes: Neroli Accord, Lemon Sfumatrice Essence, Mandarin Essence, Bergamot Essence Heart Notes: Bloom Accord (Jasmine Buds), Tuberose, Rangoon Creeper, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Sandalwood accord, Sun Drenched Wood accord, Orris Concrete, Benzoin, Musks​

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Profumo di Fiori Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MTVS56D]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Celebrating the vitality and diversity of those who identify with the House’s modern philosophy, the Gucci Bloom fragrances, wholly developed under Alessandro Michele’s vision, are for those who experience life and its fruits in order to bloom into their real selves. Staying true to the ingredients of Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum, the new Gucci Profumo di Fiori perfume for her heroes the fresh natural greenness, rich floral quality and creamy depth of Tuberose. Offering a radiant twist on the magnificent white floral signature of Bloom Eau de Parfum, Profumo di Fiori unleashes the addictive potential and magnetism of Tuberose Essence, blended with Jasmine Sambac Closed Buds and Jasmine Sambac Absolute for a more immediate and direct expression. The accord of Bloom is enriched by the textured facets of Ylang Ylang and its warmth extended by a rich wave of Sandalwood and the smooth creaminess of Sun Drenched Woody notes. Driving an elegant and distinctive trail, the Orris Concrete is blended with the resinous warmth of the Benzoin and softened with a sensual cloud of Musky notes. Fragrance Family: Amber Floral Top Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Rangoon Creeper Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Ylang Ylang Base Notes: Musk, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Orris

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=APF6SNH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum Set is a beautifully presented fragrance set containing Gucci Guilty in a full-sized 90ml bottle, alongside a 75ml deodorant stick and a 50ml shower gel in this woody, aromatic fougere EDP for men... Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum is a woody, aromatic and spicy EDP for men which seeks to intensify the traditional images of masculine beauty, enhancing their appeal with mystery and unconventionality. The combination of floral, citrus and spicy olfactory notes creates an unexpectedly invigorating retro vibe. The composition opens with the acidic, sweet, tanginess of Balsamic Vinegar blending with the heat of Red Chilli Pepper and floral tones of Rose. This leads on to the delicious harmony of a fruity, floral heart characterised by the delicacy of Neroli before the scent culminates in an earthy woody base of Cedar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Instant de Guerlain Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EDYKAT8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} L'Instant de Guerlain Eau de Parfum is an enduring masterpiece of the Guerlain brand, a sweet and indulgent floral fragrance that remains iconic to this day. A dazzling opening of orange honey, bergamot, and mandarin orange tantalises the senses. Ylang-ylang, magnolia, and jasmine beckon a bright and refreshing heart. Golden amber and rich sandalwood provide the closing touches in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Alive For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DSGDONH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Alive Perfume is a fragrance for women that combines a mix of sweet fruity accents with bold woody tones to create a memorable scent. Developed by Annick Menardo, the fragrance is ideal for daytime and spring use, as it adds a spark of energy while staying strong all day. The top notes include vibrant apple and plum tones, while the added blackcurrant and cinnamon create a warm sensation. The jasmine note in the middle of this Hugo Boss perfume creates a sweet feeling with a slight woody musk accent. You'll also find a cedarwood scent with a balsamic tone in Alive. Sandalwood and olive wood also appear at the end of this eau de parfum. These end notes create a firm body while giving the wearer the strength one deserves throughout the day. The eau de parfum is housed inside a brilliant clear bottle with a pink accent. The gold ornamentation on the top adds a sense of confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 40ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F4DBPNA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} I Want Choo Le Parfum embodies the bold, glamorous, and exceptional craftsmanship synonymous with Jimmy Choo. 'I Want Choo Le Parfum' is a playful, vibrant ode to empowering female friendships, evoking glamorous and memorable nights. This amber floral woody fragrance opens with vibrant notes of pear and is adorned by the solar inflexion of golden gardenia. The middle notes combine a creamy, warm heart with sweet jasmine, irresistible patchouli, and ambrette. The glamorous base notes, blending with moss, amber, sandalwood, and praline accord, give the creation a long-lasting trail. The sculptural-shaped bottle, crafted from captivating translucent gold metallic glass, is embellished with the distinctive JC monogram. Its gold spray cap and accent ring, intricately hammered with the iconic Jimmy Choo signature, add the finishing touches to the bottle's design. This exquisite bottle is complemented by sparkling gold outer packaging. Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum embodies a spirit of playfulness, combined with glamour, empowerment, and ignited confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Soleil Cristal Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B0YIAEF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Happiness is more than a feeling, it is an aura of light that radiates all around. La Vie Est Belle Soleil Cristal Eau de Parfum invites you to light up the world with happiness and turn the ordinary into extraordinary moments. Introducing the most luminous facette of happiness in the La Vie Est Belle fragrance line, our Eau de Parfum for women Soleil Cristal is the new solar addiction that shines bright with a warm floral heart. The new Eau de Parfum is composed of sparkling top notes of mandarin, a bursting heart of white flowers and a wake of sunkissed vanilla (Madagascar) combined with patchouli (Bali).

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray 2pcs Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AIL048T]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The first and most important quality of a fragrance should be its ability to tell a story. Every story has a beginning and for Narciso Rodriguez, that beginning was egyptian musk, his favourite scent, he was introduced to the mysterious essence by an unforgettable woman he met. Musk is at the heart of 'For Her', expressing itself through honey flower, radiant amber and tactile woody pulsations. The fragrant harmony develops gently, slowly, rounding out into the warm tones of sun-kissed skin, dusted in a soft, velvety sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina Eau de Parfum 50ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K29XC37]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Indulge in the enchanting world of Nina Ricci with the Nina Le Parfum Gift Set, a luxurious trio designed for the modern romantic. This set features the captivating Nina Le Parfum Eau de Parfum in both 50ml and a travel-friendly 10ml size, perfect for enveloping yourself in elegance wherever you go. The signature scent is a delicious blend of floral and fruity notes, leaving a trail of charm and sophistication. The fragrance opens with vibrant citrus and juicy apple, delicately blending into a floral heart of gardenia and jasmine. As it settles, a warm base of vanilla and amber wraps the skin in a soft, sensual embrace. Whether you're stepping out for a special occasion or simply elevating your everyday routine, Nina Le Parfum adds a magical touch to any moment. Completing the set is a 75ml perfumed body lotion that nourishes your skin while enhancing the longevity of the fragrance. Beautifully packaged, the Nina Ricci Nina Le Parfum Gift Set is a perfect present for yourself or someone special — a celebration of femininity, allure, and timeless elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Pure XS For Her Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FXQSF63]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Pure XS perfume For Her by Rabanne. Excess in a pure state. A floral fragrance with explosive sensuality. The ylang flower releases its carnal instinct into the leathery warmth of vanilla. Indecent... Fusion of popcorn. Addiction. And maddened senses... Notes of blown grain, musk, and milkwood, melting with the skin. Pure desire. Olfactive Family: Floral Amber Top Notes: Ylang-Ylang Heart Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood Base Notes: Salty-Sweet Popcorn, Ambrette Seed

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Deep Blue Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CC260DU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph Lauren Polo Deep Blue Eau De Parfum captures the essence of the ocean's mystery and allure. This men’s fragrance represents the pinnacle of the Polo Blue collection, offering a powerful yet refreshing scent experience inspired by the depths of the sea. Created by the renowned Master Perfumer Carlos Benaim, it combines vibrant notes that evoke the energy and vitality of the water. The fragrance opens with a refreshing burst of Bergamot, Grapefruit, and Hawaiian Green Mango, elevated by the unique CristalFizz ingredient that enhances its invigorating character. This exhilarating combination sets the tone for a journey through aromatic scents, leading to a heart that features the sophisticated elements of cypress and clary sage. These middle notes introduce a touch of elegance and natural depth, perfectly balancing the fragrance. As the scent evolves, the base notes of Patchouli, a Deep Ocean accord, and enveloping musk emerge, providing a warm and lasting finish. Polo Deep Blue embodies the sophisticated yet laid-back spirit of the Polo lifestyle, making it the ideal companion for any occasion. With Simon Nessman as the global ambassador, this fragrance is not just a scent; it’s an expression of style and confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Ginza Murasaki Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PHK8LT2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ginza Murasaki is a sweet, fruity, and sensually feminine fragrance deriving its inspiration and name from a regal shade of purple. It establishes itself with a modern accord of Fuji apple, pomegranate, and violet. The heart features gentle jasmine, wisteria, and freesia. The base finishes with silky sandalwood and radiant woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray + 75ml b/l Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JQ326VK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Burberry Goddess wraps you in warmth like a cashmere blanket on a cold evening. It opens with this beautiful woody vanilla that feels grounded and confident - not too sweet, just comforting. As it settles, there's this rich, almost creamy sweetness that reminds you of indulgent moments and makes you feel utterly luxurious. Then comes the surprise: a hint of lavender that brightens everything, adding just enough lightness to keep the vanilla from feeling heavy. It's the kind of fragrance that makes you stand a little taller, feel a little bolder. Warm, enveloping, and undeniably feminine.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Boisee Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EKI6OBD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Givenchy Gentleman Boisee Eau De Parfum is a sophisticated woody-spicy fragrance for men, embodying the perfect blend of strength and gentleness.The scent opens with the aromatic fire of Black Pepper and Coriander, bringing an energising spice to the fore, softened slightly by the floral nuance of Geranium. At its heart, the composition reveals a velvety fusion of Orris and the dry elegance of Cedarwood, enriched by the distinctive depth of Cacao. This smooth intensity evolves into a warm, sensual base where creamy Sandalwood, smoky Burning Wood and earthy Patchouli leave a lasting, elegant impression. Crafted for the modern gentleman, this refined fragrance exudes timeless charm and depth.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QGLL24H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Step into the world of refined indulgence with Gentleman Réserve Privée, where the art of perfumery meets the craft of distillation. This isn't just another fragrance, it's an experience that captures the soul of a luxury whisky lounge in a bottle. The journey begins with an unexpected twist: bright bergamot dances alongside an authentic whisky accord, crafted from aromatic barley sourced from Scotland's finest distilleries. It's bold, it's intriguing, and it immediately sets this scent apart from anything else in your collection. As the fragrance settles, you'll discover layers of complexity. Roasted chestnut brings an autumnal richness, while delicate iris adds just enough floral sophistication to keep things interesting. Then comes the benzoin: smooth, warm, and almost creamy, wrapping everything in a vanilla-tinged embrace that feels both comforting and expensive. The dry-down is where Gentleman Réserve Privée truly proves its pedigree. Cedarwood and patchouli create an earthy foundation, while vetiver adds a whisper of smoke that echoes back to that opening whisky note. It's masculine without being aggressive, classic without feeling dated. Perfect for the man who appreciates the finer things, whether that's a well-aged single malt or a perfectly tailored suit.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss The Scent Le Parfum for Her 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IJHU55H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This intense reinterpretation of the iconic ambery signature of BOSS The Scent, Le Parfum ignites the senses with orange blossom and vetiver accord, unleashing an alchemy of attraction impossible to resist. Spicy top notes of pink peppercorn contrast with orange blossom at the heart of the fragrance, setting a passionate stage. Warm vetiver unites with airy akigalawood at the base to intensify the sensuality of this fragrance. The jewel-shaped bottle with elegant plum lacquering is complete with a light-reflecting cap in a precious rose gold finish. Presented in a deep plum box, BOSS The Scent Le Parfum For Her is a powerful fragrance that takes seduction into a whole new dimension. Top notes: Orange Blossom Heart notes: Vetiver Akigalawood Base notes: Ambery Floral Woody

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold For Her Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=N4F31FM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the bold and captivating allure of Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold Eau de Parfum Spray 80ml, a luxurious fragrance designed for confident women who embrace their individuality. This radiant edition of the iconic Scandal line sparkles with vibrant notes of juicy honey, zesty blood orange, and delicate gardenia, layered over a warm, woody base. Perfect for day-to-night wear, this feminine perfume delivers a long-lasting, seductive scent that commands attention and leaves a memorable impression. Whether for everyday elegance or special occasions, Scandal Gold embodies sophistication and daring glamour. Add this exquisite women’s fragrance to your collection and make every moment unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: MontBlanc Explorer Extreme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray 4 Ps Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YFKQWHC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Embark on a journey of adventure with Montblanc Explorer Extreme, a woody, leathery parfum that calls on the modern voyager to conquer new horizons. A parfum evoking the absolute spirit of exploration, vibrant bergamot reveals an intense, invigorating essence, representing the vivacity and strength of the intrepid adventurer. The enigmatic, woody facets of patchouli and vetiver then fuse with the amber and leather accord. Amplifying every note of this intense fragrance, they add a warm depth that lingers long after the adventure begins. Reuniting a timeless elegance and a heritage of craftsmanship, this men's fragrance is wrapped in a black sleeve embossed with the signature Montblanc Extreme leather pattern, for a bottle more extreme than ever. Set comprises of 100ml EDP Spray, 100ml Shower Gel and 2x 7.5 Mini.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Dark Amber & Ginger Lily Eau de Cologne Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WD4LWA0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A whisper of incense drifts through the air, evoking the serenity of an ancient Japanese ritual. The fragrance opens with the smooth warmth of black cardamom, its smoky character lifted by a touch of ginger, creating an aura of refined sensuality and calm sophistication. At the heart lies the mysterious beauty of black orchid, weaving its deep, velvety tones through a bouquet of delicate water lily and jasmine. This blend reveals a rich floral elegance that feels both alluring and timeless, capturing the essence of quiet strength and luxury. The base unfolds into the soothing depth of Kyara incense, the prized wood at the heart of the Kohdo ceremony. Infused with the golden glow of dark amber, it leaves a lingering trail of warmth and tranquility. A dark, distinctive scent that honours tradition while embracing modern sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OGLEUVH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Montblanc Platinum is a crisp and modern fragrance cutting together sharp aromatic accords and a medley of woody notes. A leading violet leaf accord adds metallic freshness. The heart makes an aromatic showing of clary sage. The base finishes with earthy cedar.

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K79X9T8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Divine Elixir transforms how you move through the world. That first spray is like stepping into warm seawater wrapped in silk – salty, alive, unexpectedly rich. The tuberose blooms unapologetically, heady and creamy, while a marine thread keeps it from feeling too heavy. As it settles, tonka bean wraps around you like second-skin warmth, and amber creates a golden haze that feels like confidence made tangible. What it really does is make you feel magnetic. It amplifies that knowing sense of your own power and femininity. You don't just wear it – you embody it, and everything else adjusts to orbit around you.

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BCB7FXN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Paradigme, the new signature masculine fragrance by Prada. Paradigme Eau de Parfum expresses sophistication and avant-garde in an unexpected masculine Ambery Woody scent. Opening a new olfactive paradigm, oscillating between enveloping warmth and exhilarating freshness. The warm sensuality of ambery woods is entwined with a green Bourbon Geranium, uplifted by a fusing Calabrian Bergamot Heart. The Paradigme bottle immediately invites curiosity. An architectural silhouette of radical elegance and an avant-garde statement through the tactile tilted Prada triangle. A bottle lacquered in an intense and alluring black to green gradation, the house’s iconic color.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QKKKPOJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A floral ambery fragrance that embraces the paradoxes of iconic ingredients to reveal new scented sensations. Reinventing freshness with the first Neroli bud extraction for Prada, to capture the flower’s fresh dimension. Reinventing sensuality with Ambrofix™, a bio-converted amber, revealing a vibrant warmth. Reinventing intensity through a new revolutionary musk molecule: the Serenolide™, for an intense yet subtle and comfortable trail noticeable right from the top. Master perfumers Nadège Le Garlantezec, Shyamala Maisondieu and Antoine Maisondieu collaborated with Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons to reconcile timelessness and avant-garde, nature and innovation. This Prada feminine fragrance embraces the paradoxes of iconic ingredients to reveal new scented sensations.

listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KYIYML3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} My Way Parfum is a celebration of self discovery, capturing the feeling of stepping into the unknown with confidence. This intense and woody powdery bouquet blends bright solar tuberose with the refined freshness of iris pallida, all housed in a bottle that shifts from deep inky blue at the base to radiant pink at the neck. The fragrance opens with vibrant bergamot oil from Calabria paired with sparkling orange blossom infused in bitter orange oil from Egypt. In the base, the scent settles into a smooth and grounding finish. Oakmoss, sandalwood, and patchouli provide a lasting impression with their warm, woody texture. At the same time, it fits in perfectly with the lifestyle of modern women. It is refreshing and does not overpower. Daisy Marc Jacobs is one those scents that all women should have sitting on their dressing table. It derives its refreshing notes from violet leaf and grapefruit. After that, you will pick up on the gentle notes of gardenia and vanilla. In the mix, you will also find strawberry and jasmine. We are pleased to be able to offer Marc Jacobs Daisy Perfume. This wonderful eau de toilette always makes a wonderful gift. However, we are well aware that this makes a perfect treat for yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Kiss Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YAKB1US]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume is one of those scent experiences you should not miss out on. One of the most exciting additions to its fragrance collection is Marc Jacobs Daisy Kiss. This fragrance is full of hidden surprises that explode out of the bottle. At the same time, it is not an over-powering scent. It offers both soft and gentle notes. However, it has to be said that there is something else about Marc Jacobs Daisy that makes you stand up and pay attention. Hidden in the base of the scent are fuller tones including musk and cedar. It is this all-round scent experience that makes it such a crowd pleaser. Since it was first brought out in 2017, it has become a flagship scent for the brand. Buy this superb eau de toilette for yourself or for someone else. It makes a fantastic gift or personal pat-on-the back when you need an uplifting experience. We are delighted to be able to offer the fragrance at a very special price.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Decadence Eau So Decadent Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JLYVUJE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume is a top class perfumer which has so much to offer. Needless to say, if you love what the brand has to offer, you should try Marc Jacobs Decadence Eau So Decadent. It is one of those fragrances that seamlessly takes you through the day into the night. The first notes you encounter are pear mixed with black currant and ivy. Once the scent starts to develop, you will also pick up on jasmine, magnolia and delicate lily-of-the-valley. The scent ends with soft white amber and cashmere wood. This eau de toilette is certainly intriguing. When you are looking for a new exciting scent, it makes the perfect choice. At the same time, it also makes a wonderful gift purchase.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Poudree Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Narciso Poudree, a woody and floral fragrance, by Narciso Rodriguez. The Eau de Parfum opens with a burst of rose and white jasmine. Intertwined with a gentle heart of musk, resting on a base of vetiver and black cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci L'Extase Caresse Roses Legere Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2016, this sensual fragrance from Nina Ricci is a lighter interpretation of the original. It is inspired by the idea of the naked body wrapped in a fragrant veil.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci L'Extase Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2015, this floriental fragrance is inspired by a woman's erotic fantasies. The scent represents the third pillar of the house after L’Air du Temps and Nina. L’Extase invites you to liberate your fantasies.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Luna Blossom Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: Luna Blossom by Nina Ricci is a “Eau de Toilette“ for women belonging to the floral frutal family. This is Luna's younger sister, who takes on a lighter, fresher tone, but still keeps alive the story of eternal friendship, between the two girls who live in different places, day and night, and who maintain a friendship that transcends all barriers, for, without day, there could be no night, and vice versa.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Luna Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: It is a fragrance, with exquisite curves and gourmand accents, to the cascading laughter and thrills of young girls. An unprecedented fragrance dedicated to life’s explorers. A fragrance with a vibrant intensity. A magnetic apple in blue and night hues. A leather tie delicately surrounds the neck while two quivering and determined golden leaves, abound with fine promises.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: Nina Ricci launched Mademoiselle Ricci in 2012. The fragrance for women is meant as a tribute to a fashion collection that Ricci introduced in the United States in the 1960s. Mademoiselle Ricci was developed by perfumer Alberto Morillas.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: To reinvent and embellish reality, Nina Ricci tells a modern fairy tale, seductive and captivating, with a magical fragrance, a promise of charm, enchantment and emotion. A sparkling sweet floral fragrance with a hint of toffee apple to lend a femininity caressed by seduction, for a modern girl living between dream and reality.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q6ISONJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} To reinvent and embellish reality, Nina Ricci tells a modern fairy tale, seductive and captivating, with a magical fragrance, a promise of charm, enchantment and emotion. A young woman in search of her femininity, flirting consciously with magic and the unexpected. A subtle and tireless explorer of her secret. Nina L’Eau is a white swirl. listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Rose Extase Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: Rose Ecstase Eau de Toilette reveals a new interpretation of rose in a concentrate of desire and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Black XS Potion Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UBH9Q5E]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Paco Rabanne Black XS is an exciting range of fragrances. If you enjoy the finer things in life, buying a Rabanne scent is a great choice. What does Black XS for Her smell like? This is a scent that will make you stand out in a crowd. It is not one of those fragrances that you notice every day. It makes a floral opening statement while also delivering darker nuances including musk and woody notes. Let the scent fully develop, and you pick up on Black Violet, vanilla and cranberry. This is a very sophisticated scent perfect for daytime wear, it is also a good option for special occasions. We are delighted to offer this scent in a 100ml eau de toilette format. Why not buy it for yourself or treat someone special to this exquisite fragrance?

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Paco Unisex Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Paco is one of the most classic scents that you can buy. It can truly be said that it has stood the test of time. Did you know that Paco Rabanne Unisex first saw the light of the day back in 1995? For many, that is all they need to know. It goes to prove that this surely must be a quality scent and up there with many of the greatest. So, why do you need this eau de toilette? Its fresh aroma of citrus coupled with something a little bit heavier, is what makes this scent special. When you are looking for a scent that is perfect for both night and day, this is the one for you. Of course, the design of the 100ml bottle has changed over the years. But it continues to look as good as it smells. It is a fantastic scent that never fails to please.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Amber Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: The first fragrance from fashion house Prada, which took three years in the making. This amber fragrance, composed by Max Gavarry and Carlos Benaïm of IFF, is described as a reinterpretation of traditional perfumery, and features sandalwood oil, patchouli leaf, labdanum and benjui.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum is the lively, fun-filled fragrance in the Prada range. It is a modern perfume from this classic brand; celebrating life and colour and happiness. This is the perfume for Prada's next generation. It's funky and fun and full of life; not to mention that it's sexy and completely irresistible.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Florale Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R5DSO15]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Prada Candy Florale is a playful and elegant fragrance that captures a sense of youthful charm with a refined floral twist. Designed for the modern woman who embraces lightness and spontaneity, this scent blends freshness with a subtle sweetness that feels effortlessly stylish and free-spirited. Opening with a sparkling burst of Italian limoncello, the fragrance soon reveals a delicate heart of blooming peony, creating a soft and romantic aura. As it settles, warm notes of benzoin, musk, caramel, and honey wrap the scent in a creamy, inviting finish that lingers gently on the skin. Launched in 2014, Prada Candy Florale follows the success of Candy L’Eau and continues the legacy of the iconic Candy collection. Light, feminine, and full of charm, this perfume is perfect for everyday wear, bringing a touch of sweetness and floral sophistication to any moment.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Gloss Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: A bright, lively fragrance that combines joyful fruits with sweet florals. With an opening that spotlights sour cherry, it creates a contrast of sweet and sour with the addition of cassis. The intense opening mellows into a softer heart of orange blossoms, rose and peach. The scent finishes on a base of almonds, vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Kiss Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VKEL1XM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The starting point of this fragrance is the mono chord presence of musk and cotton, its signature purity and tenderness leaving their mark all the way from top to base notes. Prada Candy Kiss is an interpretation of a modern kind of woman who loves impress and being herself.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy L'Eau Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: As sweet as the name suggests, Prada Candy L'Eau is a delicious and feminine perfume which has a warming, caramel like scent perfect for the summer. Prada Candy L'Eau is a mix of citrusy top notes, heart notes of sweet pea and base notes of White Musk, Benzoin and caramel. Playful and seductive, this perfume is a fantastic choice from the luxury brand.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa, inspired by the infamous 'Luna Rossa' boat created in 1997 for the America's Cup. Taking the esteemed Luna Rossa name as its own, it is a masculine scent with a reverence for the natural world and a passion for innovation. The bottle and packaging are inspired by the technological excellence and sleek, dynamic beauty of extreme sailing boats, both displaying the iconic red Prada stripe. Prada Luna Rossa is a masculine fragrance that reinterprets traditional ingredients with agility. The backbone of the fragrance is Lavender- an unmistakable natural ingredient in perfumery- teamed with a bitter freshness of Orange essence, resulting in a fresh and invigorating scent. Aromatic Clary Sage and Spearmint Nanah Essences channel the spirit of vast open spaces and rugged, natural elements, richly nuanced and sublime.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R6O90PX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Carrying a spirit of competition, the thrill of the race, Luna Rossa Sport by Prada signifies the man who rises to the challenge. The fragrance features a fresh aromatic wrapped in spice, invigorating and sweet. It opens in juniper berries carried ginger for a fiery breath of vigour. At its heart a floral accord deeply seating itself in lavender and, at its base, comes the creamy sweet union of vanilla and tonka bean that provides a soothing finish to the sporty fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler A*men Kryptomint Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Presented as a crisp, green oriental, A*Men Kryptomint is a revolutionary limited edition of the A*Men line released for 2017. Providing a key burst of liberating energy it packs the power to feel like a superhero with a cool edge that wakes up the senses. An opening breath of mint and rosemary gives the fragrance a strong kick before striding into a heart of geraniums. A bittersweet base comprises tonka bean, chocolate, coffee and vanilla all balanced by an earthy touch of patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Womanity Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U3N5VSI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The contemporary perfume Womanity from Mugler is inspired by the women of diverse stories, colors, and cultures. An ode to the feminine and creative force, Womanity is multifaceted as its femininity. A unique creation, it blends sweet and spicy notes that so characterizes the iconic scents of Mugler. Its striking notes of caviar, ripe figs, and wood make it a versatile and unique fragrance, reflecting the modern independent woman.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Body Kouros Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: For the man who cares for his body, Body Kouros offers a daring oriental spicy fragrance that evokes a powerfully masculine portrait. Topped with a contrast of revitalizing eucalyptus, Body Kouros combines vivid freshness with the spiritual nuances of incense. At its heart, spicy clary sage meddles with a somber Chinese cedar and finally a base rich in benzoin provides a balsamic finish.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C2NQOB4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With a fresh and sparkling opening, Yves Saint Laurent's L'Homme has an elegant and modern character, made of floral and spicy notes.It is a deeply masculine fragrance. A glass and metal bottle whose architecture is drawn out to produce a new, uncluttered graphic object with the urban skyscraper reference, topped as in the original version, with the symbolic hexagonal cap. This set contains: 100ml L'Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml Aftershave Balm 10ml Travel Spray

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent 'M7' Oud Absolu Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: A resounding disruption for a fragrance of excess, the first to use oud, the most dense and diffusive of all woods. It's essence develops a deep unambiguous presence and already contains notes of balm and amber. Used in the 'M7' fragrance in an exceptionally high concentration, it merges with myrrh and cistus to create a warm, intense and fascinating trail. Mandarin gives a top opening and delivers singular vibrancy, whereas a very potent and dense patchouli wood facet provides depth and addictive tenacity. The 'M7' man has raw virility and sensuality that makes him equally desirable and dangerous.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Opium Pour Homme by Yves Saint Laurent is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for men. Opium Pour Homme was launched in 1995. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are black currant and star anise; middle notes are galanga and pepper; base notes are tolu balsam, atlas cedar and bourbon vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SBIK8HV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Azzaro Wanted by Night aftershave for men is a fragrance of vibrant and explosive freshness. Top notes: Cinnamon, Mandarin Orange, Lavender, Lemon Heart notes: Red Cedar, Incense, Cumin, Fruity Notes Base notes: Cedar, Tobacco, Cypress, Benzoin, Iso E Super, Leather, Patchouli, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Aura Refillable Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Delving into the primal essences of nature and life, Aura by Mugler embodies a fresh and sensual melody, stimulating the senses with a beautiful, feminine array of botanical fragrances. A pulse of bergamot and rhubarb leaf awakens the fragrance, carrying into a heart of orange blossom, green notes and ylang-ylang, a pair of fresh accords that offer a crisp freedom contrasted by tastefully sour notes. A base of abundant, smooth vanilla and woods completes Aura, highlighted in amberwood and sandalwood for oriental whispers.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss The Scent Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CS25NX5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss aftershave has one of the most extensive collections of exciting aftershaves in the world. When you are looking for a new aftershave, one of the scents you should put on top of your list is Hugo Boss the Scent Intense. It is one of the men's scents that has a character that is different from others. Although it is a bit more daring, it is still perfect for daytime wear as well as evening wear. The scent is an exciting blend of woody masculinity highlighted with fresh undertones. Unlike many other men's fragrances, this eau de parfum does not overpower the wearer. On this occasion, the scent is presented in a 100ml bottle. It makes a perfect gift or a personal purchase. As it is a smaller bottle, it easily slips into your gym kit, man bag, or weekend back. When you are in the mood for something different, this is the right scent for you.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CDEUJR7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A classic re-imagined. Gentleman Givenchy was originally released in 1974 and was redefined in 2017 with a new style whilst maintaining a strong masculine identity.  Succulent freshness of pear combines with the spicy roar of cardamom. Aromatic lavender entwines with powdery of iris before contrasting in a strong masculine base of leather and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Aftershave 100ml Splash
listings.description: Carolina Herrera presented the 212 VIP masculine edition in the year 2011. This night life scent radiates your uber cool style and attitude of the New York party animal with subtle notes of gin and vodka

listings.rawTitle: Loris Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Splendida Jasmin Noir Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Perfume from the Splendida collection by Bvlgari, where black jasmine enhances its opulence. Duality of perfume that breaks the molds of traditional perfumery.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum 160ml Spray
listings.description: Euphoria is defined as a state of intense excitement and happiness and the fragrance composition invites you to explore this state of mind. The composition is made up of appealing, dark and exotic flavours such as Japanese apple, green leaves, Lotus, black orchid, red woods, black pomegranate, violet and amber. Since becoming incredibly popular, Calvin Klein has launched several spin off fragrances in the same series.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier Declaration Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BNCFGN1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Cartier Declaration Eau de Parfum is crafted for the confident man who isn’t afraid to express himself. listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only the Brave Tattoo Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense fragrance is announced as ultra sensual and feminine. The heart includes intoxicating and opulent flower of ylang-ylang mixed with rose honey. The base consists of patchouli and amber accord.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Modern Muse Nuit Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Estée Lauder Modern Muse Nuit is glamorous, captivating, sensual and seduction. It is an intriguing new fragrance for the award winning Modern Muse Collection. Blends of floral and creamy woods create an extraordinary scent that is vibrant and warm. The innovative dual-impression structure allows women to experience the fragrance through two contrasting accords; bold yet seductive Jasmine Absolute and luxurious opulence of Musk & Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ange Ou Demon Le Secret Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Seduce from afar with the Givenchy Ange ou Démon Le Secret Eau de Parfum, a playful fragrance for women with radiant white floral facets. An intensely intimate Eau de Parfum for her, the Givenchy Ange ou Démon Le Secret woman is mysterious and alluring. Her captivating silhouette embraces both the sweetness and strength from this breathtaking signature. Her beauty is no mystery but her fragrance choice may say otherwise.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Live Irresistible Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: A truly alluring floral fruity fragrance that captivates the senses in a beautiful ode to life. A succulent platter of fruits opens with pineapple, grapefruit, rose petals and tangerine. Spicy pepper adds heat to the heart of rose and passionfruit. Finally a sweet base of praline accented by amber, orris root, vanilla, patchouli and musk. Set Includes Eau de parfum 75ml Spray, 75ml Body Cream and Carry Pouch.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Flora by Gucci is a fresh floral fragrance for women. Sparkling notes of citruses, peony and mandarin orange in the opening offer a burst of energy, while crisp roses and osmanthus in the heart lead the mind to a field full of gorgeous flowers; the base is a warm spring evening featuring sandalwood, patchouli and pink pepper. The fragrance was named after Flora, Roman goddess of spring and its fluid is inspired by the colour of fine champagne. Which Gucci Flora is the best? Try the Eau de Toilette for a delicate blooming scent or dare with the rich EDP! Flora was launched by Gucci in 2009.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled OUD Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

This perfume will serve you every day as a decent addition to your business style.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss The Scent Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U0BE3X2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss aftershave series is the perfect choice when you are looking for an aftershave that takes you through the day into the night. However, when you are looking for something a little bit special, you are looking for Hugo Boss the Scent Intense. It is an eau de parfum which is simply a must-have. If you are new to the brand, now is the perfect opportunity to try this exciting scent in a 50ml spray bottle. Perfect for the gym or a quick weekend get-away. A perfect gift or personal purchase for yourself to update your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss The Scent Private Accord Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BIBORHN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Aftershave added another edition to its fragrance lineup. Private accord is a perfume designed for men that was released in 2018. Being the only brand that has used the fragrance of an exotic fruit, known as Maninka, Hugo Boss The Scent is spicy, enigmatic, and warm at the same time. The first note that comes to your nose is a rich cocoa note, followed by a dark chocolate impression. A sprinkle of pepper adds some spiciness. The chocolate and coffee give this aroma a mocha vibe.
