It combines freshness and warmth in a seamless way, making it a go-to choice for any occasion. With its refined balance of citrus, floral, and woody notes, Bottega Veneta Illusione for Women evokes a sense of quiet confidence and timeless charm.

listings.rawTitle: Bottega Veneta Illusione for Her Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PN710X3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With Illusione, Bottega Veneta once again defines the true meaning of "luxury". This sensuous Eau de Parfum was created to express a relaxing siesta by the pool when all you can feel is the warm Italian breeze on the surface of the water. The fragrance also has a masculine counterpart Illusione Eau de Toilette, forming an elegant Italian couple. Make your dreams a bit more real, and your reality a bit dreamier. The Bottega Veneta Illusione Eau de Parfum can do that for you – just for a moment, it blurs the line between dream and reality to bring you a feast for the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Bottega Veneta Illusione for Her Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OYSWQTG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With Illusione, Bottega Veneta once again defines the true meaning of "luxury". This sensuous Eau de Parfum was created to express a relaxing siesta by the pool when all you can feel is the warm Italian breeze on the surface of the water. The fragrance also has a masculine counterpart Illusione Eau de Toilette, forming an elegant Italian couple. Make your dreams a bit more real, and your reality a bit dreamier. The Bottega Veneta Illusione Eau de Parfum can do that for you – just for a moment, it blurs the line between dream and reality to bring you a feast for the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Bottega Veneta Illusione for Men Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OUOQ8KS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Bottega Veneta Illusione brings you a story from the sunlit Italian countryside where the time has stopped at the perfect moment. The light reflections also play out in the design of the bottle where individual sun rays create various shapes when shining through the thick glass. A beautifully crafted cap is the crowning glory of this unique fragrance. Prolong that intoxicating moment between being awake and falling asleep. This edge between reality and dream has produced Bottega Veneta Illusione Eau de Toilette for men which will instantly transport you to a luxury pool of an Italian villa. Only you, warm summer breeze, and endless relaxation.

listings.rawTitle: Bottega Veneta Knot Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AU2WT5X]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The creation of this Eau de Parfum was inspired by the romantic idea of an old villa on the Italian coast. Its warm centre combines the aroma of fresh sea air, subtle flowers from the garden and the local earthy hills. Knot was launched in 2014. The sparkling Bottega Veneta Knot Eau de Parfum is synonymous with sophisticated, casual elegance and its fragrance will carry you away to the sunny Italian coast in a flash.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K7OD8S8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau is a fragrance that was created for today's man to project his personal appeal while manifesting his inner power throughout the day. This masculine scent is built on tonka bean, an element of nature that emanates a fresh and elegant scent. This eau de toilette makes an impact from the start through a bottle that emulates a toned male chest, which represents the spiritual strength of man. Le Beau also contains olfactory notes of bergamot, mint, lavender, cedarwood, sandalwood and coconut wood that enhance the original appeal of every man who chooses this scent. This extraordinary 75ml bottle holds within it a seductive masculine fragrance for today's man. This scent is basically fresh for men to carry out a demanding daily routine while feeling confident in their inner strength. This original fragrance faithfully represents the sexy man who seeks to evolve in all areas of his life.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=O0DUPF3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Miss Dior Perfume is a feminine collection of fragrances offered by this premier French perfume brand. With so many fragrance brands available, it is not easy to find a perfume that stands out. If you are looking for a feminine perfume packed with modern nuances, Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming is a perfect choice. Although sweet, this perfume from the Miss Dior range has hidden depths. Notes of pink pepper run through the scent making it modern and interesting. Woody and musky nuances make it modern and appealing. Adding to that, you will pick up on hints of warm sugar. In other words, you can say that this is an eau de parfum that offers you both sugar and spice. A great fragrance for daytime wear or special occasions. As it is a rather unique scent, you are not likely to run into someone else wearing it at a party. Buy it for yourself but it also makes a welcome gift.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Addict Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H0NBN9I]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Perfume offer this spray in this perfectly sized smaller bottle and it’s one of the more popular scents from the designer. As a brand, they produce some of the most exciting and vibrant fragrances in the world of perfumes. Dior Addict is not any different. If you have not yet tried the fragrance, you really should take the opportunity to do so. Dior Addict perfume delivers the perfect blend of top notes. The rich tones of Mandarin leaf and Tunisian Orange Blossom are the first notes you pick up on. This is followed by a touch of sweetness made up of vanilla and honey essence. The undertones in the scent are amber and jasmine. The fragrance is held together by the smoothness of Tonka bean. Now is the perfect opportunity to try this Christian Dior Perfume. And you’ll find, with this easy to carry 30ml bottle, it’ll never leave your side. The scent makes the perfect personal treat or a gift for someone special.

listings.rawTitle: Dior J'Adore in Joy Eau de toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EK98XIU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior perfume is a perfume brand that likes to surprise its customers. It never stops innovating and bringing out new delights to surprise its fan base. J’adore in Joy was a complete surprise to many when it was launched in 2017. Although it has notes in common with the original J’adore Perfume, the scent is full of surprises. Ylang-ylang and heavenly jasmine are two of the fragrance delights you can enjoy in this scent. You will also pick up on more exotic tones including Comoros which you find in very few scents. This combination has made this eau de toilette unique. If you have not as yet added it to your collection, it is time you did so. We are offering you the opportunity to add the joy of J’adore into your life in a 50ml bottle. A great gift for someone or a personal purchase when you want to refresh your perfume collection.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Miss Dior Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UJ1U9XJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Miss Dior Perfume is well-known for its creative use of natural ingredients. What can you expect from this beautiful eau de parfum? It is packed with flowery notes derived from the natural essences of irises and peonies. For spice, Lily-of-the-Valley has been added. Apricot and rose add further interest. Christian Dior Perfume has been creating beautiful perfumes since 1946. The brand’s experience is evident in every bottle of fragrance it produces. If you have not as yet added CD to your perfume collection, you should do so. Miss Dior is without a shadow one of the best fragrances from Dior Perfume. We are pleased to be able to offer our customers this feminine fragrance perfect for women of all ages. Order it for yourself or gift a bottle to someone special in your life. This is a truly great fragrance and you will fall in love with it from the first drop.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Eau Sauvage Parfum Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KIU5YLX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior aftershave is the perfect designer brand to get your next fragrance from. This is one of those male fragrances that can take you anywhere. It does not matter if you are going out for the evening or to work - you can rely on the Eau Sauvage Parfum. Eau Sauvage is an intense fragrance experience. The first notes are of aromatic and citrus notes. As you let the scent develop, you will also discover other undertones including fresh spices for freshness. It is this combination that makes Dior Sauvage Aftershave a go-anywhere scent. It is perfect for date nights as well as meetings. As it is a more intense fragrance experience, a little of the eau de parfum goes a long way. We are delighted to be able to offer this Dior men’s fragrance at a very special price. Take this opportunity to add it to your aftershave and scent collection or buy it as a gift for someone special.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Eau Sauvage Parfum Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SRBV6JJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Aftershave is a must-have scent brand for men. A true classic fragrance that effortlessly delivers. It has the class you would expect from this perfumer and is a reinvention of the original Eau Sauvage cologne. This is a really ‘grown up’ scent, perfect for real perfume enthusiasts. So what can you expect from Eau Sauvage? This is a truly masculine yet aromatic fragrance. It has just the right level of intensity making use of top quality fragrance oils including citrus and fresh spices. A touch of earthy and green notes has also been added for extra freshness. Compared to many other scents in this category, it lasts a really long time too! We are delighted that we can offer this top Dior Sauvage Aftershave as the eau de parfum version. It is a mature scent that never disappoints. Although most men choose to buy it for themselves, it also makes an excellent present or gift.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=STUG7IL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Sauvage is the one male fragrance that never lets you down. It is perfect for most occasions including daytime activities such as popping into the office or going out for lunch. During the nighttime, those dark and alluring notes come into their own. Sauvage is rich in classic men’s notes including bergamot and pepper. Ambroxan, a natural fragrance enhancer, adds interest and boosts the qualities of this scent. Citrus has been added for freshness. This wide range of notes is what makes the fragrance a great choice for almost any occasion including nights out or workdays. If you have not as yet tried Dior Sauvage parfum, you should order this smaller format eau de parfum bottle. It gives you a chance to try the fragrance and explore its notes. Order it for yourself or buy it for someone who needs to spice up their male fragrance collection. It is a truly great men’s fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YS2VDCR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty is an ageless classic. The sexy, warm, floral essence has led to the popularity of this scent. The opening notes of this fragrance are an airy veil of sweet flowers combined with delicious berries, fresh peaches, and crisp bergamot. The middle notes include sweet peony, subtle lily, and sensual jasmine. The base consists of deep woodsy sandalwood, earthy musk, and rich vanilla blossom.   The sweet floral-fruity bouquet mixed with the richness of vanilla makes it a great fragrance for everyday wear. The warm sexy ora of citrusy bergamot, rich jasmine, and sandalwood make it a perfect Eau de Toilette for evening wear. The addition of musk leads to the longevity of the smell so that you have to reapply less often. The combination of all of these luscious scents makes Sheer Beauty Calvin Klein 100ml an excellent choice for every occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>Azzaro Wanted is looking for you, the sophisticated man ready to take on the world. It wants you, the charismatic Don Juan, who lives life on the edge. Celebrate life with this powerful bottle of seduction and strength. Let the Wanted aftershave arouse that which you crave.</p> <p>This bold fragrance gets driven by spicy, citrus, and woody notes, radiating a desire for the man who wears it. The Wanted man oozes confidence and independence as he instinctively pursues his passions and wins. Dare to be invincible with Azzaro Wanted 100ml.</p> <p>Even the bottle drips with masculine sex appeal with its metallic contours that scream your name. Its unique shape begs for you to rip its cap off and basque in its aromatic luxury.</p>

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Introducing Azzaro 'Wanted' an audacious and flamboyant new fragrance for men. It is a woody, citrus and spicy eau de toilette with a fresh, sensual and captivating masculinity. A fragrance of vibrant and explosive brings freshness, unfolding into a bold spicy accord revealing a radiant and spirited personality. Its sensual woody notes establish a new elegant and captivating masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro pour Homme by Azzaro is a aromatic fougere fragrance for men. Azzaro pour Homme was launched in 1978. The noses behind this fragrance are Gerard Anthony, Martin Heiddenreich and Richard Wirtz. Top notes are caraway, orris, lavender, clary sage, basil, anise, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are sandalwood, juniper berries, patchouli, vetiver, cedar and cardamom; base notes are leather, tonka bean, amber, musk and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro pour Homme by Azzaro is a aromatic fougere fragrance for men. Azzaro pour Homme was launched in 1978. The noses behind this fragrance are Gerard Anthony, Martin Heiddenreich and Richard Wirtz. Top notes are caraway, orris, lavender, clary sage, basil, anise, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are sandalwood, juniper berries, patchouli, vetiver, cedar and cardamom; base notes are leather, tonka bean, amber, musk and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Club Women Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: An oriental fragrance opening with top notes of pomegranate and passion fruit; middle note of cashmere wood; and base notes of vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Club Men Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: A woody aromatic fragrance that opens with top notes of lemon and papaya; middle note of cannabis; and base notes of hinoki and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2007 Chrome Legend is a follow-up to 1996's Chrome, and is described as 'a more sophisticated fragrance'.The notes include tea, green apple, bitter orange, musk, moss, sea spray, cedar, vetiver, amber and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro Chrome Intense opens with a citrusy union of bergamot and grapefruit, creating sparkling chords embellished with tart ginger and hedione molecule. The heart develops notes of ozone, jasmine water and lichen, while the base is created of precious wood, mate, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Built on a dominant citrus and musk accord, the fragrance arouses freshness and vigor. A gentle aquatic note is added to this opening aroma, followed by a woody end note mixed with shades of 'tea'. Top note: Lemon, Petitgrain, Rosemary, Pineapple. Middle note : Coriander, Jasmine, Cyclamen, Orris. Base note : Cedarwood, Moss, Tonka, Musk. The packaging is adorned in Mediterranean steel-blue, a symbol of purity, and a silver metal color for refinement and perfection. It is made of transparent glass, with a chevron top in the shape of a horsewoman.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VAV10CF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Introducing Azzaro Chrome the new Eau de Toilette for men. Chrome is a citrus, aquatic and woody fragrance that reveals a luminous, vibrant and comforting freshness thanks to its aquatic notes. Azzaro Chrome features fresh notes of bergamot, grapefruit and ginger, aquatic notes of transparent musks and comforting notes of amber, sandalwood and maté leaves to create a blend of intense and enveloping freshness.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Florabotanica Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Inspired by a strange and wonderful garden in which you do not know whether the flowers are innocent or poisonous, Florabotanica from Balenciaga evokes the 18th Century botanical gardens in which the most exotic and rarest plant species were displayed. Strange-coloured plants discovered in distant countries brought back from their travels by enthusiastic biologists.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga B Balenciaga Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Fresh and alluring, the fragrance opens with green notes of edamame and lily of the valley bell. As B.BALENCIAGA evolves, the iris note reveals a powdery essence before drying down with darker woody notes of cashmeran woods.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Paris Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Balenciaga Paris is a lovely paradox. It is a perfume that becomes life, that melds with living. Wear Balenciaga Paris and become a close yet inaccessible woman who strolls under leafy arbors. Balenciaga Paris opens with demure notes of violet make this a light, floral and pleasing scent. Balenciaga Paris then moves into peppery notes that reveal themselves and evoke a scent of calm, mossy wood. Balenciaga Paris is a fragrance full of light with a few dark apertures that create a complex and intoxicating allure.

listings.rawTitle: Beyonce Heat Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Beyoncé Heat Fragrance Collection Catch the fever with Beyoncé Heat, the first fragrance by Beyoncé. Sensual. Sexy. Sophisticated. Beyoncé Heat is an alluring, feminine fragrance featuring rare sensual flowers created for the modern woman exuding confidence, sexiness and energy. Let yourself feel the heat.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Aromatics in White Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A women&rsquo;s fragrance which lures with tart notes of Sichuan pepper, elegant violet leaves and labdanum in top notes. The gentle transition towards the heart comes with floral shades of roses and orange blossom, surrounded with patchouli, creating a harmonious union of floral and earthy textures. Depth and sensual aromas are ensured by leather musk, intertwined with warm grey amber, benzoin and vanilla. United this way, they leave a soft, oriental signature in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Happy Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: Clinique Happy For Men is one of the more interesting male scents available. When you are thinking about buying the man in your life a cologne, you should include this one on the list. Yes, it has a distinct masculine scent, but at the same time, it offers something different. In short, there is a reason why it is called Happy - it is truly uplifting. The fragrance is vanilla based, but as you let it linger, you will also pick up masculine undertones such as sandalwood and musk. It is Clinique Happy special blend that makes it stand among other men's scents and fragrances. As Happy was initially launched as a female scent, it is easy to presume that the 100ml bottle will be geared towards the fairer sex. Take a closer look, and you will find the bottle has a clear unisex feel which makes perfect for a man's bathroom shelf. Buy it as a present or why not buy it for yourself. This is one of the scents the ladies really do appreciate.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Happy Cologne Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XYHK6TM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Clinique Happy Cologne Eau De Toilette is a crisp, cool and refreshing EDT for men recommended for daytime wear. It has a characteristic and original marine note of Oyster which is blended with Lime and Mandarin. Transparent flowers stay in the background to give room to ethereal scents of Cedarwood, Lignum Vitae and Cypress. Top Notes: Kaffir Lime, Kalamanzi Fruit, Mandarin and Yuzu. Heart Notes: Green Notes. Base Notes: Cedar, Mediterranean Cypress and Guaiacwood.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Aromatics Elixir Eau de Parfum 45ml Spray
listings.description: Something far and beyond, Aromatics Elixir touches the senses and spirit in subtle, pleasing ways. This perfume appeals to the individual in every woman.

listings.rawTitle: Aspen Aspen Cologne 118ml Spray
listings.description: Aspen for men cologne by Coty helps you exude a subtle masculinity. The outdoorsy scents of citrus and woods mingle with a hint of spice to create a clean and confident fragrance, perfect for a day at the office or an outing with friends. Aspen has been a popular signature scent for many men since its introduction in 1989. It can add a touch of rugged elegance to everyday business activities or freshen up an afternoon spent enjoying the great outdoors.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Champion Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Brimming with power, Davidoff Champion is a fragrance that unlocks your hidden potential for victory. Released in 2010 as a fragrance for men this fresh and rejuvenating scent introduces citrus opening accords of lemon and bergamot. Its heart is enriched with clary sage in union with galbanum, while the base closes with cedar and oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Champion Energy Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Affirming a more energetic side of it's predecessor fragrance, Davidoff Champion Energy is a powerful fragrance that charges your zeal, daring and vigour. An outburst of juicy citrus, bergamot and grapefruit, creates a lively opening. A fiery heart kindles fresh spices with a blade of tonic. The base brings in a deeper allure with woody cedar and rugged oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: <p class="p1">Davidoff Cool Water is a male scent that has stood the test of time. When you encounter it for the first time, you may experience the scent as slightly cool. However, once on the skin, Cool Water goes onto develop its full range of pleasurable tones. It transforms from cool, to sexy. Maybe that is why it is one of the world's best loved scents.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">When you are looking for a male scent that will take you through the day and still carry on doing its job at night, Cool Water Davidoff is the perfect choice. It will remind you of refreshing sea breezes that blow in from the ocean on a warm summer's night.</p> <p class="p1">The 125ml bottle really tells you what the scent is all about. It would be fair to say that it looks cool and utterly masculine. As a complete package, it is really the complete package as they say. Buy it as a gift or as a scent for yourself. It is certainly a fragrance that will keep on delivering.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p>

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive Women Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: This fresh fragrance opens with fruity notes of Italian mandarin, which leads to the heart of the scent created by jasmine and Pistachio. All wrapped in a warm base of amber, patchouli and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Woman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=N17GXDI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the refreshing elegance of Davidoff Cool Water for Women Eau de Toilette (100ml), a fragrance that captures the spirit of the ocean with a distinctly feminine touch. Inspired by the serene movement of waves, this scent brings together a vibrant mix of fruity and floral elements to create a scent that feels both invigorating and effortlessly sensual. Combining the crisp freshness of the original men’s Cool Water with a softer, more delicate profile, this fragrance opens with a lively burst of pineapple, watermelon, quince, blackcurrant, and lemon. The heart reveals a floral medley of jasmine, rose, lotus, water lily, and honey, which gently melts into a warm base of sandalwood, musk, vetiver, and vanilla for a smooth and lasting finish. First introduced in 1996, Cool Water for Women remains a timeless classic, presented in an elegant, wave-inspired blue bottle adorned with silver accents. The design reflects its oceanic inspiration, making it not only a captivating scent but also a beautiful addition to any fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Silver Shadow Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The Davidoff man lives life to the fullest. His experience and maturity give him an extraordinary charisma. He leaves behind him a mysterious fragrance trail; intoxicating and unforgettable. His fragrance is his signature, a fascinating shadow of his personality. Introducing Silver Shadow by Davidoff. Base notes of intense amber and oakmoss, a heart of saffron and patchouli, and top notes of orange, coriander and cedar leaves combine to create a timeless elegance with style... an unforgettable trail. The timelessly modern bottle is an object of intriguing beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive For Men Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: This fragrance has a blend of shivering mint and cold watery fruits, carefully assembled to enhance the green inflexions of lentisk. This striking prelude slowly gives way to magnetic and modern oriental notes of cashmeran. Its musky, spicy intensity is faceted with captivating ambery balmy notes heightening the woody force of lentisk.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Hot Water Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: Hot Water by Davidoff is a warm and spicy fragrance and features notes like red basil, absinthe and wormwood, its middle note is pimento, while the base note is Benzoin Siam. 'Hot Water' was developed by perfumers Domitille Bertier and Olivier Polge, and its main characteristics are 'heat and passion, intense sensation and primal masculinity'

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LC0U3VL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover the legendary marine fragrance for men, inspired by the freshness of the ocean. The strength of deep waters and pure masculinity are embodied in this iconic fragrance. The scent unfolds with aromatic notes of mint and lavender, blended with the sensuality of amber. A unique composition that delivers an immediate freshness. Make your call with Cool Water, your ultimate blend of freshness, power and seduction. Fragrance Family: Aromatic Top Notes: Coriander, Mint Heart Note: Lavender Base Note: Amber

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only the Brave Tattoo Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: A power, a fragrance. The potential to change. For the man seeking to leave his mark upon the world, Only The Brave Tattoo by Diesel carries the spirit of the man with the courage to wear his conviction on his skin. An oriental fragrance grounded in patchouli, this fragrance offers exotic sweet and spice whilst carrying a comfy down-to-earth base. Opening in a bite of sweet red apple touched by citrus the fragrance opens refreshingly fruity. Strutting forwards, the fragrance cracks open a savoury heart of spicy Bourbon pepper and sage. As it dries, the fragrance then rouses a solid base composed of patchouli and amber wood with a vein of benzoin offering a sweet and calming diversion.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Beauty Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Elizabeth Arden in 2002. Beauty is a refreshing, crystalline, oriental, woody fragrance suitable for office wear and every day occasions. Top notes of iris, bergamot, and rice flower. Middle notes of orchid, ginger, rhubarb, lotus and lily. Base notes of sandalwood, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A light fragrance for casual wear that combines melon, peach, rose and moss scents. A bright, light-hearted, happy celebration of the simplicity and joy of summer. Top notes of bergamot, melon and peach. Middle notes of jasmine and cyclamen and base notes of sandalwood and moss create this energizing fragrance. The sunflower represents strength, beauty, health and intuitive.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden True Love Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1994, True Love is a refreshing, gentle, floral fragrance recommended for romantic occasions. This feminine aroma contains a blend of jasmine, lotus, iris and is accented with narcisse, sandalwood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Untold Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A luxurious and modern rendition of a sensuous floral composition, Elizabeth Arden Untold Eau de Parfum celebrates the sophistication and intrigue of the multi-faceted modern woman. From her vibrant optimism to her refined femininity, mysterious aura and magnetic sensuality, Untold takes you on a journey through the many facets of a woman that together, make her genuinely beautiful. A sparkling and fruity introduction, a radiant floral heart and a mysterious addictive warmth, this fragrance captures all that a woman is. Top Notes: Black Currant, Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Pear. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Peony, Jasmine and base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli Heart, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Red Door Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: This elegant, sensuous blend of deep, rich florals features a captivating scent that fills the senses. Top notes of ylang ylang, rose and fruity nuances merge with middle notes of rare oriental orchid, jasmine, lily of the valley, Moroccan orange flowers, forest lilies, freesia, carnation and a touch of wild violets. The romantic final notes leave a sensual impression of oakmoss, sandalwood, vetiver, a hint of honey and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Sapphires Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Taylor in 1993, Diamonds & Sapphires is a refreshing, flowery fragrance. This aroma blends lily of the valley, rose, ylang- ylang, spices, jasmine and a fresh floral bouquet.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Passion For Him Eau de Cologne 118ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Taylor in 1989, Passion for Men is a refined, oriental, woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of ginger, clove oil, nutmeg, jasmine and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: White Diamonds, launched in 1991, has top notes of neroli, lily and tuberose, middle notes of orris and amber and base notes of sandalwood, patchouli and oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Agua Del Sol Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Introduced in 2016, this sweet floral fruity fragrance begins with sweet and sharp, icy raspberry sorbet combines with nashi pear granita to create mouth-watering top notes; touches of energizing pink peppercorn bring a pop of spice to the fragrance; and the warm and sensual combination of tonka bean, sandalwood and white musk cream forms a comforting blend.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Island Kiss Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Escada Island Kiss is a fragrance inspired by Caribbean beaches, fragrant coasts, salty air and lush notes of fruit and flower. Top notes include orange, passion flower and mango highlighting that this is an exotic edition refreshed with aquatic, juicy and fruity peach notes combined with magnolia in the heart. The base adds woody notes and sensual musk.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Elixir Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Especially Escada Elixir is a powerful interpretation of the rose fragrance that is Especially Escada. Unlike its first re-adaptation, Especially Escada Delicate Notes, the Especially Elixir fragrance represents its intense version. This fragrance stands for boldly elegant women, who radiates confidence and brightens the room with her energy and smile.This mysterious rose scent begins with pear, ambrette seed and grapefruit. The heart includes Turkish rose absolut, ylang-ylang, accords of prune and fresh plums, laid on a base of patchouli, white musk, dry amber, cashmere and Madagascar

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Delicate Notes Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Especially Escada Delicate Notes by Escada. This is a fresh and floral fragrance for women. It contains of wild rose, grapefruit, pear, rose, ylang-ylang, ambrette seed, musk and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The luxurious combination of rose and Ylang radiate a fresh and natural aura of positivity; the uplifting ingredients synonymous with joy and happiness.Light musky notes to support the delicate floral bouquet complete the scent adding a subtle touch of femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Pi Neo Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A visionary man who ventures from the real world into a virtual world, a man about to enter the fourth dimension.The Pi Neo hero is thirsty for knowledge.He defies the time-space equation, on a quest for a new dimension where everything is possible, setting out to conquer new space, where reality and virtuality merge to infinity.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HS06YEX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Choose to live a spontaneous life with the Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette, an alluring floral fragrance for women. Even more endearing than her magical smile, this flirtatious scent was made for a provocative woman. When you're touched by her presence, she's hard to resist. Her eyes sparkle with spontaneity, whilst her signature scent lingers with delight. Similar to its wearer, this playful fragrance exudes innocence, charm and complete irresistibility. Blended with the beauty of five delicate roses, a dominate burst of flower power storms open the scent. Accentuated by sparkling verbena, the elegant core of centifolia and peony rose toy with the velvet petals of passion and fantasia rose, creating an elegant affair for all to enjoy. Notes: Star Anise, Verbena Leaf, Centifolia Rose, Peony Rose, Passion Rose, Fantasia Rose, Emotion Rose

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Xeryus Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Xeryus by Givenchy is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Xeryus was launched in 1986. Top notes are lavender, green notes, mandarin orange, violet, jasmine, nutmeg flower, ylang-ylang, lily-of-the-valley, bergamot, rose and lemon; middle notes are cyclamen, coriander, carnation, cypress, sandalwood, juniper berries, cinnamon, tarragon, petitgrain and geranium; base notes are leather, amber, musk, oakmoss, balsam fir, vetiver, incense and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ysatis Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Givenchy in 1985, Ysatis is an elegant, soft, woody fragrance. This feminine scent contains a blend of mandarin, oak moss, rose, iris, vanilla, clove and amber and is suitable for daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NOO5153]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sensual, indulgent fragrance featuring a special twist: a floral quintet of five elegant roses interpose a spicy head of anise and a comforting base of vanilla and patchouli. This enchanting fragrance offers a rich sampling of roses along a trail of freshness and soft spice.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentlemen Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T5MWJYM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} If you’re a fan of the GIVENCHY Gentleman collection, you’re bound to love this latest addition. The Intense Eau de Toilette possesses all of the artisanal qualities of a true Gentleman fragrance; it’s both refined and classic. For fans of the original, you’ll recognise the iconic bottle design, which has been coloured in a black-to-blue ombre that shows the contrast of sweet blue iris and woods inside this scent. What makes this addition different to the GIVENCHY Gentleman Eau de Parfum? You can expect a green, fresher signature!

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Live Irresistible Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Your mood- Happy and Irrésistible. Your motto- Join my happiness! Your fragrance- A floral and fruity cocktail, sparkling and juicy. Seize the moment, share your happiness and rewrite all the rules, leaving just one: Live Irrésistible.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Play Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Contemporary yet timeless, the Givenchy Play Intense Eau De Toilette is what a man will love to sport for casual outings. Infused with a rich texture, character and warmth, this 2008 launch will give a boost to your confidence. The top notes concentrate on Mandarin and Bergamot to rejuvenate your senses. Coffee Wood, Pink Pepper and Amyris Wood compose the fluttering heart and give it a sensuous tone. The trail of Tonka Bean, Vetiver and Patchouli shows off a woody-oriental hint and the confidence is evident in his stride.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Xeryus Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y25LMU1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Warm and intense, Xeryus Rouge is a classic, Woody Amber designed for a man who embraces his freedom and is a risk-taker at heart. His fiery, intuitive sensuality is irresistibly captivating with an underlying mystery that cannot be resisted. Succulent kumquat and green cactus are dusted with red pepper and crushed cedar wood for a seductive scent that lingers. Woody Amber Top Notes: Kumquat, Green Cactus Heart Note: Red Pepper Base Note: Cedar Wood

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E58V0YF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A woody-aromatic scent, rich with spice notes, mingled with Russian leather, it makes a statement. The fragrance combines vigour and character, thanks to the alliance of vetiver, tarragon and cinnamon. The inspiration is a confident, contemporary and determined man, who represents timeless, masculine seduction. Givenchy Gentleman is a modern man, elegant and proud of his appearance.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Insense Ultramarine Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Givenchy Insense Ultramarine is a tart aromatic fragrance designed in 1994. It has notes of citrus, bergamot, mint cardamom, cedar, tobacco and musk. For the distinctive and modern man.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Play Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Modern and contemporary, Play by Givenchy is presented in a bottle shaped like an MP3 player. Givenchy Play will include notes of bitter orange, grapefruit, black pepper and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Organza Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1996, this floral, oriental, woody fragrance combines the freshness of sap, honeysuckle and rosewood with the voluptuousness of gardenias, poppies and tuberoses and the intensity and timelessness of amber and nutmeg.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Bamboo by Gucci is a floral fragrance for women. It contains notes of bergamot, Ylang-Ylang, Casablanca lily, orange blossom, sandalwood, Tahitian vanilla and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Bamboo by Gucci is a floral fragrance for women. It contains notes of bergamot, Ylang-Ylang, Casablanca lily, orange blossom, sandalwood, Tahitian vanilla and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Delightfully feminine, but deceptively powerful. Bamboo by Gucci is a stylish modern fragrance exhibiting exotic floral notes brewed with deep, rich woods. Created especially for the woman of many faces; sophisticated, intense but gentle all at once.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci by Gucci Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci By Gucci. This is a fresh and floral fragrance for women. It contains of guava, raspberry, pear, chamomile, Tahitian Tiare flower, orange blossom, spider lily, patchouli, honey and musky notes.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Envy Me Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: A playful fruity floral fragrance inspired by the experience of feeling irresistible. Gucci Envy Me is a playful fruity floral fragrance that is inspired by that delightful experience of feeling irresistible, of being desired. Watch me, want me, envy me.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Flora by Gucci is a subtle and sophisticated floral scent. Built on a fresh and feminine breeze of flowers (Rose, Osmanthus), the fragrance top note conveys the freshness and lightness of citrus fruits.Fresh and feminine, the fragrance remains very Gucci, with a sensual and subtly powerful base note of sandalwood and pink pepper.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Flora by Gucci is a subtle and sophisticated floral scent. Built on a fresh and feminine breeze of flowers (Rose, Osmanthus), the fragrance top note conveys the freshness and lightness of citrus fruits.Fresh and feminine, the fragrance remains very Gucci, with a sensual and subtly powerful base note of sandalwood and pink pepper.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci by Gucci Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The male counterpart of the women's fragrance line, Gucci By Gucci Pour Homme is for the successful man who has a charismatic, intense presence. He is a strong leader whose natural charisma captivates those around him, and he is grounded but leads an exciting life with a love for thrill, travel, and adventure. Gucci By Gucci Pour Homme is the signature fragrance for the modern-day icon—a witty, handsome man with impeccable style who has a firm belief in his roots and values the important things in life.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci by Gucci Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: The male counterpart of the women's fragrance line, Gucci By Gucci Pour Homme is for the successful man who has a charismatic, intense presence. He is a strong leader whose natural charisma captivates those around him, and he is grounded but leads an exciting life with a love for thrill, travel, and adventure. Gucci By Gucci Pour Homme is the signature fragrance for the modern-day icon—a witty, handsome man with impeccable style who has a firm belief in his roots and values the important things in life.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Black Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FSAVWIV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guilty Black Pour Femme by Gucci. This is a floral and oriental fragrance for women. It contains raspberry, peach, lilac, violet, patchouli and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: A scent of defiance, the wearer of Gucci Guilty is the architect of her own destiny. This warm yet striking oriental floral scent carries hedonism at its heart, and seizes the attention with a flamboyant opening of mandarin, shimmering alongside an audacious scattering of pink pepper. The effect is at once arresting and compellingly seductive. Top notes: mandarin and pink pepper Middle notes: lilac, geranium and peach. Base notes: patchouli and amber Presented in muted gold-tone metal flacon with interlocking Gs design.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: A scent of defiance, the wearer of Gucci Guilty is the architect of her own destiny. This warm yet striking oriental floral scent carries hedonism at its heart, and seizes the attention with a flamboyant opening of mandarin, shimmering alongside an audacious scattering of pink pepper. The effect is at once arresting and compellingly seductive. Top notes: mandarin and pink pepper Middle notes: lilac, geranium and peach. Base notes: patchouli and amber Presented in muted gold-tone metal flacon with interlocking Gs design.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Collecting a cordial accord of fresh, aromatic and woody notes, Gucci Guilty Eau Pour Homme initiates a wave of citrus, bergamot and lemon, before pressing into a heart of snowberry, orange blossom and fragrant orris. Rounding the fragrance off, a solid base of warm musk and exotic patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Where the original was an eau de toilette, Gucci Guilty Intense is an eau de parfum: a provocatively warmoriental floral with passion at its core. The effect is at once arresting and enthrallingly seductive. Frida Gianinni observes: "In Gucci Guilty Intensewe have created a fragrance that truly captivates the senses." The scent seizes attention with a flamboyant opening born of the natural rush. Fragrance Note Top note: Mandarin, pink pepper Middle note: Lilac, violet, andheliotropine Base: Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=REHBS2M]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guilty pour Homme by Gucci is an aromatic, woody fragrance for men. Luckily, the beautiful scent of Guilty will make you feel anything but guilt. Gucci gave us something positive, in the form of a clean fragrance built on a refreshing blend of lemon and lavender, followed by precious notes of African orange flower before the scent dries down on a comfortable base of cedar and patchouli. Gucci Guilty comes in a luxurious masculine grey bottle, with a robust base of metal and glass on the top. The bottle reflects the scent; it is a strong aroma that is perfect for evening wear but at the same time inoffensive enough to be worn in the office.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme is carefully designed for men who know what they want and who get what they want. The charismatic alpha male, a true magnet for ladies, is represented in this provocative and seductive composition. The fragrance opens with lavender and lemon, leaving enough space for very appealing scents of orange blossom. Basic tones are supported by warm woody accords of cedar and patchouli, offering a firm but exciting and soft coloring to the whole composition.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Intense Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The scent seizes hold of the senses with a heady fix of bracing Italian lemon and invigorating lavender, undercut with a tang of coriander. Its middle motifs persuade like an insistent invitation. Aphrodisiac orange flower - stimulating and entrancing - yields to an unexpectedly masculinity reinforcing neroli. The patchouli that is the hallmark of Gucci fragrances reaches a new potency laced with the driest amber and a leather-rich sillage - robustly earthy, yet suggestively exotic. The effect is at once remarkable and uncompromisingly alluring.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Intense Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: The scent seizes hold of the senses with a heady fix of bracing Italian lemon and invigorating lavender, undercut with a tang of coriander. Its middle motifs persuade like an insistent invitation. Aphrodisiac orange flower - stimulating and entrancing - yields to an unexpectedly masculinity reinforcing neroli. The patchouli that is the hallmark of Gucci fragrances reaches a new potency laced with the driest amber and a leather-rich sillage - robustly earthy, yet suggestively exotic. The effect is at once remarkable and uncompromisingly alluring.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Made to Measure Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QDTG54N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The composition is oriental-spicy, "tailor-made" like an expensive suit. Its initial notes are inspired by the look and feel of a handmade suit; there are accords of Calabrian bergamot, Tunisian orange blossom, French lavender and aniseed. The heart is eclectic, spicy and textured, including notes of nutmeg from Sri Lanka, water lily, juniper berries, plum and cinnamon. The base is luxurious and sophisticated, made of labdanum, patchouli, leather and amber. “One further ingredient is required: the man. For a suit is merely a beautiful silhouette until its owner wears it. It is only then—when worn—that it becomes something more. Similarly, the perfume’s refined leather and rich spices combine with the warmth of the skin, the Made to Measure man’s character, and the style in which he wears it.”

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Made to Measure Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The Gucci Made to Measure fragrance is intensely masculine, created for the man who demands the very best - a man whom others aspire to be. It's inspired by the Gucci Made to Measure suit, specially crafted with the Gucci philosophy of attention to detail.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Premiere Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Premi&egrave;re is the scent of a woman who is accustomed to coming first, whether in her career or in her love life. She makes the same exceptional demands of her perfume, wanting only the very best for every occasion. Just as a leading lady graces the red carpet with her couture Gucci gown, so every woman deserves her Gucci Premi&egrave;re moment.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Rush Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1999, this sharp, oriental, woody fragrance has top notes of bergamot, peony and freesia, middle notes of violet, jasmine and carnation and base notes of orris sandalwood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Rush Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1999, this sharp, oriental, woody fragrance has top notes of bergamot, peony and freesia, middle notes of violet, jasmine and carnation and base notes of orris sandalwood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Flora Eau Fraiche is a floral - fruity aromatic fragrance for women launched in 2011 as the latest spring version. Flora Eau Fraiche is enriched with additional aromas of citruses in the top notes and aquatic and green nuances in the heart, while the base remains unchanged. The composition begins with mandarin, bergamot, kumquat, lemon and peony. The heart is made of rose petals and osmanthus with green and aquatic additions, laid on the base of sandalwood, patchouli and pink pepper.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Glamorous Magnolia Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Flora Glamorous Magnolia eau de toilette spray for women is a bright and citrus scent, opening with top notes of freesia, green leaves and citrus zest, which then fuses with a heart of peony and magnolia, all of which is rounded off with a base of musk, sandalwood and warm chocolate accord.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gracious Tuberose Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Gracious Tuberose is part of the Flora by Gucci Garden Fragrance collection, a bouquet of scents inspired by the blossoms of Grace Kelly’s legendary Gucci scarf. This green-tinged fragrance is luscious and pure, with an innocent character that caresses the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Glorious Mandarin Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Giannini describes the fragrance as a 'bouquet' of scents, including Gorgeous Gardenia to underline the gorgeously feminine side of this fragrance. Glorious Mandarin because there’s a sort of euphoria in mandarin, since it’s such a sparkly fruit.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The Scent opens with a natural rush that is mandarin. The middle notes reveal a blossoming of lilac, enriched with the sensual femininity of powdery violet and heliotropine.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Bloom is a rich white floral scent that transports to a colourful and diverse garden verdant with flowers and plants. Blended by master perfumer Alberto Morillas with direction from Alessandro Michele, the fragrance is created to unfold like its name.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Hugo Man Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Hugo Boss Man is a clean fresh fragrance for men. Its herby tone makes it a natural fragrant scent designed to appeal to the modern man. This Hugo Boss Aftershave is a masculine oriental scent that is perfect for the liberated man who desires to be free from limitations. The fragrance conveys a vibrancy with its fresh top notes of green apple. This is matched by an underlying hit of a vibrant herbal tang from coriander seed and cardamon. These spicy additions give the unique earthy natural scent reminiscent of a walk in a wild oriental garden. The base notes of vanilla and patchouli bring warmth and passion to the fragrance. Boss Man is a deserving favourite in the Hugo Boss Perfume range for men as it gives a rich and musky aroma appealing to men who desire something which reflects their spontaneity and passion in a casual and relaxed way.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Ma Vie Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KND7PMX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Perfume has developed one of the most exciting collection of fragrances in the world. If you are looking for a scent that is different from the rest, you should explore what the brand has to offer. The brand is known for its unique approach to fragrances. Boss Ma Vie Intense, or Ma Vie to fans, is proof of everything that is good about Boss. This intense offering is packed with exciting nuances including cactus blossom. If you have ever had the privilege to smell a cactus blossom, you will know it is intense yet soft. In this fragrance, cactus blossom lingers with softer tones including white magnolia and pink roses. Everything is held together by fresh dew drops. Our 75ml eau de parfum makes the perfect personal treat. The bottle is the right size for slipping into your handbag or weekend away holder. We are delighted to offer this very exclusive scent in such a beautiful small package. Order for yourself or a friend.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Ma Vie Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Hugo Boss Ma Vie is the parfum to go for when you are looking for a contemporary scent. This is a fragrance with a twist. Instead of relying on traditional tones, the fragrance draws on the unique scent of sweet cactus flowers with an infusion of rose, freesia, and even jasmine. In many ways, you can say that this is an eau de parfum which is shaken and not stirred. Ma Vie Perfume is one of the perfumes that you can say is truly exciting. It is a bit of an eye opener as far as scents are concerned. When you are looking for a parfum that makes a statement - this is the one for you. The 75ml bottle has not been updated since the launch of the fragrance back in 2014. Nor does it need to be. It is truly a beautiful bottle with a slight art deco styling. The expression looks good and smells even better springs to mind. Ma Vie Pour Femme is the perfect gift choice or personal treat.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Just Different Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G410ORQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Aftershave is the brand that you can always rely on. Finding a truly male orientated scent is getting harder. If you find yourself searching for a new masculine scent to add to your collection, you should try Hugo Boss Just Different. It is one of those scents that does not overpower. At the same time, it is a fragrance that lets its presence be known. How do you define Hugo Just Different? The first notes you will come across are mint and apple. As the fragrance develops, you will pick up peppery basil and coriander. Then you will pick up notes that are associated with top class male fragrances including patchouli, labdanum and olibanum. This is a rich scent with many exciting nuances. If you have not as yet tried it, now is the perfect opportunity to do so. Our 200ml eau de toilette bottle makes a perfect gift or personal purchase. One thing is for sure, this is a scent that has a lot to offer.
