listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Absolue Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LA03FB9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume collections like making bold statements. When you are looking for a fragrance that is going to stand out, one of your best options is Issey Miyake l'eau d'Issey Absolue. If you are a follower of the brand and this exciting fragrance is not on your dressing table as yet, now is the perfect time to put it there. What does l'eau d'Issey Absolue smell like? The top notes are white floral followed by honey for sweetness. Then vanilla and woody notes develop accompanied by an aquatic freshness. The unique scent combination makes the fragrance for both the day and night. As an exclusive offer, we are offering this special fragrances in a 90ml eau de parfum bottle. The fragrance makes a fantastic personal purchase or gift for someone special. The bottle is the perfect size for slipping into your weekend away holder and slips easily into your handbag for days out.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pure Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VQP3E99]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume collections have many exciting choices that you must add to your perfume collection. Unlike many other perfume brands, the company launches far few fragrances. It only seems to launch a new scent when it thinks it has developed a fragrance which stands out. Issey Miyake l'eau d'Issey Pure is just such a scent. What does l'eau d'Issey Pure is one of the brand's more exciting offerings. When you have not added a new perfume to your collection for a while, this is the perfect choice. The scent delivers a fragrance experience which is second to none. The first notes you will pick up are amber and marine nuances soon followed by aromatic aromas. We are delighted to have the opportunity to offer this fantastic eau de parfum. You now have to decide whether you should treat yourself to it or gift it to a friend. Why not do both? Once you have opened the bottle, tearing yourself away from this unique blend of freshness and aromatic nuances is next to impossible.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau Majeure D'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A masculine strength combined with a breath of the ocean, L'Eau Majeure D'Issey features an invigorating marine fragrance that opens with crisp notes of bergamot and grapefruit. A wave of sea notes gives the fragrance an aquatic heart and a base of woods and cashmeran gives depth.

listings.rawTitle: Joop Femme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Designed in 1987, this luxurious, oriental, woody fragrance explores essences of bergamot, lemon and coriander blended with notes of jasmine, lilly of the valley and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Can't get enough couture? Well here's even more, for Juicy girls who want it all. Juicy Couture presents Viva La Juicy, an enticing scent of wild berries and mandarins, honeysuckle, gardenia, and jasmine. To round it out, amber, caramel, vanilla, sandalwood, and praline add just the right touch of sweetness. It's bottled in a bold gold decanter decorated with Juicy charms.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Peace Love & Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Peace, Love and Juicy Couture is created in a massive flacon made of heavy glass, with wonderful decorations on its neck (turquoise pearls, fluffy pink decoration and a small heart-shaped pendant with peace sign). Its composition was created by Givaudan perfumer Rodrigo Flores-Roux with such notes as Meyer lemon, wild hyacinth, sweet apple and black currant buds absolute in the top. The heart blooms with floral kisses of Sambac jasmine absolute, star magnolia, Malibu poppy, honeysuckle and linden blossom, while the base features iris root extract, patchouli blossom and sensual musk which rounds up the composition as a non-chalant embrace.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Pam and Gela wanted every girl to have her own Juicy Couture, so they made an Eau de Parfum. It comes complete with Juicy Couture's world famed J and Crown charms...so now everyone can have the charmed life, and scent, of a real live Juicy girl! Top notes: mouth-watering watermelon, mandarin, pink passion fruit, bright marigold, green apple, water hyacinth and crushed leaves. Middle notes: tuberose, wild rose and princess lily. Base notes: caramel crème brulee, vanilla, precious woods and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture I Am Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Brimming with confident attitude, I Am Juicy by Juicy Couture is the fragrance of a strong, independent and rebellious girl. Awash in sweet, juicy flavours this lively fragrance enraptures the senses with an addictive dance of fruits, white florals and warming base notes. Opening in a delicious gambit of raspberries, pomelo and passionfruit, I Am Juicy combines a gourmand selection of succulent fruits. At its core, a crowning note of addictive gardenia is draped in accents of sweet pea, rose and heliotrope. Finally a classic base combines rustic notes of wood and musk smothered in a coating of sunny amber for a finishing of comfortable, cosy warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Dirty English Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Presenting the scent of irresistible bad boys all over the world. A passion-inducing mix of peppered mandarin, blue cypress, black leather, ebony wood and amber musk. Live hard, live fast, live loud, live now. It's all Dirty English, the fragrance for men.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: For the woman who is sultry, daring and leaves a lasting impression. She likes her eyes smoky and her lips rouge. Never afraid to show off and get noticed, she wears this fragrance to feel confident and seduce. Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau de Parfum embodies the limitless possibilities that the night time can bring.

listings.rawTitle: Justin Bieber Next Girlfriend Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Opening notes of Next Girlfriend accentuate sweetness, innocence, youthful dash and positive emotions. The juiciness of pineapple and velvety peach is succeeded by a fruity-floral embrace in the heart composed of passionate raspberry combined with freesia and citrusy lily of the valley. The sensual and seductive tone of the composition is provided by musk in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Homme Classic Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: The perfume opens with aldehydes, bergamot, nutmeg, sweet orange and estragon. The heart is collected of cedarwood, intense and sweet jasmine, iris, patchouli, rose, sandalwood and tobacco. The base exposes amber, musk, oak, Tonka beans and vanilla. A casual fragrance with a light, cool sensation, scented with natural essences of cinnamon, cypress and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Chloe Narcisse Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1992, this seductive feminine fragrance is a blend of exotic fruits and flowers.

listings.rawTitle: Katy Perry Royal Revolution Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Royal Revolution is tempting, royal and rebellious. This irresistible floral fragrance conquers at first breath with notes of pink freesia, mystical blackthorn, jasmine and vanilla orchid. Heart notes consist of orange flower, sandalwood, jasmine petals. The base is soft Leather, skin musk and vanilla orchid.

listings.rawTitle: Katy Perry Killer Queen Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Pop star Katy Perry launches her third fragrance and the first one done in cooperation with Coty. The scent is called Killer Queen and apparently it is totally different from its two predecessors. The bottle is shaped like a red ruby and comes in its own golden pedestal. Killer Queen was launched in 2013.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A woody aquatic fragrance inspired by the power of the ocean. It features top notes of citruses, mint, and cardamom, heart notes of sage, marine accords, and spices, and base notes of vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Parfum D'Ete Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1993, this refreshingly feminine, floral fragrance contains a blend of freesia, citrus and jasmine and is accented with lemon grass, vanilla and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo L'Eau Par Kenzo Pour Femme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L'Eau Par Kenzo for women is a refreshing floral fragrance with top notes of bergamot, jasmine and freesia, middle notes of citrus, ylang-ylang and patchouhi fading down to residual notes of cedar, sandalwood and oakmoss. This floral fresh marine scent is recommended for daytime use.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo L'Eau Par Kenzo Intense Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L`Eau Kenzo Intense Pour Homme by Kenzo is an aromatic aquatic fragrance for men. It contains notes of Japanese yuzu citrus, lime, seawater, black basil, cedar and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo L'Eau Kenzo Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L'Eau Kenzo is a soft, green, citrus fragrance. A transparent blend of Japanese yuzu, ho leaf, lotus leaf, mint, pepper, and musk that is ideal for the active man. The soft, fresh fragrance lingers subtly, and is never too heavy.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jungle Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: In 1998, Kenzo created a fragrance for men with woody and citrus accords. A sensual, hybrid fragrance... Mat&eacute; is warm and sweet lime has a slight tang; they blend with generous notes of soft, spicy nutmeg and musky mallow seeds. Finally, Atlas cedar and blue cedar from Lebanon offer up sweet and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jungle L'Elephant Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Kenzo Jungle was the name of the first Kenzo shop in France. The elephant is the fetish animal shown in the bottle cap. A fragrance to catch the eye. A spicy composition, ideal for the cosmopolitan woman. Kenzo jungle brings us the jungle to the city. Top notes: cardamom, tangerine, cumin, cloves. Heart notes: Ylang-ylang, mango, liquorice, heliotrope. Background: patchouli, vanilla, amber, cashmere.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jeu D'Amour Elixir Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: An oriental floral fragrance introduced as a deeper, warmer, more sensual version of the original. It opens with top notes of blackberry and Mandarin orange, heart notes of jasmine and tuberose, and base notes of rum, vanilla, patchouli, caramel, and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jeu D'Amour Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The new fragrance from Kenzo collection Amor is named Jeu d'Amour and it represents edition for 2014. Daphne Bugey and Christophe Raynaud create the composition of notes of blood mandarin, pomegranate, tea, tuberose and freesia. The face of the perfume is French actress Louise Bourgoin.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower L'Eau Originelle Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A contemporary remastering of a classic fragrance, L'Eau Originelle by Kenzo released in 2015, is a modern spin on the original Flower fragrance that features fresh aquatic notes and gentle florals. In an opening of bright fresh fragrance, the scent starts with a pool of water notes splashed with ginger, bergamot and pink pepper. At the fragrance's heart it spins a floral accord comprised of peony, freesia and rose before finally drying down to a feminine base of violet and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower in The Air Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The fragrance is a modern and light floral, created by Alberto Morillas. The top notes include fresh accords of raspberry and pink pepper. The heart includes dazzling rose, magnolia and gardenia, placed on the elegant white musk base.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>Kenzo Flower truly is an iconic perfume. Of course the brand has other scents, but the moment someone says Kenzo, you will be excused for thinking of Kenzo Flower Perfume.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">Yes, the fragrance is young and uplifting, but it really is a fragrance for all age groups. It is a scent that will have you dreaming of flower meadows and beautiful summer days out in no time at all.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">A gentle wooden touch completes Flower By Kenzo. But, the first scents you will experience include Hawthorne, roses and cassis. You will also pick up subtle notes of vanilla and wood. It is this fragrance combination that makes the fragrance so unique.</p> <p class="p1">Both the packaging and the 100ml bottle are instantly recognisable. Branding and styling are two major selling points. Anybody will be delighted to receive this scent as a gift. And if you think the bottle would look stylish on your dresser, why not buy as a personal special gift for yourself.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p>

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Amour Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MLM4AVM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The slow and sensuous journey of a couple through Asia, punctuated by encounters, bursts of laughter and smiles, soft sensations, pictures and perfumes brimming with life. A bird accompanies them, symbolising the flare of love and the freedom of traveling. Top Notes: Gentle rice Heart Notes: Frangipani blossom Base Notes: Musk

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Touch Of Pink Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q32JJ3F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lacoste Touch of Pink for women is the feminine expression of an authentic and carefree sensuality. A fragrance for independent and spontaneous women with the magnetism of vitality. Fashioned in vibrant pink and white, the Lacoste Touch of Pink bottle embodies the scent's effortless charm.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Red Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TN8D8OG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lacoste Red. An aftershave fragrance for active, competitive men who flourish in challenging situations that require risk-taking. This is just the extra boost of energy and confidence a man needs...

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Released in 2003, this is a beautifully feminine fragrance that is both energetic and uplifting. It has top notes of pepper and bergamot, sensual heart notes of heliotrope, jasmine and hibiscus and warm base notes of cedar wood and gaiacwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J6LUJLF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lacoste Pour Femme is an elegant woody musky fragrance that embodies the free spirit of today's women. The fragrance is beautifully feminine, energetic and uplifting. Top Notes: Jamaican pepper, Purple freesia. Heart Notes: White heliotrope flower, Iranian jasmine, Hibiscus flower, Bulgarian rose, Ambrette seed. Base Notes: Himalayan cedarwood, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Essential Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste Essential is sophisticated yet bright, fresh yet comfortable, spirited yet complex and classic yet modern. Lacoste Essential is about enjoying freedom in a hectic world. There's an immediacy, a spontaneity and a freshness to the fragrance each time you experience it. Lacoste Essential will be as fresh as the moment you sprayed it on.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity gourmand fragrance described as being cute, cheerful and playful with a "French signature". It opens with mandarin orange, red apple, spices, and blackberry, moving into a heart composed of cotton candy, lily-of-the-valley, and macarons, and settling on a base of patchouli, vetiver, cashmere and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity fragrance said to be mood-lifting, authentic and warm, it opens with pineapple, raspberry leaf and mandarin, heart notes of woody, powdery orris root, jasmine and rose, and a base of coconut, sandalwood, and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Pour Elle Elegant Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2015 as a part of the L.12.12 Pour Elle collection, it is announced as a classic scent for a confident woman, always fresh and relevant. This floral woody musk fragrance begins with notes of citrus oils, cassis buds, and pink pepper; blending with mimosa, violet, and lily of the valley; and base notes of vetiver, vanilla, and heliotrope.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste L 12 12 Rouge eau de toilette spray for men is described as a fresh and spicy perfume, opening with top notes of Mandarin, Mango and Tea, flowing into a heart of Black Pepper, Ginger and Cardamom, all of which sits on top of a smooth base of Acacia, Benzoin and Rockrose.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L.12.12. Blanc is a pure classic floral woody fragrance. Top notes are grapefruit, cardamom, rosemary and cedar leaf, mixed with the core of Mexican tuberose and ylang-ylang. Sensual notes of leather, suede and cedar form the base.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Jaune Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L.12.12. Jaune is a scent that triggers optimism, joy and positive energy. The inventiveness and elegance of the Lacoste polo shirt revisited in a fragrance. A light and energizing fragrance to make you feel optimistic with the first rays of sunshine.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Challenge Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste Challenge opens with fresh and energetic notes of tangerine and lemon, augmented by a burst of lavender. The middle accord is driven by spices including ginger, while the powerful base notes of rosewood and teak bring a modern edge and reinforces the heritage of the brand.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Energized Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Celebrate your passion for the game with the new Eau de Lacoste Energized Edition! Lacoste has spiced up their iconic Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc with an edgy note of excitement. The original has been spiced up in the top with fiery ginger and a hint of cool mint to enhance the scent’s energetic freshness. The signature tuberose heart of Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc remains untouched but is shaped in the base by masculine leathery and cedar wood notes.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Live Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A dynamic fragrance with an energetic composition. It reflects the fashion statement of Lacoste with its legendary short sleeves polo shirt. Fragrance Family: Green Notes Top Notes: Lime Heart Notes: Green leaves, Aquatic notes Base Notes: Gaiac wood, Licorice, Iris.

listings.rawTitle: Lady Gaga Fame Black Fluid Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Lady Gaga Fame is the first perfume to be endorsed by singer Lady Gaga. Released through the singer's Haus Laboratories label in association with Coty, Inc. The perfume utilizes a "push-pull technology", rather than a pyramidal structure, to bring out its notes of Atropa belladonna, Tiger Orchid, incense, apricot, saffron, and honey. It is stated to be the first black-colored perfume to spray clear and turn invisible once airborne.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Tresor In Love Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Lancome Tresor in Love captures the spirit of the first moment of love. Nectarine accord and bergamot enchant with a radiant burst of youth. Turkish rose essence and jasmine reveal your feminine side. Cedarwood and musk creates a warm, modern effect.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Poeme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1995, this scent is unusual in that it is based on a single floral bouquet of blue poppy, mimosa, jonquil, freesia, rose, and vanilla rather than the more common multi-layered composition of most fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Vetyver Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Hubert de Givenchy’s personal bespoke fragrance, Vétyver was later offered as a distinguished Couture masculine scent in Givenchy’s flagship stores across the fashion capitals.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Electric Rose Eau De Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Very Irresistible Givenchy Electric Rose is announced as an aromatic - floral fragrance inspired by the raw rock 'n' roll music. The fragrance reflects rebellious style and unusual elegance signature to this house. The composition begins with very bright and fresh notes of blueberry, lemon, basil and verbena. The heart is expectedly dominated by rose, mixed with notes of anise and dewy green violet. The base accords include cedar wood and pearly musk.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Essence Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SXW2RIY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Guilty Essence Eau de Toilette for Men invites you on a journey of self-expression, creativity, and authenticity. Celebrating individuality, friendship, and love in all its forms, this distinctive fragrance offers a modern twist on the classic aromatic Fougère. It’s a scent designed for those who embrace their true selves with confidence and style. Opening with the clean, captivating scent of Lavender, the fragrance then transitions into a heart of Orange Blossom. Traditionally associated with feminine perfumes, this floral note adds a touch of bold romanticism, reflecting Gucci’s non-traditional approach to perfumery. Finally, Patchouli, a signature element of the Gucci fragrance line, grounds the scent with warm, earthy richness that lingers. Encased in a bottle that blends matte black with deep green glass—a nod to Gucci’s iconic stripe—the design reflects the duality of strength and sensitivity. The iconic interlocking Gs serve as a gateway to this luxurious fragrance, symbolising a deeper connection to oneself through scent. Gucci Guilty Essence is more than a cologne; it’s a statement of self-acceptance and bold individuality.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty EAU Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Guilty Eau by Gucci is a floral fruity fragrance for women. It contains watery notes, litchi, lily, wild strawberry and musk. Guilty Eau by Gucci was launched in 2015.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Made to Measure Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: This is a masculine, oriental and spicy scent which opens with notes of bergamot and lavender and anise. The heart contains nutmeg, juniper berry, while the base notes follows with notes of cistus labdanum, patchouli and dark hints of leather.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau D'Orange Verte Concentre Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Concentre D'Orange Verte is a deeper, more vivid, interpretation on the original Eau D'Orange Verte fragrance. Provide a lasting well of freshness, Concentre D'Orange Verte excites a mass of crisp citrus fragrance founding itself strongly in sweet, sunny and succulent orange. This is then backed in a peppering of basil and patchouli that eventually sinks into a steady base of amber and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Hugo Woman Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The 1990s was very kind to us. We got The Lion King, Friends and the Spice Girls. For the younger folk, we even got the Internet itself - making this fine website and cracking Hugo Boss offer possible. The nineties also gave us Hugo Boss Woman Eau de Parfum. A classic fragrance that woman all over the world have relied on for years to give them a modern, feminine and sensual scent. Boss Woman begins with fruity top notes of orange, mandarin and apple which is blended with freesia, and finished with sandalwood, vanilla, cedarwood, orris and musk. It might not be the most memorable release of the 90s, but it's survived and that's testament to strength of the Hugo Boss brand and this incredbily stylish perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Nuit Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K63L6J3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss perfume embodies a sexy and feminine fragrance that lingers on the body for hours. The creation of the perfume was inspired by little black dress and is designed to radiate a soft, mysterious, sweet, and distinctive smell coupled with a good silage. Starting from the top, the notes of the Hugo Boss Nuit Pour Femme consist of ingredients like peach and aldehyde, which gives the perfume its good performance. Together with a fresh, elegant and fruity flavor, this perfume really stands out from the crowd. In the heart note is a blend of white flower, violet and jasmine, which gives the perfume its sensual vibe. The base note constitutes creamy sandalwood and crystalline moss, giving the spray its sophisticated and exotic tang. The Hugo Boss Nuit Eau de Parfum 50ml spray is designed for the smart, sexy, and modern woman who wants to keep a low profile while ensuring that she smells good throughout the night.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Jour Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: As a contrast to Boss Nuit Pour Femme, the house of Hugo Boss has launched Boss Jour Pour Femme, with a milky white flacon, shaped like Nuit. This fragrance shows the three faces of a woman: inspiration, composure and ease, described with a beautiful blend of white flowers chilled with sparkling citrus. Lightness and freshness are presented with a combination of accented accords of lime and grapefruit blossom representing the liveliness of the first morning rays of light that radiate with positive anticipation. Inspiration is retold with a rich bouquet of white flowers, including flowers of freesia, lily of the valley and honeysuckle celebrating the femininity and beautiful diversity of life of every woman.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pure Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KVOVSPP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume never fails to delight. You will know this if you are already a fan or follower of this exclusive perfumer. One of its outstanding fragrances is Issey Miyake l'eau d'Issey Pure. This fragrance is a delight for the senses. It has a presence and a softness that makes it instantly recognisable. If you have not as yet tried it, now you have an opportunity to do so. What can you expect when you open a bottle of l'eau d'Issey Pure? The fragrance is beautiful in its simplicity. The first notes are of embracing amber and marine waves. Once the first wave of delight has washed over you, aromatic notes will make their presence felt. We have to admit that we are delighted to have Pure available as a special offer. The eau de toilette is perfect for wearing at anytime and anywhere. It is one of those fragrances that never fails to delight. Purchase it for yourself or give it away as a very special gift.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pure Nectar Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HHJN9MD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume have added another gorgeous light scent to their collection. People do not only describe this spray as floral. It also has strong woodsy notes. Subtle aquatic notes round out the fragrance as well. A delicate and feminine pear scent kicks off this perfume. The foundation of the fragrance, though, lies in the rose aroma. The rose scent includes a touch of honey. The core of this Issey Miyake spray includes strong notes of the previously mentioned cashmeran, ambergris and sandalwood. Dominique Ropion and Fanny Bal are the two creators of this fragrance. The Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pure Nectar is an eau de parfum that features prominent notes of flowers. L'eau D'issey Pure Nectar is equipped with top notes such as bergamot, pear and honey. Its middle notes are peony, rose and water. The base notes, last but not least, are ambergris, violet, white musk, cashmeran and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Katy Perry Purr Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The composition of Katy Perry Purr is developed by Firmenich perfumer house, combining top notes of peach, forbidden apple, gardenia and green bamboo with the heart of jasmine, pink freesia and Bulgarian rose and the base of vanilla orchid, creamy sandalwood, white amber, coconut and musk. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y9PRSAA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume is one of the best perfume brands in the world today. At the same time, there are other deeper notes that develop as you let the scent linger. This makes Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh perfect for wearing any time of the day or night. We are offering this unique scent in a 75ml bottle. The bottle is a piece of art in its own right. Treat yourself to this amazing fragrance or buy it for a friend. It a feminine scent that never fails to please and is one of the flagship fragrances from the brand.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb in Bloom Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Subtly rebellious and nonchalant, Valentino Uomo is a synthesis of contrasts and timeless modernity. It is retained by an enveloping musky hint of white leather that reveals the majesty of cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Muse Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2016 in a bottle described as a "cosmic pebble", this oriental vanilla fragrance begins its composition with top notes of grapefruit and pink pepper; heart notes of rose, hazelnut, and whipped cream and a base of vetiver and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Innocent Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Edition Passion Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Eau Sucree Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Eau de parfum 25ml Gift Set
listings.description: Angel, released by Thierry Mugler in 1992, is a refreshing, oriental, woody scent recommended for daytime wear. listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau Extraordinaire Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum 30ml Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler A*Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Azzurro Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Azzurro is a luminous celebration of the beauty of the Mediterranean coast. listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph Fresh Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa, inspired by the infamous 'Luna Rossa' boat created in 1997 for the America's Cup. listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum is the lively, fun-filled fragrance in the Prada range. It is a modern perfume from this classic brand; celebrating life and colour and happiness. listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F64FB5B]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Olympea Perfume offers an exciting collection of fragrances. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Nuit D'Issey Parfum 125ml Spray

When you are looking for a gift for a man, it has to be said this fragrance never fails to please. Buy it for someone special or for yourself as a personal treat.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Glace Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L1AIL3H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Distinctly masculine base notes of rum, sandalwood, cedarwood, vanilla, incense and modern musk fuse with a heady citrus cocktail to express the elegant, calm, warm and slightly mysterious character of a Lacoste man.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Dream Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Light and airy, Daisy Dream captivates with its delectably fruity and floral personality. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray Gift Set

Like the woman who wears it, Daisy Eau So Fresh inspires us to be bold and feminine, sweet and unpredictable. The scent's enticing top notes of raspberry and grapefruit sparkle on the skin like sunshine, deepening into a sensuous heart of wild rose and a musky, sophisticated finish of warm plum and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WUGBG27]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume offers some of the best scents in the world. listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: One Direction That Moment Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BFCDK2X]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fantastic fragrance created in 2006, Terre D'Hermes is for the man who is a poet by nature, someone who sees the extraordinary in the ordinary. listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioia Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OSSF5HW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} There is a charming sensation of freshness from the very first notes which are carried along in a deliciously heady current of crushed Mint, with a zest of Italian “Limone Primo Fiore Femminello", harvested from the first spring blossoms in Calabria. A beautiful fresh floral fragrance ideal for the warm season.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent For Her Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo L'eau Eau de Toilette 90ml spray Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Prive Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Aura Refillable Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Aura Refillable Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray

The lavender adds a classic, aromatic softness, while the metallic accords hint at an industrial undertone, creating a unique contrast that embodies the duality of modernity and tradition. In the base, Prada Luna Rossa Carbon grounds itself with a robust blend of ambroxan and patchouli. Ambroxan lends a clean, slightly woody quality, while patchouli adds a touch of earthy depth. This combination gives the fragrance its enduring and charismatic finish, resonating with strength and sophistication. Prada Luna Rossa Carbon is a versatile scent, ideal for daily wear and evening occasions. It's perfect for the man who appreciates a fragrance that balances freshness with a subtle industrial edge. Whether worn in the office or for a night out, this fragrance encapsulates the spirit of a modern man who is both innovative and grounded, effortlessly navigating the complexities of contemporary life.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Girl Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Aftershave 100ml Lotion
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TFJHQOU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Acqua di Giò Pour Homme Eau de Toilette by Armani is a timeless fragrance that has remained a favourite since its debut in 1996. listings.rawTitle: Loris Azzaro Pour Homme Elixir Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Loris Azzaro Azzaro Elixir Eau De Toilette Spray 100ml/3.4oz. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK Everyone Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: CALVIN KLEIN, CK EVERYONE A clean, green, citrus fragrance, CK EVERYONE by Calvin Klein is a genderless scent for today that celebrates the infinite freedom of self-expression. The multifaceted scent for men and women is fresh and provocative. Building on the iconic legacy of CK ONE, this new scent is vegan, made from naturally-derived alcohol and infused with ingredients derived from natural origins, making this Calvin Klein's first ‘clean’ fragrance. Organic orange oil layers over a heart of blue tea accord and a musky base of cedarwood, creating a complex, uplifting scent. The glass bottle, which is recyclable once the pump is removed, features an elastic logo band, in homage to classic Calvin Klein Underwear, that can be worn and reused. Love every one of you in CK EVERYONE. Suitable for vegans. Please note: We are unable to ship fragrances over 150ml outside of the UK.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Women Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: The first fragrance ever created by Raf Simons, Calvin Klein WOMEN denotes not one, but many—a group of individuals, each with their own distinct voice. Drawing inspiration from the inherent freedom and empowered reality of modern women, this perfume celebrates the feminine spirit in all its forms. A light pink hue composed of delicate orange flower petals layered with fresh eucalyptus acorns open to reveal a rich heart of Alaskan cedarwood. Calvin Klein WOMEN is a tribute to the contrasts within femininity, infinitely varied and deeply complex, like the personas of the women who inspired it. An perfume that is perfect for day and night occasions. Lightly spray on your pulse points (neck, wrists and back of your knees) and complete your perfuming routine by using Calvin Klein WOMEN shower gel and body lotion.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Booster Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste Booster Eau De Toilette 125ml Spray Booster by Lacoste is a fresh, aromatic and woody fragrance for men. The crisp mint and eucalyptus gives an incredibly green opening that blends very well with the herbal heart of basil, lavender, galbanum, chilli pepper and nutmeg. The base is loaded with slight spicy woody notes of vetiver, cedar and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: The Narciso Rodriguez for her collection strips back facades to reveal the elegance and pure beauty found within every woman. First, honied notes of orange blossom and osmanthus radiate at the top, then the wearer is enveloped in a light and unique embrace of amber and vanilla and finally a woody pulse of vetiver and patchouli amplify its sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray + 20ml Set

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Man Refillable Eau De Toilette 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Florale Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A sensual flourish of charming floral nuances, Mon Guerlain Florale features a deep breath of flowers surrounding a powdered accord. Soothing lavender accents a triad of citrus; bergamot, lemon and mandarin, creating a light and refreshing opening. A deep note of jasmine focuses a broad scope of flowers, peony and neroli amongst other. Finally a base of sandalwood, iris and vanilla completes the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

Powerful in its simplicity, Idôle’s ultra-slim bottle radiates light. So sleek is its design that it almost belongs in the hand, a reminder that endless possibilities are within reach. POWERFUL AND BEAUTIFUL With its alluring scent and sharp thorns, the rose symbolises the complexity of femininity. The perfect marriage of beauty and strength, a sustainably sourced Rose Accord can be found in the heart of Idôle. Simply by wearing Idôle a distinctive scent identity is created. Harnessing the essence of the woman wearing it, Idôle becomes a declaration of her intention to be herself. To become her own Idôle.

As you probably already know, the bottle looks great and makes a fantastic gift. Or maybe you should just buy it for yourself as a scented personal treat.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled United Eau De Parfum 200ml Spray

When you are looking for a gift that will most certainly impress, this is the right choice. Of course, it also makes an excellent personal purchase.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Goldea The Roman Night Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Intensify your own seduction with the BVLGARI Goldea The Roman Night Eau de Parfum, a contemporary chypre fragrance for women with musk facets. Captivating in every which way, the mysterious scent trail of Goldea The Roman Night complements and enhances the sensual appeal of the current BVLGARI Goldea woman. As the BVLGARI Goldea The Roman Night fragrance opens, juices of luscious berries drench the dark black peony leaves. Glowing in the core, a flourish of in bloom tuberose force the elegant nuances of jasmine petals to awaken, shining the light on the dark and mysterious core of black musk and patchouli. listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=D11BML5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This scent doesn’t shout—it speaks with quiet confidence. It opens fresh and clean, with a soft hit of French lavandin and bright Italian lemon that feels effortless and modern. There’s a natural ease to it, like crisp air in the early morning—sharp but calm. Then, the warmth comes through. The heart of the fragrance deepens with rich cistus resin and a touch of orange flower, softened by a whisper of nutmeg. It’s smooth, a little spicy, and unexpectedly elegant. As it settles, the scent grounds itself in earthy patchouli, dry woods, and musk. It lingers close to the skin, warm and magnetic—something others notice when they’re near. This is a fragrance that feels timeless but never old-fashioned. Understated, yet unforgettable. Top Notes:  Fresh Rose, Hot Chili Pepper Heart Notes:  Lavender, Orange Blossom Base Notes:  Cedarwood, Patchouli This set contains: 90ml EDP Spray 75ml Deodorant Stick 50ml Gel

listings.rawTitle: Mugler A*men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Thierry Mugler A*men For Men Gift Set includes 100ml Refillable EDT Spray, 50ml Hair & Body Shampoo. A*Men is a strong, masculine fragrance that was launched in 1996. This fragrance comprises of peppermint, patchouli, coffee, cedar-wood and leather notes.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Described as a lighter, fresher variant on the classic The One fragrance by Dolce & Gabbana, The One Eau de Toilette features opening notes of juicy litchi, peach, mandarin and bergamot blossom. Middle notes are graced by light lily, bitter orange blossom and the sweetness of jasmine, ylang-ylang and lily-of-the-valley. A base of bountiful vanilla, vetiver, musk and amber completes the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Memoire D'Une Odeur Eau De Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The transcendent accord features unexpected and enigmatic ingredients, and is defined by a note of Roman chamomile. Alessandro Michele envisioned this particular flower inside the scent, blended by master perfumer Alberto Morillas. Gucci Memoire d’une Odeur’s Roman chamomile is structured with Indian Coral Jasmine petals for tenderness, precious musks for depth, and noble woods including warm, luminous sandalwood and airy, subtle cedarwood, a powerful tree with deep roots and an irresistible vanilla note.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Noir Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XXXVIE8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Noir Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that embodies mystery, sophistication, and a sense of refined sensuality. Designed for the modern man with a taste for the bold and the elegant, this scent is as complex as it is captivating, offering a unique blend of spicy and oriental notes. The fragrance opens with a striking combination of bergamot and verbena, delivering a fresh and crisp start. This brightness is quickly balanced by the warmth of black pepper and nutmeg, creating an intriguing contrast that immediately captures attention. As it transitions to the heart, the scent reveals a lush blend of floral and herbal notes, including violet, geranium, and rose. These elements add a soft, romantic quality, underscored by the subtle warmth of clary sage. This interplay between fresh and warm creates a sophisticated middle that is both elegant and intriguing. In the base, Tom Ford Noir Pour Homme settles into a deep and sensual foundation with amber, vanilla, and opoponax, accompanied by a hint of patchouli. This rich and velvety combination gives the fragrance a luxurious and long-lasting finish, evoking a sense of mystery and allure. Tom Ford Noir Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is ideal for evening wear or special occasions, when you want to make a bold yet refined statement. It's designed for the man who is confident, sophisticated, and embraces the art of seduction. This fragrance is perfect for those who appreciate a complex and nuanced scent that resonates with intensity and depth.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F71N7W7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Challenging ambition, Montblanc Explorer is a daring and elegant fragrance portraying wanderlust and adventure within earthy woods and aromatic strikes. And just when you think it couldn't get any better, the scent settles into a cozy base of tonka bean and benzoin, like wrapping yourself in a warm, luxurious blanket after a long day of saving the world. Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Eau de Parfum: because every man deserves to feel like a movie star, even if it's just in his own imagination!

So if you're ready to up your game and become the most wanted man in town (in a good way, of course), then Azzaro's The Most Wanted Parfum is the scent for you. Just don't be surprised if you find yourself dodging paparazzi on your way to work - with a fragrance this irresistible, anything is possible!

Omnia Coral is ideal for those who want a fragrance that embodies the joy and energy of summer, perfect for beach outings, casual gatherings, or anytime you want to bring a splash of sunshine into your day.

Jean Paul Gaultier's Divine evokes a sense of confidence and sophistication, perfect for those who embrace their individuality with a touch of glamour. It's the ideal scent for someone who appreciates a bold, yet balanced fragrance that lingers with an elegant warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Siwa Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YKVRO5L]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Memo Siwa whispers of desert winds with a heated accord of amber flavours; it is a sensual scent evoking the sandy landscapes of Siwa Oasis in Egypt. A top of aldehydes and violet leaf tantalises the senses with a sharp freshness. Whisky, cinnamon, and narcissus warm the heat with an invitation of spice. Popcorn, musk, and vanilla create a sweet and comforting base.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Absolu Parfum Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=I96PAL7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Crafted by Annick Menardo in collaboration with Suzy Le Helley, BOSS Bottled Absolu opens smoothly with a textured Leather accord “ featuring a roasted facet “ harmonised with invigorating Incense essence. At the heart of this BOSS parfum for men, enveloping Patchouli essence and Myrrh absolute elevate the vigour and splendour of this sophisticated scent. Warm Cedarwood and fruity Davana essences at the base leave a lasting, precious trail.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UCFU4OO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir by Carolina Herrera is an aromatic, more intense interpretation of our original Bad Boy Cobalt fragrance, presented in a smouldering blue-to-black dégradé bottle. This new addition to the Bad Boy family puts a bold new spin on the duality of modern masculinity with a fiery blend of sage, black truffle and resinous wood that will reignite your senses.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KYVDJJW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce Gabbana Devotion For Men Eau de Parfum celebrates unwavering and unconditional devotion, the power of love, and the joy of life. The fragrance, anchored by the timeless Sacred Heart, reflects the essence of a determined man, confidently guided by his instincts. The glass bottle of Devotion For Men features the same elegant silhouette as its female counterpart, reinterpreting its signature codes. The light gold fragrance is beautifully encased in a bottle adorned with the Sacred Heart in coordinating silver, complementing the cap.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel D Red Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UVYNCAM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} D RED embodies the men of today, real, evolving and daring. Men who show their radicality and live each moment with unregretful passion. D RED addictive scent captures the ecstasy of living in the moment and owning your uniqueness. Represented by Diesel's iconic Red, this is the fragrance of energy, passion, and unapologetic authenticity. Embrace who you are as only radical minds last. D RED, your crazy trip of adrenaline to unleash your truest intensity. D RED is a unique and unexpected blend of clean freshness and warm sensuality. The fragrance liberates the energising notes of juicy dazzling red grapefruit, clashing with the extreme cleanness of bleached lavender from Provence, France. Highly contrasted with the hot sensual intensity of Sandalwood accord. A subversive scent that leaves an unforgettable long-lasting trail. D RED so fresh, it's hot.

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Instant Crush Eau de Parfum 120ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XCJ7494]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Instant Crush by Mancera brings together a trio of fragrance classics; rose, jasmine, and amber, for a rich and romantic display of floral prowess. Citrus fruits, saffron, and ginger enable a crisp and refreshing opening. Rose, jasmine, and amber form a precious heart. Sandalwood, oakmoss, vanilla, and musk complete the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Pomegranate Noir Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q24LDPT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jo Malone Pomegranate Noir Eau de Cologne is a fruity, aromatic fragrance that was launched in 2005. The scent opens with an invigorating top note of Pomegranate, a middle note of Casablanca Lily infuses the fragrance with a spicy floral scent. A base note of Guaiacwood brings the scent to a smoky finish.

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum 120ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WAAB0LL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Red Tobacco is a warm and intoxicating fragrance measuring strong amounts of spice to accent a distinctive tobacco core. A flash of heat with saffron, cinnamon, nutmeg, white peach, oud, and green apple creates a fresh opening. Patchouli and jasmine offer a sensual heart. Tobacco accord closes the scent with touches of amber, vetiver, vanilla, white musk, and woods.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QE3YKDU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Confidence, sensuality, intensity. The open road is a siren's song. The desert heat captivates you; the golden-hour horizon beckons—vast, mysterious, yours to discover. Ralph Lauren Polo Red Parfum is into-the-night long-lasting and undeniably intense. An overdose of absinthe intoxicates, while fresh and opulent orris softens the edge. Sustainable bergamot and diva lavender heart merge to refine the captivating scent. The classic masculinity of cedarwood finishes the trip with seductive ruggedness. This journey into the desert expanse is an unforgettable thrill.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Ambra Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PPHKCQY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ambra expresses a radiant warmth with sensual woody-aromatic aromas wrapped around ambergris. A stroke of citrus creates the head with notes of orange, bergamot and petitgrain. Flowers and woods indulge the heart with an accord between rose, nagarmotha, cedar and patchouli. The base is rich in ambergris alongside sandalwood, vanilla, labdanum and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Peonia Nobile Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GUGC5G2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover the sophisticated fragrance of the eau de parfum Peonia Nobile by Acqua di Parma: an elegantly sublime scent with a graceful sillage that expresses assertive femininity and sensuality. The fragrance of the eau de parfum Peonia Nobile by Acqua di Parma is inspired by the multi-faceted peony flower that is both delicate yet exuberant, and supple yet energetic. This scent opens with refreshing and slightly fruity top notes of black pepper and raspberry. Sumptuous notes of peony come together with geranium, Turkish rose and fresh freesia notes while the base of this eau de parfum is rounded off with enveloping tones of amber, patchouli and musk notes.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VUWIXWH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau de Parfum is an exquisite fragrance that combines floral elegance with a bold, refreshing twist. The perfume opens with bright, zesty notes of tiger lily, complemented by the sweetness of mandarin and rich floral undertones. A hint of sensual patchouli adds depth, creating a captivating and sophisticated scent. Perfect for the confident woman, this fragrance offers a unique, unforgettable experience with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only The Brave High Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LSTH6KR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Diesel Parfums introduces Only The Brave High, a fresher variation of the original fragrance. Only The Brave High aims for exhilaration: that clear-headed, intoxicating sensation of being on top of the world. Conquer the world, elevate yourself. Go higher and higher. Rise above the skyline. Breathe in the smell of success. Only The Brave High is a new, airier interpretation of the original Only The Brave. This is an addictive boost of frosty mint leaf and a woody accord, refreshed by bright citrus and spicy notes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mandarino Di Sicilia Eau de Toilette 180ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NBSTW69]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Unwind with the invigorating essence of the Mediterranean in Acqua di Parma Mandarino di Sicilia Eau de Toilette. This unisex fragrance captures the essence of early-harvested Sicilian green mandarins, bursting with a vibrant, green fragrance. Sparkling notes of bergamot, lemon and juicy red orange add a touch of effervescence, reminiscent of a bright Sicilian summer. The heart of the fragrance reveals a touch of sophisticated complexity. Fresh petitgrain and spearmint extend the fragrance's life, while a base of cedarwood and musk adds depth and a clean brilliance. Presented in the iconic Acqua di Parma bottle, a beautiful object inspired by Art Deco design, Mandarino di Sicilia is a timeless fragrance for those who appreciate the vibrancy of the Mediterranean.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GW9MNRR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Embark on a journey of self-discovery found through renewed confidence and strength with Burberry fragrance. An intensified interpretation of the original, Burberry Goddess Intense Eau de Parfum unveils a long-lasting gourmand aromatic woody scent for any occasion. The signature trio of vanillas from Goddess is amplified with a fourth vanilla wood to add smoky character. When combined with a luminous lavender essence, the scent is intensified with a vibrant woody edge. Inspired by the colours at sunset, the perfume bottle features a sleek square silhouette which allows the luminous ambery fragrance to shine through. The vegan perfume is designed to be refilled for an endless scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto Di Calabria Eau de Toilette 180ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G4R4B93]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Blu Mediterraneo - Bergamotto Di Calabria is an aromatic, woody fragrance that was launched in 2010. The scent opens with top notes of Bergamot and Citron, middle notes are Red Ginger and Cedar-wood. Base notes are Vetiver, Benzoin and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FV4SS9G]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Add an air of elegance with the Acqua di Parma Signatures Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum, a personal fragrance that combines floral notes with citrus for a beautiful, evocative scent. Representing infinite possibilities, this scent is full of surprises. The perfume features top notes of Calabrian bergamot, orange and lemon for a zesty freshness. Heart notes include a captivating blend of jasmine sambac, magnolia, rose and ylang ylang, while base notes of musk and patchouli add sensuality. Packaged in a transparent bottle, Acqua di Parma Signatures Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum has a removable screw pump that allows the bottle to be easily recycled.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Oud Eau de Parfum 180ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=O0WUIAE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Are you looking for a powerful and luxurious fragrance to revitalize and energize? Look no further than Acqua Di Parma Oud. This unique and captivating scent is the perfect combination of woody warmth and zesty citrus. The top notes consist of a tantalizing blend of bergamot and oranges, creating an invigorating and vibrant smell that will awaken the senses. The heart of Acqua Di Parma's Oud is enriched with Haitian Amyris, Russian coriander, and the luxurious Oud wood. The combination of these notes creates a depth of richness and warmth that will leave you feeling confident and in control. As the scent starts to dry down, you'll be treated to a sumptuous base of leather, cedar, patchouli, sandalwood and musk. This base creates an aura of power and sophistication that will linger on your skin for hours. So, if you're looking for a fragrance that will have you feeling like a million bucks, then Acqua Di Parma Oud is the perfect choice. Not only will you be left with a feeling of strength and capability, but you'll also be left with a scent that is uniquely luxurious and captivating.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua Di Gio Profondo Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B7NQS1S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dive in deep with the Armani Acqua Di Gio Homme Profondo Eau de Parfum, a marine-inspired fragrance that summons the courage and vigour of the ocean. Rehoused in an updated flacon, the scent remains the same classic formula - just in a new bottle. Refreshing notes of bergamot and green mandarin crash together to create a crisp and clean surface that blends into an icy plunge to awaken the senses. At its core, lavender, rosemary and cypress reveal a strong fougere heart that liberates the soul and body. Darkening at the base, patchouli and woods ground the scent at the sea's deep depths, while musk and amber add a warming quality to the uncertainty of the seafloor.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RQGJHJG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein One Eau De Toilette was the first fragrance released by the iconic US fashion house for both men and women. Created in 1994, this unisex EDT is a light, relaxed and aromatic fragrance that complements all genders. The fragrance was designed for everyone who is confident in defining their own identity, evoking a refreshing combination of brightness and sensuality. The fragrance has a unique, citrus floral and herbaceous scent that begins with subtle tones that give way to more bold wooden undertones. Housed in a simple, frosted glass bottle with silver cap, the fragrance epitomises Calvin Klein's minimalist approach to style.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AJMAFC7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} YSL invites you to reveal the untold. Dressed in an elegant blue box and featuring a tri-colored YSL Cassandre, this gift set contains Y EDP 100ml + 75g Deodorant Stick. With both light and dark fougere facets, Y Eau de Parfum blends elegance, sensuality and strength, echoing the multifaceted personality of the YSL man. Woody and aromatic, the original Eau de Parfum opens with fresh notes of bergamot and ginger enhanced by juicy green apple for powerful freshness. Sage and juniper bring masculinity contrasted with the elegance of geranium absolute and lavender, two floral notes at the heart of the Y olfactive signature. At the base, a mysterious blend of sensual wood, frankincense and warm tonka beans is uncovered, reinforced by smokey vetiver for intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C2K2LXQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Reimagined in a light caramel colour, the iconic chocolate bar shaped bottle is dusted with a pearlescent opaque finish for an irresistible sugary sparkle. Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense revisits the original fragrance with deeper and more enveloping notes. This fragrance was created by Olivier Cresp for Dolce&Gabbana. Fragrance Family: Fruity, Gourmond Top Notes: Hazelnut Heart Notes: Orange Blossom Base Note: Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Women Energising Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=M8T1122]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DKNY Women Energizing is a feminine perfume by Donna Karan. The scent was launched in 2011 Top Notes: Citrus, Vodka, Violet leaf, Tomato leaves Middle Notes: Narcissus, Lotus, Orchid Base notes: White birch, Tulip tree bar

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray Duo Set No Cellophane
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q11Y2RI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} BOSS The Scent is the seductive Eau de Toilette for Men by BOSS Fragrances. An irresistible fragrance that invades the mind and leaves an enduring mark. BOSS The Scent boasts an exclusive ingredient from South Africa, the aphrodisiac Maninka fruit which complex facets allude to rhum and passion fruit. Set on a virile leather base, its effect is potent, original, never to be forgotten.  The aftershave opens on the aphrodisiac and spicy freshness of Ginger which provides the man who wears it with a stimulating energy. In the heart note, the aphrodisiac exotic sweetness of the African Maninka fruit invades the senses. The smoky and addictive richness of leather adds a lingering seductive warmth to the base note and conveys pure, magnetic masculinity. The flacon presents an evocative amber juice, set in a silver cage, as if capturing the spirit of seduction before it unleashes its dynamic power. This item is Brand New but sold without the Cellophane Seal.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Big Pony 2 Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IRV1C3P]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Sensual Fragrance. A Floriental Fruity with the key ingredients of Cranberry & Tonka Mousse, this fragrance is for an alluring flirt with a romantic spirit. Playful and irresistible, this modern woman follows her heart…and she just might break yours. The eye-catching pink bottle is complemented by a green oversized polo pony icon opposite a cool blue number 2.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Nova Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ORPPYW1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Angel nova eau de toilette is an inspiring floral, fruity fragrance for the modern heroine who turns dreams into reality. Launched in 2021, the light and lovely scent created by sonia constant, louise turner, and quentin bisch will make you effortlessly dazzle in floral, fruity freshness. apply with purpose to pulse points for an irresistible feminine aura that radiates with pleasure and confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PTV64CG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Putting a bold spin on the iconic Bad Boy fragrance, Carolina Herrera’s Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir Eau de Parfum is a woody-amber cologne with a warm, magnetic allure. Housed in the iconic smouldering blue bolt, the fragrance stars a majestic, sensual scent profile with top notes of smoked sage and black pepper. Roasted black truffle lends a luxurious undertone, weaving into the earthy edge of the elixir, before luscious vanilla melts onto the skin with each spritz and rounds the aroma off with a multi-dimensional aura.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PC0P6LP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum is a fresh and floral explosion of contrasts that forms a powdery expression of femininity. Housed in a blush-pink stiletto, this radiant re-invention of the iconic Good Girl scent reveals the multifaceted nature of modern womanhood with a double dose of Vanilla and the pastel romanticism of Peony - evoked with two forms of Ylang Ylang and upcycled rosewater. Sensual and strong, romantic and empowered, it's good to be pink.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Paradise Garden Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R6410I3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Featuring exotic creatures and flowers, Gaultier's flamboyant garden was inspired by his 2010-2011 Autumn/Winter show, and conjures up a splendidly captivating Eden abounding with forbidden pleasures. In this luxuriant paradise, La Belle Paradise Garden and Le Beau Paradise Garden share their all-consuming passion. Embroidered with a dazzling botanical necklace featuring colourful Couture touches, this blue-lagoon naked bottle bewitches the senses with an irresistible natural sensuality. Give in to the charms of this aphrodisiac floral and vanilla nectar.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Paradise Garden Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MEI8O66]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Featuring exotic creatures and flowers, Gaultier's flamboyant garden was inspired by his 2010-2011 Autumn/Winter show, and conjures up a splendidly captivating Eden abounding with forbidden pleasures. In this luxuriant paradise, La Belle Paradise Garden and Le Beau Paradise Garden share their all-consuming passion. Embroidered with a dazzling botanical necklace featuring colourful Couture touches, this blue-lagoon naked bottle bewitches the senses with an irresistible natural sensuality. Give in to the charms of this aphrodisiac floral and vanilla nectar.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Million Gold Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IJ81UF1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Million Gold Eau de Parfum encapsulates the thrill of success. The intense 50ml fragrance from Rabanne offers a powerful, sensuous take on the Million man, thrilling the senses with its addictive woody blend. Finding the perfect balance between warm and fresh, the scent marries juicy mandarin with creamy sandalwood and cedarwood accords. Wrapped in an elixir of spices, the perfume creates an exhilarating sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Eau du Soir Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OXRG08J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sisley's limited edition gift set can be given for celebrations, celebrating the Eau du Soir fragrance with fantasy and spontaneity. The dominant purple of the box echoes the sensual and refined notes of the eau de parfum, composed around an enveloping seringa flower. The freshness of the citrus opening is combined with a bewitching floral heart, underlined by an elegant chypre signature.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre d’Hermès Pure Perfume 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TXG8LTC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The emblematic orange box is embellished with light to celebrate the holiday season in style. The Hermès signature ex-libris is reinvented in the form of studs, adding sparkle to this limited edition box. This gift set comprises one 75ml Terre d’Hermès Pure Perfume, one 15ml travel size Terre d’Hermès Pure Perfume, and one 40ml hair and body shower gel. A warm, woody fragrance, Terre d’Hermès pure perfume combines enveloping cedar and sparkling grapefruit with a radiant note of shiso.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Queen of Silk Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QSINE08]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Reach for Creed Queen of Silk Eau de Parfum for a sensual fragrance experience. Inspired by the story of silk, this Creed fragrance with floral amber notes reflects the history and nature of this luxurious material. Explore the multi-dimensional nature of Creed Queen of Silk perfume in its harmonising combination of fragrances. Enjoy the floral head notes of Chinese osmanthus, magnolia and saffron, which yield a blend of sweet and woody heart notes, including tuberose and Javanese patchouli. Finally, be warmed by the base notes of vanilla, incense, myrrh and musk. To enjoy the opulent fragrance of Creed Queen of Silk parfum, apply liberally to pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Fuel For Life Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LKV2F91]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Diesel Fuel for Life Homme is a mythical elixir that evokes images of something that's a source of energy and fuels a passion for life. These emotions, combined with sexiness and seduction, are exactly what Diesel have recreated and bottled - It's Fuel For Life. A magic potion of mysterious star anise, vintage raspberry and authentic heliotropine for him.

listings.rawTitle: Gisada Ambassador Women Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
