listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MAL4B8X]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ambassador Women by Gisada, launched in 2019, is an Amber Floral fragrance for Women. Perfect all year round this fragrance can be worn day or night. Top notes of this fragrance are Apricot, Violet Leaves, Bergamot, Pear and Tagetes. Middle notes of this fragrance are Plum, Raspberry, Freesia, Tuberose and Rose with base notes of Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Musk, Patchouli and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WTLHFNV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Pear Inc. is a playful and comforting fragrance that combines juicy fruits with soft, warm musk tones. Its bright, fruity opening highlights the sweetness of ripe pears, creating an inviting and cheerful impression. At the heart, a hint of cetalox adds a modern, distinctive twist, giving the scent a unique and intriguing character. The base wraps the fragrance in smooth musk, providing lasting warmth and depth. Cruelty-free and vegan, Pear Inc. is a versatile, feel-good scent that blends sweetness and subtle sophistication for everyday wear.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Sunny Side Up Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ISOYXUX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This bright and creamy fragrance blends soft musk and warm woods for a comforting and indulgent experience. Its inviting sweetness makes it feel both elegant and soothing, perfect for daily wear. The heart reveals a luxurious floral and woody combination, creating depth and richness while maintaining a smooth, sophisticated character. The fragrance evolves seamlessly, balancing warmth with delicate brightness. The base leaves a lasting impression of soft, comforting woods and subtle musky notes, enveloping the wearer in gentle sophistication. Cruelty-free and vegan, this scent is both mindful and luxurious.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Ultra Blue Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BANV9TB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Explorer Ultra Blue captures the invigorating essence of the ocean with a fresh and dynamic fragrance. Its vibrant opening combines citrus and exotic fruits for an energetic and uplifting introduction. The heart evokes the marine world, blending sea notes with subtle ambergris for a crisp, refreshing character that feels both sophisticated and adventurous. A warm, earthy base of woods, patchouli, and leather grounds the fragrance, leaving a lasting impression of strength and depth. Explorer Ultra Blue is perfect for men who seek a modern, ocean-inspired scent.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=O9X23YY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inspired by the energy of the ocean and the beauty of the Mediterranean, Acqua di Giò Parfum brings a bold new intensity to the iconic fragrance line. This refined scent reimagines aquatic freshness with a deeper, more sensual character, offering a sophisticated balance of nature’s most invigorating elements. The fragrance opens with a bright burst of bergamot and the zing of ginger extract, layered over refreshing marine accords that instantly awaken the senses. In the heart, aromatic rosemary and clary sage meet floral geranium to create a naturally vibrant core. These notes are harmonised to evoke a sense of pure, effortless strength. As the scent settles, smoky incense and earthy patchouli add warmth and richness, leaving a powerful and long-lasting trail. Presented in a sleek, timeless bottle made to endure, every format is refillable—blending sustainability with elegance and style.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RAPL3YW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Eau De Toilette Spray 200ml is a fresh and energetic fragrance that captures the spirit of youth and freedom. Its vibrant scent blends crisp citrus with subtle spicy and woody undertones for a lively, uplifting aroma. The fragrance opens with bright grapefruit and refreshing mint, flowing into a heart of lavender and geranium that adds balance and sophistication. It settles into a warm base of cedarwood and amber, leaving a lasting, confident impression. Ideal for everyday wear, Tommy embodies adventure, style, and casual confidence, making it a timeless choice for men who enjoy a fresh and versatile fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PCBJQOQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Eau De Toilette 200ml is a fresh and playful fragrance that captures the spirit of the American outdoors. Its fruity and floral composition creates a lively, uplifting scent perfect for everyday wear. Bright top notes of mandarin, apple blossom, and blackcurrant provide a cheerful and energetic opening, while a heart of lemon, honeysuckle, rose, grapefruit, lily, mint, and violet adds a soft, floral complexity. The fragrance settles into a warm, comforting base of magnolia, jasmine, cedar, sandalwood, and leather, leaving a subtle yet lasting impression. Tommy Girl is ideal for women seeking a fresh, youthful, and versatile scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RRU7S4D]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia is a radiant floral fragrance that celebrates joy, freedom, and the beauty of following your heart. Created for women with a playful, spirited energy, it offers a delicate yet expressive scent that feels both enchanting and uplifting. At its heart lies the luminous White Gardenia, a flower long associated with magic and mystery. This elegant note is paired with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute, enhancing the floral richness and giving the fragrance a glowing, sun-drenched character. The scent opens with a bright Pear Blossom accord, bringing a fresh, fruity charm that sets the tone for the sweetness to follow. A soft touch of Brown Sugar adds a gentle gourmand warmth, leaving behind a captivating and joyful trail that lingers.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Nomade Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U7LAIJO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloe Nomade Eau de Parfum encapsulates the spirit of a woman open to the beauty of the World. The Chloe woman carries with her freedom and an immutable, natural elegance. Confident, inspiring, she flourishes through her experiences and encounters, asserting who she is without ever imposing it. This inner strength leads her to embrace otherness. Chloe Nomade Perfume is a mix of softness and strength: the facets of this floral chypre blow like the winds of freedom. The intense, mineral character of the oak moss is shrouded in the voluptuous sweetness of the cherry plum and the flowery freshness of the freesia.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Nomade Nuit D'Egypte Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=S2063FP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte is a sensory masterpiece, carefully crafted with age-old inspirations in mind. Inspired by the ancient kyphi, the first-known perfume to humankind, this alluring eau de parfum weaves a timeless tale of age-old allure and modern refinement. Powerful accents of myrrh appear instantly, seamlessly blending with the spicy scents of cinnamon and ginger, followed by honeyed hues of broom flower nectar and supremely round, balsamic and ambery undertones of cypriol and opopanax. At the very heart of this Chloé Nomade Nuit D'Egypte Eau de Parfum for Women, the exquisite kyphi accord is paired with an opulent orange blossom absolute, sourced from the heart of Egypt itself. Finally, a sensuous touch of warm vanilla completes the base note of this beautiful fragrance composed with 90% naturally sourced ingredients.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Signature Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BHV9T2C]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} In 2015 Chloe released a new version of their Signature Eau de Toilette. The floral fragrance includes notes of white roses, bergamot, lemon, magnolia, gardenia, rose buds, cotton flower and musk. This new version is significantly different to the 2008 original and comes in a two-tone pink and white box.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G3CX42A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum is a radiant floral fragrance that feels like stepping into a lush garden in full bloom. Created for women who embrace their individuality, it inspires confidence and self-expression with every wear. Bright Jasmine opens the scent with a romantic freshness, followed by the creamy richness of Tuberose at its heart. Finally, the soft, powdery sweetness of Rangoon Creeper lingers on the skin, leaving a trail that’s both delicate and intoxicating. Wearing Gucci Bloom feels like unfolding into your truest self - feminine, graceful, and full of life.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XHE9TOB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid is a luminous floral gourmand with a fresh twist on vanilla. It blends the creamy sweetness of Vanilla with a breezy Ozonic Accord, creating a fragrance that feels both airy and indulgent. At its heart, the sensual glow of Vanilla Orchid adds depth and richness, while the ozonic freshness keeps it light and modern. Wearing it feels like wrapping yourself in soft petals kissed by sunlight - comforting, radiant, and irresistibly feminine.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MXVJ831]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci’s first Ozonic gourmand floral fragrance is a powerful reinvention of a gourmand scent with breathtaking contrasts. The vibrant warmth of Vanilla notes in this perfume for her is infused with the fresh marine Ozonic Accord to enhance the luminous sensuality of Vanilla Orchid at its heart. Its addictive and enticing trail is lifted by a disruptive fresh air that creates the perfect balance between floral gourmand richness and a bracing breeze.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PJUN1HN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Burberry Her Eau de Parfum is a vibrant and modern fragrance that embodies the energy of London life. Opening with a burst of juicy berries, it immediately feels playful, sweet and full of character, setting the tone for a fragrance that’s bold yet elegant. As it develops, soft florals of violet and jasmine add a touch of femininity, balancing the brightness of the fruit with delicate charm. This blend creates a smooth transition that feels both youthful and refined, capturing the essence of effortless beauty. The fragrance settles into a warm base of musk, amber and soft woods, giving depth and lasting allure. Luxurious yet understated, Burberry Her is a celebration of individuality and creativity, housed in a chic pale pink bottle that reflects its modern spirit.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JVHH8F6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bvlgari Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a refined fragrance that balances freshness with comforting warmth. Its opening of Darjeeling tea and ginger essence delivers a crisp and invigorating start, setting the tone for an elegant yet understated scent. At its heart, the fragrance reveals a smooth blend of Ceylon tea extract and guaiac wood, evoking a natural sophistication that feels both grounded and inviting. This harmony of notes creates a subtle depth that lingers with quiet confidence. The dry down is soft and enveloping, where ambrette seed absolute and white musk accord leave a lasting impression of comfort and calm. Presented in a minimalist flacon, Bvlgari Pour Homme embodies simplicity, elegance and timeless style.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GWN3RN9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum Intense For Her is an Ambery Floral fragrance with Woody notes that rewrites the Gucci Guilty For Her line’s essential core. The bold vibrancy of Mandora and the generosity of Lychee come together to modernise the cosmetic touch provided by notes of Violet. At its heart, an audacious floral bouquet of Ylang Ylang and Tuberose is enhanced by the mysterious sensuality of a dark Plum accord. Finally, the empowered woody effect of Patchouli and Vetiver meet the indulgence of Vanilla for a bold, long-lasting feminine signature.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T0FYRDY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Creed Aventus is a fragrance that embodies strength, ambition and timeless style. Created to celebrate Creed’s 250th anniversary, it captures the presence of a modern leader with an unmistakable sense of authority. The opening strikes with a vibrant blend of blackcurrant, bergamot, apple and pineapple, setting a bold and confident tone. The heart reveals a refined balance of patchouli, jasmine and earthy tones, lending the fragrance both depth and sophistication. As it develops, Aventus settles into a rich foundation of oakmoss, ambergris and vanilla, supported by woods and musk for an enduring and powerful trail. Celebrated worldwide as an icon of contemporary perfumery, Aventus is a scent of triumph and self-assurance, designed for those who make their own mark on history.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LV8J3IM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Creed Silver Mountain Water captures the invigorating spirit of the Swiss Alps, evoking the clarity of fresh mountain air and the rush of icy streams. It opens with a crisp brightness that immediately feels pure and uplifting, carrying a modern elegance that remains effortlessly refined. As the fragrance unfolds, a delicate harmony of tea and blackcurrant softens the sharpness, adding depth without losing its airy freshness. Musk lingers in the base, wrapping the scent in a smooth and comforting finish that mirrors the quiet strength of alpine landscapes. This is a fragrance that embodies both vitality and tranquillity, perfect for those who seek a clean yet distinctive signature.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray 3 pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OS5H2Q2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette celebrates freedom, authenticity and connection through a bold and modern fougère composition. With a fresh and daring character, it opens in a lively burst of pink pepper and Italian lemon, setting the tone for a fragrance that is both energetic and sensual. At the heart, orange blossom, neroli and French lavender bring warmth and elegance, blending traditions of romance with contemporary creativity. This balance of floral tones against an aromatic backdrop creates a refined yet non-conformist charm that feels effortlessly captivating. As the fragrance settles, patchouli and cedarwood lend depth and richness, layering a smoky, woody trail that endures with quiet strength. Housed in a sleek bottle of contrasting textures, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme stands as a symbol of confidence and individuality.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MVMKH3C]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guerlain L’Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette (100ml) captures the spirit of the modern man—confident, refined, and effortlessly stylish. Inspired by the concept of the "ideal man," this fragrance brings together strength and elegance in a fresh, sophisticated blend that leaves a lasting impression. The scent begins with a burst of bright citrus, as notes of bitter orange, orange blossom, and rosemary create a crisp, aromatic opening that energises the senses. As it develops, the heart reveals a smooth blend of almond and tonka bean, delivering a warm, slightly sweet character that adds depth and charm. This contrast of sharp freshness and soft richness is both intriguing and balanced. In the base, the fragrance settles into a sensual, masculine finish. Rich leather notes combine with the earthy tones of vetiver and the woodiness of cedar, giving the scent a bold and enduring quality. Guerlain L’Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette is a refined signature for the man who knows what he wants—and wears it well.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L099FF6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette for men is a fragrance that has defined freshness since its debut in 1991, now reimagined in a sleek new bottle designed with sustainability in mind. The updated design reflects a closer connection with nature, echoing the fragrance’s spirit of freedom and vitality. The scent opens with invigorating sea notes, brightened by a hint of nutmeg that brings subtle warmth. A heart of pine and cedarwood introduces a grounded, woody depth, while the base blends creamy sandalwood with the resinous sweetness of labdanum for a smooth, lingering finish. More than just a fragrance, Kenzo Homme evokes the feeling of coastal air brushing against your skin, a timeless symbol of masculine freshness with a modern, responsible edge.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RXXNNCB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum feels like a statement of modern masculinity without trying too hard. The first spritz hits with the brightness of French lavandin and lemon, a clean and refreshing burst that feels energizing, almost like stepping out into crisp morning air. As it settles, the fragrance deepens into something warmer and more intriguing. The mix of amber-like cistus, soft orange flower, and a touch of nutmeg gives it a smooth, slightly spicy edge - elegant but with just enough bite to keep it interesting. The base of patchouli lingers long after, grounding everything with a woody, musky richness. It leaves behind a trail that feels confident, refined, and quietly magnetic, the kind of scent that stays with you through the day without ever being overwhelming.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Extreme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=W271PU7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mysterious, bold, and irresistibly captivating, this new interpretation of L’Homme Idéal reveals a deeper, more seductive side of the modern man. Reimagining the signature almond note by unveiling its darker, richer facets, L’Homme Idéal merges a warm and complex blend of spice, woods, and tobacco to create a scent full of allure and charisma. The fragrance opens with a lively mix of bergamot and pink pepper, setting an energetic and spicy tone that enhances the familiar almond accord. At the heart, heliotrope lends a soft floral layer with elegant almond nuances, perfectly complemented by the richness of cinnamon and the juicy depth of plum. This middle phase adds an inviting sweetness and warmth that draws you in. As the scent settles, the base reveals an intense combination of patchouli, cedar, and a smoky leather accord, deepened further by the enveloping presence of tobacco. The result is a powerful and sophisticated fragrance that leaves a lasting impression—ideal for the man who embodies confidence, complexity, and mystery.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Extreme Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UQ09Q7D]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jimmy Choo Man Extreme Eau de Parfum captures the essence of fearless exploration and unshakable confidence. Created for the man who charts his own path, it’s a scent that embodies leadership, strength, and a relentless drive for adventure. This modern fougère offers a bold and energetic twist, designed for those who thrive on intensity and the thrill of the unknown. The fragrance opens with a fiery blend of red thyme and black pepper, delivering an immediate sense of heat and vitality. At its heart, crisp geranium and aromatic clary sage provide a sharp yet balanced contrast, adding freshness and complexity to the composition. These vibrant notes come together to create a dynamic, invigorating core that reflects a sense of movement and freedom. As it settles, the scent reveals a warm base of amber woods, smooth tonka bean, and earthy vetiver. This dry down leaves a lasting impression of understated masculinity and magnetic charm. Encased in a striking scarlet lacquered bottle with silver lettering and a textured red leather cap, Jimmy Choo Man Extreme is both a visual and olfactory statement—bold, refined, and unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q0YC4WT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense is a bold and sensual Eau de Parfum that takes the original Libre to deeper, warmer heights. It reimagines the balance of floral elegance and gourmand indulgence with a richness that feels luxurious and addictive. The fragrance opens with fresh lavender, juicy bergamot and sweet tangerine before unfolding into a radiant heart of orange blossom, jasmine sambac and orchid flower. This luminous bouquet is anchored by a seductive base of vanilla, tonka bean, ambergris and vetiver, creating a warm, long-lasting trail that feels powerful and unforgettable. Encased in the striking Libre bottle with its sharp lines, asymmetric black cap and iconic oversized YSL logo wrapped in gold, Libre Intense reflects both luxury and strength. It is the perfect fragrance for women who embrace their individuality with confidence and a touch of daring glamour.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K0UK9R9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora is a captivating fragrance crafted for the confident, contemporary woman. Designed to stand out, it offers a refined balance of elegance and individuality, making it a perfect everyday scent that seamlessly transitions from day to evening. Its delicate yet expressive character sets it apart as a fragrance that’s both timeless and versatile. The scent opens with a vibrant blend of jasmine, pink pepper, and mandarin orange, instantly awakening the senses. As it settles, you’re met with a soft floral heart composed of lilac, peach, and raspberry, enriched with subtle hints of geranium and black currant for added depth. These notes create a playful yet sophisticated profile that lingers beautifully on the skin. The base notes bring warmth and sensuality with amber, white musk, and patchouli, while a final touch of vanilla rounds out the composition with a smooth, comforting finish. Presented in a generous 100ml size, this elegant Mediterranean-inspired fragrance is an ideal choice for women of all ages who appreciate beauty with a bold twist.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Q Eau de Parfum 100ml 3Pcs Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YHWCVXC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A vibrant blend of fruity and floral tones, this elegant fragrance balances freshness with depth. Bright Sicilian lemon and tangy red orange create a lively opening, softened by the gentle presence of jasmine petals. These citrus notes bring a sparkling, energetic start that gracefully leads into a rich, inviting heart. At the centre of the scent lies the juicy sweetness of cherry, offering a playful contrast to the creamy, almond-like scent of heliotrope. This unique combination brings a bold yet smooth character to the perfume, capturing a sense of modern femininity and allure. The composition is crafted to leave a lasting impression, perfect for those who appreciate both elegance and edge. A refined woody base of cedarwood, crystal musk and soft musk anchors the fragrance, adding warmth and intensity. Housed in a weighty glass bottle tinted in delicate pink, the perfume is crowned with a regal gold cap in a deep cherry red—a nod to the passion, strength, and spirit that inspired the scent’s creation.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Miracle Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L7F6FAH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This luminous fragrance captures the essence of a fresh morning, bursting open with the juicy sweetness of lychee and the airy brightness of freesia. The opening notes feel light and uplifting, like the first sunlight on dewy petals, inviting a sense of renewal and vitality. It's a radiant introduction that sets the tone for a scent both modern and expressive. As the fragrance unfolds, a heart of floral and spicy tones emerges. Soft magnolia blends beautifully with the bold character of ginger and bourbon pepper, while hints of jasmine add a smooth, elegant layer. This intriguing blend creates a warm pulse at the centre, striking a fine balance between delicacy and intensity. Finally, the base brings a lasting sense of depth and warmth. The richness of amber pairs with the soft, enveloping comfort of musk, grounding the scent in sensuality. The result is a perfume that lingers with confidence and grace, perfect for those who embrace both lightness and strength in their personal style.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Nuit Tresor Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PP7MVND]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} La Nuit Trésor is a deeply sensual fragrance that weaves together bold notes to create an unforgettable scent. Opening with a burst of juicy raspberry, it immediately captures attention with its vibrant, fruity charm. At its heart lies the essence of Black Rose—rich, mysterious, and alluring—balanced by smoky hints of frankincense that add a smouldering depth. Crafted as Lancôme’s first gourmand woody amber scent, this perfume is a celebration of passionate love. Warm vanilla, sourced from orchid petals in Tahiti, adds a creamy radiance to the composition, enhancing the floral heart with a glowing sensuality. The result is a perfume that feels both enchanting and addictive, expressing desire with elegance. The iconic bottle, shaped like a black diamond, reflects the luxurious and mysterious nature of the scent within. Finished with a delicate black rose choker around the neck, it’s a symbol of refined femininity. Created by two master perfumers, La Nuit Trésor is a rich and captivating fragrance that redefines modern romance with every spray.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Sport Fresh Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KOMU833]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience a refreshing take on a classic with Polo Sport Fresh Eau de Toilette by Ralph Lauren. This invigorating men’s fragrance captures the energy and spirit of the original Polo Sport, reimagined with a modern twist. Designed to awaken the senses, it’s a bold scent that blends cool, vibrant elements to create a clean yet powerful impression. At the heart of the fragrance lies a crisp combination of mint and mandarin orange, offering an immediate burst of freshness. These citrus notes are balanced by aromatic sage and marine accords, evoking the sensation of cool ocean air. It's a dynamic blend that speaks to confidence and effortless style. The base reveals a striking frozen wood accord layered with soft iris and woody tones, creating depth and long-lasting warmth. Launched in 2021, Polo Sport Fresh is perfect for the modern man who values a clean, active lifestyle with a sophisticated edge.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=INLYKHK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Very Irrésistible Eau de Parfum by Givenchy is a radiant celebration of femininity, reimagined in a sleek, ultra-feminine bottle design. This modern floral fragrance blends elegance with an unexpected twist, creating a scent that is both timeless and boldly individual. Inspired by confident women who embrace their unique charm, it leaves a lasting impression of sophistication and spontaneity. At the heart of the fragrance lies a bouquet of five exquisite roses, elegantly layered with vibrant star anise for a distinctive aromatic edge. The floral core is enriched with fresh notes of violet leaf and blackcurrant bud, creating a bright yet balanced harmony. A soft undercurrent of magnolia adds depth, while patchouli and sensual vanilla bring warmth and lasting richness to the composition. Encased in a prismatic violet-tinted bottle, the fragrance captures the essence of modern glamour with a hint of playfulness. Very Irrésistible is more than a perfume—it's a signature scent for those who dare to stand out, offering a graceful yet daring trail that reflects true individuality.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci L'Air du Temps Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U8DKYKF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} L’Air du Temps Eau de Parfum by Nina Ricci captures the essence of peace, love, and freedom through a fragrance that transcends generations. Presented in its iconic bottle adorned with intertwined doves, the design symbolises harmony and hope, reflecting the spirit of a more optimistic era. Originally created in Paris in 1948, this timeless perfume is a poetic blend of delicate florals. A radiant bouquet of jasmine, rose, and carnation forms the heart of the scent, celebrating femininity with a graceful and uplifting character. It’s a fragrance that feels both classic and emotionally evocative, a true tribute to joy. As the first-ever spicy-floral composition in perfumery, L’Air du Temps holds a unique place in fragrance history. Its elegant structure and enduring appeal make it more than just a scent—it is a symbol of resilience and beauty that continues to inspire, decade after decade.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K5AGIW9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum by Issey Miyake is an intense men’s fragrance where the raw energy of nature meets refined masculinity. Inspired by the transformative power of salt, this scent amplifies sensations, deepens emotions, and brings a heightened awareness to the world around you. It’s a bold expression of contrast—between land and sea, freshness and warmth. Crafted by perfumer Quentin Bisch, this woody marine dry amber composition opens with a vivid salt accord, blended seamlessly with marine seaweed and oakmoss of natural origin. These oceanic elements evoke the crisp, invigorating essence of the sea. The journey then moves to land, where natural incense and amber add a rich, grounding warmth to the fragrance's core. Upcycled cedarwood enhances the dry down with its enveloping depth, reinforcing the fragrance’s commitment to sustainability and sophistication. Long-lasting and powerful, Le Sel d’Issey is a statement scent for men who seek intensity, authenticity, and timeless elegance in every experience.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J4RRXJF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette is a bold new men’s fragrance that transforms the elusive nature of salt into a powerful olfactory experience. Inspired by the natural process of crystallisation, this vegan scent captures the essence of water as it evaporates, leaving behind the vital trace of salt on the skin. This fragrance offers a refreshing yet intense sensation, evoking motion, vitality, and raw masculinity through the pulse of the sea and the grounding force of the earth. Composed of 95% ingredients of natural origin and featuring 100% natural origin French alcohol, this woody marine fragrance opens with a vibrant salt accord and sparkling ginger. The duality of sea and land is expressed through contrasting olfactive polarities: marine seaweed and oakmoss offer oceanic freshness, while earthy vetiver and sustainably sourced cedarwood bring warmth and structure. The result is a scent that’s both invigorating and grounded—clean, textured, and undeniably masculine.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette 300ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PM6T6IA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} CK One by Calvin Klein is a clean, modern fragrance that redefined the world of scent with its bold unisex identity. Bright and effortlessly cool, it captures a sense of youthful freedom and individuality, making it a timeless choice for both men and women. This Eau de Toilette continues to stand out as a fresh expression of simplicity and unity. The scent opens with a lively blend of citrus and fruit, featuring notes of pineapple, bergamot, mandarin orange, and lemon. At its heart, a delicate mix of jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, rose, and papaya brings a soft floral depth. The base offers warm and earthy tones of amber, musk, oakmoss, and a woody foundation, creating a balanced and long-lasting finish that feels fresh and inviting. Launched in 1994, CK One broke new ground as one of the first truly unisex fragrances and continues to influence fragrance design today. With its iconic minimalist bottle and signature scent, it remains a classic staple—reimagined each year in exclusive summer editions that reflect its enduring appeal.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UFB01XP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Fico Di Amalfi is a radiant fragrance that transports you to the picturesque cliffs and citrus-filled air of Italy’s Amalfi Coast. Fresh, fruity, and irresistibly uplifting, this scent captures the warmth of Mediterranean sunshine and the charm of coastal living. First introduced in 2006, it’s the perfect companion for anyone who craves a vibrant, feel-good fragrance. The scent begins with an invigorating burst of bergamot, lemon, and grapefruit, evoking the crisp zest of Italian citrus groves. As it unfolds, the heart reveals a beautifully balanced blend of pink pepper, soft jasmine petals, and the creamy sweetness of fig nectar. This middle layer adds both brightness and a delicate touch of spice, enhancing the fragrance’s refreshing character. In the dry down, fig wood and cedarwood provide a subtle woody backdrop, while benzoin adds a hint of warmth and smoothness. Together, these notes create a comforting finish that lingers like sun-kissed skin after a day on the coast. Fico Di Amalfi is a celebration of nature’s beauty, bottled with elegance and vitality.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Sound Of The Brave Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YY7XK8U]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Diesel Sound of the Brave is a bold and modern fragrance for men who lead with courage and inspire change. Created for those who challenge the norm and pursue their goals without compromise, it embodies the fearless spirit of a new generation. It's more than a scent—it’s a call to action for those who live with purpose and passion. The fragrance opens with a burst of refreshing spices, setting a dynamic and energetic tone. At the heart lies a distinctive Bison Grass accord, a rare and vibrant note that adds a unique rhythm to the composition. This is balanced by a base of warm amber woods and musks, which bring depth and sensuality to the blend, leaving a powerful and lasting impression. Housed in Diesel’s iconic clenched fist bottle, now in electric blue, Sound of the Brave symbolises strength, self-belief, and determination. It’s a scent built like a song—layered, expressive, and unforgettable—designed for men who aren’t afraid to make noise and stand for something greater.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Good Fortune Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GUJQ1BA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Step into a world of haute couture fantasy with the Viktor&Rolf Good Fortune Gift Set. Presented in a striking purple box adorned with pearl and diamond-inspired detailing, it’s finished with the iconic Viktor&Rolf ribbon and seal—a luxurious expression of style and sophistication. Whether as a thoughtful gift or a personal indulgence, this set radiates elegance and charm. Good Fortune Eau de Parfum is a fragrance inspired by empowerment and self-determination. It opens with a distinctive blend of co-distilled fennel and gentian flower, offering a fresh, herbal brightness. At the heart, luminous Jasmine Superinfusion adds warmth and femininity, while the base of rich Bourbon Vanilla delivers a smooth, enveloping finish—creating a scent that is both captivating and bold. This set includes a 50ml bottle of Good Fortune Eau de Parfum and a 10ml travel spray, perfect for carrying your signature scent wherever you go. A fragrance that inspires confidence and embraces the power of choice, Good Fortune is made for those who believe in creating their own path.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum 10ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MTWDBB2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum by Mugler is a radiant celebration of divine femininity, created for the woman who brings light to the world around her. She is powerful, serene, and otherworldly—guided by purpose and filled with grace. With every step, she transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary, radiating beauty, hope, and strength wherever she goes. This floral ambery woody fragrance opens with a luminous burst of solar notes, offering an immediate sense of warmth and vitality. At its heart blooms the sacred golden flower, a symbol of healing and power, surrounded by rich floral tones and a sensual depth. The base reveals warm, enveloping woods and ambery notes, completing a scent that feels both grounding and transcendent. Alien Goddess is more than a fragrance—it is a mindful and radiant expression of femininity, a call to women everywhere to embrace their inner light. Worn like an aura, it surrounds the wearer with positivity and brilliance, inviting her to shine boldly and unapologetically. Step into your own power and create the extraordinary with Alien Goddess.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J9AP3I7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Opening with a duo of delectable juicy top notes, kiwi accord and orange essence sparkle out of the bottle as they pack a refined yet playful fruity punch. This fruity pair meets the heart notes of delicate rose and heady jasmine, warming on the skin to give a romantic feel. Then, the seductive base of musk and ambrette seeds adds an earthy depth that feels sophisticated amongst the zesty bright tones and sumptuous florals, completing this striking yet well-rounded scent. Top notes are Kiwi Accord, Orange Essence. Heart notes are Indian Jasmine, Rose Accord. Base notes are Ambrette Seeds, Musk Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Sauvage Eau Forte Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BPX4III]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience a bold reinvention of freshness with this powerful new fragrance, uniquely enhanced through an innovative alcohol-free formula. Crafted to intensify and extend the scent’s presence, it brings a modern twist to masculine fragrance, pushing the boundaries of traditional cologne with a water-driven composition that’s exclusive to Dior. Created by Dior’s Perfume Creative Director, Francis Kurkdjian, this fresh yet intense scent balances the brightness of an eau de toilette with the depth of a parfum. Inspired by the elemental force of water, this aromatic blend ventures into new olfactory territory, fusing dynamic cool spices with a refined, spicy freshness. At its core, the fragrance flows with crisp spices, softened by the clean character of blanched lavender and anchored by warm, musky woods. The result is an energising and memorable scent experience that feels both invigorating and enduring — a signature for the modern man.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Eau Sauvage 200ml Aftershave Lotion
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=O8J58FS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Rediscover the tradition of grooming with this classic post-shave essential, designed to calm and restore skin after every shave. Crafted to provide immediate relief, it brings a sense of comfort while enhancing the overall shaving ritual with a refined touch. Its lightweight, fluid texture glides effortlessly onto the skin, offering fast absorption without leaving any greasy residue. The formula is designed to protect the outer layer of the skin, helping to maintain its natural balance and comfort throughout the day. Subtly infused with a woody fragrance, it delivers a refreshing and masculine finish that completes your grooming routine with elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H0ILGGE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Elizabeth Arden White Tea is a woody floral musk that captures the calm, restorative feeling of a quiet moment with a warm cup of tea. Crisp, soothing and quietly confident. The fragrance opens with bright mandarin orange and clary sage, lifted by airy fern and delicate sea notes that bring an immediate sense of freshness. At the heart, white tea blends with mate and white iris to create a clean, gently floral character. The dry down settles into a warm base of amber, ambrette, tonka bean and exotic woods, leaving a soft, lingering trail of tranquil warmth on the skin. Clean and understated, White Tea suits everyday wear and works well across seasons. Its calming, easygoing nature makes it a reliable choice whether worn to the office, on a weekend or given as a thoughtful gift.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Deep Red Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C77PPRW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Deep Red Eau de Parfum is a rich oriental fragrance built around bold florals, warm spice and smooth woody depth. Passionate, sensual and expressive. The opening bursts with juicy blackcurrant, mandarin and blood orange, balanced by a sweet pear note that softens the citrus edge. At the heart, freesia, tuberose and hibiscus bring a lush floral warmth, sharpened by a hit of fresh ginger that adds an unexpected spicy kick. The base settles into smooth warm wood, vanilla and musk, leaving a captivating, lingering trail on the skin. An evening-ready scent with real presence, Deep Red suits nights out and special occasions where you want a fragrance that holds its own. The 75ml Eau de Parfum offers lasting wear throughout the night. Cruelty free.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YHL5OQ1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette is a light, rosy floral grounded in the Centifolia rose from Grasse, with 90% of its ingredients drawn from natural origins. Delicate, fresh and quietly radiant. A bright, sparkling rose heart is threaded with tangy fruity notes that keep the fragrance feeling playful and modern. As it develops, white amber and white musk bring a gentle warmth and softness to the base, creating a trail that feels comforting without heaviness. Easy to wear day to day and suited to any season, La Petite Robe Noire is a reliable go-to floral. Presented in Guerlain's iconic soft pink "inverted heart" bottle, it also comes with the option of a free custom engraving, making it a lovely gift choice.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Forever & Ever Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IOKX5YG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Forever and Ever is a delicate floral fragrance that brings together soft jasmine, rose and freesia in a tender, feminine blend. Light, graceful and quietly romantic. Jasmine petals and Bulgarian rose sit at the heart of the composition, creating a classic floral pairing that feels elegant without being heavy. Freesia adds a fresh, airy brightness that lifts the scent and keeps it feeling modern and easy to wear. The result is a gentle, refined trail that stays close to the skin. A naturally understated fragrance suited to daytime wear and warmer months, Forever and Ever is a lovely choice for those drawn to clean, soft florals with a timeless, feminine quality.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OMA058I]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Elegant, graceful and chic. La Petite Robe Noire by Guerlain draws inspiration from the classic black dress. It incorporates fruits and sweets into a playful, charming fragrance. Black cherries, berries, bergamot, and almonds; a sour tart accord that welcomes the fragrance. Fresher fragrances; rose, tea, Taif rose and liquorice create a crisp and inviting heart. A final indulgence uses a base of anise, tonka bean, vanilla and patchouli to complete the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Signature Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VV6NF26]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloe reinterprets the holiday spirit, drawing inspiration from the Maison’s iconic accessories to celebrate the magic of the season. Starry flowers made of golden studs illuminate the gift boxes, delicately evoking the festive end-of-year decorations. An invitation to joyfully celebrate the holidays with Chloe.  Both Chloe’s Eau de Parfum and matching perfumed body lotion carry the fresh and feminine scent that takes a modern rose and translates it into a vibrant and airy perfume for women.  Set includes: - Chloe Signature Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml - Chloe Signature Body lotion 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=V0YE82S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience moments of unforgettable bliss with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense. The highest concentration among the Flora collection, this floral woody gourmand fragrance envelops you in a full-bodied embrace. The lively zest of Mandarin Essence adds a sparkling, cheerful touch. The velvety petals of elegant Gardenia Accord entwine with Hedione to evoke a sunlit garden in full bloom. Deeply creamy Sandalwood Essence soothes the senses. Pulse racing, heart beating louder, enter another world of Flora with this burst of pleasure.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Eau de Parfum 4 x 5ml Mini Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WMW5MBC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Paco Rabanne Mini Set, a divine collection of fragrances specially curated for women. This set  is a luxurious assortment of signature fragrances that capture the essence of feminity. The Mini Set is a fantastic embodiment of elegance and sophistication, featuring a splendid variety of four different fragrances. Each scent has been meticulously crafted, embodying a distinct aroma that will leave you feeling confident and empowered.
