listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GOBLSWM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} For Her Eau de Parfum Intense opens with a wave of peach and Calabrian bergamot that feels sun warmed and a little intoxicating, the kind of opening that makes people turn their heads before they even realise they're doing it. Then the white flowers bloom, wrapped around a red spider lily accord that adds something almost hypnotic to the mix. It's familiar but deeper, like a version of yourself you only meet on certain nights. The base is where it really gets under your skin. Vetiver, moss, amber, and vanilla settle into something rich and quietly addictive. It doesn't shout, it pulls people closer, and that's far more powerful. If you already love For Her, this is everything you know cranked up beautifully. If you're new to it, you've started in exactly the right place. Either way, don't be surprised if you start getting questions about what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IDNT13L]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir is an invitation to fall in love with yourself, wholly, unapologetically, and on your own terms. This warm and radiant fragrance opens a doorway to possibility, where intention becomes reality and confidence becomes second nature. Vibrant purple rhubarb shimmers against the glow of golden amber woods, while creamy vanilla bean lingers like a quiet promise. Bold yet tender, this floral elixir is for the person who has found their power and isn't afraid to wear it. A richer, more intense expression of the original Marc Jacobs Perfect, Elixir is self-belief bottled. Top Notes: Purple Rhubarb Accord · Plum Accord · Liquid Honey Nectar Accord Heart Notes: Golden Amber Woods Accord · Orange Blossom Absolute Egypt LMR Base Notes: Vanilla Bean Extract · Myrrh Resinoid · Patchouli Heart

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Voce Viva Intense Eau De Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TKS9NYQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Valentino Voce Viva is a chypre floral fragrance that pairs rich white florals with a warm, addictive base of moss and vanilla. Bold, feminine and magnetic. Luminous bergamot and mandarin open the scent with a bright, citrus-led freshness before orange blossom and jasmine absolute take centre stage at the heart, bringing a lush, couture-inspired floral depth. The dry down shifts into crystal moss intensified by a generous double dose of bourbon vanilla, creating a warm, enveloping trail that clings to the skin. A fragrance with presence and staying power, Voce Viva carries enough depth for evening wear while remaining refined enough for daytime. A confident, statement-making scent that suits cooler months particularly well.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EJ4D2FP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette is a bold, spicy fragrance built on contrasts, blending sharp pepper with smooth, addictive depth. Confident, masculine and unapologetically striking. The scent opens with a punchy combination of black and white pepper, cut with vibrant bergamot to add a citrus edge. At the heart, cedarwood and sage bring a refined, woody masculinity that grounds the initial heat. The base reveals the darker side of the composition, with tonka bean and cocoa creating a smooth, addictive warmth that lingers on the skin. This gift set includes a 50ml Eau de Toilette Spray, a 10ml travel spray and a 100ml shower gel, offering a complete way to layer and wear the scent from shower through to the finishing touch.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Jeans Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=W6V796A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss HUGO Jeans Eau de Toilette is a fresh, woody cologne with an easygoing energy that works across all seasons. Invigorating, modern and effortlessly wearable. The opening hits with a crisp blend of grapefruit, peppermint and juniper berries, delivering an immediate burst of freshness that feels clean and uplifting. As the scent develops, sandalwood and vetiver warm the composition, drawing it into a smooth, woody base that adds depth and gives the fragrance a lasting trail on the skin. A reliable daily wear that suits casual and smart-casual settings alike, HUGO Jeans arrives in a matte denim-effect flask finished with the brand's signature red and black logo.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry London Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G6DHCNC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Burberry London for Women Eau de Parfum is a classic floral fragrance that captures the energy and elegance of the city it's named after. Feminine, refined and effortlessly stylish. The scent opens with honeysuckle, tangerine and rose, creating a bright, inviting floral freshness. At the heart, jasmine, tiare flower, peony and a twist of clementine zest bring a lush, layered depth that feels both modern and timeless. Sandalwood, musk and patchouli warm the base with a soft, grounding trail that keeps the fragrance feeling polished without heaviness. A versatile everyday scent that moves easily from day into evening, London for Women comes in the signature check-wrapped 50ml bottle that ties the fragrance to Burberry's heritage.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum 15ml Refillable Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WWFWRAK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum is a pioneering gourmand fragrance that redefined perfumery when it launched, pairing indulgent sweetness with dark, earthy depth. Bold, seductive and unmistakable. The scent opens with crisp bergamot, offering a brief flash of citrus brightness before a rich praline heart takes over, bringing a warm, almost edible sweetness to the composition. The base anchors everything with deep patchouli and smooth vanilla absolute, creating a powerful, long-lasting trail that balances decadence with a raw, earthy edge. A fragrance with serious presence that works from day through to night, Angel suits those who want a scent that leaves an impression. Housed in the iconic blue star bottle, it remains one of the defining gourmand fragrances in perfumery.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Nude Velvet Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=N5CYABD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Nude Velvet is a refined floral woody musk that wraps rose and iris in a soft, velvety warmth. Elegant, sensual and quietly commanding. The opening blends almond oil and ambrette absolute with neroli from Tunisia, creating a creamy, skin-like softness from the first spritz. At the heart, Turkish rose water and rose essential meet iris concrete from France, building a textured floral bouquet that feels rich yet delicate. Virginian cedarwood, musks and a subtle rice powder accord settle at the base, cocooning the florals in a warm, lasting embrace. A sophisticated fragrance that leans into softer, skin-close territory, Nude Velvet suits both daytime and evening wear across seasons. Presented in a couture-inspired flacon finished in nude pink lacquer.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AYPPHQ7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Parfum is a dark, woody leather fragrance that builds on the original Defy signature with added warmth and intensity. Fresh, bold and unapologetically masculine. The scent opens sharp with mandarin oil and black pepper, delivering a crisp, energetic burst before giving way to a velvety leather accord at the heart, enriched with saffiano and rich suede that adds a rugged, textured depth. Responsibly sourced Haitian vetiver oil anchors the base, grounding the composition with an earthy strength and lasting presence on the skin. A long-wearing fragrance that carries well from day into evening, Defy Eau de Parfum suits those who want something with substance and staying power. Housed in the denim-inspired minimalist bottle with contrasting straight edges and soft curves.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TUDK80G]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette is a sparkling fruity floral with a soft, warm dry down. Light, feminine and effortlessly elegant. The opening bursts with juicy bergamot, red berries and peach Bellini, bringing an immediate freshness that feels bright and inviting. At the heart, peony, lily and jasmine unfold into a delicate floral bouquet that adds depth without weight. Musk, vanilla and sandalwood round out the base with a gentle, lasting warmth that sits comfortably close to the skin. A youthful, easy-wearing fragrance that particularly suits warmer weather, Sheer Beauty works well as a daytime scent for spring and summer.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Infusion de Vetiver Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VBUB2J1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Prada Infusion de Vétiver Eau de Parfum is a woody citrus fragrance that places bold vetiver at its core, softened by musks and citrus for a clean, second-skin feel. Earthy, refined and quietly confident. Bergamot and cardamom open with a fresh, aromatic brightness that eases into a warm ginger heart, adding a subtle spice that bridges the top and base. Vetiver takes centre stage in the dry down, grounding the composition with a rich, earthy depth that feels natural and intimate against the skin. Part of the Les Infusions de Prada collection of unisex fragrances, Infusion de Vétiver is a understated daytime scent that feels personal and effortless. Presented in the collection's signature bottle with a green-tinted hue and dark green Saffiano cap.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum 15ml Refillable Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=D5X1FXW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum is a radiant woody amber fragrance built around a rich jasmine heart. Warm, powerful and luminous. The scent centres on a full-bodied jasmine that drives the composition with a bold, solar intensity. Woody and amber notes surround it, creating an enveloping warmth and depth that gives the fragrance a magnetic, almost hypnotic quality. The result is a trail that feels both grounding and expansive, lingering on the skin with real presence. A statement fragrance that carries well from day into evening, Alien is designed to be refillable, either in store via the Mugler Fountain or at home with the dedicated refill bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HS10L8F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Acqua di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum is an intensified take on the house's iconic Colonia, blending bright citrus with aromatic florals and a warm, earthy base. Fresh, refined and full of character. The opening is immediately zesty with bergamot, blood orange, grapefruit and petitgrain delivering a vibrant citrus burst. Rosemary, ylang ylang and orange leaves absolute add an aromatic, floral richness at the heart, giving the scent depth beyond its fresh opening. Patchouli and vetiver oil ground the base with an earthy warmth that holds everything together and extends the wear. A polished fragrance that works throughout the day and across seasons, Colonia Il Profumo suits those who enjoy citrus-led scents with enough substance to last.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Nectarine Blossom & Honey Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JOTVEYW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bursting with fresh fruit, Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom and Honey Cologne embodies the vibrancy of the stalls at Covent Garden’s famous markets. Uplifting like an early morning breeze, the cologne sets you up for a day of playful excitement. Juicy Cassis offers a top note of intense ripeness finished with a crisp edge to refresh and revitalise the senses. Sweetening into a smooth stream of Acacia Honey, the scent becomes luxuriously indulgent, balanced by accents of Blossoms and Beeswax for a deeper, richer scent. With a base of Peach, the fragrance is wrapped in a delicious velvety texture with the essence of succulent flesh turning rosy in the sunlight.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BOH0NMF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild is a floral Eau de Parfum celebrating nature's wild character. Fresh, feminine, and versatile for everyday wear. The fragrance opens with fruity banana blossom for a bright, airy introduction. Jasmine blooms in the heart, adding delicate floral softness, while sandalwood and vetiver settle into a warm, grounded base with subtle nutty depth. The composition evolves from fresh to comforting as it develops on the skin. At 50ml, this Eau de Parfum offers an easy way to enjoy a quality floral fragrance with natural versatility for any season.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Chloe Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JRVDATR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloé L'Eau de Parfum Intense for Women is a floral fragrance that celebrates confidence and femininity. The 100ml bottle delivers a rich, layered scent experience with depth and elegance. The fragrance opens with vibrant raspberry notes that feel fresh and inviting. Rose takes centre stage in the heart, revealing different facets as it develops, from bright and airy to honeyed and warm. The base unfolds with ambery woods, ambrox and cashmeran, grounded by cedary warmth that lingers softly on the skin. The pleated Chloé bottle features a refined black and ecru label with a deep garnet ribbon, reflecting the fragrance's floral character. A sophisticated choice for those who appreciate layered rose compositions with depth and staying power.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J8Y7NKN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense is a floral fragrance with brightness and depth. The scent offers a fresh yet grounded character that feels both playful and wearable. Opening with banana blossom, the fragrance feels immediate and warm. Jasmine and tuberose bloom in the heart, adding sensuality and floral richness. The base settles into amber and sandalwood with woody nuances that bring unexpected complexity and staying power to the composition. Housed in the signature Daisy bottle, reimagined with ombré hues and vivid tones. A layered floral that rewards wearing throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co Rose Gold Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BXS9XE1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tiffany & Co. Rose Gold Intense is an eau de parfum that builds on the original Rose Gold with greater depth and a darker, more complex character. A floral chypre gourmand that leans warm and confident. It opens with a bright citrus sparkle tempered by pink pepper, giving the fragrance an immediate energy that quickly gives way to something richer. At its heart, orange blossom, Turkish rose oil and orris butter layer together into a full, rounded floral that feels both fresh and opulent. Sustainably sourced patchouli anchors the base alongside warm woods, a delicate touch of pink sugar and a marine accord, pulling the scent into deeper, more sensual territory as it dries down. Developed in 2023 in collaboration with perfumer Jérôme Epinette, Rose Gold Intense was conceived as a darker evolution of its predecessor, and that intention carries through clearly in the dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Oud Yuzu Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XPWVKEG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Oud Yuzu Forte is part of the nature-inspired Aqua Allegoria collection, pairing the sharp, citrus brightness of yuzu with the deep, resinous weight of oud wood. An unexpected combination that works with contrast rather than against it. The fragrance opens with the zesty acidity of yuzu alongside mandarin, lemon and neroli, giving it a crisp, luminous quality from the first spray. As the citrus settles, the oud wood begins to emerge, grounded by vetiver and cedar and warmed by a tincture of amber. The result is a woody fragrance that moves fluidly between light and depth, carrying the freshness of the opening through into a richer, more shadowed dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K9KLI6A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire is a feminine eau de parfum that places the rose at its centre while building something altogether more playful around it. Fruity, floral and warmly sweet. It opens with a bright, berry-led accord of blueberry and strawberry sharpened by a touch of bergamot, giving the fragrance an immediate freshness before the floral heart takes over. Rose and jasmine form the core, with orange flower adding a soft luminosity to the bouquet. The base settles into a warm blend of sandalwood, patchouli, vanilla and white musks, with a hint of cotton candy lending a gentle, gourmand sweetness to the dry down. Presented in the house's well-known upside-down heart bottle, this 75ml eau de parfum is as recognisable on the shelf as it is on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TWD8ROD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum Intense is the highest concentration in the Flora Gorgeous Gardenia line, bringing a fuller, richer version of the floral that has defined the collection. Italian Mandarin Essence opens the fragrance with a bright, citrus-led energy that quickly gives way to the heart, where a Gardenia Accord combines with Hedione for a full, radiant floral character. Sandalwood Essence anchors the base with a warm, woody softness that deepens the floral notes and gives the fragrance its lasting trail. This gift set contains a 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml pen spray and a 5ml miniature, all presented in the house's Flora-patterned fuchsia packaging with gold lettering.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum 30ml + 10ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MPYIJ57]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild is a bold feminine eau de parfum that draws on the freshness of a wildflower meadow, bringing something earthier and more textured than its predecessor. Banana blossom leads the opening with a soft, fruity quality before jasmine adds a fuller floral richness at the heart. Macadamia introduces a subtle nuttiness that gives the composition an unexpected depth, while warm sandalwood and vetiver des sables ground the base in a smooth, woody earthiness that lingers on the skin. This gift set contains a 30ml eau de parfum alongside a 10ml travel atomiser. The bottle takes the Daisy silhouette in a new direction with a pastel green finish and multicoloured flowers cascading from the cap, and is compatible with the 150ml refill for continuous use without replacing the bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Pure Musc Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R85AVW2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau de Parfum is a soft, musc-centred fragrance designed for layering, presented here as a gift set alongside a complementary purse spray. The main fragrance opens with orange blossom and jasmine, building a clean, luminous floral quality before settling into a heart of musc and cashmeran wood. The result is a warm, skin-close scent with a woody softness that carries well through the day. The accompanying purse spray takes a slightly different angle, pairing osmanthus with musc and amber wood for a smooth, understated trail that blends naturally with the eau de parfum. Both can be worn independently or together, with the two compositions designed to complement and build on one another.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Chloe Le Parfum 100ml Refillable Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QLR2ST1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloé Le Parfum is a floral fragrance that centres on orange blossom and rose, two notes the house has long drawn on, brought together here in a composition with a warmer, deeper character. The florals carry the opening with a full, rounded presence before tonka bean and vanilla draw the fragrance into a soft, ambery finish that lingers on the skin with a quiet intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C947MTG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense is a floral woody gourmand eau de parfum that takes the Gardenia line into deeper, more intense territory while keeping the brightness that defines the Flora collection. Italian Mandarin Essence opens with a clean citrus freshness before the heart unfolds into jasmine extract and tuberose, creating a full, rounded floral character with a natural warmth to it. Sandalwood Essence anchors the base with an earthy softness, giving the fragrance a smooth, lasting dry down that carries the florals without overwhelming them. At 30ml, this is a neat size for everyday use or travel. Cruelty-free and vegan-friendly.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OV2TYS0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense is the deeper, more enveloping counterpart to the original Gardenia fragrance, sitting within the floral woody gourmand family with a composition that balances freshness and warmth. Italian Mandarin Essence leads with a bright, citrus-forward opening before jasmine extract and tuberose build a rich, layered floral heart. The transition into the base is smooth, with Sandalwood Essence lending an earthy warmth that softens the florals and gives the scent a clean, lasting trail on the skin. At 100ml, this is a generous size suited to daily wear. Cruelty-free and vegan-friendly.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum 10ml + 4.5ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R1JE5NX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jimmy Choo I Want Choo is a floral gourmand woody eau de parfum with a warm, playful character built around fruit, flowers and a rich vanilla base. Mandarin juice and velvety peach open the fragrance on a bright, fruity note before the heart introduces red spider lily alongside jasmine sambac, adding a warm, slightly exotic floral quality. Vanilla and benzoin anchor the base with a deep, resinous sweetness that gives the fragrance its lasting warmth and projection. This gift set contains a 10ml and a 4.5ml eau de parfum, housed in the distinctive peach-tinted bottle with a hammered gold spray cap and JC monogram.

listings.rawTitle: Joop! Homme Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U6W7P0P]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} JOOP! Homme Eau de Parfum is the 2021 intensified take on the original Homme fragrance, sitting within the oriental aromatic family with a richer, more concentrated character than its EDT counterpart. Cinnamon opens with a warm, spiced quality alongside hazelnut and a touch of bergamot that keeps the opening from feeling too heavy. Orange blossom and a powdery vanilla heart add a softer, slightly floral dimension before the fragrance settles into a deep base of tonka bean, sandalwood, moss and honey, where the sweetness and warmth of the composition fully comes through.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WSRT58H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense takes the Daisy Wild composition and deepens it, amplifying the floral and woody character of the original into something with more presence and longevity. Banana blossom opens the fragrance with a soft, fruity quality before jasmine and tuberose take over the heart, building a full, layered floral that carries warmth without feeling heavy. Amber and sandalwood close the fragrance with a smooth woody depth that grounds the florals and extends the dry down on the skin. The signature Daisy bottle returns here in ombré hues and vivid tones, giving it a distinct look within the Daisy Wild range.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=M47JL5H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir is a warm, rich interpretation of the Perfect fragrance, taking the original's floral character and adding greater depth and intensity through a resinous, amber-led composition. Purple rhubarb and plum accords open the fragrance with a dark, fruity quality, sharpened by a liquid honey nectar accord that adds a sweet, almost syrupy edge. Orange blossom absolute moves through the heart alongside golden amber woods, bringing a warm floral richness that anchors the fruitier top notes. Vanilla bean extract, myrrh and patchouli close the fragrance with a deep, resinous warmth that lingers on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum 20ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q644VV2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb is a rich, full-bodied floral fragrance that has built a loyal following since its launch, centred on a dense bouquet of flowers anchored by a warm, earthy base. Jasmine, freesia and orchid open the fragrance with a bright, layered floral quality that sets the tone for what follows. Centifolia rose and Sambac jasmine deepen the heart, adding a lush, rounded sweetness that gives Flowerbomb its distinctive character. Patchouli and vanilla close the composition with a warm, grounding depth that extends the wear and softens the florals into a smooth, lasting finish.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TQQNE2U]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb is a floral oriental eau de parfum that opens with an unexpected freshness before settling into the rich, densely layered heart the fragrance is known for. The 30ml eau de parfum is presented in Flowerbomb's signature diamond grenade bottle, one of the more recognisable designs in contemporary fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Eau de Parfum 4 x 5ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YLT2RRO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Gucci Flora Miniature Gift Set brings together four 5ml eau de parfum miniatures from the Flora Gorgeous collection, each built around a different floral at its core. At 4 x 5ml, the set works well as an introduction to the Flora range or as a gift for someone yet to find their preferred scent within it.

listings.rawTitle: Rochas Eau de Rochas Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Rochas Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Le Parfum Intense 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RH75BDU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Le Parfum Intense arrives here as a three piece set, built around the 100ml fragrance and completed with a body lotion and a travel size spray. The idea is simple: start with the lotion so the scent has something to hold onto, follow with the eau de parfum, then keep the smaller spray in a bag for later in the day. Divine Le Parfum Intense is the deeper, warmer reading of the Divine line, and it sits well on skin that has been prepared first. The lotion softens and gives the fragrance a longer life, while the travel spray means you are not carrying the full bottle around with you. Presented in Gaultier's signature packaging, the set works as a gift without needing much wrapping, and it is a sensible way to try the full ritual rather than the scent on its own.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Off Now Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DBX5Q10]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A 100ml eau de toilette from Lancome that sits on the elegant side of floral without ever feeling heavy. It is easy to wear day to day and still has enough character to stand out. It opens on bergamot and bright citrus, so the first impression is clean and immediate. Jasmine and rose come through in the heart and give the scent more depth as it settles on the skin. The dry down turns warmer, with vanilla and musk holding it all together and keeping it going for hours. It works just as well in the office as it does over dinner. At 100ml it will last you a long time, and the eau de toilette strength gives you presence without taking over the room. Scent profile: bergamot, citrus and fresh florals at the top, jasmine, rose and a soft floral bouquet through the heart, then vanilla, musk and woody notes in the base.

listings.rawTitle: MontBlanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=X01Q6F6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Montblanc Legend Red is the bolder, warmer side of the Legend family. Where the original Legend leans clean and fougère, Legend Red opens with a burst of juice and spice, then settles into dry woods that stay close to the skin for hours. It launched in 2022 and has become one of the brand's most reached-for men's fragrances, helped along by that red lacquered bottle. The scent begins with blood orange and grapefruit, sharpened by cardamom. Underneath, cedar, juniper berries and clary sage give it an aromatic, slightly herbal edge that keeps the fruit from turning sweet. The dry-down is where it earns its keep: Atlas cedar and mahogany bring a smooth, dry woodiness, with tonka bean softening the finish. It works year-round but comes into its own in autumn and spring. Fresh enough for the office and daytime wear, with enough warmth in the base for evenings out. As an eau de parfum it projects well, so two or three sprays are usually plenty. Why the 200ml bottle? This is the largest size Montblanc makes for Legend Red, and it's the one to buy if you already know you like the scent. Cost per millilitre works out considerably lower than the 50ml or 100ml, and a bottle this size will last most people well over a year of regular wear. Fragrance notes Top: Blood orange, grapefruit, cardamom Heart: Cedar, clary sage, juniper berries Base: Atlas cedar, mahogany, tonka bean

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Fantasm Sensuelle Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q1HWXSG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Angel Fantasm is the newest chapter in Mugler's Angel story, launched in 2024 and housed in a black star bottle rather than the familiar blue. It takes the patchouli backbone that made the original Angel famous in 1992 and rebuilds everything around it — swapping the caramel and praline sweetness for something tropical, creamy and closer to the skin. It opens on juicy pineapple lifted by bergamot, which is brighter and fresher than anything in the original. The middle is where it turns: a soft coconut accord with tiare flower gives it a warm, sun-cream sort of creaminess. Underneath, patchouli, bourbon vanilla and amber do the heavy lifting, and that's what keeps it recognisably Angel rather than just another sweet fruity scent. "Eau de Parfum Sensuelle" is Mugler's own name for this concentration, and it wears like it — rich, long-lasting and with real presence in a room. Two sprays is enough for most people. It's genuinely year-round: the pineapple and coconut work in warm weather, while the vanilla and amber base make it just as comfortable in autumn and winter. Who it suits A good pick if you like the original Angel but find it heavy, or if you want a gourmand that leans tropical rather than sugary. It's marketed for women, though the patchouli and amber base give it enough weight to be worn by anyone. Fragrance notes Top: Pineapple, bergamot Heart: Coconut, tiare flower Base: Patchouli, bourbon vanilla, amber

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PDGRR5K]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} La Nuit de L'Homme has been one of the best-selling men's fragrances in the UK since it launched in 2009, and this set pairs the full 100ml bottle with a matching shower gel — making it one of the easier gifts to get right for someone who wears fragrance. The scent was built by Anne Flipo, Pierre Wargnye and Dominique Ropion around a single idea: contrast. It opens on cardamom, spicy and slightly sweet without being heavy. The heart brings lavender, Virginia cedar and bergamot, which is where it picks up that clean, almost barbershop quality that stops the spice turning sharp. Vetiver and caraway in the base give it a dry, warm finish that sits close to the skin. It's an evening fragrance by reputation and by name, but plenty of people wear it during the day in autumn and winter. Sophisticated enough for dinner or an occasion, easy enough for the pub. If you only own one going-out fragrance, this is usually the one people land on. Why buy the set? The 50ml shower gel uses the same scent profile, so using it before you spray gives the fragrance something to hold onto and helps it last longer on the skin. It's also a handy size for a weekend bag or the gym. The set comes ready-boxed, which saves wrapping if you're buying it as a present. Fragrance notes Top: Cardamom Heart: Lavender, Virginia cedar, bergamot Base: Vetiver, caraway

The addition of heliotrope makes this perfume addictive and acts as an invitation to self-indulgence and pleasure. listings.rawTitle: Hermes Barenia Eau de Parfum 125ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WVI0H49]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Leather has a smell that's almost impossible to replicate. Hermès didn't try to replicate it. They found something better. Barénia Eau de Parfum takes its name from the brand's most storied leather, the kind that softens and deepens with time rather than wearing out. The fragrance works the same way. Christine Nagel designed it to dissolve into skin rather than sit on top of it, and that's exactly what it does. It opens with Calabrian Bergamot and a quiet touch of miracle berry, barely-there sweetness that clears the way for the heart. Butterfly lily takes centre stage there, a floral note so rare this is its first appearance in perfumery. Worth knowing. Worth smelling. The base settles into roasted oakwood and a dense patchouli absolute that gives the whole thing its quiet, earthy gravity. Hermès calls it a skin perfume. That's accurate. It doesn't announce itself. It just becomes part of you, and stays there.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WIDU57N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created by Hermès’ perfumer Christine Nagel, H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum is the third chapter in the H24 line. In the footsteps of contemporary man in motion, this new olfactory expression captures the rediscovery of urban nature after the rain. H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vegetal composition. The power of a bouquet of fresh herbs, the texture of a pear granita, and the vibrancy of a high-tech molecule, Physcool®. Created by designer Philippe Mouquet, the bottle is adorned with green lacquer, echoing the olfactory notes. In gray-green with a lime-green line, the box both defines and opens up the space. The H24 Herbes Vives 30 ml travel spray is accompanied by a 200 ml refill. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. H24 opens up a new space. The letter H is for Hermès, Homme, and Hours. The number 24 expresses a relationship with time and with the house of Hermès, located at 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Intense Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DL1A5QV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense reveals a deeper facet of the inner fire that animates the earth and man. Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense is a deep, woody fragrance that combines fiery bergamot with burning wood, underpinned by the mineral notes of intense lava stone. 100 ml and 50 ml Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense bottles can be replenished using the easy-to-use 200 ml refill. Remove the cap from the Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense bottle, then unscrew the pump. Pour in the contents of the refill, placing it vertically on top of the bottle but taking care not to overfill it. Screw the pump back on, then replace the cap to close the bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G2BYFCP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Bottled Men’s Gift Set is a sophisticated three-piece collection featuring the rich and refined Boss Bottled Parfum. Combining warm, woody and aromatic accords, the fragrance delivers a confident and distinctive signature. Complete with a 100ml Parfum, 100ml Shower Gel and 70g (75ml) Deodorant Stick, this luxurious set is perfect for layering the scent or gifting.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=S1J71NA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum Him Eau De Parfum Gift Set (100ml) is a 2-piece fragrance gift set for men pairing the intense, charismatic EDP with a matching shower gel. An intense, charismatic EDP that radiates confidence and masculinity. This bold fragrance is a theatrical masterpiece, designed to captivate and leave the audience yearning for more. Starting with the invigorating top note of Geranium, Scandal Pour Homme immediately grabs attention. The heart of the fragrance features a sensual Tonka Bean, adding a provocative and smooth contrast. As it settles, the deep and robust base note of Sandalwood ensures a lasting, triumphant impression. The perfume is housed in a captivating, blacked-out bottle, adorned with a flamboyant gold crown that amplifies its 'King of the Ring' status. Collection Contains: 1 x Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum Him Eau De Parfum (100ml), 1 x Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Shower Gel (75ml)

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J6XR3YJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Kenzo Flower Eau de Parfum is presented here in a refined gift set that brings together the signature scent in two spray sizes with a coordinating body milk. Known for its soft floral character, this composition is widely recognised for pairing powdery rose and violet with a gentle veil of vanilla and white musk, creating a modern fragrance with a calm, elegant presence. The set offers an easy way to enjoy the scent in different moments, with the 50ml spray suited to everyday dressing and the 10ml size convenient for travel or keeping close to hand. Layering with the body milk adds a more enveloping finish while maintaining the fragrance’s delicate, polished style. Graceful rather than overpowering, it lends itself particularly well to daytime wear and makes a thoughtful choice for anyone drawn to floral scents with a soft, contemporary edge. Gift set Includes 50ml Eau de Parfum Spray, 75ml Body Milk and a 10ml Eau de Parfum Spray

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette 100ml + 10ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L3V5B06]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover the invigorating power of Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette, a fragrance that perfectly embodies masculinity and victory. This 100ml bottle offers a purely energising and fresh scent designed to captivate and inspire confidence. The blend opens with a burst of citrusy freshness, followed by aromatic herbs and floral elements, finishing with a warm and sensual woody base. Ideal for daily wear or special occasions, Invictus symbolizes strength, power, and victory. Experience a scent that invigorates your senses and leaves a lasting impression with every spray.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Stellar Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EARQGMA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Get introduced to a luminous different gourmand fragrance with angel stellar eau de parfume lumineuse. an ambery, gourmand addition to mugler’s iconic angel collection. this eau de parfum for women is a 2025 fragrance debut crafted by perfumers louise turner and jacques huclier. Angel stellar eau de parfum is a captivating and radiant feminine fragrance. the ambery, gourmand fragrance is a great choice for fall and winter though it can be worn year-round. as an eau de parfum angel stellar has impressive longevity that will last longer than a traditional eau de toilette. perfect for a cool night no matter what season. angel stellar perfume opens with a zesty scent of bergamot. next at the heart is a sweet, nutty salty pistachio accord truly transforming the floral and woody scent into a modern gourmand the base holds a sweet bourbon vanilla accord intensified by a mysterious woody accord. Mugler’s asymmetrical star perfume bottle is presented in a striking cobalt blue color reflecting and echoing the depth and mystery of angel stellar. the bottle has a refillable design and can be replenished in a store or at home. engrave this gorgeous bottle for a more personal touch.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XAYVYGS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Invite your senses along a journey of mystery and intrigue with the Oud Wood Eau de Parfum Spray. This exotic and unmistakably distinctive cologne features Tom Ford’s pioneering composition of exotic woods and spices to evoke visions of smoky, incense-filled temples. The earthy fragrance is underpinned by a rare, precious oud wood, enveloping the wearer in its rich and dark blend of sensuality and strength. Exotic spices and cardamom add further warmth to the eau de parfum, complemented by natural elements of sandalwood, rosewood and amber. Confident and seductive, this intoxicating and elusive scent embodies the Tom Ford man. Oud Wood is housed in a smoked grey private blend bottle, inspired by the architectural appeal of a chess piece.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y4T5UYV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This sultry solar floral amber scent evokes remote private islands where summer lasts all year and one day seamlessly blends into the next. Alive with seductive cardamom and refreshingly decadent ylang ylang, Soleil Blanc unapologetically exudes the endless pursuit of sun and luxury. Soleil Blanc is a solar floral amber scent that exudes the endless pursuit of sun and luxury. Key Notes Bergamot, Cardamom Oil Orpur®, Pistachio Accord, Ylang Ylang Comores Island, Benzoin Extract Orpur®, Coco De Mer Accord

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SUFYQXT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Addictive by nature, desirable by design. Vanilla S*x spotlights a captivating interplay of deep and bright vanilla notes. Featuring the exclusive Vanilla Tincture India accord, a bright and sensuous nuance of the iconic ingredient. Fragrance Foundation Awards 2024 Winner:  Fragrance of the Year Award — Universal Luxury. Vanilla assumes a role that is anything but ordinary in Vanilla Sex.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EKD2V7S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The fragrance of freedom by YSL. Starring Dua Lipa, Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. LIBRE, the French word for 'free', pays tribute to YSL's most defining value: freedom. Freedom to be yourself. Freedom of choice. No compromise. Your own rules. Since 1961 freedom dresses the YSL woman: fierce, bold, authentic. A woman powerful like ocean waves crashing against the shore. With fire burning in her soul, like flames flickering in the breeze. Bestowing strength, like an eagle soaring through the sky. To embody LIBRE is British singer song-writer Dua Lipa. "To be free for a woman in 2019 goes without asking. We live life by our own rules." - Dua Lipa. A grand floral Eau de Parfum with an unequivocal YSL twist. The burning sensuality of the orange blossom flowers from Morocco, twisted with the aromatic boldness of lavender from France. Lavender, traditionally used in male perfumery is given an ultra sensual facet for a women's perfume that is both fiery and couture, with that uniquely androgynous YSL attitude. Crafted by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim.   Fragrance Family: Floral Top notes: tangerine, neroli, lavender. Heart notes: jasmine sambac, orange blossom. Base notes: white musks, vanilla extract. Key notes: orange blossom, lavender

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Gold Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RN975TQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The unisex Calvin Klein CK One Gold Eau de Toilette presents a youthful woody scent that combines the strength of both genders. The unisex CK One Gold fragrance came to life in 2016 and is the modern interpretation of the iconic CK One Eau de Toilette from 1994. Its motto is: “Be brave. Stand out from the crowd. Everything you touch exudes gold.” The energetic top notes consist of the unusual combination of fresh bergamot, juicy figs and slightly bitter sage. The heart of the composition is dominated by playful violet accords complemented by jasmine and tantalising neroli. The warm sensual conclusion will captivate you with guaiac wood and the essences of patchouli and woody vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Intense Eau De Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: Guerlain explores a powerful and sensual display of feminine power within Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense. Displaying an expression of independence, this fragrance invites many layers of sweet, floral and powdery nuances. The head displays a prominent lavender accord with touches of citrus. The heart of the fragrance centres around sweet vanilla before dressing in rose, jasmine and iris. The base concludes on tonka bean, patchouli, benzoin, liquorice and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Musc Nude Eau De Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RK4PVGO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The eau de parfum is composed around an elegant and timeless olfactive structure, enhanced with solar facets and the signature Narciso Rodriguez heart of musk. A piquant pink peppercorn accord meets an abstract floral bouquet of delicate white flowers as the fragrance gently caresses the skin. At the perfume's core, the for her heart of musk is infused with floral notes of precious rose oil and orange blossom. As the fragrance dries down, rich tonka bean absolute blends with the softness of cedarwood and patchouli, embracing you in a feeling of caring warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom Parfum 100ml Spray 2Pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G3FW8NK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Phantom Parfum by Rabanne embodies the essence of rebellion and magnetic allure, designed for those who command attention when darkness falls. This intensely captivating fragrance celebrates the untamed spirit of urban nightlife, where confidence meets mystery in perfect harmony. With its bold and unapologetic character, this scent becomes an extension of your persona, amplifying your natural charisma and leaving an unforgettable impression wherever you venture. The fragrance composition masterfully balances contrasting elements to create an intoxicating olfactory experience. Vibrant lavender opens with an electrifying burst of freshness, while rich vanilla adds warmth and sensuality at the heart. Deep vetiver grounds the blend with earthy sophistication, creating a scent that evolves beautifully throughout the day and into the night. This carefully curated combination ensures each spray delivers complexity and depth that mirrors the multifaceted nature of modern masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PGH9COG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Luna Rossa OCEAN Eau de Parfum by Prada is a bold expression of masculine intensity, crafted for those who seek to push beyond limits and redefine what’s possible. The fragrance captures the spirit of transformation and the thrill of the unknown, blending performance with sophistication in a scent that inspires confidence and ambition. It opens with a refreshing surge of grapefruit essence, immediately awakening the senses. This bright introduction is soon enveloped by the smoky, aromatic depth of incense, creating a contrast that is both invigorating and sensual. At the base, a rich vanilla bean accord lends a warm, creamy finish, enhancing the scent’s overall elegance and magnetic allure. Encased in a deep blue lacquered bottle inspired by high-performance sailing, Luna Rossa OCEAN reflects the sleek power and technical beauty of the sport. The signature Prada red line slices through the design, while the black cap is subtly accented with a red dot—an homage to Luna Rossa, the red moon. It’s a fragrance that feels as limitless and captivating as the ocean itself.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray 2 Pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SD0PI42]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Scandal is a new kind of fragrance for women: the elegant aura that it leaves in her wake is sullied by the Pigalle spirit beloved by Jean Paul Gaultier. Even Madam Minister is tempted by this scent of Scandal. It's more than a breath of fresh air - it's a breath of freedom. At night, everyone is allowed to be a party animal, make a scene and be scandalous! Delicious fresh honey with the wonderful scent of gardenia and blood orange. This set contains: 50ml Eau de Parfum spray 75ml Body Lotion

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Good Fortune Elixir Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NV1GG58]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Good Fortune Elixir Intense is a fragrance steeped in mystery and magnetic allure, inviting you to shape your own destiny with every spritz. This deeper, more powerful rendition of the original Good Fortune Eau de Parfum offers a bolder, more entrancing olfactory experience for those drawn to the spiritual and the sensual. It opens with the hypnotic curl of incense, casting a spell of intrigue from the very first moment. At its heart, a luminous jasmine superinfusion unfurls, rich and solar, bringing a radiant elegance to the composition. As it settles on the skin, the warmth of bourbon vanilla and creamy Caledonian sandalwood is elevated by a mystical palo santo accord, creating a finish that feels both sacred and intimate. Crafted with a vegan formula, Good Fortune Elixir Intense is more than a scent—it's an invitation to awaken your inner power and embrace your path with intention.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau De Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BM2DKYL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience a scent inspired by the winter holidays with Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau De Parfum 100ml, an invigorating unisex fragrance that evokes the serene shimmer of sun on snow. Smooth, sweet and sensual, it's a winter floral that suits any occasion. It opens on notes of bergamot and carrot seed, before deepening into a floral heart of ivory rose, jasmine, orange flower and Karmaflor Captive. These gently melt into a base of cistus labdanum, musk, benzoin and vanilla, lending the scent a warm, soft and lingering finish. Soleil Neige comes in a classic ivory bottle finished with a decorative label and plaque, making it an ideal gift as well as a treat for yourself. A great choice for anyone who loves soft, warm florals with a sweet, sensual depth, equally suited to men and women.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Florence Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U5OI5OU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Roberto Cavalli Florence Eau de Parfum is a chypre floral EDP for women, blending fruity brightness with soft floral elegance to create a radiant and uplifting scent. Inspired by the vibrant spirit of Florence, it delivers a refined yet expressive composition that feels feminine, luminous and full of life.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Just Cavalli For Her Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Just Cavalli 2013 by Roberto Cavalli is described as creamy-floral and extremely sexy! Top notes of Just Cavalli offer luminous and sparkling drops of neroli, announcing the sexy heart created of Tahitian tiare flowers, along with warm, cuddly and creamy rosewood accords in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Nero Assoluto Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A132BSW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Nero Assoluto is a decidedly uncompromising creation : absolute quality, absolute sensuality, absolute glamour. An artful contrast of boldness and elegance, it perfectly reflects Roberto Cavalli’s values, his unique sense of style and audacity. It was especially designed for women who are not afraid to stand out and assert themselves. A sensual and exclusive bottle, an elegant and sophisticated scent, a refined lesson in the art of seduction. The night is still young, full of untold promises. In the velvet half-light of her room, she unveils a sinuous silhouette, baring the soft glow of her golden skin printed tiger gown. Her secret fragrance suddenly fills the air, adding to the incredible sensuality of this moment. Glamour, feminine, absolute. Its elegance is bestowed by its precious and ultimate quality key ingredients. A seductive orchestra of orchids, paves the way with a captivating top note that attracts attention and awakens the senses. This delicate but opulent flower bestows exceptional sensuality, that is prolonged and intensified by a rich and warm middle note of dark vanilla. The dualism of Nero Assoluto is highlighted by its bitter sweet aroma. This unique fragrance boasts a heady and majestic woody base note of ebony.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Barenia Eau de Parfum Intense 125ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DVSU6KB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Barénia is named after the leather Hermès uses for its saddles and bags, a hide that darkens and softens the more it is handled. The Intense version leans into that idea, going deeper and warmer than the original with the leather brought right to the front. Christine Nagel built it as a chypre. Leather notes open, butterfly lily adds a soft, creamy middle, and oakwood with patchouli absolute gives a dry, earthy base that stays close to the skin for hours. It suits cooler evenings and anyone who likes florals with some weight behind them. This 125ml refill tops up the 100ml, 60ml and 30ml Barénia Eau de Parfum Intense bottles, so you can keep the amber studded bottle inspired by the Collier de Chien bracelet rather than buying a new one. Notes Top: leather Heart: butterfly lily Base: oakwood, patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GH2453A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum and Body Lotion Gift Set brings together a radiant blend of fruity and floral tones, offering a luxurious way to explore the many sides of femininity. It’s a duo designed to feel indulgent from the first spritz to the final touch of moisturiser. Inside, the Divine Eau de Parfum opens with bright, juicy notes of calypsone, pink berry and bergamot. Its heart unfolds into a warm, sunlit bouquet of lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang, before softening into a sweet, comforting blend of meringue and musk. It’s luminous, creamy and unmistakably Gaultier. The matching body lotion mirrors the same scent profile, with a rich texture that leaves the skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Layered with the fragrance, it adds depth and longevity while wrapping the skin in those floral-gourmand tones.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Pure Musc Blanc Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UPVSCDK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Musk has been at the heart of Narciso Rodriguez For Her since 2003. With Pure Musc Blanc, perfumer Sonia Constant made that signature brighter and more intense. The formula is vegan. Jasmine and a clean accord open the scent, then a creamy musk heart settles on the skin. Cedarwood and vanilla add warmth to the base, giving a white floral chypre that feels clean but sensual. You can also layer it over For Her Pure Musc Eau de Parfum. The 100ml bottle uses the familiar For Her shape, inspired by New York architecture and finished in tonal whites. Top notes: Jasmine, Clean Accord Heart notes: Musk Base notes: Cedarwood, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BO574QH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph’s Club began as an Eau de Parfum and has since grown into a full line for men. This Eau de Toilette is a fresher, lighter version of the original, with the same woody aromatic character. It opens with lavandin, crisp apple and grapefruit. Clary sage and geranium form an aromatic heart, softened by a touch of orange blossom. Virginia cedarwood and vetiver finish it with a smooth, woody trail that works well for both daytime and evening. The 100ml spray comes in the Ralph’s Club flask-style bottle, inspired by classic men’s barware. Top notes: Lavandin, Apple, Grapefruit Heart notes: Clary Sage, Geranium, Orange Blossom Base notes: Virginia Cedarwood, Vetiver

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PD78DMM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} MYSLF is the first woody floral fragrance Yves Saint Laurent has made for men. It shows a softer, more expressive side of masculinity, pairing bright freshness with warm woods. It opens with a fresh accord of Calabrian bergamot. At the heart sits orange blossom absolute from Tunisia, an unusual choice in men’s fragrance, which gives it a distinctive floral edge. Indonesian patchouli and Ambrofix in the base add warmth and depth to the trail. The set includes the 100ml Eau de Parfum spray and a 10ml travel pen, which is handy to keep in a bag or take away with you. The refillable full-size bottle is finished in high-shine black lacquer, with the YSL Cassandre logo sculpted into the glass. Top notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Bergamot Leaf Heart notes: Orange Blossom Absolute Base notes: Patchouli, Ambrofix, Woods

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KWIM1DR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A more intense escape into the Mediterranean blue. This Eau de Parfum fragrance opens with a tangy sharp, addictive duo of scents: luminous lemon and crisp green apple. Its signature dry down of lustrous amber woods and precious musks melts into sun-kissed skin, unfurls into a vibrant, sensuously scented wake. Light Blue Eau Intense is more than a scent, it is the aura of Mediterranean beauty. Top Notes: Lemon, Green apple, Peach skin Heart Notes: Marigold, Jasmine Base Notes: Amber Woods, Cedar Wood, Musks

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau Intense 100ml EDP Spray Gift Set
listings.description: A more intense escape into the Mediterranean blue. A chilled citrus cocktail of refreshing mandarin and frozen grapefruit gives the top notes a cool, elegant twist. Aromatic juniper dives into the heart of salty, aquatic accord, conjuring the translucent blue water of the Mediterranean sea. An abundance of vibrant amber woods wrapped in musks extends the radiance and staying power of this masculine blend, leaving a potent trail that captures the innate sensuality of the Light Blue man. Set comprises of - 100ml EDP Spray, 50ml Shower gel and 75 A/S Balm

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue 40ml + Red 40ml + 67 40ml EDT Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XVDM0R6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the essence of luxury and sophistication with the Ralph Lauren World of Polo Holiday Set. This exclusive set includes three timeless fragrances: Polo Red, Polo Blue, and Polo 67, each presented in a 40ml bottle. This collection is not just a gift; it embodies a spirit of success, style, and togetherness, making it the perfect choice for any occasion. Indulge in the invigorating aromas that each of these fragrances offers. listings.rawTitle: Mugler Amen Eau de Toilette 100ml Refill
listings.description: There's something about the moment you spray A*Men that just stops you in your tracks. It opens with a burst of bergamot and lavender that feels less like a fragrance and more like stepping outside on a crisp morning with nowhere to be and nowhere you'd rather go. Then it shifts. Mint, coriander, and cedar creep in and suddenly you're standing a little taller. It's the kind of scent that makes you feel like you've got your life together, even on the days you absolutely don't. The dry down is where A*Men really earns its place on the shelf. Coffee, patchouli, and musk settle into your skin and stay there, warm and grounding, like a leather jacket you've had for years. It doesn't announce itself, it just lingers in the best possible way. The sort of scent people notice as you walk past and can't quite place, but definitely remember. And the refill bottle? It's genuinely one of those rare cases where doing the right thing for the environment doesn't feel like a compromise. Same scent, less waste, and a bottle that actually looks good sitting on your bathroom shelf. Mugler A*Men isn't trying to be subtle. It's bold, it's warm, and it makes you feel like the most confident version of yourself, which honestly, is all you can really ask of a fragrance.
