listings.description: Gucci Oud is an oriental and floral fragrance for women and men. This new version of Ambre from the Gucci collection focuses on natural notes of resinous heartwood enriched with slightly sweeter notes, which makes it a balanced, but deep and mysterious perfume. As the gourmand opening of pear, raspberry and leathery saffron notes dries down, the scent reveals rich floral notes of orange blossom and woody Bulgarian rose, which rest on an exquisite oriental base of oud, musk, amber and patchouli. Oud is housed in a sophisticated, yet simple bottle made of black glass embellished with golden accessories and a golden cap. Gucci Oud was launched by in 2014.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Intense Eau De Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Strong, bold, with an intensity that is unashamedly seductive, new Black Opium Eau de Parfum Intense fragrance for women brings a new magnetic light to the iconic coffee-floral accord. Blue absinthe, flavoured with wormwood, and aromatic herbs combines with anis and sweet blue boysenberry; jasmine sambac absolute fuses with orange blossom absolute, making up the sensual heart of the fragrance. At the base, the sultry coffee note that underpins the Black Opium iconic olfactory signature is accompanied by licorice, sandalwood and creamy vanilla for a deliberately daring, ultra-feminine scent.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Absolute Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A luxurious and sophisticated fragrance highlighting woods and spices within a forcefully masculine assortment of scents. A head of bergamot invites freshness, a fiery heart combines three spices: cinnamon, nutmeg and saffron, and a base of vanilla and sandalwood completes the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Fuel for Life Him  Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Diesel Fuel for Life Homme is a mythical elixir that evokes images of something that's a source of energy and fuels a passion for life. These emotions, combined with sexiness and seduction, are exactly what Diesel have recreated and bottled - It's Fuel For Life. A magic potion of mysterious star anise, vintage raspberry and authentic heliotropine for him.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Live Irresistible Blossom Crush Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: An up-beat and vibrant fragrance impassioned with lively florals. Live Irrésistible Blossom Crush utilises deep rose notes alongside fresh peony to create a charming, but light and graceful, floral accord. Cacao gives the scent an offbeat of spicy, bitter fragrance and musk completes it with cosy, warm tones.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Absolute Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: The #GuiltyNotGuilty revolution continues with the launch of Gucci Guilty Absolute Pour Femme, the ultimate partner for Gucci Guilty Absolute Pour Homme. Together, the Absolute couple express the notion of emancipated love, a pair of fragrances that complement one another as a journey of liberation. Beginning from a mysterious note of blackberry, Gucci Guilty Absolute Pour Femme is a non-traditional women’s fragrance created for a contemporary woman. There is no one absolute way to wear fragrance. There is no one absolute way to love. There is no one absolute way to connect.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir For Him Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PKNL1MW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} For Him Bleu Noir Eau de Parfum celebrates pure masculine sensuality in an olfactory composition that’s discreet yet potent. The signature musc is heightened by sensual and woody notes - blue cedar and black ebony - and further transformed with vetiver. The bottle is an artful reinterpretation of the original bleu noir bottle in a dégradé translucence. Bleu Noir Eau de Parfum personifies the mercurial nature of seduction.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Divine Decadence Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GIADBO7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume is one of the best fragrance brands in the world. Although the brand has a huge following, many are yet to discover the more exciting and unusual scents the brand has to offer. Marc Jacobs Decadence is just such as fragrance. When it comes to fragrances, this is one scent that really stands out. It is fresh and vibrant. That makes it perfect for any time of the day or night. What does Marc Jacobs Divine Decadence smell like? Although it is packed with floral notes including hortensia and honeysuckle, you will pick up on something else. That something else is the scent of champagne the brand has managed to capture in a bottle. Needless to say, it is a real treat. We are delighted to offer this exciting fragrance in an eau de parfum bottle. When you are looking for a scented personal purchase, it has to be said that this is the perfect personal buy. It does make a great gift, but do you really want to give it away?

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau So Sweet Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A74LCHJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume is the fragrance brand that completes a woman's dressing table. Not only is the scent exquisite, the bottle makes a statement in its own right. Daisy Love Marc Jacobs is one of those fragrances that you simply have to own. There are many different fragrances with the Daisy range, but when you want a scent with a bit more refinement, this is the one. Marc Jacobs Daisy Love is packed with exciting notes. Like other perfumes by the brand, it is rich in feminine notes including a certain soft freshness. Take your time and allow the scent to develop. Before you know it, you are discovering deeper notes including woody and earthy accords. This scent experience really resonates with the modern-day woman. We know that this fragrance is one of the best feminine fragrances in the world. That is why we are so delighted to offer this eau de toilette. This beautiful fragrance makes a fantastic gift or one of those personal treats that you should award yourself with once in a while.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Knowing Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: Knowing is a warm and elegant woodsy scent for a sophisticated and self-confident woman. The top notes are rose, tuberose, coriander, green notes, plum, mimosa, aldehydes and melon. Middle notes are jasmine, pittosporum, orris, cardamom, patchouli, cedar, bay leaf, lily of the vally and orange blossom. Base notes are musk, vetiver, oakmoss, amber, sandalwood, civet and spices.

listings.rawTitle: Joop! Jump Eau de Toilette Spray 200ml Spray
listings.description: JOOP! JUMP Eau de Toilette for men is the perfume of a new generation of leaders which expresses power and masculinity. It features heady citrus and herbal top notes of Grapefruit, Thyme and Rosemary that pique the senses, while the middle notes include Coriander and the sweet radiance of Heliotrope flower. And then, the shock of the new: an unexpected jolt of Frozen Vodka. All this stands proudly on a dry, sensual base of sweet Tonka beans, Vetiver and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Joop! Go Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: JOOP! GO for men is an energetic and masculine perfume. It opens with a liberating top note thanks to the powerful combination of wild sparkling blood orange, vibrant frozen rhubarb and pimento berry accord. This woody aromatic perfume is entertainingly fresh while providing an irresistible energy and lasting scent. The pulse races as the unexpected and unconventional collide in a unique fragrance - JOOP! GO has a zest for life captured.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal A Paris Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EWS3KTB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Scandal A Paris is just as scandalous as its 80ml bottle. This is the one perfume bottle that have got tongues wagging. Jean Paul Gaultier always manages to break with tradition as far as bottle design goes. His latest attempt stands out in this rather crowded marketplace and immediately draws your attention to the bottle. What does Scandal eau de toilette smell like? Once again, Gaultier likes to make an impact. This wonderful scent is full of exciting notes including grapefruit and blood orange. Yes, fruity is the name of the game. After the fragrance impact, you will also pick up tones of tutti-fruity bubble gum. It may sound like an odd combination, but it certainly works. A perfect present and gift, but when you want an energy boost first thing in the morning, you should treat yourself to this scent. It is original and took the world by storm in 2019. A total surprise, but a nice and fragrant surprise that you will love.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: A remastered classic originally heralding from 1965, Habit Rouge was recreated and relaunched in the year 2003 by Jean Paul Guerlain. Inspired by the dressage of horses this oriental fragrance expresses the man of refinement and practised finesse. Opening in fruity citrus, Habit Rouge starts its display with a trail of lemon, orange and bergamot. Trotting on it gives way to a heart of spiced woods combining Brazilian rosewood, cinnamon and sandalwood smattered with jasmine for a slight aromatic breath. The fragrance then grounds in a warming but sweetened base marked in vanilla and spotted with smoky leather and warming amber.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Heritage Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: While Héritage originated from a tradition, it also heralds a new spirit. This highly nuanced scent speaks to the man of tomorrow. It opens with aromatic freshness, succeeded by the subtlety of a warm spicy accord on a woody dry-down with shades of the orient. Modern in its geometry and rigorous in its form, the bottle – iconic of the Guerlain men’s fragrance collection – and its luxurious wooden cap are timeless figures of French elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Aspiring to become the ideal man may seem impossible, but the fragrance of the real man at least is a reality. This fragrance boasts all the traits that make up the ideal man; its strong, smart and handsome. Launched in 2014; this fragrance opens with notes of citruses, rosemary and orange blossom. The heart of the scent is created with almond and tonka bean whilst all is laid on a warm base of leather, cedar and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Unleashing a potent burst of energy within cool aquatic and warm spicy notes, L'Homme Ideal Sport refreshes and awakens the senses; a masculine elegance for the active man.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Insolence Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Insolence represents modern femininity: daring, unpredictable and free. Belonging to the fruity floral olfactive family, its 3 key notes illustrate the 3 facets of insolent femininity: Extrovert and daring with sparkling violets; Brilliant and sparkling with glints of red berries and voluptuous and radiant with rays of iris. This triad of scents forms a smooth and comforting core that provides incredibly long lasting fragrance. As it eventually settles the fragrance gives into a deliciously creamy base of tonka bean and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Instant Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: L’Instant de Guerlain Eau de Parfum is one of these unique moments where everything can change. It's a moment of intense emotion between a man and a woman. L’Instant de Guerlain inaugurates a new olfactory interpretation of the oriental family: ""Crystalline Amber"". In the tradition of the great Guerlain fragrances, this one revisits the celebrated Guerlinade. Embrace your perfume in the mythical Bee Bottle. Designed in 1853 by Pierre-François-Pascal Guerlain for the Empress Eugénie, wife of Napoléon III, this precious bottle is adorned with the symbol of the Empire: the bee, which is now La Maison Guerlain’s emblem.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Toilette 30ml Spray
listings.description: Inviting a new facet upon the Mon Guerlain fragrance, Mon Guerlain Eau de Toilette inspires joy with a fresh and radiant scent, incorporating bright citrus and floral in a delicately feminine symphony. The top features a lavender accord with bergamot and mandarin orange. The heart uses jasmine with ylang-ylang and orange blossoms. In conclusion, a blend of vanilla, caramel and benzoin provide sweetness balanced by orris and violet.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Inviting a new facet upon the Mon Guerlain fragrance, Mon Guerlain Eau de Toilette inspires joy with a fresh and radiant scent, incorporating bright citrus and floral in a delicately feminine symphony. The top features a lavender accord with bergamot and mandarin orange. The heart uses jasmine with ylang-ylang and orange blossoms. In conclusion, a blend of vanilla, caramel and benzoin provide sweetness balanced by orris and violet.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Delightfully fresh, strong and sensually feminine, Mon Guerlain opens into a refreshing accord of bergamot and lavender. A delicately pure floral heart dresses the heart with rose, jasmine and iris. Finally a deeper accord lines the base in an anthology of comforting notes; vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean, benzoin and liquorice. Set comprises of: 100ml EDP Spray, 75ml Body Lotion, Mini and pouch.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Bloom Of Rose Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A beautiful portrait of strong feminine florals, Mon Guerlain Bloom Of Rose explores a bold composition that reflects free and courageous women. Top notes of citrus and lavender invite a delightful freshness, melding over a heart of bright neroli, rose and jasmine. The fragrance finishes on a base of sandalwood and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Vetiver Extreme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A powerfully masculine fragrance infused with woody and spicy notes. Vetiver Extreme by Guerlain offers a revitalising freshness; an accord of artemisia, tarragon, bergamot, licorice and lemon that opens the fragrance. The spicy core of the fragrance uses nutmeg, pepper and smoky incense before finishing in vetiver, tonka bean and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Vetiver Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Inspired by the outdoorsman whose presence evokes the richness and warmth of the earth, Vetiver captures the freshness and vitality of nature. An invigorating fragrance whose magic combines a very fresh note with a woody, spicy aura. Kicking off with a twist of spiced citrus, Vetiver opens in lemon and bergamot laced in coriander and nutmeg. At its heart it carries the namesake scent of vetiver mingled with woody notes and finally, as it matures, it brings out a smoky base of tobacco, rich leather and smooth tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Shalimar Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Shalimar, the most defiant of timeless fragrances, the perfume of temptation. Elegance, sensuality and subtlety are at the heart of Shalimar which is inspired by an oriental love story. Sublime and intimate, its soft voluptuous oriental floral notes are enveloped in a creamy vanilla embrace.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Samsara Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Samsara is an elixir of seduction for a woman who has found harmony and balance, which is notably conveyed through the composition's raw materials : the purest sandalwood and a jasmine used only for religious offerings until then.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: An absolutely essential and utterly irresistible perfumed creation. The legendary "heart-shaped" bottle has been boldly reinterpreted with a modern touch. Its crystalline transparency, fading from black to powdery pink, reveals the silhouette of the little black dress, ready to dance! The first arabesque is an armful of fresh flowers. This bouquet of roses, jasmine and orange blossom gives off a delicate fragrance. Cherry, apple and blackcurrant take centre stage, refreshed by sparkling green notes. Last but not least, tempting notes of white amber subtly reveal themselves. A swathe of silky musk notes envelops everything in a soft halo. My admirers applaud at such grace and elegance!

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity gourmand fragrance opening with top notes of bergamot, cotton candy, blueberries, cassis, and raspberry, heart notes of rose, orange blossom, and jasmine, and base notes of patchouli, musk, sandalwood, and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Twilly d'Hermes Eau Poivree Eau de Parfum 85ml Spray
listings.description: Twilly d'Hermes Eau Poivrée provides a sharp and peppy fragrance that dances with energy. A passionate embrace of floral and chypre fragrances is engaged by an opening of rosy pink pepper. The heart comprises a romantic rose accord before finishing on a rich patchouli base.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Pour Homme Night Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A rush of energy, a bold and daring fragrance dressed in woody and aromatic nuances. A crest of zesty grapefruit, cardamom and coriander leads into a heart of mango, artemisia, wormwood and geraniums. The final level, a base of rich guaiac wood, vetiver and a strong pull of tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford White Patchouli Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: An accord of white flowers lain atop a base of vivid patchouli. White Patchouli by Tom Ford was released in 2008 and creates a chypre floral scent with opening accords of bergamot, peony, coriander and white flowers. Rose picks up the heart alongside notes of jasmine and ambrette before finishing on a potent patchouli note, incense and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford White Patchouli Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: An accord of white flowers lain atop a base of vivid patchouli. White Patchouli by Tom Ford was released in 2008 and creates a chypre floral scent with opening accords of bergamot, peony, coriander and white flowers. Rose picks up the heart alongside notes of jasmine and ambrette before finishing on a potent patchouli note, incense and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Black Orchid was launched in 2006, this contemporary fragrance opens with top notes of Jasmine, Gardenia, Blackcurrant, Lemon, Bergamot and Mandarin. Middle notes are Orchid, Spicy notes, Fruity notes and Lotus, base notes are Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Incense, Amber, Chocolate and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau De Vie Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A flush of refreshing and bright floral fragrance, Flower by Kenzo Eau De Vie charms a tantalising opening accord of fresh ginger, bergamot, neroli and petitgrain. The heart encounters a duet of roses and orange blossom before falling upon a tonka bean base with elements of musk, benzoin and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Visit Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro Visit is a modern, woody and spicy fragrance for self-confident men. Forget about all the common days and draw energy and strength with this original perfume. If you long for the image of an elegant seducer and a cosmopolitan man who can see the bigger picture, then this fragrance in its golden package is the right choice for you. At first you'll notice exotic tones of cardamon, nutmeg, and pink peppercorn which will boost your self-confidence. Later, essences of precious blue cedar, frankincense, and guaiac wood develop, only to be replaced towards the end by a warm aroma of musk and amber, which lasts incredibly long. Don't hesitate and order Azzaro Visit! The perfumes by Azzaro are full of freshness, exotic flowers, elegance, and luxury to satisfy both women and men. Azzaro Visit is tailored for a self-confident and casually elegant man who can draw the attention of any woman.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only The Brave Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Only the Brave is the iconic male fragrance by Diesel, a modern perfume for a self-assured leader who achieves his dreams with conviction. Its emblematic bottle, a clenched fist, conveys the brave values: masculinity, power and self-confidence. A Citrus Woody, this popular Eau de Toilette opens with the invigorating and energizing freshness of Lemon and Mandarin contrasted with the herbaceous spicy freshness of Coriander. The heart notes bring an aromatic sensuality with Labdanum, Violet Leaves and Rosemary. Finally the base notes create a long lasting strength and elegance with the warmth of amber, the intensity of Leather and the woody Cedar notes Edgy and cool, the question is are you brave enough?

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Essentiel Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Le Parfum Essentiel is a sensual ode towards Elie Saab couture. It features resplendent designs of floral and chypre fragrance that create a sunny and sensual impression. The head of the fragrance is a fresh accord between mandarin and orange flower. The heart uses gardenia for a sweet but gentle fragrance. The base finishes with cedar and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Essentiel Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Le Parfum Essentiel is a sensual ode towards Elie Saab couture. It features resplendent designs of floral and chypre fragrance that create a sunny and sensual impression. The head of the fragrance is a fresh accord between mandarin and orange flower. The heart uses gardenia for a sweet but gentle fragrance. The base finishes with cedar and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray + 75ml b/l Set
listings.description: Set contains - 50ml Eau de Toilette & 75ml Body Lotion Give the gift of a completely irresistible look this season with an enticing Givenchy fragrance set including a Live Irresistible Eau de Toilette and luscious moisturising body lotion. Surprising, stunning and spontaneous. At its heart, a deeply feminine floral. Very Irresistible, the first women’s aromatic floral fragrance. An armful of multi-faceted roses. A blend of the aromatic accord of star anise that brightens the notes of rose, accentuating the sensuality with freshness. Daring originality that’s unexpected. Very Irresistible; French elegance with an impertinent twist.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Contains 50ml Eau de Parfum and a Maxi Lash So Volume Black Mascara Mon Guerlain, the House's new fragrance, is a tribute to today’s femininity: A strong, free and sensual femininity, inspired by Angelina Jolie. The fresh oriental fragrance enhances exceptional raw materials: Carla lavender from Provence, Sambac jasmine from India, Santalum Album sandalwood from Australia and Tahitensis vanilla from Papua New Guinea. For five generations, the Guerlain perfumer has explored the planet in search of precious raw materials. Behind all Guerlain creations, there are amazing people who cultivate, extract and distill. All of these emotions experienced and shared – from the field to the laboratory – become the notes of Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Miss Dior Originale Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J7HIL64]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Miss Dior Perfume never fails to delight. If you are looking for a new scent to add to your collection, this is one of the best perfumes you should definitely look to. Christian Dior Perfume is a perfumer that never fails to innovate and come up with new and exciting fragrances for both men and women. On this occasion, we are delighted to bring you Miss Dior Originale. It has beautiful floral notes which highlight the femininity within the scent. However, don’t let this trick you into thinking this perfume doesn’t have hidden depths to discover. The addition of musky notes makes the scent modern and confident. Oakmoss and patchouli have both been added to its bouquet. This offering from Miss Dior is an excellent choice when you are looking for an eau de toilette that is perfect for both day and night. If you are looking for a scent with a difference, this is the one. Buy it for yourself or introduce someone special to the wonderful world of Dior fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Miss Dior Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CS13F0E]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Miss Dior Perfume has something for every occasion. When you are looking for a new daytime fragrance, you should put Miss Dior on top of your list. The scent has an unexpected freshness to it. This makes it the perfect fragrance for the office or the school run. The eau de parfum offers a range of flowery essences. They are interrupted by apricot essence which adds a touch of depth and spice to the scent. Lily-of-the-Valley makes the scent slightly daring and cheeky. There is no doubt about this - it is one of the best Christian Dior perfumes. It is available in a range of formats, but as it is such a delight, buying a larger size is a good idea. A Dior perfume always makes the best gift. Or, why not treat yourself to this much-loved fragrance? A great perfume that lifts your mood instantly.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Pleasures for Her Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1995, this is one of life's simple pleasures. Capturing the clarity of flowers just after a spring rain, the sheer, shimmering floral fragrance is a spirited blend of Lilies, Peonies and Jasmine, all tingling with the rare essence of exotic Baie Rose. Ever fresh with White Lily's and Violet Leaves, this fragrance delights the senses with pleasure after pleasure.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Spirit of the Brave Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YNKKVTW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Spirit of the Brave opens a new Chapter with a name that echoes the huge success of Only The Brave. It introduces a new kind of masculinity and bravery that is more unconventional and playful. Together, Diesel and Neymar have co-created a fragrance that reinterprets the codes of masculinity with playfulness and sophistication. The remastered iconic bottle is inspired by Neymar's tattoos as the lion represents courage and strength. Spirit of the Brave reinvents the classic fougere and redefines the codes of masculinity in Diesel's most luxurious fragrance yet. The very first notes unveil a modern and masculine green signature bringing a boost of freshness with an unprecedented concentration of natural ingredients for a masculine fragrance. The crisp and elegant resinous heart carries texture and creates a daring contrast with the fresh top. The warm, luxurious dry down laced with Tonka bean brings an addictive twist and conveys a sensual masculinity. Completely captivating, this Eau de Toilette is the fragrance of audacious and sophisticated masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Passione Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: Si Passione by Giorgio Armani is a fruity floral fragrance for woman. It contains notes of spicy pink pepper, rose and jasmine. Si Passione, the new perfume for women by Giorgio Armani. A powerful reinvention of the signature Armani fragrance, Si Passione adds a new dimension to Giorgio Armani’s feminine fragrance personality - in his own words, “an irresistible combination of grace, strength and independent spirit". An intense, uncompromising scent for a confident woman who dares to say yes.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Goldea The Roman Night Absolute Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Orange blossom and black Plum provide a stunningly unexpected opening, taking the breath away before intoxicating the senses. Mysterious and magnetic, blended with black Musk, the Chypre accord stirs under bewitching Patchouli and crystal Moss while exuding the scent of infinity. A fragrance exuding freedom and carefree exuberance captivating all the intensity of ephemeral experience. The absolute embodiment of sensuality, unpredictability and casual spontaneity. Top Notes: Black Plum and Orange Petal Heart Notes: Jasmine and Vanilla Madagascar Base Notes: Black Musk, Patchouli and Crystal Moss

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Man Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Cool Water Intense, Davidoff, Eau de Parfum. Discover the Intense freshness from the sea. Davidoff, for the first time has revisited Cool Water’s freshness with an ethically sourced ingredient: the green mandarin. This handpicked citrus was harvested by a community in the Vale Do Caí in Brazil, as part of a sustainable sourcing partnership monitored by the perfume creator. The scent unfolds into oriental notes of coconut water blended with the sensuality of amber accord. Your ultimate call of freshness, hedonism and seduction.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Wave Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Opening with a lively burst of Mexican Lime and Nashi Pear, the energetic EDT is enhanced by Bondi Beach Flower, Sambac Jasmine and salty Amber, before crashing into Australian Sandalwood accords. Housed in a striking blue bottle inspired by the rippling waves of azure seas.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Wave Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Catch the wave with Davidoff Cool Water Wave! Like a rush of pure adrenaline, this immersive scent plunges you straight into the crashing swells of the ocean, an invigorating encounter with the euphoria of catching the perfect wave. It begins with a surge of bracing Marine Splash and Grapefruit mingling with energising Sichuan Pepper to evoke the cool spray of a breaking wave. A swell of stunning intensity arrives next with vibrant Birch Leaf and Juniper. Beneath it all is a masculine undercurrent of Patchouli and Sandalwood that suggests the immense power that exists below the surface. The modern bottle, in fresh confident aquamarine, with a silver cap, is the incarnation of contemporary style. With its zest of orange, the logo emphasises the vibrancy of this new scent while the thin vertical silver line replicates an iconic surfboard design. Ingredients: Alcohol denat., Aqua/water/eau, parfum/fragrance, linalool, benzyl salicylate, limonene, hydroxycitronellal, citronellol, geraniol, alpha-isomethyl ionone, coumarin, eugenol, citral, bht, acrylates/octylacrylamide copolymer, hydrolyzed jojoba esters.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Bad Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Diesel Bad is the new masculine fragrance from Diesel, coming out mid-2016, announced as a daring and sophisticated, addictive and fresh woody fragrance. It is apparently the first one that combines notes of tobacco and caviar, discovering the fresh salty side of the woody scents territory..

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Bad Intense Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: Diesel launches Bad Intense in August 2017 as an enhanced version of the fresh, salty and woody fragrance Diesel Bad from 2016, which will now be in Eau de Parfum concentration. The fragrance is described as bold and sophisticated, intended for "mysterious" and "rebellious" bike-riding, leather-jacket-wearing men. This new intense version is enriched with additional spicy accords and red herbs, which makes it warmer than the original. The dominant notes of the original composition, such as bergamot, caviar and smoked white tobacco, are also present in this new interpretation

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only The Brave Street Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Only The Brave Street, the new fragrance by Diesel, takes its inspiration from the raw and playful energy of the street. Only the Brave Street is the fragrance for the ones who make the city their playground, for those who express themselves and build success there. The iconic bottle of Only The Brave is remastered in powerful concrete and vibrant orange to embody the contrast of this new scent. The Eau de Toilette has a fresh crunch with basil, apple and bergamot notes and a new masculine addiction with vetiver, cedar and liquorice notes. This woody aromatic fragrance is unique thanks to this liquorice ingredient, a note which brings an unexpected tone to the woody accord and creates a new addictive freshness. Top notes: Basil, Apple, Bergamot Heart notes: Liquorice, Cardamom Base notes: Cedar, Vetiver, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Nectar Love Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: DKNY Nectar Love is an oriental, floral fragrance that was launched in 2017. The scent opens with top notes of Yellow Freesia, Mandarin, Grapefruit, Nectarine and Solar Salicylates, middle notes are Jasmine, Muguet, Orange Flower and Mirabelle. Base notes are Cedar-wood, Vanilla, Musk, Beeswax and Neroli.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray + 50ml b/l + Mini
listings.description: This Set Includes: Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray + Body Lotion 50ml + Mini 7.4ml Spray. BOSS THE SCENT For HER exudes feminine elegance, warmth and sensuality. The scent reflects the tension between two people who are getting closer. Starting with the first electrifying spark, powered by an irresistible force. The beguiling intensity of the fragrance enables BOSS THE SCENT For HER to reflect the art of seduction in all its facets - attraction, seduction, devotion. Honey-sweet peach notes and freesia combine to form an elegant, feminine top note that exudes lightness and immediately captivates both men and women. The desire to discover more is aroused. Both come closer to each other. Oriental osmanthus flowers unleash the seductive power of the fragrance in the heart note. The initially tentative approach increases to an irresistible force. Devotion: Intense and mysterious, the base note with roasted cocoa radiates the magic that seduces and seduces both the power of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YOEKPMO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Set Includes: 100ml EDP Spray, 100ml Aftershave Balm and Pouch. Capturing the energy of nature for an urban man in tune with his environment, Bvlgari introduces its new fragrance creation, Bvlgari Man Wood Essence.  The fragrance opens with a bright spark of citrus and spice. This liveliness gives way to masculine notes of Cypress Wood and Haitian Vetiver. Like the hearth of a home, the fragrance’s foundation is thoroughly warm and inviting. Base notes of Cedar Wood and Ambergris provide a final rush of invigorating strength.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray + 75ml s/g Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G04VV2W]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The ideal man is a myth. His fragrance, a reality. Guerlain decodes men`s aspirations and creates for them a concentrate of ideal. The ideal fragrance? Smart, handsome, strong. Three adjectives, three accords for this fresh woody fragrance that will trigger your full potential. The ideal bottle? Masculine, luxurious and distinguished. A mysterious pack, a graphic, black and white object, a flashcode as a door to a digital universe. The bottle square, facetted and streamlined, luxurious. Radical matte black lacquer side faces. A decidedly masculine, heavy cap that is also matte and borrows its guilloché detailing from the world of watchmaking.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill London Century Eau de Parfum 135ml Spray
listings.description: Presence and impact open this fragrance with an exquisite infusion of citrus freshness highlighted by a nuance of vibrant bergamot. A heart of resinous spices and aromatics deepens into signature sophistication. Luxurious musk wraps the spiced woodiness of exotic cypriol for an unforgettable trail of masculine elegance and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Because It's You Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: This women’s fragrance is feminine, full, instinctive and passionate. It features the addictive and sophisticated rose absolute, which combines the notes of vanilla and musk, revealing a complex and incredibly deep sensuality. Fragrance Family: Fruity Floral Top Notes: Raspberry, Blackcurrant, Neroli essence Heart Notes: Violet leaves accord, Rose Absolute, Jasmin Sambac Absolute Base Notes: Patchouli essence, Vanilla Extract, Musks

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: The aftershave by Emporio Armani, Stronger With You, is a warm, sensual Eau de Toilette for men, featuring spicy accords in the top notes of a mix of cardamom, pink peppercorn, and violet leaves. Stronger With You has inherited a confident elegance, with the easy nonchalance of youth, conveyed by the sage at its aromatic heart. These notes combine with the smoky Vanilla Jungle Essence™ and the sugar coated chestnut accord, producing an irresistible men’s fragrance. Top notes: Pink Pepper Essence, Apple Accord & Violet Leaves Accord Heart notes: Lavender Essence, Sage Essence, Cardamom Essence & Cinnamon Essence Base notes: Glazed Chestnut Accord, Cedar Tree Essence, Guaiac essence & Amber Wood

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Amber Gold For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Awaken the sprit to sensual sensations with a spritz of Euphoria Amber Gold by Calvin Klein. Launched in 2018, this oriental fragrance blends an array of notes that capture the essence of its name. It opens with a zesty burst of mandarin and plum wrapped in silky rose.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Givenchy introduces its new fragrance L’Interdit. A tribute to bold femininity. Forbid yourself nothing. Allow no rules. An invitation to defy convention and embrace your singularity. A white floral cut through with dark notes unleashing a bold luminosity that flirts with obscurity. The shocking side of chic. The first resolutely underground flower, to discover the thrill of the forbidden. Orange blossom, jasmin and tuberose, vetiver and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UNFRJPF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume is the one fragrance brand that never fails to delight. It is one of the more exclusive fragrance brands in the world. One of the most exciting scents it has to offer Issey Miyake l'eau d'Issey. If you have not added this scent to your choice of perfumes yet, you simply must. The opening statement is one of white flowers and light sweet honey. As the scents develops further, you will also pick up on other notes including tuberose, vanilla and wood. All of this is held together by an aquatic freshness. In other words, this fragrance is perfect for both day and evening wear. We are delighted to be able to offer this fragrance experience in a 50ml bottle. This special eau de parfum makes a wonderful personal purchase. If you can be persuaded to part from it, we have to say that it makes a nice petite present for a friend other special person in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Intense Eau De Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: La vie est belle is a universal declaration to the beauty of life. A unique olfactory signature perfume scent created by three of France's leading perfumers, La vie est belle introduces a new olfactive language with precious ingredients. Olfactory notes: Transversal Notes: Iris, Fine delicacies Accord. Top Note: Pear, Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Blackcurrant Bud. Heart Notes : Orange Flower, Jasmine Sambac, Tuberose, Hazelnut accord. Base Notes: Iris, Tonka, Patchouli, Gourmand Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Modern Muse Chic Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2014 Modern Muse Chic is a darling white floral fragrance accompanied by musks and woods. Plays a delightfully feminine feel whilst carrying races of exotic notes. An opening of plums and artemisia. The heart of the fragrance is jasmine, tuberose and lily creating a triad of white florals, all layed upon a base of musks, patchouli, ebony and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Modern Muse Le Rouge Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: A daring and romantic infusion carrying the heights of glamour alongside a daring bravado. Two distinctly contrasting accords meld into an inspirational fusion of fragrances both intriguing and intoxicating. An accord of rose and red fruits opens with red currants, raspberries, pink pepper and saffron linking to a heart of rose, jasmine and magnolia. A vanilla base, complimented by vetiver, vanilla and ambrette.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J29SR50]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This clean feminine fragrance has floral overtones made up from a wide range of flower scents including lotus, cyclamen, freesias, carnations and white lilies. Base notes are musky and woody tones. Set includes: - L'Eau D'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml - L'Eau D'Issey Travel Spray 25ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 125ml Spray Set 3 Pieces
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y0SMUJT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey is the male scent that you can rely on to always deliver. It was created for the sophisticated man who wants his eau de toilette to differ from the rest. There is the one thing that you can say about L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme, It is one of the scents that will get you instantly noticed.  What does Issey Miyake Pour Homme smell like? The fragrance is often described as woody. However, there is something more nestling among the notes. You will also pick up on a fresh aquatic tone. In many ways, it is this fresh tone that makes this scent stand out in a crowd. The finishing touches include lemon, tarragon, and bergamot. The best way to describe the scent, is as a bit of spice.  Set Includes: 125ml EDT Spray + 50ml Aftershave Blam + 50ml Shower gel.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Women Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HRPD4TM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Feminine. Sensual. Luminous. The first perfume ever created by Raf Simons, Calvin Klein WOMEN denotes not one, but many—a group of individuals, each with their own distinct voice. Drawing inspiration from a sense of freedom and unlimited possibilities, empowered modern women celebrate every aspect of the feminine spirit. Celebrating femininity, Calvin Klein WOMEN combines strength and freshness with sensuality. A woody perfume combined with floral tones, WOMEN makes for an approachable scent at any time of day. The bottle features the female eye as a metaphor for an outlook on the world and a reflection of oneself. Created by artist Anne Collier, the eye artwork motif represents an iconic emblem of the WOMEN campaign and serves as a source of strength and emotion.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier Pasha Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A deeply intense and long-lasting scent, Cartier’s Pasha Eau De Parfum is a modern take on the original Pasha Eau De Toilette. Perfumer Mathilde Laurent combines the finest ingredients to create a high concentration Parfum, which brings together sensual sandalwood and fiery amber for an aroma with a lasting hold on the skin. The inclusion of patchouli offers an earthy edge; the warm, woody notes blended with herbaceous greens, create a modern fougere accord ideal for a stylish gentleman who wants to be noticed.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Alive For Her Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: What makes you feel ALIVE? Every woman has her own answer. Inspired by living life to the fullest and finding your own way, BOSS ALIVE from HUGO BOSS empowers women on their path to success. Contemporary and confident, blending soft and bold notes, the BOSS ALIVE perfume fragrance leaves a trail of positive energy. Sparkling apple and plum top notes exude optimism, while a powerful floral heart of jasmine sambac reveals radiant femininity. The contrasting base fuses woody notes with a magnetic vanilla absolute, bringing comfort and confidence. A golden ornament surrounds the glass bottle like a piece of jewellery, while the nude pink juice captures the light, reflecting the aspirational, life-affirming nature of ALIVE. Fragrance family: Woody, fruity. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Apple Middle notes: Jasmine, cedarwood Base notes: Vanilla, sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>An expressive and lively interpretation of London within a delightful, feminine fragrance. Her, by Burberry, is a bright floral-fruity fragrance opening in a berry accord of strawberry, raspberry, blackberry, cherry and blackcurrant which compile a sweet but tart flavour. The heart features a jasmine and violet accord. The base brings musk alongside cashmeran, amber, woods and moss.</p>

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 Vip Black Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: The new definition of incredible, 212 VIP Black by Carolina Herrera is an energetic, spicy fragrance designed to own the party. It’s fierce and addictive with an aromatic top note of Absynth, heart notes of Lavender and Leather whilst the base leaves an oriental musky trail with Vanilla and Musk. Enclosed in a mysterious monolithic black bottle, this explosive yet elegant fragrance is the new must-have for any modern influencer. Available in 50ml and 100ml eau de parfum spray.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Collector Edition Eau de Parfum 25ml Refillable Spray
listings.description: Introducing the Angel Christmas Collector, the iconic Angel Eau de Parfum fragrance in a gradient sparkling blue bottle, to let Angel shine on a deep night. Angel Eau de Parfum, a voluptuous oriental gourmand fragrance created with a delicate blend of sweet red fruits, soft caramel, honey and praline, combined with the captivating power of patchouli and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TGN15JF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sì Passione Eau De Parfum Intense, the fragrance for women by Giorgio Armani, captures the vibrating true passion. The iconic Sì signature of blackcurrant nectar is blended with an emphatic floral heart made of a jasmine duo, creating a fierce and powerful energy that is further enhanced by patchouli essence and vanilla extract. An ode to vibrating femininity, Sì Passione Eau De Parfum Intense celebrates the contrast between the floral brightness and the intensity of passion. In Giorgio Armani's own words, "Intensity doesn't need to be dark. Intensity is a movement in the making, a continuous vibration.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker Covet Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A floral, woody musk scent first launched in 2007. This desirable fragrance opens with top notes of lavender, pelargonium leaf, dark chocolate and Sicilian lemon. The heart notes of honeysuckle, lily-of-the-valley and magnolia then begin to sink in. Finally the fragrance settles on the warming base notes of amber, musk, vetiver, cashmere wood and teak wood.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker NYC Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A total celebration of fashion and fragrance. A deliciously addictive and colourful fruity floral built around a vivacious wild strawberry accord with a cocktail of feminine floral and creamy sensual undertones. Top notes of strawberries, mandarin and Osmanthus enable a delectably sweet and refreshing accord. The heart graces floral tones of gardenia, honeysuckle, rose and mimosa. The base handles a rich accord of sandalwood, rum, musk and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker Lovely Sheer Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Sarah Jessica Parker Lovely Sheer Eau de Parfum evokes a joyous, exciting and carefree holiday atmosphere and surrounds you with lightness and freshness. a floral, woody scent for the sensual woman for everyday wear

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker NYC Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray + 10ml Rollerball Set
listings.description: 100ml Eau de Parfum Spray and 10ml Roller Ball Sarah Jessica Parker launches her new fragrance "NYC", capitalising on SJP's "Carrie Bradshaw" alter ego, creating a new brand which is fun and fashionable, aiming toward a slightly younger audience. NYC is a deliciously addictive fruity floral fragrance built around a wild strawberry accord with a cocktail of feminine florals and creamy sensual undertones. A must have for all Sarah Jessica Parker Fans and Sex & The City fanatics.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker Lovely Eau De Parfum 100ml Spray + 10ml Rollerball
listings.description: Sarah Jessica Parker Lovely Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray + 10ml Rollerball. An icon within the fashion industry, SJP always wanted to create her signature scent. Lovely was the first of her many successful fragrances; a soft powdery aroma with an opening of lavender, citruses and Martini, a blast of patchouli, orchid and pepper, which quickly settles into a beautiful, clean and fresh musky base. The packaging is just as lovely as the scent, with an egg-shaped pink bottle, a silver ribbon and golden details on the cap.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker NYC Eau de Parfum 10ml Rollerball
listings.description: Sarah Jessica Parker SJP NYC Eau de Parfum is a fruity and sweet fragrance for women. Classed as a citrus, powdery and rum scent. Top notes: Strawberries and White Osmanthus. Heart notes: Gardenia, Honeysuckle and Red Damascena Rose. Base notes: Vanilla Absolute, Sandalwood, Rum and Creamy Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Lime Basil & Mandarin Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VNQV9B4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Lime Basil and Mandarin Cologne is a signature fragrance from Jo Malone. Quintessentially British and luxurious, Jo Malone has gained a global presence for its elegant scents. This fragrance perfectly blends citrus and herbal hues, revealing a unique scent which is both revitalising and relaxing. Cool and confident, this fragrance evokes a Caribbean breeze, transporting you to a world of calm. Drying down to the base note of Amberwood, the cologne leaves you with a comforting presence, familiar and warming.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Nectarine Blossom & Honey Eau de Cologne 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YW4WFUS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bursting with fresh fruit, Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom and Honey Cologne embodies the vibrancy of the stalls at Covent Garden’s famous markets. Uplifting like an early morning breeze, the cologne sets you up for a day of playful excitement. Juicy Cassis offers a top note of intense ripeness finished with a crisp edge to refresh and revitalise the senses. Sweetening into a smooth stream of Acacia Honey, the scent becomes luxuriously indulgent, balanced by accents of Blossoms and Beeswax for a deeper, richer scent. With a base of Peach, the fragrance is wrapped in a delicious velvety texture with the essence of succulent flesh turning rosy in the sunlight.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Wild Bluebell Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RQENMA9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Filled with the whimsy of an enchanted forest, Jo Malone London Wild Bluebell Cologne takes you on a magical journey through a blooming sapphire sea. Wild and untamed, Bluebell is an enigmatic floral that beckons from sunlit groves. Nestled amongst leafy green notes, petals become dewy and crisp with an underlying sense of spicy clove emanating from the woodland trail. A sumptuous, silky heart of Persimmon fuses a subtle peachy scent to the clean top notes for a creamier blend that settles into a light White Musk. This powdery base feels like a fresh spring breeze, blowing the flowers into a soft and comforting cloud.

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau de Parfum 120ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RVM8OHP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A citrus aromatic fragrance opening with top notes of bergamot, Sicilian lemon, black currant, and spicy notes, heart notes of water jasmine, fruity notes, and patchouli leaf, and base notes of sandalwood, cedar, leather, moss, white musk, and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Musky Garden Eau de Parfum 120ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GUQAHGH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Musky Garden embraces a beautiful trail of floral and fruity fragrances, indulging a top of cranberries, white peach, and citruses. Bulgarian rose, iris, Indian jasmine, and patchouli create a sweet and refreshing floral heart. Rich white musk, raspberry, blackberry, and amber create the base.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YGYPLXH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Indulge in the luxurious allure of Marc Jacobs’ Perfect Intense Eau de Parfum, a captivating rendition inspired by the designer's personal creed: ‘I am perfect as I am.’ Embark on a sensory journey as the top notes of roasted almonds, pink pepper, and the exclusive Pamplezest™ unfold, evoking an atmosphere of warmth and sophistication. In the heart of this fragrance, Daffodil Absolute and Jasmin Sambac intertwine, creating an exquisite bouquet that transcends the boundaries of tradition. A radiant floral sanctuary emerges, radiating vitality day and night. As the composition deepens, embrace the intoxicating embrace of Sesame Oil, Sandalwood from New Caledonia, and Cashmeran in the base notes. These elements converge to form a harmonious blend, seamlessly merging with the skin and leaving a lasting, sensuous impression.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IOYDX0L]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The burning sensuality of the orange blossom flowers from Morocco, twisted with the aromatic boldness of lavender from France. Lavender, traditionally used in male perfumery is given an ultra sensual facet for a women’s perfume that is both fiery and couture, with that uniquely androgynous YSL attitude.  • Top notes: tangerine, neroli, lavender • Heart notes: jasmine sambac, orange blossom • Base notes: white musks, vanilla extract • Key notes: orange blossom, lavender

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=N98UN6W]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia invites all who encounter it to give in to their heart’s desire with a floral and delicately sweet blend. A signature floral scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau De Parfum 100ml Spray + 20ml Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PQAXQCC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Flowerbomb is one of the best fragrance ranges you can add to your collection. This extensive range has many scents which work well during the day and night. If you have not as yet added a Flowerbomb perfume to your fragrance collection, you should do so. What does Flower Bomb by Viktor & Rolf smell like? This is a classic floral fragrance with rose and jasmine at his heart. Other more delicate notes such as vanilla and peon enhance the scent’s feminine qualities A great perfume to wear during the daytime as it stays fresh. This Flowerbomb fragrance is a great introduction to this exciting perfume brand. We are delighted to offer the fragrance in a 100ml EDP format complete with a 20ml mini fragrance. Buy it for yourself or treat someone special to a fragrance which works well during any time of the year. A truly feminine perfume!

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Miracle Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WQS9O0Y]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A vibrant, sparkling fragrance that opens like the dawning of a new day with fresh, dewy notes of Lychee and Freesia. Its spicy heart echoes with notes of Magnolia, Jasmine, Ginger and Pepper as its warm base notes envelop you in the sensual splendor of Amber and Musk. Top: Lychee & Freesia Heart: Mangolia, Bourbon, Pepper & Ginger Base: Jasmine Absolute, Amber & Musk

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole L'Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T7QBIQB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lancome Perfume offers some of the best perfumes and skincare products in the world. The brand is constantly updating its range, adding new exciting fragrance experiences. Lancome Idole Intense is just such a fragrance experience. Instead of saying it has been created, you can say it was crafted. Today, it is one of the premier women’s fragrances. What does it smell like? The fragrance offers more intense notes when compared to Idole Perfume. At first, its floral nuances may appear slightly delicate. But, before you know it, the intensity of the fragrance increases with wood, mandarin and bitter orange. A touch of vetiver has been added for extra interest. It is a wonderful fragrance which wears well during the day. But it has to be said that it is perhaps more of an evening fragrance. Take the opportunity to snap up this sensual EDP in a 75ml format. Great for nights out or one-to-one intimate dinners.
