The result is green, energising and distinctly modern, clean without ever feeling sharp. Designed by Philippe Mouquet, the bottle's pure lines are finished in green lacquer to echo the fragrance, and the aerodynamic flacon is refillable and made from recycled glass. The name carries meaning too: H for Hermès, Homme and Hours, and 24 for the house's iconic home at 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Un Jardin a Cythere Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=W8S4NJU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Reach for Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère Eau De Toilette to step into another world, one inspired by a surprising garden that is neither green nor floral, but blonde. Part of the house's Jardin collection, it evokes a place of intrigue and sunshine, with luminous graduated yellow glass that echoes the warmth of the scent itself. Enveloping notes of grass meet the strength of olive wood and the tenderness of fresh pistachio in this citrus and woody fragrance. Breathing it in feels like passing through a hidden door into an oasis of tranquillity, sun-warmed, dry and quietly green. Easy to wear day to day, Un Jardin à Cythère is a unisex scent that transports you to a fertile, natural world far from the everyday. A lovely choice for anyone drawn to fresh, woody fragrances with a sunny, Mediterranean feel.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Un Jardin a Cythere Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MUUXY6R]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère Eau De Toilette 200ml invites you into a surprising garden, one that's neither green nor floral but blonde, sun-bleached and full of quiet intrigue. Part of the house's Jardin collection, it's bottled in luminous graduated yellow glass that captures the warmth of the scent inside. The fragrance wraps enveloping notes of grass around the strength of olive wood and the soft tenderness of fresh pistachio, for a composition that's both citrussy and woody. Wearing it feels like slipping through a hidden door into a sun-warmed oasis, dry, green and calming. This unisex scent makes an easy everyday companion, evoking a fertile, natural world wherever you are. In its generous 200ml size there's plenty to keep that sunny, Mediterranean feel going, ideal if Un Jardin à Cythère is already a favourite.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Le Jardin de Monsieur Li Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IHYJHTM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Part of Hermès's Jardin collection, Un Jardin de Monsieur Li takes you exploring through a fresh Chinese garden, a fragrance built around peaceful meditation and a sense of enchanting creativity. Calm, green and gently uplifting, it's a unisex scent designed to feel like a quiet moment to yourself. It's composed around a triad of key notes: the bright citrus of kumquat, the crisp coolness of mint and the soft sweetness of jasmine. Together they create a clean, refreshing fragrance that's light on the skin yet quietly characterful, like a stroll past water and blossom on a still afternoon. Easy to wear whatever the occasion, Un Jardin de Monsieur Li is a lovely everyday choice for anyone who enjoys fresh, green scents with a serene, contemplative feel.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HR7J2UU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Reach for Hermès Un Jardin sur la Lagune Eau De Toilette to discover another world, one inspired by a secret garden and the memories it holds. Part of the house's Jardin collection, it evokes a place of intrigue where fragrant, lush flowers surround a crystal-clear lagoon. Creamy magnolia, delicate pittosporum and fragrant madonna lily come together in a soft, luminous floral bouquet. Breathing it in feels like passing through a hidden door into an oasis of tranquillity, fresh, green and gently sweet. Easy to wear day to day, this unisex fragrance transports you to a fertile, natural world nestled within the magical city of Venice. A lovely choice for anyone who loves soft, watery florals with a real sense of place.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau de Citron Noir Eau de Cologne 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UOFE6HP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created in 2018 by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Eau de Citron Noir is a cologne that finds elegant, surprising freshness in a fruit known and loved by all: the lemon. Part of the Hermès Colognes collection, it's a sophisticated composition built on contrast and paradox. A citrus woody fragrance, it combines the sharpness of lemon with the unexpected depth of a woody black tea and the smoky character of guaiac wood. The result is bright and zesty up top yet warm and shadowy underneath, far more intriguing than a simple citrus cologne. Crisp, smoky and effortlessly modern, Eau de Citron Noir is a unisex scent that wears beautifully across the seasons. A great choice for anyone who loves their citrus with a darker, woodier twist.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau de Rhubarbe Ecarlate Eau de Cologne 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E731AM4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created in 2016 by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Eau de Rhubarbe Écarlate is an unexpected interpretation of the Hermès cologne, revisiting the surprising freshness of a humble herbaceous plant: rhubarb. Part of the Hermès Colognes collection, it's bright, lively and a little unconventional. A fruity citrus fragrance, it captures the crisp, tart freshness of rhubarb alongside tangy lantana, all mingled with elegant musk notes that soften and round out the composition. Fresh and delicate, it's the kind of cologne that feels clean, zesty and effortlessly easy to wear. It comes in Hermès's iconic lantern bottle, here finished in a vivid scarlet hue and presented in the signature orange box with a contrasting band that echoes the colour of the glass. Fitted with a removable pump and made in France, it's a unisex scent designed to be enjoyed beyond genres, ages and seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Tutti Twilly d'Hermes Eau de Parfum 85ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B8290KF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tutti Twilly d'Hermès is a fun, charming fragrance that teases the senses with a playful mix of fruity and floral notes. Light-hearted and youthful, it's a women's scent made to feel like a little burst of joy. A delectable litchi accord opens the fragrance with a tantalising sweetness, before a warm, sensual heart of ginger flowers adds a touch of spice and depth. A soft base of musk then rounds everything off, leaving a comforting, skin-close finish. Sweet, spicy and easy to love, Tutti Twilly d'Hermès is a lovely choice for anyone who enjoys fruity florals with a little character. An effortless everyday pick with a youthful, carefree spirit.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Cherry Poppy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F0ALX3G]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fragrance that smells like joy itself, Flower by Kenzo Cherry Poppy Eau De Parfum is a gourmet, fruity floral scent for women that combines fruity refreshment with delicate floral elegance. Launched in 2025 and created by perfumer Dora Baghriche, it draws inspiration from the Japanese art of confectionery, with all the precision and harmony that suggests. Juicy black cherry kick-starts the composition, its subtly tart sweetness marrying with a delicate touch of fresh strawberry. A floral heart of Damask rose and water lily essence then adds depth and a feminine elegance, before a sensual base of creamy white musk and warming Virginian cedarwood lends a soft, natural character. The fragrance is made with 91% natural ingredients. The presentation is just as joyful. The legendary Kenzo flacon is adorned with a pink and purple poppy, its heart hiding a captivating cherry burst, a fitting symbol for a fragrance built around joy and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Le Rouge Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BVXTUR9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Kenzo Flower by Kenzo Le Rouge Eau De Parfum is a symbol of strength and femininity, born from the deep connection between nature and art. Created for women by master perfumers Alberto Morillas and Marie Salamagne, this sensual, intense fragrance captures the energy and passion of the colour red. The gentlest notes of fresh, soft rice mingle with the intoxicating scent of Damask rose, lending the composition depth and elegance, while seductive musk meets warm amber for an enveloping glow. The finish embraces the skin with sensual sandalwood and sweet, creamy vanilla, a floral-musky blend with a gourmand touch that suits evening events and special occasions especially well. There's substance behind the beauty too. The elegant bottle is made from recycled materials, reflecting Kenzo's commitment to a more sustainable world, and the fragrance was developed in collaboration with Masami Charlotte Lavault, a French-Japanese florist who champions growing flowers ecologically and in harmony with nature.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo L'Eau Pure Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VUWODDW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Kenzo L'Eau Pure Eau De Parfum is a fragrance of purity that plays with every colour, much as water itself can seem both colourless and full of colour. A tribute to the vision of brand founder Kenzo Takada, it's a unisex aquatic scent that combines freshness with depth and tenderness with intensity, harmonious yet full of contrast, like nature itself. At first spray you're met by the sparkling freshness of Italian lemon and mandarin, soon joined by the calm, aromatic lavender of Provence, which plays against the lively citrus. Underpinning it all is the marine molecule Aquozone®, lending an unusually long-lasting sense of purity, while velvety musk and Australian sandalwood add a warm, sensual finish. There's a conscience behind the scent, too. It comes in a reusable bottle made of recyclable glass, and Kenzo supports ocean restoration through a partnership with Coral Gardeners, an organisation dedicated to caring for coral reefs. Choosing L'Eau Pure is a way to enjoy beauty that respects the world around you.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Original Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J8HCQKG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Channelling an air of elegance and power, Lacoste Original Eau De Parfum reinvents the meaning of modern masculinity. It's a men's fragrance powered by an enigmatic fusion of dazzling spices and enlivening fougère accords, confident without ever feeling heavy. Bursting with freshness, zesty bergamot opens the scent with an energising kick, spiked with the fire of pink pepper and cardamom. Its aromatic core then reveals a more sophisticated side, with an earthy duo of French lavender and clary sage, before the intensity of patchouli and the sensuality of sandalwood combine at the base for a finish that stands out. Fresh, spicy and grounded in warm woods, Lacoste Original is a versatile scent that carries easily from day to evening. A great choice for anyone who likes a classic fougère with a contemporary, slightly spicy twist.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Original Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QG9AOXW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Find your new signature in Lacoste Original Parfum, a fougère woody and spicy blend that reworks the brand's original 1984 fragrance with a warmer, smoother profile. Creative, refined and energising, it's a men's scent built for everyday confidence. Bergamot, cardamom and ginger inject sharpness and spice up top, setting a confident tone, before lavender, incense and violet soften that initial hit into a slightly mysterious, powdery-floral core. After the dry-down, amber essence, patchouli and tonka bean swell with lingering warmth and sweetness. The sillage is noticeable without being overpowering, building on Lacoste's sporty, fresh DNA. Versatile and easy to wear, Lacoste Original Parfum carries effortlessly from day to night and season to season. A great choice for anyone who likes a classic fougère given a warmer, more contemporary edge.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Calvin Klein in 1989, Eternity is described as a refreshing, spicy, lavender, amber fragrance. It's fragrant nature explores essences of lavender, jasmine and amber. Blended with notes of rosewood, greens, crisp jasmine, sage, basil, vetiver and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men is the pure essence of masculinity. Potent, powerful, and intensely provocative, this scent is a compelling blend of botanicals, spices, and rare woods. Designed in 1986, Obsession cologne for men is a refreshing, oriental, woody fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Reveal Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Reveal captures the sensational game of seduction. The enchanting possibility of a game between equals. The fragrance is characterised by an unpredictable freshness with a surrounding warmth. A raw salt signature enhances the erotic natural scent of the skin. This melts into a heart of orris, leaving a base of sensual sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>Calvin Klein Euphoria is one of the best fragrances that you will find in today's perfume market. It provides you with the perfect blend of the exotic with slightly seductive notes. You can rely on Euphoria when you want to give a gift of perfume whether to a friend or someone very special.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p>The 100ml bottle looks classy and is perfectly presented in a nice gift box. For its price, the Euphoria perfume from Calvin Klein has so much to offer a buyer. The scent is right for both men and women and never fails to please.</p> <p>When you are looking for a long lasting scent that lingers, this is the right choice for you. At the same time, it has to be said the perfume does not overpower like so many other perfumes within the same price range. Euphoria Calvin Klein is one of the few perfumes that has stood the test of time. It remains popular with all age groups.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p>

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria For Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The Euphoria Men fragrance from Calvin Klein was launched in the year of 2006, this scent is addictive fresh and oriental with an intriguing freshness and modern sensuality. Top notes of ginger pepper cocktail, raindrop accord and chilled sudachi. An aromatic heart of black basil, cedar leaf and hydroponic sage. A sensual drydown of creamy suede, addictive patchouli, brazilian redwood and solid amber.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Truth Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Truth for Men is a scent drawn from nature. This aromatic, sensual, woody fragrance is centered around a clean, watery, green freshness that is accented by aromatic basil and fresh cardamom. Truth cologne by Calvin Klein is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Richer and sweeter than the original Euphoria For Men the Euphoria for Men Intense scent includes notes of ginger pepper, hydroponic sage, oudh wood, vetiver, amber, myrrh and labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Downtown Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Downtown aims at a younger population which prefers sweet fragrances. The perfume is constructed as floral-woody and it was created by perfumer Ann Gottlieb of Givaudan. The composition opens in a foamy and dashy way, with notes of Italian lemon, bergamot, Tunisian neroli, green pear and aquatic plum. The heart incorporates gentle gardenia petals combined with pink pepper and violet leaves on a base of cedar from Texas, incense, vetiver and velvety musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Beauty Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BN55TLN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sophisticated. Confident. Inspiring. Calvin Klein Beauty for Women Eau de Parfum radiates with intense, luminous allure. A modern lily forms the essence of this fragrance, encapsulating ultimate feminine strength. A heart of ambrette seeds adds warmth, getting elevated with timeless jasmine. Cedarwood contributes a vibrant, earthy base to this radiant fragrance. A woman who knows her strength and carries herself with classic femininity. Beauty for Women Eau de Parfum complements and celebrates her sophisticated style. A statement as important as the wardrobe she chooses. Bright and bold, like the shiniest necklace, enhancing but never detracting from her true charm. Designed to accentuate true inner beauty. Top note: Jasmine Heart note: Ambrette Base note: Cedarwood

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Endless Euphoria Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: The composition begins with a light breeze of cherry blossom, refreshed with mandarin and bergamot. Pastel rose and violet form the day-dream inspired heart of the perfume, and it's followed by its gentle and sensual base of bamboo, sandalwood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Now For Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity Now for Men opens with unexpected spicy ginger, refreshing coconut water and star anise. The heart comes to life with addictive notes of crisp starfruit, cedar leaf and the fresh intensity of patchouli. It dries down to a sensual embrace of Moroccan wood, tonka bean and Madagascar vanilla. Eternity Now for Men by Calvin Klein reinterprets the iconic Eternity bottle in a fresh, contemporary way. The warm grey colour of the juice within conveys energy and strength.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Night Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: ETERNITY NIGHT Calvin Klein is a creamy floral inspired by the romantic aura of dusk. the scent opens with enticing top notes of pink pepper, elderberries and a touch of succulent quetsche. the heart is a luminous floral bouquet of frangipani mingled with the warm sweetness of wisteria and creamy nuances of jasmine sambac. the drydown of precious sandalwood, smooth tonka bean and enveloping musks lingers with a soft, sensuous air.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Man Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RBSKXNR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein MAN is a refined yet bold fragrance that captures the spirit of modern masculinity through clean lines, confident notes, and a sleek aesthetic. Designed with minimalist precision, the bottle features a striking black gloss and sharp contours, echoing the brand's signature style. The scent opens with a burst of fresh violet leaf, mandarin orange, rosemary, and bergamot, creating an invigorating introduction. This leads into a heart of aromatic bay leaf, warm nutmeg, cooling mint, and smoky incense—offering a complex blend that’s both fresh and intriguing. As it settles, the fragrance unveils a powerful base of cypress, sandalwood, guaiac wood, musk, and amber. This rich foundation adds depth and elegance, resulting in a timeless woody-spicy composition that embodies confidence, style, and sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK 2 Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A woody aromatic fragrance launched in 2016, it begins with top notes of wasabi, mandarin, and violet leaf; heart notes of pebbles, orris root, and rose absolute; and a woody base of vetiver, sandalwood, and incense.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK IN2U for Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Fresh floral with a woody oriental base, with fresh pink grapefruit and bergamot with a note of red currant leaves.Notes of sugar orchid and white cactus are in the heart.The base notes are: amber, red cedar and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal For Him Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IT25CCU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal is a popular scent from the Gaultier team. As like so many other big brands, Jean Paul Gaultier are gearing up to meet with new environmental-friendly standards. The brand is one of the few brands that are taking refills seriously. If you already have a bottle of Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme in your collection, you should take advantage of this very special offer. This 200ml refill offers you the perfect opportunity to replace your scent. It is perfect to have on standby so that you never run out of your favourite Jean Paul Gaultier fragrance. As you probably know, Scandal is one of the most popular and exciting eau de toilette offerings from Jean Paul Gaultier. Don't miss out on this chance to stock up to make sure that you never run out. Needless to say, you will also be doing your bit to help the environment.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YG5UJUA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal is one of those scents you are not going to be able to live without once you have tried it. The scent was launched in 2021 and instantly became a hit. It will make you feel like a champion in no time at all. It is not only the fragrance which is different. The bottle is one of those scent bottles that you are not going to forget in a hurry. As with all other offerings from this exciting brand, the fragrance is what makes Scandal stand out. It is very aromatic with a sweet note of caramel and undertones of vanilla. As the scent develops, you can also enjoy notes of amber and citrus. Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme is a perfect choice no matter what age you are. It is an eau de toilette that never fails to please and always hits the right spot. Take the opportunity to try this 50ml bottle of this wonderful masculine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal For Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JU51I4O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The new SCANDAL POUR HOMME by Jean Paul Gaultier. With muscled elegance and boxing gloves on, the new SCANDAL POUR HOMME by Jean Paul Gaultier makes a spectacular, hard-hitting entrance with a masculine eau de toilette that's sensual, energising and extremely addictive. Intoxicating the senses and crowned with victories, this king of the ring seduces his fans with a bang, leaving a masculine trail contrasted by an intense woody oriental fragrance in a refillable bottle. Keep your guard up: his eco-friendly and athletic charisma knocks out all his opponents. Paris trembles before him and asks for more: let the show begin! Set Includes: 100ml EDT + 75ml Shower Gel

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BX6R6VL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} BAD BOY is a fragrant expression of duality, representing the bold nature of the modern man. At once strong and sensitive, confident and relaxed, the BAD BOY embraces his contrasting characteristics with assured ease. BAD BOY Eau de Toilette is a fragrance of layered notes inspired by the BAD BOY’s complexity and harmoniously combined for a distinctive blend of modern sophistication This gift set includes the fragrance in its 100ml bottle, as well as a 10ml travel spray and 100ml Shower Gel.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower L'Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OX3154E]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Welcoming the bewitching power of the poppy, Fragrance Direct introduces Kenzo L'Elixir. A precious flower, with invaluable vitality. Its bloom conceals a vibrant sensuality, revealing the essence of women, their most captivating facet. FLOWERBYKENZO L'Elixir celebrates this femininity with a gourmand floral fragrance. The juicy Raspberry note and Bulgarian rose essence compose a deliciously chic alchemy, while the Bourbon Vanilla and Praline distil a sensual addiction. Fruity gourmand lead to luscious Raspberry and Mandarin opening notes. The heart is a precious floral blend of Bulgarian rose essence and Orange blossom, before coming to a close with an addictive sensual base of praline,

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold For Men Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PA3GE2B],#html-body [data-pb-style=SHDEAHK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}#html-body [data-pb-style=SHDEAHK]{background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat} The One Gold fragrance celebrates a man who has a natural but unmistakable magnetism. A true gentleman, he exudes confidence with his innate elegance and unique style. The One Gold is the olfactory embodiment of this masculine charisma, a sophisticated woody, spicy, citrus Eau de Parfum Intense that is as powerfully alluring as the man who wears it. An invigorating fusion of juicy Italian bergamot and zesty bloody orange opens the fragrance, with red ginger adding a warm spiciness to the citrus top notes. The vibrant energy of these sparkling citruses evolves to a powerfully masculine heart of aromatic clary sage and crisp Egyptian geranium essence, enlivened by spicy notes of cardamom. Mysterious patchouli gives the perfume an intensely alluring base, its richness and subtle smokiness balanced by earthy Haitian vetiver and woody ambery notes.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GV0SN4S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce & Gabbana presents The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense, the intense addition to the iconic The One Men fragrance family. The epitome of masculinity and elegance, the fragrance is charismatic and seductive, magnetic and sophisticated. This floriental fragrance features spicy notes of golden neroli essence and woody notes of cypress and aromatic cardamom. These are unexpectedly associated to rich base notes made from deep black leather, sweet patchouli and Mediterranean scents of cistus labdanum. The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense is encased in an elegant black bottle with gold touches to express its distinctive olfactory facets.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GA1R6K9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce&Gabbana presents The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense, the intense addition to the iconic The One Men fragrance family. The epitome of masculinity and elegance, the fragrance is charismatic and seductive, magnetic and sophisticated. This floriental fragrance features spicy notes of golden neroli essence and woody notes of cypress and aromatic cardamom. These are unexpectedly associated to rich base notes made from deep black leather, sweet patchouli and Mediterranean scents of cistus labdanum. The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense is encased in an elegant black bottle with gold touches to express its distinctive olfactory facets.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau D'Orange Verte Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=M23575M]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The original Hermès fragrance, Eau d’orange verte was originally created in 1979. Inspired by the intense freshness of lush undergrowth coated in morning dew, Eau d’orange verte provides a stand-out sunny fragrance that is well suited to man and woman alike. This unisex fragrance opens with an intense citrus blast of lemon and bergamot which invigorates the mind and body before softer floral notes of jasmine and orange blossom form the delicate, neutral body.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Tres Fraiche Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray

Terre d’Hermès contains many woody notes, including Atlas cedar. It is also a mix of grapefruit, effervescent orange, gunflint, silex, pepper, baies roses, geranium leaves, patchouli, vetiver, and balm of benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QKJXDVX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold Eau de Parfum for women will become your new addiction you simply won’t be willing to give up. It’s magic spell will enchant you from the first sniff and every new day will be a proof that you simply need to keep it on your vanity at all times.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Florabotanica Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QASA7HW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inspired by a strange and wonderful garden in which you do not know whether the flowers are innocent or poisonous, Florabotanica from Balenciaga evokes the 18th Century botanical gardens in which the most exotic and rarest plant species were displayed. Strange-coloured plants discovered in distant countries brought back from their travels by enthusiastic biologists. The vetiver, amber and caladium leaf accord create a resonance of mossy and mysterious dark wood, whilst the Experimental rose, carnation and mint accords add an exhilarating, freshness to the fragrance. To give Florabotanica its fairytale air, the perfumers added a formula of psychosensory plants, making it particularly enchanting.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Ultrared Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PG8184J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ultrared for woman by Paco Rabanne is an electrifying fragrance that dares to play with the contrast between the sparkling and ardent. A fruity burst of redcurrant and wild strawberries mixed with a festive floral heart of jasmine, star anis and marshmallow. The base of addictive cedar, amber and vanilla balances the sparkling fruity notes and gives a harmonic feel to this gorgeous fragrance.

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A1PHC26]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ultra red is an ultra masculine fragrance bursting with energy, sensuality & passion. listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DKQUNIJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum for women, a fruity, joyful and irresistibly fresh floral fragrance by Dolce&Gabbana. First, be charmed by the colourful top notes of luscious mango contrasting with the zesty tartness of natural grapefruit essence. Then the heart of the scent blooms with a glorious swirl of airy jasmine accord mixed with a supple accord of sun-drenched blonde woods, which shine through this sunny fruity floral perfume. Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum will transport you to springtime on the Italian Amalfi Coast, when the first rays of sunlight trickle into the gardens at the beginning of the blooming season. This Mediterranean perfume is a new addition to the "Dolce" collection and comes in a delicate sunny yellow bottle with its Dolce&Gabbana signature handwritten name and the iconic bottle cap.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Bad Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FJH3WKF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lose yourself in the lavish aromas within the Diesel Bad Eau de Toilette. Seductive and alluring, the cologne opens with notes of tantalising Lime, Lavender and fiery Cardamom. Heady and captivating, the top notes mingle deliciously with a heart of opulent Caviar, offering an element of luxury to the cocktail. Brooding, smouldering visions are conjured with base notes of intoxicating Tobacco, Orris Root and hypnotic Woody Notes. Images of a dimly-lit bar are summoned, the hairs raising on the back of your neck as a tall, leather-clad figure approaches. Bad to the bone, the bottle is encased in a leather-look coating, making a rebellious statement wherever it is placed.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Summer (2021) Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

An uplifting and refreshing heart of anise star notes over a soft base of musk, and is topped with feminine desert rose oil—true to the natural scent of a desert rose. The balanced contrast between the floral and fluid notes is comparable to the blurred lines between water and sky, a perfect entity. Housed in a luminous coral bottle, the solar floral perfume scent exudes exotic allure. Luxuriantly feminine, the balanced fragrance is the quintessential fresh summer iteration of iconic ETERNITY.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Pin Up Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XDKTNIE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Classique was released in 2020 and immediately gained women's love for its unique and majestic scent. With a deep gourmand and amber base, followed by floral center notes that blend majestically with pimento, this eau de parfum is perfect for bold, independent, and gracious women. Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Pin Up is designed with glitter inspiration in the most fashionable way. 100ml of this emblematic aroma is enough to give women a sense of power and sweetness at the same time. If you are a strong, classy, and funny woman, always ready to respond with spontaneity, not afraid of herself, and with a warm smile that will melt every man's heart out there, then Pin Up is the perfect aroma! Amber like a candy, sweet like a rose and soft like a gourmand, it awaits you to sample and see how well it blends with your character.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male In The Navy Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=S6NK3P7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male is one of those men's fragrances that you just have to have. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Gold Edition Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y11MNPB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The unisex Calvin Klein CK One Gold Eau de Toilette presents a youthful woody scent that combines the strength of both genders. listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss In Motion Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

The first notes are packed with the rich aroma of warm spice and woody top notes. Take the time and let the scent develop and you will soon encounter citrus and cinnamon. A deep dark musky note will also drift buy. Thanks to its many nuances, the fragrance is perfect for any time of the day or night. The 100ml eau de toilette bottle is stylish and never looks out of place. It has to be said that the fragrance makes a fantastic personal purchase as well as a gift idea.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Man Extreme Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F5N1JKY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Aftershave is a brand that knows a lot about men's fragrances. listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=S4JS5X5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} 212 VIP ROSÉ by Carolina Herrera is an “Eau de Parum” for women belonging to the Floral Fruity family. This new fragrance continues the iconic 212 saga, this time bringing infinite glamor, tinged with pink, keeping the festive and exclusive atmosphere of its predecessor alive.  This fragrance was created in 2014 by the perfumer Lucas Sieuzac. This edition has nothing to do with its predecessor, 212 VIP, as it inspires sophistication and more formality, but still keeps the festive and highly exclusive spirit alive. With 212 VIP Rosé, the party continues, but more relaxed we stay in the most exclusive club in New York, but the dances end to prioritize a good conversation.  Its olfactory pyramid begins with an impressive output of champagne and red berries, is there something more exclusive and elegant than that? The answer is no. Subsequently, its heart adopts a very feminine and sophisticated tone, counting on the presence of the peach blossom, a sweet, soft and formal style aroma. In its final residue, we can appreciate an enveloping warmth, creating an atmosphere of sensuality and suggestion, this one featuring amber, white musk and woody notes.  ROSÉ. Many people associate its name with the flower, but no, this fragrance does not smell like roses. This word refers to pink champagne, its first sparkling, sparkling and glamorous top note. An exquisite drink, only suitable for VIP people.

A tribute to the modern woman and her sensual femininity, the GUERLAIN Mon Guerlain gift set pairs the long-lasting Eau de Parfum with a fragranced body lotion so you can envelop. Set Contents: Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum 50ml & 5ml Mon Guerlain Body Lotion 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'interdit Absolu Eau de Parfum Intense 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AOUMFQG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} L'Interdit Absolu reveals a new floral woody ambery composition, a chase between iconic scents and unconventional notes. For the most immediate thrill, a fresh aromatic facet of lavender galvanizing all the senses is paired with a magnetic cardamom essence and unique quality of Neroli Essential. These new radical and modernised top notes blur into the iconic L'Interdit white bouquet made of orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine sambac absolutes. Like all Givenchy fragrances, L'Interdit Absolu reveals a contrasted facet: the florality leaves room for woody notes of vetiver and patchouli, bringing depth and elegance to the fragrance. Addiction reaches its climax with the new mysterious trail of tobacco and cistus absolutes; a long-lasting experience which will leave you forever transformed.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Pure Parfum 75ml Spray 3 Pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KLH9QBS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Composed of interlacing riding accessories inspired by the equestrian world, the Fantaisie d'Etriers design, by illustrator Virginie Jamin, brings its radiance to this festive gift set. Influenced by joyful creativity, its curves, braids and twists will be the signature of your holiday celebrations. A warm, woody fragrance, Terre d’Hermes Parfum combines enveloping cedar and sparkling grapefruit with a radiant note of shiso. Terre d’Hermes narrates the relationship between man and earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with the elements and nature. Terre d’Hermes is the perfume that connects man to his origins, to the source of his creative power. GIFT SET CONTENTS - Parfum Spray (75ml) - Parfum Miniature (12.5ml) - After Shave Lotion (40ml)

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray + 80ml S/G Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U4HSYCY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fantastic fragrance created in 2006, Terre D'Hermes is for the man who is a poet by nature, someone who sees the extraordinary in the ordinary. Terre D'Hermès contains a large amount of woody notes, including Atlas cedar. It's also a mix of grapefruit, effervescent orange, gunflint, silex, pepper, baies roses, geranium leaves, patchouli, vetiver and balm of benzoin.   This set contains Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray, 80ml Shower Gel.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Pleasures for Her Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PWYHFAC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} An inspiring arrangement of fresh and floral pleasures, reflecting the beauty of an exotic garden fresh after the Spring rain. A symphony of green notes highlighted by white lily and violet leaves promises a joyous top. Within the heart black lilac, white peony, kar-karounde blossoms, Baie rose, pink rose and jasmine combine into a sensually powerful floral accord. Finishing in sandalwood and patchouli the final thoughts of Pleasures lies in a comforting, eastern rapport.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau Fraiche Superman Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NR20SX7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Superman here: planet Gaultier localised. Extra-olfactory capacity: activated. Perfume identification: A sexy fabric softener. Ready to identify ingredients! Fresh departure with mint and Neroli: check. Union of sage and Tonka bean: check. Sensual notes of sandalwood and vanilla: check. A fragrance built on a fabric softener accord, clean and fresh like an impeccable tank top that you slip into. Neroli flower and mint give depth to the base. Sage unites with tonka bean, sandalwood and vanilla - the sensual base notes - because a tank top is always sexy.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome O de Lancome Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VTTKHOL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Fresh, bright and naturally spontaneous, the Lancome O de Lancome Eau de Toilette is a delightful citrus fragrance for cheerful women. The invigorating scent sparkles with life, full of joyful optimism and elegance. It’s a naturally beautiful fragrance, the essence of lightness and exhilaration, like a first kiss or the first days of summer. O de Lancome opens with a refreshing cocktail of lemon, mandarin and bergamot. In the heart, an aromatic and herbal accord of basil, rosemary and coriander brings energy, before a deeply woody drydown warms like the last rays of summer sun. Top Notes: Lemon, Mandarin, Bergamot Heart Notes: Basil, Rosemary, Coriander Base Notes: Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Vetiver

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Two Wood Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ON0OLYM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} At the top, the irresistible sparkling freshness of citron and lemon primofiore enhances the vibrant notes of pink pepper before giving way to a modern and charismatic woody heart of vetiver, responsibly sourced in Haiti, Virginian and Alaskan cedarwood, with their fresh and aromatic tones, and the resinous accents of silver fir. The dry down to this Woody-Citrus fragrance features addictive vegetal amber, with its unmistakable deep and mysterious character, alongside musk and vulcanolide, an exclusive captive molecule with a mineral aspect and an incredible persistence.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray + 50ml B/l + Bag Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KMC3X63]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Kenzo Flower is a soft floral scent with hints of violet, vanilla, and rose, a powdery-floral fragrance with contemporary poetic power. Uniquely packaged in a poppy-embossed bottle this fragrance is for the modern, city woman who looks to nature for inspiration and renewal. Flower by Kenzo includes notes of Wild Hawthorn, Bulgarian Rose, Parma Violet, Cassia, Hedione, Cyclosal, Opoponax, White Musk and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Poudree Eau de Parfum 90ml + Mini Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EM8FP3U]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Narciso Eau de Parfum Poudrée by Narciso Rodriguez is a captivating blend of elegance and sensuality. This fragrance explores the delicate balance between softness and strength, drawing out an inner confidence that feels effortlessly alluring. Inspired by the mystery of feminine allure, it offers a luxurious scent that lingers with subtle power. The fragrance opens with luminous white jasmine petals and rich Bulgarian rose, setting a floral tone that’s both fresh and refined. At its heart lies the signature powdery musc—distinctive and smooth—creating a velvety texture that defines the fragrance. This musc core is what sets Narciso Rodriguez’s scents apart, offering an unmistakable warmth and depth. Grounded by an earthy base of white and black cedarwoods with a hint of vetiver, the scent settles into a woody, musky finish that adds lasting intensity. Poudrée is a statement of softness with strength—an intimate and sophisticated fragrance that becomes one with the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Sparkling Ice Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WE8S6D2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dressing in glittering ice-white and topped with a twinkling snowflake, Good Girl Sparkling Ice evokes the enchanting essence of a snow-covered winter landscape. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Almond Heart notes: Tuberose & Jasmine Sambac Base notes: Tonka Bean & Cocoa

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OI37MXG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} An electrifying take on the duality of modern masculinity that defines Carolina Herrera’s Bad Boy fragrance, the Cobalt Eau de Parfum fuses mineral sensuality with an energising freshness. Daring and sophisticated, the scent expresses the bold nature of the modern man, reinvented as his most elegant and confident self. Fresh, aromatic top notes of pink pepper and lavender are amplified by a floral, yet masculine, heart of geranium. At the base, mineral accents of truffle accord are infused with smoky oakwood, vetiver and enticing cedarwood to complete this aromatic woody fragrance. Housed in a striking lightning bolt bottle, the fragrance draws inspiration from cobalt and its pigmented hue.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C0X19HR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A captivating floral gourmand scent, twisted with dark, roasted notes of black coffee, for vigour and vitality. Energy and sensuality married with the unique YSL edge. The signature black coffee accord is paired with sensual vanilla, enriched by the softness of white flowers and orange blossom, set against a base of patchouli and comforting white musk. A daring contrast of light and dark, for a women’s fragrance that bewitches with its trail. Crafted by Marie Salamagne, Nathalie Lorson, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc. - Top notes: pear accord, mandarin essence - Heart notes: vanilla, orange blossom, white flowers - Base notes: black coffee accord, cedarwood essence, white musk, patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Extreme Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PYGYNQP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Eau de Parfum Extreme takes Black Opium’s original captivating floral gourmand scent to a new level - no holds barred. Uncompromising energy and boundless sensuality married with the unique YSL edge. Extra black coffee, for vigour and vitality, is paired with luminous ultra-white flowers, set against a base of sweet, earthy patchouli and heady vanilla.  This exhilarating amalgamation of ingredients makes for an intense and long-lasting women’s scent that challenges gender stereotypes in fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OXMOFQG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} La Vie est Belle is Lancôme’s best selling feminine fragrance that captures the luminosity of Magnolia Essence. A unique olfactory signature perfume scent created by three of France's leading perfumers. Iris is the key ingredient of this floral Eau de Parfum, surrounded by orange blossoms and jasmine in the heart. Top notes: Pear, Blackberry Heart notes: Pallida Iris concrete, Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac absolutes Base notes: Heart of Patchouli essence

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CHIUCDK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fiery take on the orange blossom and lavender Libre signature, this new flamboyant fragrance makes an olfactive statement with its unapologetically spicy notes. listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One 2 Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Beautiful Magnolia Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FE3UENY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Estee Lauder’s passionate fragrance starts with a honeyed, juicy splash of mandarin oil, green violet leaf and a warm, spicy and aromatic dash of cardamom oil. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Musc Noir Eau De Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FFSF1UV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Musc Noir eau de parfum, the signature heart of musc is enveloped in mystery and sensuality. Top notes of juicy plum followed by heliotrope, an addictive flower with an intoxicating scent, bring brightness to the fragrance. Next, the captivating heart of musc builds texture with a dark and sensual leather suede accord. This enigmatic fragrance pays homage to the duality of all women, where shadows and light search for each other in a blend of mystery and extreme sensuality. for her Musc Noir reveals the femininity of each woman and pays tribute to her inner beauty, revealing it for all who wear the perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Al Haramain Amber Oud Blue Edition Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C2UKV10]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Al haramain amber oud bleu edition cologne has an energetic, uplifting open that gradually transitions to spicy wood and earth tones.
