listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum 125ml Refillable Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EYKLEAM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Armani Code is one of the world’s premier men’s fragrances. When it was first launched in 2004, this masculine scent from Giorgio Armani Perfume quickly became a best seller. Today, it remains a popular men’s fragrance. Rightly so, it belongs in your bathroom cabinet. It is a great go-to perfume. What does Parfum smell like? Although fresh, Armani Code by Giorgio Armani is also masculine and confident. Bergamot and the delicate notes of olive blossom make the scent stand out. Lemon adds freshness and there is a final flourish of wood and leather. Soft notes of tonka bean hold the fragrance together. A truly masculine Armani perfume which inspires confidence. We are offering this cologne in a 125ml bottle. The fragrance is perfect for daytime wear and works well in the evening as well. It makes a wonderful gift for any man or a welcome addition when you are refreshing your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Black Musk Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CJJ27C2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Montale Perfume was founded in France in 2003. The brand’s founder, Pierre Montale spent time living in Saudi Arabia. This is clearly reflected in his range of top-quality fragrances. They offer something exotic which you may not find in other men’s fragrances. Black Musk Perfume is one of the premier offerings from the brand. What does it smell like? You immediately pick up there is something very different about this fragrance. Like a good wine, it is full-bodied and indulgent. The velvety scent of Arabic roses blends with leather with a touch of oud added for extra depth. When should I wear the scent? As it is a very seductive and sensual fragrance, the best time to wear it is in the evening. We are delighted to offer this special fragrance in a 100ml EDP format. If you have not as yet added a cologne from the brand to your bathroom shelf, it is about you to do so. A great personal purchase or gift for the man in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes H24 Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BTS7DOG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} H24 Eau de Toilette is the first olfactory expression of contemporary man according to Hermès. Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, it is a bright and radiant fragrance stemming from the daring blend of nature and technology. Fresh, aromatic and botanical, H24 Eau de Toilette combines the softness of clary sage with the energy of narcissus and invigorating rosewood and the warmth of metallic sclarene. Created by designer Philippe Mouquet, the bottle expresses the energy of contemporary man. Its grey box is illuminated by a fine lime-green line that delimits and opens up the space.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L3G0MSY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Step into a world of radiant freedom with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum. This captivating fragrance for women is infused with the richness of Grandiflorum Jasmine, offering a luxurious floral experience. The scent radiates positivity and charm, housed in a striking elongated turquoise bottle that echoes the uplifting energy within. Part of the enchanting Flora Fantasy collection, this perfume brings a vibrant spirit to life. The design is completed with Gucci’s iconic Flora pattern, adding a magical and elegant touch. Its playful yet sophisticated character makes it an ideal choice for those who love expressing their individuality through scent. Opening with fresh Mandarine essence, the fragrance reveals a heart of Grandiflorum Jasmine and Magnolia accord, finishing with warm, comforting notes of Sandalwood. Perfect for those who seek lasting elegance and a floral scent that stays with you all day, this Eau de Parfum is a celebration of joy, beauty, and self-expression.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Rose Passion Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SAPJTB6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jimmy Choo Perfume offers you the opportunity to own a sophisticated perfume from what is quickly becoming a classic perfume brand. Just like the shoes and handbags from the same company, the perfumes take fragrance to another level. Many ladies have started to buy perfumes from this true luxury brand. Jimmy Choo Rose Passion was launched in 2023. The nose behind the scent is Nathalie Lorson. She has managed to capture the essence of the rich scents of the South of France on a summer’s day. You can exotic blooms highlighted by frangipani before it is softened by coconut water and vanilla. The addition of sandalwood takes this fragrance to another level. Hints of jasmine and orchids make welcome appearances. Let us introduce you to this fragrance with this EDP in a 100ml format. Once you have smelled this fragrance, you will never forget it. It is simply wonderful!

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum Intense 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=U8IKPMR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Perfume has always produced some of the best and most exciting perfumes in the world. If you are looking for a new scent, there is absolutely no reason why you should not turn to this Italian brand. In recent years, it has launched many vibrant perfumes perfect for the modern woman. One of the most popular scents from the brand is Women's Gucci Guilty. What does Women Gucci Guilty smell like? The fragrance was launched in 2021. The notes are vibrant consisting of a range of sensual notes including pink pepper. This is quickly followed by peach, lilac and jasmine with hints of raspberry. Other tones inclined geranium and black currant. White musk, Madagascar vanilla and patchouli make this fragrance long-lasting. It is an EDP which combines the best of both fresh and deep notes. If you have not tried the fragrance yet, don’t feel guilty. We are delighted to offer this scent in a 90ml format for you to enjoy.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FJXEHF4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora offers a fantastic range of fragrances for the modern woman. This is a brand that always goes the extra mile to dare to be different. When you are looking for a fragrance which works well in almost any setting, this scent with its feminine notes is the perfect choice.What does Jasmine smell like? It goes without saying you pick up on jasmine in this fragrance. Other notes include cheeky pink pepper and refreshing mandarin orange. But Gucci Flora Gucci does not stop there. Other exciting notes include peach, lilac and raspberry. A touch of geranium and black currant adds interest. Finishing flourishes come from amber, white musk and patchouli. The last note of vanilla is an interesting addition. Gucci Fragrance Flora is a must-have fragrance. It is feminine and makes a wonderful fragrance for any woman of any age. We are delighted to offer this beautiful Mediterranean fragrance in a 100ml format.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HFYEK9A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The best things happen after dark, and Spicebomb makes those after-hour affairs just that extra bit more enthralling. A mysterious, daring and provocative rendition of the original fragrance, Spicebomb Night Vision is an invitation to entice and captivate and is made for the man that is just as much sophisticated as he is seductive. An explosion of contrasts, Spicebomb opens with an electric blend of green mandarin, cardamom and apple enhanced by a powerful fusion of bergamot, grapefruit and a black spices complex. In the heart, a fresh flurry of clary sage, geranium, rosemary and lavendin creates an intriguing sensuality, before giving way to a base of vibrant woodsy notes set alight by accords of roasted almond and musk. Top Notes: Bergamot, Green Mandarin, Grapefruit, Apple Accord, Green Cardamom, Black Spices Complex Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Geranium, Rosemary, Lavandin Base Notes: Roasted Almond, Tonka Bean Absolute, Patchouli, Cedarwood, Vibrant Woods, Musks.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia 100ml Eau de Parfum Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YFT8DVI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora has managed to capture the delicate scent of Gardenia. If you already have other fragrances from the Gucci Perfume collection, you should add this scent. It is a beautiful scent which works well during the daytime or for a dinner date. It is feminine but still slightly daring. What does Gardenia smell like? Gucci Flora is clearly proud of its Italian heritage. In this women’s fragrance, pear blossom mingles with red berries and Italian mandarines. Once the scent opens up, you also pick up on more delicate notes of gardenia, frangipani and jasmine. The final notes offer hints of patchouli and brown sugar. Gucci Flora is without a shadow of a doubt one of the premier perfume collections for the modern woman. The fragrance deserves a place on every dressing table. Buy it for yourself or treat someone special to this wonderful, exciting fragrance from Gucci.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EYD0T3L]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Escape the everyday along the windswept shore. Waves breaking white, the air fresh with sea salt and spray. Alive with the mineral scent of the rugged cliffs. Mingling with the woody earthiness of sage. Lively, spirited and totally joyful. Top Note: Ambrette Seeds Heart Note: Sea Salt Base Note: Sage

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NDCYV34]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph Lauren Perfume is a range of fragrances which you simply can’t go wrong with when you need a new men’s fragrance. The entire collection has so much to offer for both young and senior men. Many argue that Ralph Lauren Polo is the best range of colognes for the modern man. Of course, many of its offerings have become classics. Let’s take a look at what Polo Red has to offer. The fragrance is citrusy and fresh thanks to red grapefruit. At the same time, it opens up with slightly spicy notes thanks to red cranberry and ginger. Sage continues the fresh accord before classic men’s nuances including guaiac and cedar wood are released. Make no doubt about it, this is a very sensual scent and deeply seductive. Perfume Price is offering this rather recent addition to the range as an eau de toilette in a 200ml format. The cologne makes a fantastic gift for the special man in your life. Alternatively, don’t miss out on this opportunity to add it to your basket as a personal treat.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T4876W5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia invites all who encounter it to give in to their heart’s desire with a floral and delicately sweet blend. A signature floral scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its scent trail. SET CONTENTS: - 100ml Eau de Parfum Spray - 10ml Eau de Parfum Spray

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum 125ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TLPV988]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Strong yet sensitive, Armani Code Parfum reinvents the olfactory signature of the original Armani Code fragrance.  Retaining its woody aromatic, sensual identity, Armani Code Parfum captures the Armani Code quintessence. This is expressed in the fragrance’s aromatic top notes and powerfully masculine base notes, with the heart now infused with an amplified sensitivity.  Crafted with high attention to details, the institutional Armani gift box is dressed with a festive sleeve premium quality tailored with Japanese inspired paper and decorated with gold hot stamping. With a vision of mindful luxury, the sets are entirely free of plastics and designed-to-last.  Gift Set is composed of Armani  Code Le Parfum 125 ml + Shower Gel 75 ml + Mini 15 ml

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray + 2 Products Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NOHOWXY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} During the day, it’s a delicious fresh honey with the wonderful scent of gardenia and blood orange. At night, it is a sensual and scandalous honey combined with patchouli: an addiction that is just so Jean Paul Gaultier. The elegant aura that it leaves in her wake is sullied by the Pigalle spirit beloved by Jean Paul Gaultier. Even Madam Minister is tempted by this scent of Scandal. It's more than a breath of fresh air - it's a breath of freedom. At night, everyone is allowed to be a party animal, make a scene and be scandalous! Delicious fresh honey with the wonderful scent of gardenia and blood orange. Top notes: Gardenia, Blood Orange. Middle notes: Honey. Base notes: Patchouli. Gift set contains: EDP 80ml, Body Lotion 75ml, Travel Spray 6ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Twilly d'Hermes Eau de Parfum 85ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WJ87VLJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A floral and spicy Eau de Parfum that expresses its impertinence with fresh ginger, light tuberose and milky sandalwood. "It is with young women in mind, by observing their lives, that I created Twilly d’Hermès. Free, bold, connected, mischievous and irreverent, they turn expectation on its head, swim against the tide, impose their own rhythm, invent a brand new tempo." Christine Nagel. It is in this spirit that Christine Nagel composed Twilly d'Hermès. Ginger, tuberose and sandalwood are given a new twist. Combined differently, they become searing spice, disconcerting attraction, a revelation of the carnal. In a final flash of wit, a hand-tied silk ribbon playfully graces the bottle. Each silk ribbon is unique. Set contains: Twilly d’Hermès Eau de Parfum, 85ml Twilly d’Hermès Eau de Parfum, Mini, 7.5ml Twilly d’Hermès Moisturising Body Lotion, 80ml

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir For Him Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NA1B7HD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Amber notes meet addictive woods to enhance a sensual heart of musc. An infusion of dark blue captures the interior of the bottle for more mystery. The deep-black bow is marked by a black frame. Top Notes: Bergamot, Black Pepper Heart Notes: Heart of Musc Base Notes- Blue Cedar, Black Ebony, Amber Vetiver Set includes: 100ml EDP +10ml EDP +50ml Gel

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 NYC Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NQ6AK0J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A cool and sexy fragrance for women, Carolina Herrera 212 EDT is modern and attractive, reflecting the feel and scent of New York City. A delightful blend of Bergamot, Cactus Flower, Orange Blossom and Mandarin Orange top notes, heart notes which include Iris, White Camelia, Freesia, Rose and Jasmine and base notes of Sandalwood and Musk, Carolina Herrera 212 is optimistic and feminine - EDT 100ml - Body Lotion 100ml - Travel EDT

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FIRHWLX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the sizzling and seductive voyage with Le Male Elixir - the latest addition to Jean Paul Gaultier's crew. The intense parfum for men exudes sex-appeal that is hard to resist, and the striated gold of his bulging muscles adds to the allure. As the sun sets, the copper hue of his skin creates a magnetic pull that you can't ignore. The sailor top, with its translucent brown, evokes a sensual amber wake that is both enticing and mesmerizing. As you inhale the zesty mint, the fragrance ignites your senses and raises your addiction to a whole new level. The dashing lavender quickly takes on a carnal breadth, enhanced by the fragrant richness of benzoin with syrupy and vanilla notes. The tonka bean adds a layer of hot, mellow inflections, reminiscent of honey and tobacco, making you succumb to its spell. With Le Male Elixir, you'll find yourself completely immersed in a world of burning sensuality and torrid elixir, it's a fragrance that you won't be able to resist.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Ltd Edition
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A6YKM5A]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Classique has been one of the most recognisable fragrances on the shelf since 1993, and this limited edition gives the famous corset bottle a fresh look while keeping the scent exactly as fans know it. It opens bright and a little spicy, with star anise, mandarin and orange blossom. Once it settles, the heart turns soft and floral with rose, iris and orchid, plus a hint of ginger and plum that keeps it interesting. The base is where Classique really shows its character: warm vanilla, amber and sandalwood with a clean musk that lingers on skin and clothes. The result is feminine, sensual and slightly powdery, with enough warmth to wear in the evening but soft enough for everyday use. It works well in cooler months and suits anyone who likes a fragrance with a bit of confidence to it. Limited edition bottles are made in small runs and are not restocked once they sell out, so this is a good one to pick up for a collection or as a gift. Key notes Top: star anise, mandarin, orange blossom Heart: rose, iris, orchid, ginger, plum Base: vanilla, amber, sandalwood, musk

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray + 12.5ml Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E4L6GCS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} L'Interdit by Givenchy is a sophisticated and intriguing fragrance that beautifully balances darkness and light, creating a scent that is both elegant and edgy. It opens with a burst of bright and fresh orange blossom, which quickly intertwines with lush jasmine and creamy tuberose, giving the fragrance a rich, floral heart. As it settles, the scent reveals its deeper, darker base notes of vetiver and patchouli, lending a smoky, earthy undertone that grounds the fragrance and adds a touch of mystery. The overall effect is a harmonious blend of sweet florals and woody depth, creating a luxurious and captivating fragrance that's perfect for those who enjoy a bold yet feminine perfume. L'Interdit's name, meaning "forbidden," hints at its allure and daring character, inviting you to embrace the thrill of the forbidden and step into the unexpected. It's a fragrance that invites you to break boundaries and express your unique style with confidence. Set Includes: 80ml Spray + 12.5ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Modern Muse Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y0E2LVB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} An innovation of duality crossing a shimmering jasmine accord with a trail of stylish woods. Modern Muse inspires a sensual movement into creative energies, a charismatic femininity and a reserved yet potent confidence. Juicy and exotic mandarin opens the fragrance, inviting a heart of jasmine, honeysuckle nectar, dewy petals, tuberose and lily. A final accord adds sophisticated amber wood, patchouli, Madagascar vanilla and soft musks.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Musc Noir Eau De Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MHQ07C2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inspired by the original for her fragrance, MUSC NOIR reinterprets its core, building on the iconic fragrance’s darkest and most intense facets. Top notes of juicy plum followed by heliotrope, an addictive flower with an intoxicating scent, bring brightness to the fragrance. Next, the captivating heart of musc builds texture with a dark and sensual leather suede accord. This enigmatic fragrance pays homage to the duality of all women, where shadows and light search for each other in a blend of mystery and extreme sensuality. for her MUSC NOIR reveals the femininity of each woman and pays tribute to her inner beauty, revealing it for all who wear the perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Spirit of the Brave Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A0T9IF1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Diesel's masculine fragrance Spirit Of The Brave from 2019 has been intensified with the new edition Spirit Of The Brave Intense. The Spirit Of The Brave line is made in collaboration with popular football star Neymar Jr. Spirit Of The Brave Intense retains the signature of the original, and adds fruity and oriental tones to it. Cypress accord remains the center of the composition, this time enriched by the freshness of apple and the sensuality of vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LDAYT9N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} At first, the fresh, bright tones of mandarin oil grace your senses, alongside a dash of black pepper before the star of the show takes centre stage: leather. A smooth, sensual blend of saffiano leather and rich suede for a rugged fragrance that descends into a base of subtly smoked vetiver oil, which is responsibly sourced from Haiti. Top notes are Mandarin Oil, Black Pepper. Heart note is Leather Accord. Base note is Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OY4315J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The ideal fragrance for a romantic young woman who expresses her graceful sensuality through a natural elegance, Signorina is an exceptionally fresh scent signature with a vivaciously cheeky soul. It is a Floral/Fruity fragrance inspired by the chic sensation of a rice steam, feminine rose notes and fruity tones on a milky woody dry-down. Juicy litchi and tender tasty grapefruit pulp create a natural fruity top before giving way to a heart that is a delicate veil of rice steam aerial notes and fresh rose. In the dry-down, a smooth and addictive milk mousse is shaken by the ambery woody vibrations of cashmeran.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=X0PRJRP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A sensuous, sun-drenched blend of Bergamot, warm Amber, Tiare Flower and Vanilla combined with delicious creamy Coconut. TOP NOTES • Italian Bergamot, Ginger Extract SFE, Mandarin MID NOTES • Indian Jasmine Sambac Absolute, Creamy Coconut, Frangipani Petals BASE NOTES • Vanilla Absolute, Cashmere Wood, Captive Musk, Amber

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Sensuous Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IIBT79N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Estee Lauder Sensuous is an opulent oriental-woody fragrance for women. This extremely feminine, elegant scent opens with an irresistible bouquet of jasmine, magnolia and lily  melting gently into the woody heart of molten wood and amber. Woody aromas continue in the base with added sweetness and spice with notes of juicy mandarin, pepper and white honey. The bottle is made of heavy waves of glass, with rose gold topper. Fragrance Notes: - Top Notes: Jasmine, Magnolia, Lily - Middle Notes: Amber, Woody Notes, Ylang-Ylang - Base Notes: Sandalwood, Mandarin Pulp, Pepper, White Honey

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree Eau de Parfum 125ml Refill Bottle
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=V132W85]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree Eau de Parfum combines the vigor of citron and the incisive freshness of juniper berry with the power of Timut pepper. The striking sensation of an icy breeze is juxtaposed with the generosity of the woody, mineral notes characteristic of Terre d'Hermes.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Elixir 100ml Eau de Parfum Refill Bottle
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BPNF8UM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With Angel Elixir, a new star is born. A totally original, woody floral gourmand scent that reinvents what makes Angel Eau de Parfum so unique. Here, Angel’s signature indulgence turns into a floral Milky Way, captured in Mugler’s iconic star-shaped bottle, morphed into a captivating deep blue. A shimmering spark of metallic spices. An out-of-this-world, floral bouquet invented by Mugler. A nebula of luscious vanilla infusion, empowered by woody Amber Xtreme. More than a fragrance, Angel Elixir is the catalyst to reinvent your reality. Because the real world is not enough… Thanks to the Mugler Fountain and Mugler Refills, you can refill your precious bottle anywhere at home. 1. Remove the cap and unscrew the pump 2. Take the Refill and fill into the matching fragrance bottle 3. Twist-on to refill the bottle without losing any drop 4. Wait for the refill to stop automatically and then twist-off 5. Re-screw the pump and cap back on

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill Bottle
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=W1WT6BY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Take yourself on an endless journey across the Mugler galaxy with the Alien Eau de Parfum Eco-Refill Bottle, which allows you to top up the original Alien flacon with this radiant woody-floral fragrance for women. For dedicated fans of the iconic Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum fragrance, you can treat yourself to the refillable, eco-conscious edition. Mugler’s instantly-recognisable scent is presented to you in a smooth, streamlined glass bottle that nods to the original mauve and gold-adorned talisman. If you’re looking to purchase a refill, you'll be familiar with the unbeatable aroma of Alien: heady sambac jasmine, cosy cashmeran wood and sensual white amber. The fragrance is inspired by femininity and captures a sense of vibrancy and mystery.

listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UO4X1UO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} My Way Parfum is an invitation to a journey of self-discovery, capturing the life-affirming feeling of a step into the unknown. An intense and woody powdery bouquet, born from the contrast between the bright solar Tuberose and the majestic blue Iris Pallida, encapsulated in a new contrasted bottle, dressed in tones that graduate from inky blue at its base to radiant pink at its neck. The scent opens with fresh, citrusy notes of Bergamot Oil from Calabria, blending with sparkling Orange Blossom enfleurage in bitter orange oil from Egypt. A new intense heart, born from the contrast between the solar, creamy velvety notes of Tuberose Heart Absolute from India, and the majestic freshness of Iris Pallida from France. The powdery and woody base is enhanced by the sensual creamy notes of Cedarwood from USA, with the suave and addictive Vanilla Bourbon Infusion from Madagascar, both magnified by white musks for an enveloping, second skin effect. As a result of My Way's innovative refill system, responsible and sustainable ingredients sourcing, and biodiversity protection through forest preservation programs, My Way Parfum reduces its carbon footprint and its impact on the environment. I AM WHAT I LIVE.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Alive Intense For Her Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RGFTR2S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A powerful fragrance, illustrating the intense lust for life and the boldness of the BOSS woman. Created for women who take risks and step outside their comfort zone, the new BOSS Alive Eau de Parfum Intense invites you to be daring and feel intensely ALIVE. Exquisite notes of raspberry exude positive energy, while an impactful woody base of vibrant vetiver reflects the assertiveness of the BOSS woman. Sensual benzoin leaves a trail of confidence and femininity as the ultimate signature of this Eau de Parfum Intense for women. A golden ornament surrounds the glass flacon like a piece of jewellery, while vivid raspberry pink lacquering encapsulates the passionate nature of the BOSS ALIVE woman.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Q Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DM257AR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The quintessential citrus-fruit fragrance. Q by Dolce&Gabbana is a bright and refreshing fragrance that captivates the senses with a lively mix of Sicilian lemon, tart blood orange, and jasmine. The heart features a succulent cherry accord with accents of heliotrope. The base is finished with musk and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only The Brave High Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XL940A8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Following Only The Brave and Only The Brave Extreme, Diesel Parfums introduces Only The Brave High, a fresher variation of the original fragrance. The scent provides a sensation of extreme freshness. Artical, an exclusive molecule developed at IFF’s Research & Development is combined with Yuzu accord, Peppermint oil, Grapefruit oil and Ginger oil, to create an intense and mineral iciness. The sparkle of the new scent lies on Only the Brave signature base of Geranium oil, Amber and Woody notes. Just like the original Only The Brave and Only The Brave Extreme, Only The Brave High comes packaged in a bottle shaped like a clenched fist, its breeziness expressed through inflections of light blue. A touch of silver enlightens the bottles and expresses the idea of freshness. Liam Hemsworth continues to be the face of the Only The Brave advertising campaigns.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Solar Eau De Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FVXTEIQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Olympéa Solar, the intense Eau de Parfum by Rabanne. The fragrance of the Amazon Goddess - fierce and independent, she owns her radiant power with confidence. A true zenith beauty, victorious and forceful. A luminous burst of sensual brightness reveals her many facets. Sparkling flowers under the sun. A radiant bouquet of florals that takes the striking sensuality of aromatics and solar oakmoss. Discover the sparkling energy of mandarin peel and orange warmed with heady white blossoms and ylang-ylang. The immediate feeling of being transported to a sunshine haven on a radiant day.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BVDC8D4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Le Parfum takes Black Opium’s original floral gourmand scent and shines a spotlight on vanilla, it’s most precious facet. The iconic coffee accord has been twisted with an exceptional blend of four vanilla notes, each different yet complimentary. Ranging from the most delectable aromas to sensual woody notes, the diverse quartet of vanilla ingredients combines to create an unexpected smoothness, with uncompromising intensity. Bound to an exhilarating dark-coffee accord, and bright white florals, this new take on the classic Black Opium signature exudes a wildly powerful sensuality, equal parts bold and exquisite. An ultra-intense scent for those seeking the ultimate day-to-night olfaction.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=D6VSNI4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hero Eau de Parfum starts off with a vibrant, aromatic pine needle note that's reminiscent of the forest-floor before it warms through with a resinous, vanillary note of benzoin in the heart. But the heart is really powered by incense, which adds a rich and powerful smokiness that creates a deeply seductive vibe. The base of Burberry’s Hero fragrance features a trio of cedarwood oils for a warm, comforting woody finish. Top notes are Pine Needles. Heart notes are Benzoin, Incense. Base notes are Cedarwood Oil Trio.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PPKIDFW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bvlgari Man Rain Essence is an invitation to experience the unstoppable creative force of Water through the transformative and regenerative power of rain. A fragrance paying homage to the thrill and the invigorating lively trail of this natural element in an olfactive crescendo. Powerful yet essential like rain, Bvlgari Man Rain Essence is a fresh woody musk signature with a transparent and fizzy trail, a fragrance whose strength is expressed by a powerful minerality.   The Bvlgari Man Rain Essence bottle appears to be sculpted by a fluid energy that generates unpredictable reflections and an essential, refined appeal.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Nettare di Sole Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XSWQLKN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Aqua Allegoria Nettare Di Sol is a bright and enchanting summer fragrance carrying the warmth of the sun across fields of white florals and honeyed citrus. Orange blossom, bergamot, and water notes create a refreshing splash of fragrance. Solar notes carry the heart amongst touches of magnolia, rose, and jasmine. Luxurious honey fills the base with a delectable gourmand sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau de Citron Noir Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E9Y1TFW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Eau de citron noir was created in 2018 by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel. It presents an elegant and surprising freshness that reveals the paradoxes of a citrus fruit known and loved by all: lemon. A sophisticated composition full of contrast. A citrus woody fragrance, Eau de citron noir cologne combines sharp lemon and a woody black tea with smoky notes of guaiac wood.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Chloe Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R57XMDM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Founded in the heart of Paris over six decades ago, Chloe epitomizes freedom, lightness, and femininity. The essence of romantic, effortless chic breathes through their ready-to-wear, accessories, and fragrances. Chloe Eau de Parfum embodies the creative, confident individuality of the Chloe woman, an olfactory celebration of a free spirit with innate chic. This fragrance artfully reinterprets the classic rose, transforming it into a vibrant, intimate, and sensual experience. Opening with floral powdery notes, delicate peony, and lychee, entwined with the freshness of springtime freesia, Chloe Eau de Parfum unveils a heady allure. As the flirtatious top notes dissipate, a richer, more sensual facet of the rose emerges. Magnolia and lily of the valley interlace, creating a distinctive character, while warm amber and elegant cedarwood provide subtle, sophisticated undertones. Capturing the very essence of the Chloe woman, this fragrance is a sensory journey that mirrors the brand's enduring commitment to timeless style and individuality.

Patchouli, a deep, woody note, takes hold at the base to create a sensual, timeless and lasting cologne.

The base unfolds with the comforting richness of tonka bean and the earthy depth of patchouli. These smooth, warm notes leave a lasting impression, balancing sweetness with sophistication. Girl of Now Lovely is an enchanting scent designed to celebrate life’s beautiful moments with grace and positivity.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

With a philosophy rooted in “I am what I live,” My Way invites exploration, curiosity, and the courage to embrace the unknown. It is a tribute to individuality, where each moment and connection shapes a deeper sense of self. At its heart, My Way is a radiant floral bouquet, blending the finest natural ingredients with innovative craftsmanship. The composition features tuberose from India, extracted through a meticulous process that highlights its creamy, velvety nuances. Orange blossom from Egypt adds a fresh, luminous touch, while rich vanilla from Madagascar lends warmth and depth. Each note reflects a journey, brought to life through sustainable sourcing and artisanal techniques, ensuring both purity and authenticity in every drop. The bottle is as thoughtful as the fragrance itself, designed with sustainability in mind. Its sleek, transparent glass reveals a vibrant pink hue, symbolising the many facets of femininity. A deep blue cap, inspired by the iconic Armani stone, represents the planet and the wealth of experiences it offers. Accented with a golden ring and a fabric collar, the bottle feels like a timeless keepsake. My Way’s refillable and recyclable design underscores Giorgio Armani’s commitment to a sustainable future, making it a fragrance that not only tells a story but also supports a responsible way of living.

The minimalist packaging reflects the Maison’s dedication to grace and sophistication, echoing the creative legacy of Hubert de Givenchy and his passion for understated luxury. Part of the Les Mythiques collection, this fragrance is a celebration of Givenchy’s iconic olfactory creations. With its distinctive blend of freshness and elegance, this scent evokes the essence of modern femininity. Indulge in its charm and let it become a signature part of your daily ritual.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne 180ml Spray

Balanced and refreshing, Colonia C.L.U.B. is a scent that captures effortless elegance for every occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina Rouge Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SC6KQQA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Nina Ricci Nina Rouge Gift Set includes a 50ml Eau de Toilette and a 75ml body lotion, offering a delightful pairing for everyday indulgence. Presented in a striking deep red apple-shaped bottle, Nina Rouge is both eye-catching and irresistible—an ideal gift for someone who loves a touch of fun and sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Boisee Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

As the fragrance develops, the heart reveals a smooth blend of iris and cacao, lending a soft, powdery sweetness. Cedarwood adds structure, enhancing the composition with its dry, aromatic presence. This contrast between spice and softness creates a layered and distinctive signature. The base settles into rich woody accords, where creamy sandalwood meets earthy patchouli for a deep, sensual finish. Gentleman Boisée leaves a lasting impression with its elegant warmth and subtle intensity, making it an ideal choice for evening wear or any moment that calls for understated luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 60ml Spray

The result is a rich and lasting scent trail that feels both luxurious and seductive. I Want Choo Le Parfum is perfect for evening wear or any occasion that calls for unforgettable elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Ultra Blue Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Set

Elegantly packaged, this gift set is ideal for the gentleman who appreciates sophistication, performance, and the thrill of discovery.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray

These warm, spicy undertones linger on the skin, leaving a tantalising trail that is both seductive and refreshing. Electric Cherry is a perfect blend of sweetness and spice, making it a standout choice for those who crave a unique and memorable scent.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Her! Vibes of Freedom Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

The base features warm chestnut and creamy whipped cream, adding depth and a subtle gourmand twist. This rich foundation enhances the fragrance’s longevity while leaving a comforting, sensual trail. This is Her! Vibes of Freedom is an empowering scent that celebrates the spirit of bold femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Fabulous Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C9MWB6B]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Fabulous Eau de Parfum is a refined leather fragrance crafted for both men and women who appreciate bold sophistication. Together, these notes generate a glowing, long-lasting finish that exudes confidence and warmth. Tom Ford Fabulous is a striking, elegant scent designed for those who want to stand out with style and grace.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Mandarino dI Amalfi Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OYVFH2R]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mandarino di Amalfi is a fragrant journey to the sun-kissed Mediterranean coast, capturing the essence of a peaceful Italian escape. This luminous scent blends vibrant citrus and aromatic herbs, evoking the serene beauty of Amalfi’s cliffs and sparkling sea breezes. These uplifting top notes are balanced by the unique green freshness of shisho leaf accord, adding an unexpected and refreshing twist. At its heart, delicate jasmine and wildflowers bloom softly, layering the scent with gentle floral warmth. Together, these ingredients create a textured, radiant fragrance that perfectly reflects the natural beauty and tranquil charm of the Amalfi coast.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Romance Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WU7STHM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ralph Lauren Romance Intense Eau De Parfum is a deeper, more luxurious interpretation of the iconic original, crafted to bring warmth, richness and sophistication to evening moments or the cooler seasons.  A vibrant rush of Blackcurrant Accord, Green Mandarin and Bergamot Heart introduces the composition with freshness and energy. listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SS22FS2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum is a portrait of quiet strength and self-belief. Presented in a deep oak-toned bottle accented with subtle gold, the design reflects the scent itself: refined, intense, and elemental. Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum is invigorating yet composed, made for men who draw strength from within and wear it effortlessly.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau & Cedre Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Prada Infusion D'Iris Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
