listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Frozen Flower Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y1S462S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Every year, as summer draws to a close and we enter autumn, brands present limited holiday editions inspired by winter. One of them is the new Flowerbomb Frozen Flower edition by VIKTOR & ROLF, dressed in a frosted glass bottle, which is totally suitable for winter holidays.   The iconic Flowerbomb bottle is adorned with an elegant rose-gold design evoking the look of frost, adding a touch of luxury to this exclusive edition. This feminine floral fragrance is imbued with a bouquet of cattleyas, sambac jasmine, freesia, and countless rose petals. The captivating flowery vanilla scent is further enriched with notes of patchouli, crafting an opulent and enchanting aroma.   Top notes : Cattleya Orchid, Freesia, Centifolia Rose; Middle notes : Sambac Jasmine, India Osmanthus; Base notes : Patchouli, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Extreme Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=G9E709S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A captivating floral gourmand scent, twisted with dark, roasted notes of black coffee, for vigour and vitality. Energy and sensuality married with the unique YSL edge. The signature black coffee accord is paired with sensual vanilla, enriched by the softness of white flowers and orange blossom, set against a base of patchouli and comforting white musk. A daring contrast of light and dark, for a women’s fragrance that bewitches with its trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Scarlet Poppy Eau de Cologne Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=I1ATGWU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Scarlet Poppy is a potent infusion of floral powers inspired by the beauty of the distinctive scarlet poppy. Ambrette provides a quirky, powdery, opening that gives the scent a distinct nature. Scarlet poppy blossoms in the heart, a captivating floral adorned with fig and orris. A tonka bean base, touched by heliotrope and barley, closes the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PX1912W]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Unveil the captivating essence of Mugler Alien Refillable Eau de Parfum 90ml, a fragrance that brings a touch of mystery and allure to your everyday style. Mugler Alien Refillable Eau de Parfum 90ml offers a unique blend of floral and woody notes that make it truly unforgettable. Its rich jasmine top notes, combined with warm cashmeran wood and deep amber, create a scent that lingers beautifully. With its refillable design, this perfume not only enhances your collection but also supports sustainable choices, making it ideal for those who value both luxury and the environment. This gift set contains:  Alien eau de parfum 90ml Alien body lotion 50ml Alien eau de parfum travel spray 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Oud & Bergamot Eau de Cologne Intense 100ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MDK58HB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jo Malone London Oud and Bergamot is a refined unisex fragrance that captures opulence through contrast, blending freshness with deep, resinous warmth. From the first spray, it feels elegant and assured, offering a luxurious scent experience that suits both everyday wear and more considered occasions. The fragrance opens with bright, zesty bergamot, bringing clarity and lift before smoothly transitioning into a warm, woody heart of cedarwood. This middle phase adds structure and depth, balancing freshness with a calm, composed richness that feels unmistakably Jo Malone London. As it settles, the base reveals smoky, sensual oud, enveloping the skin in a smooth and lasting trail that feels timeless and sophisticated. This gift set includes a 100ml Cologne Intense spray alongside a 9ml travel spray, making it ideal for both home and on the go use.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau de Parfum 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DEM1H1O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A resounding chord of strength played within a deeply masculine fragrance. Reforging the original Terre d'Hermès fragrance into a fresher composition, a bright accord of bergamot, grapefruit and lemon weaves a crisp citrus accord. Geraniums and Sichuan pepper create a flash of heat before sinking into a deep vetiver note that commands the base, alongside notes of patchouli, olibanum and amber wood.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H8DSRMK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum is a scent of infinite movement in which the freshness of the sea meets the warm vibrancy of the land. Top Notes: A vivid salt accord & incense Heart Notes: Fresh natural origin marine seaweed Base Notes: Enveloping oakmoss, sensual upcycled cedarwood & a warm amber accord

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray 3 Pcs Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BSXJRKV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette is the dynamic new vegan perfume by Issey Miyake, harnessing the power of salt. Water. Copious and crystal-clear. Within its vital current, salt, elusive and imperceptible, is carried. As water evaporates, the salt crystalizes, leaving its tactile fragrance upon the skin. A surprising scent that awakens the senses, salt reveals the flavour of life.  Flow with the movement and feel your pulse beat. Savour the vitality. A new freshness in a woody perfume for men.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Parfum 150ml Refill Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YO72ENG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A bold yet refined signature scent built to last. Bright Calabrian bergamot opens with fresh, green intensity, while Provençal clary sage and iris blend sensitivity into the heart. The base commands attention with Brazilian tonka bean and Virginian cedarwood, a powerful, modern masculine fragrance. Available in a sustainable 150ml refill format. Key notes: Bergamot, Clary Sage, Iris, Tonka Bean, Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Nomade Nuit D'Egypte Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MAOJVV7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloe Nomade Nuit d'Égypte is a sensory masterpiece, carefully crafted with age-old inspirations in mind. Inspired by the ancient kyphi, the first-known perfume to humankind, this alluring eau de parfum weaves a timeless tale of age-old allure and modern refinement. Powerful accents of myrrh appear instantly, seamlessly blending with the spicy scents of cinnamon and ginger, followed by honeyed hues of broom flower nectar and supremely round, balsamic and ambery undertones of cypriol and opopanax. At the very heart of this Chloe Nomade Nuit D'Egypte Eau de Parfum for Women, the exquisite kyphi accord is paired with an opulent orange blossom absolute, sourced from the heart of Egypt itself. Finally, a sensuous touch of warm vanilla completes the base note of this beautiful fragrance composed with 90% naturally sourced ingredients.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UO8OTGF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum is a captivating floral fragrance with Patchouli, Magnolia and Dewberries...   This perfume is built around Magnolia Essence, emanating a bright, floral sweetness and an exquisite feminine dimension, while a Dewberries Accord lends an irresistible fruity quality. This tantalising balance of fresh and sensual notes is enhanced by the woodiness of Patchouli Essence, which grounds the scent with a subtle, earthy facet.    The floral elements of this Gucci scent are magnified by the soft and sensual hues of Blond Woods, while a Coconut Accord offers an addictive and sweet freshness. Finally, Jasmine Sambac Absolute and a trail of Musks combine to offer an enticing warmth. A beautiful fragrance that lasts all day long and will attract compliments every time you wear it.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Nomade Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J3AJXRJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloe Nomade Eau de Parfum encapsulates the spirit of a woman open to the beauty of the World. The Chloe woman carries with her freedom and an immutable, natural elegance. Confident, and inspiring, she flourishes through her experiences and encounters, asserting who she is without ever imposing it. This inner strength leads her to embrace otherness.  Chloe Nomade Perfume is a mix of softness and strength: the facets of this floral chypre blow like the winds of freedom. The intense, mineral character of the oak moss is shrouded in the voluptuous sweetness of the cherry plum and the flowery freshness of the freesia.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Signature Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RJ6B4D7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloe reinterprets the holiday spirit, drawing inspiration from the Maison’s iconic accessories to celebrate the magic of the season. Starry flowers made of golden studs illuminate the gift boxes, delicately evoking the festive end-of-year decorations. An invitation to joyfully celebrate the holidays with Chloe.  Both Chloe’s Eau de Parfum and matching perfumed body lotion carry the fresh and feminine scent that takes a modern rose and translates it into a vibrant and airy perfume for women.  Set includes: - Chloe Signature Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml - Chloe Signature Eau de Parfum Spray 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=ILBNLUE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience a mesmerising Eau de Parfum with floral top notes of freesia, mandarin, and sage. This Eternity perfume for women transitions to essences of white lily and marigold, completed with notes of soothing sandalwood, patchouli, and amber. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, White Lily Heart Notes: White Rose, Carnation, Violet Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Musk Gift Set Contents: Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml Body Lotion 100ml Eau de Parfum Spray 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KC48ACO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A new chapter of self-discovery, Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women radiates an intense magnetism that captivates those nearby. The ambery fragrance opens with a vibrant raspberry accord complemented by lavender essence from the original Eau de Parfum. The signature trio of vanilla extracts is unveiled at the heart, before a suede leather accord at the base conjures warmth and sensuality. Reminiscent of the shades of a radiant sunset, the refillable bronzed square bottle is housed in elegant light brown packaging adorned with a gold label inspired by Burberry’s signature gabardine fabric.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Pure Musc Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MYJ55OY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau De Parfum is a floral, woody EDP for women which combines sophistication and delicacy in an addictive scent which seeks to convey feminine purity and strength. A sublime heart of Musc is augmented with a white floral bouquet while Cashmeran at the base lends warmth. The frosted white lacquer bottle with black cap perfectly symbolises this paradox of strength and softness.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co Tiffany Rose Gold Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PQ7UJD3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Vibrant and magnetic, Tiffany & Co. Rose Gold Eau de Parfum for Women opens with a fruity blackcurrant paired with the spicy scent of pink pepper and lychee fruit for a sparkling, playful top note. At the heart of this floral fragrance is the blue rose accord, a unique hybrid featuring Japanese rose that nods to Tiffany's signature shade and lends a delicate floral scent to this perfume for women. For a warm finish, ambrette seed blends with deep musk and iris at the base of this perfume. This perfumed body lotion moisturises and adds another layer of delicate scent that stays on for hours. This festive Giftset contains: Eau de Parfum 75ml Body Lotion 100ml Eau de Parfum 5ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DSV71F0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This fragrance is designed to capture the essence of London. One of the first Gourmand fragrances from the House, it is so sweet you could eat it! The pale pink bottle creates a luxurious yet feminine feel. • Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Lemon, Blackcurrant, Blackberry, Sour Cherry; Raspberry and Strawberry • Heart notes: Violet and Jasmine • Base notes: Cashmere, Vanilla, Patchouli, Musk, Woody notes; Oakmoss and Amber This set includes: 100ml Burberry Her Eau de Parfum 10ml Burberry Her Eau de Parfum 75ml Body Lotion

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SBUSO41]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Colonia Essenza takes the timeless charm of the original Colonia and sharpens it, adding a modern, more assertive edge. It’s crisp, polished, and quietly powerful—like walking into a room with quiet confidence and leaving a lasting impression. The fragrance opens with a burst of zesty citrus—lemon, orange, and bergamot—that feels instantly uplifting and clean. But where the original Colonia is soft and warm, Essenza introduces a sharper, more aromatic core. Notes of clove, rosemary, and jasmine add depth and structure, creating a refined, masculine energy. As it settles, the base of vetiver, patchouli, white musk, and amber lingers with understated strength. It's elegant without being flashy, modern yet rooted in tradition. Wearing Colonia Essenza feels like starting your day with intention. It’s fresh, focused, and undeniably sophisticated—a fragrance for those who appreciate the classics, but demand more presence.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina L'Elixir Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=B2BWET5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Nina Ricci Nina L'Elixir is a sparkling, sweet, and sensual floral-fruity gourmand fragrance designed as a "love potion". It features a vibrant, intense blend of red berries, Calabrese lemon, lime, and jasmine, settling into a warm base of amber and musk. It is a long-lasting, modern, and youthful scent. Top Notes: Calabrese Lemon, Lime, Red Berries Heart Notes: Jasmine, Red Apple Base Notes: Amber, Musk Scent Profile: Fruity, Citrus, Sweet, Musky

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Elixir Parfum Intense 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XGD8EWL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover Davidoff Cool Elixir, the aromatic oud treasure. Cool Elixir introduces a noble olfactive signature at once so sensual and rare. Superbly textured, three ingredients an intriguing oud accord, lavandin absolute and rose oxide give the woody fragrance its elegant and precious profile. The deep blue faceted perfume bottle mirrors the intensity of the oud scent, while the weighted cap boasts a luxurious texture. Charles Melton embodies the charismatic, gentleman adventurer hero who dives to the ocean’s depths, where the bottle is being fiercely guarded by a mythical sea dragon a first in perfumery. This saga unfolds through suspenseful encounters with this gigantic underwater creature and a fierce queen played by Annahstasia Enuke. Embark on a quest for the ultimate noble Davidoff scent. Mood Adjectives: Noble Perfumery. Fresh Aromatic oud. New oud treasure. Top Notes: Rose Oxide Heart Notes: Lavandin Base Notes: Oud Accord

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Intense Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NLUA2I2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The #ForeverGuilty collection takes the concept of love to new heights with a fresh twist on the iconic Gucci Guilty fragrances. This new interpretation intensifies the scent for those seeking a love declaration that defies societal constraints and embraces freedom. Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum Intense Pour Femme serves as a bold symbol of the connection between unconventional, like-minded lovers, offering a more profound expression of the original Gucci Guilty Pour Femme essence. In this Ambery Floral Woody fragrance, the scent unfolds with the vibrant energy of Mandora notes, seamlessly blended with a rich bouquet of Ylang Ylang flowers. This captivating combination is further enhanced by the deep, empowering nuances of Patchouli, creating a complex and alluring aroma. The Gucci Guilty For Her Eau de Parfum Intense is designed to be a statement of passion and individuality, redefining the signature scent with an intensity that matches its daring spirit. Embrace a fragrance that celebrates a liberated approach to love and connection.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Aftershave Balm 75ml
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IUIOBU7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This 75ml tube of BOSS Bottled Aftershave Balm offers a soothing touch after your shaving routine, providing a refreshing and calming sensation for your skin. Its lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving the skin smooth and hydrated. The fragrance features a fresh, fruity top note that blends harmoniously with a spicy-floral heart of geranium and a hint of clove. This sophisticated combination is balanced by warm base notes of sandalwood, cedar, and vetiver, creating a scent that is both timeless and refined. BOSS Bottled captures the essence of the modern man with its captivating aroma. This aftershave balm is the perfect addition to your grooming routine, ensuring you feel refreshed and confident throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake A Drop D'Issey Fraiche Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UP3CD5O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A Drop d’Issey Eau de Parfum Fraîche by Issey Miyake invites you to experience the essence of nature awakening under a gentle spring rain. This fragrance takes you on a sensory journey filled with fresh, floral notes, symbolizing the beauty and vitality of nature. Following the original A Drop d’Issey Eau de Parfum, this version reveals a refreshing narrative of water intertwined with delicate blossoms. The fragrance opens with a crisp rain accord, crafted by perfumer Ane Ayo, imparting an invigorating freshness. At its heart, the enchanting aroma of lilac unfolds, harmonizing beautifully with damask rose to create a delicate and vibrant floral bouquet. The base notes of sandalwood, cedarwood, and musky elements provide a rich depth, rounding out this exquisite scent. Encased in a beautifully designed bottle, A Drop d’Issey Eau de Parfum Fraîche maintains its signature round shape, now adorned with a captivating gradient from blue to green. This design reflects the journey of a raindrop as it descends from the sky into the lush greenery below. The drop-shaped bottle can be laid flat, and a gentle touch on the white cap releases its refreshing fragrance, making it a perfect addition to your collection.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'eau d'issey Pivoine Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IYUH5HY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Peonies, vibrant symbols of the return of sunny days, are among the most radiant of all flowers. Though their delicate fragrance cannot be naturally extracted, Issey Miyake’s perfumer has crafted a unique peony accord, capturing the floral, juicy, and green nuances of this exquisite bloom. L’Eau d’Issey Pivoine is a vegan fragrance, made with 87% ingredients of natural origin. This fresh and elegant scent represents Issey Miyake’s dedication to sustainability, combining nature's purity with ethical fragrance creation. The bottle, iconic in its design, embraces eco-responsibility. Made from 20% recycled glass, it is topped with a natural wood cap, entirely free of plastic. The wood is responsibly sourced from sustainably managed forests, minimizing environmental impact while maintaining an elegant, timeless design.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Fusion D'Issey Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KO6MF8R]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Nature reveals its vibrant and creative essence with Fusion d'Issey, a mineral fougère fragrance for men crafted by master perfumer Nathalie Lorson. This scent redefines masculinity by playfully blending contrasts of heat and coolness. Bursting with the lively zest of lemon and the sweetness of coconut milk, it offers a refreshing top note. This is followed by a robust aromatic breeze harmonizing with a warm solar amber accord. Beneath these layers, hints of volcanic forests intertwine with deep patchouli, creating a truly unique olfactory experience. The bottle design of Fusion d'Issey is a stunning reflection of its fragrance. Tall and elegant, it boasts a gleaming deep blue glass that embodies the scent's contrasts. The multifaceted cap is meticulously sculpted to resemble black obsidian, giving it a striking appearance that captivates the light. The packaging mirrors this aesthetic, featuring the same blue and black tones, with the name "Fusion d'Issey" prominently displayed in bold orange lettering. This striking creation beautifully marries inspiration from nature with human craftsmanship. To enjoy the full benefits of this fragrance, spray it directly onto pulse points such as your neck, wrists, and inner elbows. You can also apply it generously to your clothing and upper body for an immersive scent experience. Inspired by the life-giving energy of volcanoes, Fusion d'Issey captures the essence of nature's power and vitality, thriving in a landscape rich in nutrients and freedom.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum 25ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YYPPXWG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} At the heart of this fragrance is water, the essential element and source of life, which inspired Issey Miyake's first creation. This perfume captures the essence of water meeting the elements, resulting in a scent that reflects purity and freshness. The elegantly designed bottle embodies the beauty of water, featuring smooth, simple lines that evoke the delicate curves of a drop. Its sharp, slender silhouette is inspired by a vision of the full moon illuminating the Eiffel Tower, topped with a brushed metal cap and a transparent ball for a modern touch. This floral and sensual fragrance intertwines the brightness of sun-kissed blooms with a woody base, creating a sunny aquatic scent that lingers on the skin. Experience the enchanting blend where flower meets sun, leaving a captivating trail that celebrates femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'eau d'issey Eau & Magnolia Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TAOI3AG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake’s journey began with water, the essence of life and a symbol of boundless potential. This element, raw and pure, gave birth to the first Issey Miyake fragrance, which now finds a new harmony with the ethereal beauty of the magnolia flower. L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia is a delicate blend of nature’s most fundamental gifts, celebrating the meeting of pure water and gentle, feminine florals. L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia Eau de Toilette Intense offers a radiant and simple fragrance, where the softness of magnolia petals intertwines with the freshness of water. The fragrance opens with a burst of sparkling bergamot, while the heart reveals a floral bouquet enriched with an aquatic touch, allowing the magnolia to shine. The base is grounded by precious woods, creating a lingering and refined scent experience. The bottle of L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia reflects the minimalist elegance Issey Miyake is known for. It stays true to timeless design, with a touch of beige and a natural wooden cap inspired by the purity of nature. Made with 20% recycled glass and topped with ash wood, each cap is uniquely veined, embodying the natural beauty and individuality of the materials used.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey IGO Eau de Toilette 20ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DQLW8UT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the timeless elegance of Eau d'Issey by Issey Miyake, now available in an innovative format designed for modern adventurers. The IGO cap and ISTAY bottle combine to create a versatile fragrance solution that invites you to embrace exploration while enjoying this iconic scent. This unique two-in-one design reflects Issey Miyake's commitment to innovation, achieved through four years of meticulous research and development. Eau d'Issey features a refreshing and simple composition that captures the essence of a drop of water on a woman's skin. The fragrance opens with delicate notes of lotus and rose, leading to a sensual heart enriched with a bouquet of lily and fresh flowers. The warm base of precious woods adds sophistication and depth, creating an olfactory experience that is both inviting and captivating. The IGO cap is lightweight, travel-friendly, and holds 20ml of perfume, making it perfect for on-the-go spritzing. While the ISTAY bottle is designed to be a beautiful, statuesque addition to your vanity, allowing you to return to your beloved fragrance after your travels. Both elements of this unique packaging pay tribute to the original l'Eau d'Issey design, inspired by the beauty of the Eiffel Tower illuminated by the moon, combining elegance and practicality in a timeless shape.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette IGO 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GR2PBIC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover the innovative Eau d'Issey fragrance by Issey Miyake, now available in an exciting new format. The IGO cap and ISTAY bottle combine convenience and elegance, allowing you to carry the iconic scent with you wherever you go. Designed for the adventurous spirit, this two-in-one travel-friendly format encourages exploration while staying true to the fragrance's timeless essence. listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum 25ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Now Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=W4J458E]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Idôle Now offers a distinctive floral experience that blends the essence of nature with scientific innovation. This composition results in a richer, bolder scent that pushes the boundaries of fragrance with its soft, vanilla undertones. The Idôle Rose is uniquely upcycled from discarded Rose water, which is then reintegrated into the final formula, enhancing its environmental responsibility. This innovative process infuses the fragrance with a fresh and uplifting rose note, symbolizing a blend of nature and sustainability. The Nature Print Orchid Accord adds a touch of elegance with its musky and warm aroma, contributing to Idôle Now's captivating trail while maintaining the flower's natural essence. Additionally, the augmented Vanilla Bourbon infusion, enhanced with natural Vanillin created from repurposed ingredients, enriches the scent with a deeper, more alluring vanilla profile.

A fragrance made for nights out and occasions when you want to be remembered.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q8UDJJV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Prada Paradigme rewrites the rules of masculine fragrance with a refined, avant-garde signature. An ambery woody Eau De Parfum for men, it's built around a reversed olfactive structure, revealing its depth from the very start rather than saving it for the dry-down. Warm resins and guaiac wood form a rich foundation, while a floral twist of bourbon geranium and airy musks brings lift and light. A Calabrian bergamot heart then adds a touch of freshness, balancing the deep, woody base with brightness for a thoroughly modern, contrasting scent. The bottle mirrors Prada's iconic triangle in a bold tilt, lacquered in a gradient from deep black to green, fittingly distinctive for a fragrance shaped by new perspectives. A great choice for anyone who likes warm, woody ambers with a fresh, contemporary edge.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DQQKAS3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Reimagining gourmand as you know it, Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum explores the boundary between sweet and salty in a sophisticated display of floral amber nuances. A modern women's fragrance, it takes the much-loved Paradoxe in a richer, more playful direction. It opens with a bright bouquet of neroli and orange flower, lending the scent a zesty, uplifting aura, before salted pistachio adds an unexpected twist at the heart with its addictive, roasted note. Sophisticated sandalwood then grounds everything at the base, leaving a sensual, contemporary trail. That contrast of fresh florals, salty-sweet gourmand and warm wood gives the fragrance real character. A lovely choice for anyone who loves modern gourmands with a twist, or fancies something a little more unexpected than the usual sweet floral.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=X9HNW5K]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 90ml reimagines the gourmand, playing on the fine line between sweet and salty in a sophisticated blend of floral amber nuances. A richer, more daring twist on the original Paradoxe, it's a women's scent built around the unexpected. A modern, characterful pick that wears beautifully from day into evening.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XBNG6FA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Come together at Ralph's Club, where icons of style and culture meet. A sophisticated pick for anyone who loves deep, woody scents with a sensual edge.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club New York Eau de Parfum 110ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EIL444C]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inspired by the energy of Ralph Lauren's hometown, Ralph's Club New York Eau De Parfum exudes a fiery amber character, made for evenings spent in the city. It's the first in Lauren's men's collection to open with a juicy blackcurrant accord, lending a vibrancy that gives way to mandarin and lavender nuances. The fragrance then takes a heady, warming turn, revealing notes of fir balsam, sandalwood and bourbon vanilla that settle on the skin with an addictive, alluring intensity. The bottle is just as distinctive, inspired by a polished flask and embossed with a black "R" diamond monogram, a design that pays homage to the city. A great choice for anyone who loves warm, ambery scents with a fresh, fruity opening and a sensual, woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Hypersense Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SI4I2UD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mugler Alien Hypersense offers a sensorial take on the brand's quintessential Alien fragrance. An undeniably hypnotic Eau De Parfum for women, it enthrals the senses with a blend of florals, fruits and woods, and this version arrives as a refill to replenish your existing bottle. A lovely choice for anyone drawn to rich, jasmine-led florals with a fresh, fruity lift.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler A*Men Stellar Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UHTC455]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A*Men Stellar is the ultimate indulgence by Mugler, a men's fragrance that combines creamy pistachio and a powerful woody accord with boozy accents. Rich, sweet and gourmand, it's a bold, characterful scent designed to be noticed. It opens with sweet, juicy bergamot from Calabria and aromatic lavandin from Provence, before its heart reveals a creamy-smooth, sweetly nutty and tantalisingly salty blue pistachio accord. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C4PDM6D]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Toilette 100ml embodies seduction and fantasy. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MOINQ66]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Step into the hypnotic allure of a midnight garden with Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum, which unveils the dark, sensual beauty of the black orchid in its most opulent form. Luscious black plum swirls into deep floral and spicy accords, lending the fragrance an even more alluring, opulent depth. A great choice for anyone drawn to dark, sensual florals with a warm, boozy richness.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Reserve Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OXA0JSO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Black Orchid Reserve Eau De Parfum 100ml delivers your floral fix with a rich, autumn-winter edge. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DITRQ55]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum breathes an air of freshness through crisp Italian lemon, while the dense coastal forest comes through in magnified oakwood extract and cypress. Stunning cistus absolute and a harmony of ambers are illuminated within the composition, lending real warmth and depth beneath the bright, herbal opening. As Tom Ford himself has described it, the scent is a deeper take on the original that captures the feeling of a Mediterranean getaway. A great choice for anyone who loves fresh, woody scents with a coastal, aromatic character and a warm, ambery base.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Eau D'Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=X7OXQ7N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Eau d'Ombré Leather Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray brings together rich, luminous notes in a wildly radiant composition. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IG68KQN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Be inspired by matchless style and panache with Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum, a bolder take on the original Grey Vetiver. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q6LK6NG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Noir Extreme is made for those occasions when you really want to make a statement. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=I4SHWX8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum intensifies the original Noir Extreme for a richly sensual experience, a masculine fragrance made for those who enjoy bold, characterful scents. listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower in The Air Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Flower In The Air by Kenzo. This is a fruity, floral and fresh fragrance for women. It opens with fresh accords of raspberry and pink pepper. The heart contains of rose, magnolia and gardenia. Its base is made of sensual white musk.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower L'Elixir Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity gourmand fragrance introduced by Kenzo in 2015. This fragrance has top notes of mandarin orange, and raspberry; heart notes of rose and orange blossom; and base notes of praline, vanilla, and powdery notes.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Pour Homme Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Homme Sport by Kenzo. This is a fresh and aromatic fragrance for men. It contains of grapefruit, mint, lemon, geranium, ginger, cedar and vetiver. Homme Sport by Kenzo was launched 2012.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo World Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: A romantic floral fragrance that dares for originality. Kenzo World embraces an unknown composition, brushing an opening of red fruits that offer sweetness before settling into the innovative blend of peony, jasmine and sparkling ambroxan. Remarkable and enticing, it draws the senses into its own world of sweetness and fresh fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L'Homme Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=D3COYY9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Created for a contemporary gentleman, the L’Homme fragrance captures the perseverance and skill that tennis player and Lacoste founder René Lacoste displayed on and off court. Sophisticated yet daring, the L’Homme scent will fill every day with palpable, confident energy. Dynamic and full of vigour, the captivating Eau de Toilette opens with juicy servings of quince, accompanied by a bold rhubarb accord. A backhand of black pepper swings into the heart, meeting sharp notes of ginger for a spicy core. A final round of cedarwood in the base create a timeless elegance that echoes the heritage of Lacoste brand. Top Notes: Quince, Rhubarb Accord Heart Notes: Black Pepper, Ginger Base Notes: Cedarwood, Dry Amber

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: A new universal declaration of happiness, composed of some of the noblest naturally-derived ingredients. As one of the first flowers to bloom in Spring, Magnolia is the symbol of new beginnings. Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau De Toilette is illuminated with Magnolia Essence which adds a fresh luminosity and is a majestic interpretation of the iconic La vie est belle signature.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang For Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Stay seductive with Vera Wang For Men. This signature scent for him is masculine yet fresh, with top notes of green leaves and luminous yuzu, followed by a spicy heart of nutmeg, leather and anis, on a sandalwood and tobacco base.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Intense Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XSS06VC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Olympea Perfume range continues to expand. It is an exciting collection of body care products and perfumes. When you are looking for women’s fragrances that fit in during the day as well as the night, the Paco Rabanne Olympea collection is a great scent collection to explore. One of the latest perfumes from this premier brand is Olympea Intense. What does it smell like? Although it has notes in common with the original Olympea perfume, this fragrance also offers other nuances. As it is a more sensual perfume, it is a perfect eau de parfum for special occasions. Patchouli and saffron have been added to the bouquet. This is a great fragrance to wear any time of the year. It reminds you of warm, long summer nights. We are offering you the opportunity to add this fragrance to put this perfume on your dressing table in an 80ml format. Buy it as a personal treat or gift to someone who enjoys fine fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Man Extreme Eau de Parfum 60ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YFOGO29]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Aftershave is perhaps the leading fragrance brand for men. One of its more popular offerings is Hugo Boss Man. If you have not as yet added this scent to your fragrance shelf, you simply must. It is not only aromatic, it is also spicy. In many ways, you can say that this scent dares to be masculine. At the same time, you can pick up on softer notes in Hugo Boss Hugo Man. Take your time and explore the fragrance. You will soon pick up on other tones including herbal and more delicate fresh greens. It is this unique combination that makes the fragrance perfect for any time of the day or night. Do you already have it in your fragrance collection? If not, you should treat yourself to this fantastic offer of 60ml eau de parfum. It is perfect for taking with you on a holiday or slipping into your gym bag. Alternatively, buy it as a treat for the man in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Kenzo Homme is a light, woodsy- herbal fragrance for men, relaunched in Spring 2002. It's almost rich enough to wear out to dinner at night, but it's really subtle. So make it either a casual day-time, or a casual dinner.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: The first and most important quality of a fragrance should be its ability to tell a story. Every story has a beginning and for Narciso Rodriguez, that beginning was egyptian musk, his favourite scent, he was introduced to the mysterious essence by an unforgettable woman he met. Musk is at the heart of 'For Her', expressing itself through honey flower, radiant amber and tactile woody pulsations. The fragrant harmony develops gently, slowly, rounding out into the warm tones of sun-kissed skin, dusted in a soft, velvety sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Dream Forever Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BOTRNRT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume offers you a wonderful world of scents and fragrances. If you have not had the opportunity to try a fragrance from this brand as yet, now you have the perfect opportunity to do so. Marc Jacobs Daisy Dream Forever is the perfect scent when you are looking for a feminine fragrance. It delights you with its many notes. There is little wonder Marc Jacobs Forever Daisy Dream has amassed so many followers. It is packed with exciting notes including jasmine, litchi and wisteria. At the same time, it manages to stay fresh thanks to pear and grapefruit. Let it linger and you will also pick on white woods and blackberries. As an exclusive offer, we are offering this lovely fragrance as an eau de parfum. The bottle looks stunning on any dressing table. The fragrance makes a much-appreciated gift. Alternatively, you can buy it for yourself as a personal treat.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Aqua Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TM9JLTC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Olympea Perfume collection never stands still. When you are looking for a new scent, this is an excellent fragrance range to turn to. One of the latest additions to the collection is Aqua. This is a classy fragrance perfect for wearing any time of the day and night. It is not heavy but still has substance. What does this new, exciting scent from the Paco Rabanne Olympea collection smell like? The first notes are fresh. You immediately smell clementine and lemon blossom. Both are fresh notes. Jasmine, ambergris and cashmere wood add interest to this fragrance. Salt and vanilla are two interesting nuances found in this scent. We are pleased to offer this eau de toilette in an 80ml format. It is a lovely scent for any time of the year. Treat yourself to this lovely light scent or buy it for someone who appreciates nice perfumes.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=COIO765]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Bright and fresh in its initial impression, Sì Passione opens with notes of spicy pink pepper and radiant pear. The most exquisite rose notes in perfumery and feminine jasmine combine to create a powerful scent, like a seemingly fragile woman who shows incredible strength when guided by passion. The addition of heliotrope makes this perfume addictive and acts as an invitation to self-indulgence and pleasure. The warm and sensual vanilla and cedarwood dry down mirrors the self-assurance that a swipe of red lipstick can instantly give the wearer.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: A powerful reinvention of the signature Armani fragrance, Sì Passione adds a new dimension to Giorgio Armani’s feminine fragrance personality - in his own words, “an irresistible combination of grace, strength and independent spirit".

listings.rawTitle: Burberry My Burberry Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The scent is a contemporary British grand floral. Top notes of sweet pea and bergamot fuse with a geranium leaf, golden quince and freesia heart, rounded out with a base of patchouli and rain-tipped Damask and centifolia roses.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Goldea The Roman Night Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The seductive scent subtly blends the spontaneous spice of black pepper with a bed of hypnotic night-blooming florals at the heart and mesmerizing black musk and alluring vetiver at the base. A bewitching and truly magical scent for the dynamic modern woman...

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Femme is an alluring fragrance from the Italian fashion house with all the sophistication you've come to expect from the brand. Together with a sleek bottle design, this eau de parfum spray evokes the same style and elegance as a classic Giorgio Armani dress. Armani Code pour Femme is a perfume full of charm and femininity, and will definitely leave a lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Omnia Pink Sapphire Eau de Toilette 65ml Spray
listings.description: Omnia Pink Sapphire is a festive floral eau de toilette capturing the essence of the frangipani, sparkling pink pomelo, and vanilla musk. The vibrant scent is a daring reminder to run, jump, and dance into every day with sweetness and spontaneity. Alberto Morillas, master perfumer and creator of Omnia Crystalline, composed Pink Sapphire as a whimsical combination of bright citrus and exotic florals.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Omnia Eau de Parfum 65ml Spray
listings.description: Omnia by Bvlgari is a Oriental fragrance for women. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are ginger, mandarin orange, saffron, pepper and cardamom; middle notes are nutmeg, cloves, cinnamon, almond, masala chai and lotus; base notes are sandalwood, tonka bean, white chocolate, guaiac wood and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Reveal Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: It contains notes of crystallized ginger, mastic, pear brand, kiwano (African horned melon), suede, clary sage, agave nectar, tonka bean, vetiver, organic Haitian Orpur and golden amber. Reveal Men was launched in 2015.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Reveal Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: It contains notes of crystallized ginger, mastic, pear brand, kiwano (African horned melon), suede, clary sage, agave nectar, tonka bean, vetiver, organic Haitian Orpur and golden amber. Reveal Men was launched in 2015.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Chic Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Chic for Men by Carolina Herrera is a spicy woody fragrance for men. This is a refined fragrance where traditional masculine notes have been elevated with spices and melon giving the scent plenty of freshness. The result is a dynamic yet elegantly layered scent.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier Declaration Essence Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Cartier Declaration Essence Eau de Toilette 50 ml A fresh spicy woody perfume, with the power and majesty of cedar wood, refreshed with cardamom and warmed by notes of cistus labdanum. A fragrance of truth, to say the things that count. A fragrance for a man who knows what he wants, and knows what he feels. An unforgettable fragrance of emotions.

listings.rawTitle: Cerruti 1881 Pour Femme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Designed by Nino Cerruti in 1995 this feminine scent is a blend of blooming fresh cut flowers and linen with woody undertones.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Woman Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Experience the fresh sensation of Davidoff Cool Water Woman. Like a modern mermaid emerging from the sea in a wave of freshness, Cool Water Woman captures the essence of sensual, natural beauty. The transparent floral fragrance, sets a mood of sparkling, confident femininity. Fresh, juicy top notes of watermelon and pineapple introduce the delicate energy of a floral accord led by lily of the valley. The Eau de Toilette dries down to a seductive finish of blackcurrant and sensual woods.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Horizon Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Horizon by Zino Davidoff for Men 4.2oz Eau De Toilette Spray Davidoff Horizon for men is a woody, aromatic cologne for men that embodies the link between earth and air. It opens with traces of citrus and spice from grapefruit, mandarin, warm rosemary and ginger. Darker, earthier middle notes blend scents of cedar, nutmeg, patchouli, sesame and pepper.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Fuel for Life Him Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Diesel Fuel for Life Homme is a mythical elixir that evokes images of something that's a source of energy and fuels a passion for life. These emotions, combined with sexiness and seduction, are exactly what Diesel have recreated and bottled - It's Fuel For Life. A magic potion of mysterious star anise, vintage raspberry and authentic heliotropine for him.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Dolce Vita Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y36KBHW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Perfume have created another fragrance that truly lives up the the name. Dior Dolce Vita is just that - the sweet life. Whether you are planning on going out for the evening or just popping into the office, you can rely on this special scent. It is a Christian Dior Perfume that never fails to deliver. If you are new to this brand’s perfumes, you are probably wondering what you can expect from a fragrance called the Sweet Life or the Good Life. It’s rich in oriental notes with spicy wood influences. It is feminine but has a depth to it you will like. A long-lasting scent that is not going to let you down. The eau de toilette is offered to you in this in a lovely 100ml bottle. The scent makes a wonderful gift or why not keep it for yourself? This is a scent that has so much to offer as a modern perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Fahrenheit Cologne 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C7XX1MT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Aftershave is a must-have for any man. If you are familiar with this high-end perfume brand, you know that it is never going to let you down. Not only are the men’s fragrances produced by the brand exquisite, but they also last for a long time. Fahrenheit cologne is not any different from other fragrances offered by the brand. It is rich, intense and lasts longer when compared to generic colognes offered by high street shops. This fragrance has a freshness to it thanks to the addition of citrus notes. If you don’t already have Fahrenheit Aftershave in your fragrance collection, now is the perfect time to pick up a bottle or two. We are delighted to offer you the opportunity to add Dior to Fahrenheit your bathroom shelf. Why not buy it as a gift or buy it for yourself as a personal treat?

listings.rawTitle: Dior Forever & Ever Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IIJ2IY3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Perfume is one of those colognes you simply have to have. When it comes to modern fragrances, the brand offers some of the most exciting and vibrant scents in the world. As a brand, it always moves with the times launching new and exciting scents. If you looking for a new scent to add to your collection, this is one of the perfumers you should check out. Forever and ever is one of the brand’s more popular fragrances for women. What does Forever and Ever Dior smell like? The best way to describe the scent is as a floral bouquet. It delivers freesia, rose and jasmine. Pelargonium adds depth to the fragrance. The final notes are of vanilla, nutmeg and musk. The scent is both fresh and seductive at the same time. We have this excellent Christion Dior perfume available in a 100ml format. This is a scent that is perfectly at home both in the office and out in the evening. Buy it as a personal treat or gift as a present to someone special in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Homme Sport Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WO5G7O6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dior Aftershave is a must-have for all men. Over the last few years, Dior has added to its range of men’s fragrances. One of its most exciting offerings is Sport. This is a scent with a difference. Yes, you will instantly recognise its notes, but there is something else lingering in this classic blend as well. What does Dior Homme Sport smell like? It has all of the refined notes you expect from a Dior fragrance. This eau de toilette offers spice and deep aromatic nuances. A touch of citrus has been added to lift the fragrance and gift a new direction. Perfect for wearing during the day or splashing on after your gym session. It is a truly great addition to the Dior Homme range. We are offering this fragrance as an eau de toilette. You will appreciate it for its freshness and lightness. Wear this sophisticated and fresh scent any time of the day or night.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Golden Delicious Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WFK68LE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} DKNY Golden Delicious radiates with a tempting sensuality. A lavish seduction that is dripping in gold. A sensual and warm evocation of a New York state of mind, the DKNY Golden Delicious scent reveals its elegance in its rich and discerning accords. The luxe fragrance scintillates the senses in a cascade of glistening flora and a tempting Golden Delicious Apple note. A golden transformation of an iconic fragrance family. A majestic and radiant scent that intoxicates and inspires. Top Notes: Orange Flower Water, Mirabelle, Golden Delicious Apple. Heart Notes: White Rose, Casablanca Lily, Vanilla Orchid. Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Teakwood.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana L'imperatrice Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana presented five perfumes of their Anthology Collection in 2009. The collection originally started with 5 fragrances (No 1, No 3, No 6, No 10 and No 18). The D&G Anthology collection was inspired by tarot cards and their marks.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill London X Centric Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: X-Centric, created by Alfred Dunhill was 2001, has top notes of cypress, clary sage, grapefruit, cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, and green leaves. It has middle notes of freesia, rose, and lotus. X-Centric cologne has base notes of cedar wood, guaiacwood, patchouli, amber, and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum in White Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Dazzling and modern, an exhilarating fragrance of fruity and chypre accords. Le Parfum In White plays into an opening of orange blossom alongside a succulent handful of red fruits. The heart comprises a rich bed of jasmine before a base that utilises patchouli, white musk and white amber in glorious trilogy.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Sensuous Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A romantic embrace of woods and amber, Sensuous by Estée Lauder mimics the soft, warm embrace of a woman; a trail of passion, confidence and elegance. Jasmine, magnolia, ylang ylang and lily creates a four-part floral accord for delicate freshness and intrinsically female fragrance. Warming tones offer up rich amber and woods, the fragrance finished with black pepper, sandalwood, honey and mandarin.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: This unique aromatic floral fragrance is sensually radiant, luminous and very feminine with immense sensitivity and elegance. Bursting with roses and infused with star anise, and verbena leaf, notes include centifolia rose, peony rose, fantasia rose, passion rose, emotion rose, verbena leaf and star anise.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray is a luxurious scent for men launched as the follow up to the popular Gucci Guilty womens fragrance. Designed for men who know what they want and how to get it, it is seductive and attractive, a cool blend of Amalfi Lemon and Lavender top notes, middle notes of African Orange Flower and base notes of Virginia Cedar and Patchouli. A strong and alluring fragrance for men, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme is ideal for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Guy Laroche Drakkar Essence Eau de Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Feel the power with Drakkar Essence, an aromatic woody fragrance for the charming and daring man. This fragrance is an irresistible blend of spearmint, lavender, and sage that collides with the warm and vibrant base of dry woods, musk, and tonka bean resulting in statement-making sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DX39IA9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} At its core, Terre d’Hermès blends earthy cedarwood, patchouli, and vetiver with the softness of geranium leaves, pink peppercorn, and the comforting warmth of benzoin balm. This complex base creates a deep, textured aroma that lingers with elegant masculinity, perfect for the modern man who embraces nature and sophistication. Terre d’Hermès is a timeless fragrance introduced in 2006, designed for the man who finds poetry in everyday life. This scent celebrates the extraordinary within the ordinary, capturing the essence of nature’s raw beauty. It’s a bold, woody composition that embodies strength and subtlety in perfect harmony. The fragrance opens with vibrant citrus notes of grapefruit and sparkling orange, bringing a fresh and energetic burst. These lively top notes are enriched by spicy pepper and the smoky mineral scent of gunflint and silex, adding a unique, rugged character that sets it apart.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Twilly d'Hermes Eau de Parfum 85ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=V8C6MRH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ginger, tuberose and sandalwood are given a new twist. Combined differently, they become searing spice, disconcerting attraction, a revelation of the carnal. In a final flash of wit, a hand-tied silk ribbon playfully graces the bottle. What’s more, each silk ribbon is unique. Twilly d'Hermès by Hermès is a floral fragrance for women. It contains notes of tuberose, ginger and sandalwood. Twilly d'Hermès was launched in 2017.

listings.rawTitle: Anna Sui Flight of Fancy Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: This scent brings the explosion of luminous Java lemon, litchi, and yuzu notes, followed with soft notes of Star Magnolia, rose blossom, and waves of Purple Rain Freesia. The bottom notes end the composition with amber crystals, light wood, and skin musk, bringing peace and tranquillity.

listings.rawTitle: Anna Sui Secret Wish Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Secret Wish expresses Anna Suir's own magical optimism -- wishing will make it so. All things are possible; one has only to ask. Only to reveal a hidden, innermost wish. And, from somewhere beneath a blue bell, a new fragrance spirit emerges.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Havana Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1994 by Aramis, Havana Aftershave is a sexy, masculine fragrance with a rich scent of rum and tobacco. This is a truely seductive and intoxicating cologne, suitable for romantic use.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Adventurer Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: Offering a daring foray into woody aromatic fragrances, Adventurer by Aramis provides a lively scent that perfectly compliments the courageous and hardy man who tackles the world head-on, daring to experience a challenging and exciting world. A sharp, zesty accord of lemon, bergamot and black pepper tops the fragrance with a kick. A core of bitter wormwood, lavender and geranium gives the heart a deep aromatic vibe and, finally, a base of patchouli, cedar and seawood provides a grounding, savoury finish.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Voyager Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: An aromatic spicy fragrance for men, opening with top notes of ginger, juniper berries, and black pepper; heart notes of nutmeg, sage, and lavender; and a base of tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Aramis Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Aramis in 1965 this self-titled fragrance, Aramis is a refined masculine scent that possesses a blend of rich spices, sandalwood, leather, moss and clove. It is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Aramis Eau de Toilette 240ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Aramis in 1965 this self-titled fragrance, Aramis is a refined masculine scent that possesses a blend of rich spices, sandalwood, leather, moss and clove. It is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Blossom Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Euphoria Blossom by Calvin Klein is a sparkling, citrus, casual fragrance for the modern woman. It has top notes of kumquat, dewy green accord pomegrante, a heart of orchid blossom, lotus blossum pink peony petals woods, amber musk at the base.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity is an exciting revolution in the modern world of perfume. Like a soft melody, Eternity for women plays with the fragrance notes and creates a memorable perfume composition. The fragrance tones are quite feminine in style, with the floral scent prominent in the chic bottle of Eternity Calvin Klein. The sophisticated yet timelessly elegant and simple scent is what we love about the Calvin Klein brand. Eternity for women steps even higher by delivering a mixture of a bouquet of beautiful flowers and the spicy nuances of golden amber and sandalwood. Opening the bottle is like the exhilaration and anticipation that a woman feels when she finds her true love. The intertwining notes of lilies, white roses, violets, and the gentle essences of spicy notes dance like two soulmates that were destined to be together. Let the music of Calvin Klein Eternity take over and sweep you off your feet with the deep emotions of passion and love hidden in this prestige perfume scent.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Shock For Him Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WUEM3VB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} CK One Shock was created by noted perfumers Ann Gottlieb, Loc Dong and IFF.  This eau de toilette presents as a masculine and alluring aromatic that includes ingredients clementine and purple lavender on top,  a middle of cardamon and osmanthus, and a bottom of patchouli, musk, chocolate, and tobacco.   When first applied a fresh slightly citrusy aroma may be noted, perhaps with a hint of rose as well, soon to be enriched with tobacco, musk, and chocolate undertones. The complete effect is a woodsy appealing scent that is hard to resist.   Calvin Klein, the leading global lifestyle company, has long been a leader in the perfume/cologne market, having achieved great success with its CK One Unisex release in 1994. 2011's follow-up, One Shock for Him 200ml, reaffirmed One Shock's position with men, featuring a new carefully blended fragrance representative of CK's modern and authentic style.   One Shock for Him, created for you.

The sunniness mellows into a smooth, comforting base of woods, Vanilla and Musk, making for a creamy, lingering trail. Top: Pear, Red Fruits, Neroli. Heart: Rose, Jasmine. Enlivened by the invigorating Bergamot edge, the opening is filled with contrasting layers. Diving into the gourmand heart, the fragrance seamlessly blends the woody hues of Cedar and Patchouli with the sweet scent of Candied Plum. The fragrance finds its final form in the musky base, mixed with the hue of Vanilla to create a bittersweet ending. Velvety, seductive, sweet – cloak the body with a fragrance that is as complicated as you are. Top Notes: Cypress, Incense, Elemi, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Candied plum, Cinamon leaves, Cedar, Patchouli. Base Notes: Labdanum, Sandalwood, Musk, Vanilla.

Encased in a dark grey smoky bottle inspired by an antique hip flask, the bottle is as innately masculine as the juice within. It's strong and clean lines are enhanced with a raised trompe-l'oeil design of embossed crocodile skin in a blend of contrasting colours, evocative of a striking metal sculpture. Jimmy Choo Man is a woody aromatic fougère that opens with the warm floral notes of Lavender, blended expertly with citrus Mandarin and softened with the fruity notes of Honeydew Melon. In the heart, crisp accords of Geranium accompany the subtle nuances of Pineapple Leaf, creating a bright, vibrant scent shot through with spicy Pink Pepper. In the base notes the fragrance unveils a lasting, lingering print of Patchouli Heart, Suede and Ambery Woods to leave a signature scent that's sophisticated, refined and inherently masculine. The scent embodies a luminous femininity that dares to flirt with darker undertones, inviting you to embrace your individuality and let your unique essence shine.

It reflects the rich olfactory heritage of Yves Saint Laurent, embodying the idea that a man can be both magnetic by day and electric by night. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Toilette 30ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NJABA6N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} LIBRE, meaning "free" in French, embodies YSL's core value of freedom—the freedom to be yourself and make your own choices without compromise. Since 1961, the YSL woman has been portrayed as fierce, bold, and authentic, exuding power akin to ocean waves crashing against the shore. With a fiery spirit and unwavering strength, she soars high like an eagle. This essence of liberation is beautifully captured by British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa, who states, “To be free for a woman in 2019 goes without asking. We live life by our own rules.” The signature LIBRE bottle mirrors the potent character of the fragrance within. Inspired by Yves Saint Laurent's revolutionary tuxedo for women, the Eau de Toilette features an elongated design that combines striking height with an oversized gold-tone YSL logo. The bright, sophisticated rose gold color enhances the bottle's allure, reflecting the fragrance's fresh and sensual qualities. For those who embrace a carefree spirit and seek to live life with undressed femininity, YSL Beauty presents the new LIBRE Eau de Toilette. This light floral fragrance encapsulates a sense of youth, sensuality, and freshness, making it the perfect choice for the modern woman ready to express her liberated self.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HLDMKPB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} YSL’s Eau de Toilette takes the iconic Libre fragrance and reimagines it lighter and fresher than before. Staying true to the original, Lavender and Orange Blossom carry the scent while White Tea brings a softer accent to this light floral encapsulation of femininity and youth. Carrying the ‘Libre’ namesake, it characterises an untamed freedom of choice and expression. Presenting a shifting duality that lingers somewhere between coolness and warmth, the perfume celebrates YSL’s signature olfactory tension. It marries the Orange Blossom’s smouldering heat with the crispness of White Tea, an androgynous accord that adds a contemporary edge with a brighter, clearer presence. Expertly crafted by perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm, the fragrance is a masterful triumph from the surface to the trail. Housed in a bottle that reflects the power within, it pays homage to YSL’s role in designing the first tuxedo for women. Influenced by the original bottle, the Eau de Toilette’s vessel is similarly detailed with logo hardware in a new rose-gold tone finish to reflect a fresher, more sensual interpretation.

This exceptional Black Opium Eau de Parfum presents an enchanting floral gourmand composition, revolutionized with abundant black coffee notes for an exhilarating sensation. The distinctive black coffee element harmonizes with luxurious vanilla, further enhanced by gentle white floral notes and orange blossom, contrasted against rich patchouli and soothing white musk undertones.
